Description:
About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation

Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence

Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also
includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks,
dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer
experience.
Responsibilities
Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to
deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer hasFollowing the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Eye check-up & Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive
dispensing lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer Product
recommendation Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions Achieving sales
Vs. Plan & SOP
adherence Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due
communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the
reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment Store upkeep & regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
maintenance Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the storePersonal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma in Optometry Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Job Description - Agency Frontline Sales Role
Band- 1
CTC- Up to 3.5 lakh rupees
JOB SUMMARY: To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to onboarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re-activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through company's sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors' offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation Definition- Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)
Skillset required- Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation Definition- Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets
Skillset required- Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services
Skillset required- Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values
Skillset required- Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior
Competency - People and Team Leadership
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required- Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition- Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.

Description:
Job Summary
Role Overview The Field Officer is the frontline member of the KiDS project team, responsible for direct engagement with schools, teachers, students, parents, and communities in the assigned districts. The role reports to the District Coordinator or Programme Manager and requires consistent field presence and strong community engagement skills.
Location
Saharanpur, Chitrakoot, Jhansi, Lucknow, Kanpur
Organization
YR Gaitonde Medical Educational Research Foundation (YRGMERF)
Project
KiDS (Kids and Diabetes in Schools) - supported by Sanofi
Experience
Minimum 3 years of experience in development, health, education, or nutrition programmes at the district level.
Qualifications
Post-graduation in Home Science, Nutrition, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.
Working knowledge of the education department system in UP is required.
Key Responsibilities
Field Implementation Facilitate teacher training sessions using the KiDS manual in assigned schools.
Support trained teachers in conducting diabetes awareness sessions with students.
Organise and facilitate parent-teacher meetings in project schools.
Map the communities linked to each project school and conduct community awareness meetings.
Identify and support diabetes ambassadors within communities who can sustain awareness efforts beyond the project period.
Documentation and Reporting Document all field activities systematically and compile data for submission to the District Coordinator / Programme Manager.
Provide field data and inputs for programme reports in coordination with the ME Officer.
Maintain complete records of referrals to health facilities, forms, and related documentation.
Travel The role requires approximately 20 days of field travel per month. Travel and logistics support will be provided under the project.
Skills
Proficiency in MS Excel for data entry and reporting.
Strong written and oral communication skills in Hindi and English.
Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently in field settings with minimal supervision.

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Management and Support (Specialized in Laboratory, Physiology, and Rehabilitation Equipment)
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 6 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Medical Electronic or Electronic or Biomedical Engineering.
-Certifications or training in laboratory or rehabilitation equipment preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum 15 years of professional experience in managing laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation-related equipment, with at least 5 completed projects.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 3 projects.
-Hands-on experience in the installation, calibration, and basic maintenance of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
Role Responsibilities:
Equipment Installation Calibration:
-Lead the installation, setup, and calibration of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment at MSSSCRC.
-Ensure that equipment is installed according to specifications and regulatory standards, meeting safety and performance requirements.
-Conduct initial testing to verify the functionality of newly installed equipment, making adjustments as necessary to optimize performance.
Compliance and Quality Assurance:
-Perform routine checks and inspections to ensure that equipment continues to meet operational standards and regulatory requirements.
-Monitor equipment performance, ensuring it adheres to safety and operational regulations in line with national and international standards.
-Assist in compliance audits and support the creation of reports to document adherence to health regulations.
Troubleshooting Technical Support:
-Provide technical troubleshooting support for any malfunctioning laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation equipment.
-Offer quick resolutions for minor issues and escalate complex technical problems to senior specialists or vendors for further investigation and resolution.
-Diagnose equipment faults and recommend corrective actions to maintain optimal functionality.
Training MSSSCRC Staff on Equipment Use Maintenance:
-Develop and deliver training programs for MSSSCRC staff (clinical, technical, and administrative) on the correct use, handling, and safety protocols for laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Conduct hands-on training sessions to ensure staff are proficient in operating the equipment, including detailed instructions on how to maintain and troubleshoot the equipment.
-Create training materials and user manuals tailored to the equipment, ensuring that staff have clear, accessible guides for reference.
-Assess staff competency in operating the equipment and provide additional guidance or refresher courses as necessary to ensure staff confidence and safety in equipment handling.
-Provide specialized training in equipment calibration, regular maintenance tasks, and how to perform troubleshooting for common issues.
Record Maintenance Reporting:
-Maintain accurate and detailed records of equipment installation, servicing, and performance, ensuring that all equipment data is properly documented and accessible.
-Track service histories, calibration schedules, and any repairs or modifications made to the equipment.
-Assist in preparing periodic reports on equipment status, including any issues identified, actions taken, and overall performance evaluation.
-Coordination with Senior Specialists Vendors:
-Collaborate with senior specialists and vendors to manage upgrades, repairs, and replacements of equipment.
-Coordinate with vendors to procure spare parts and ensure that all equipment remains functional throughout the project duration.
-Ensure timely maintenance schedules are followed to minimize equipment downtime and avoid disruptions in medical services.
Project Support Management:
-Assist in the management of project timelines, ensuring that equipment-related tasks such as installation, calibration, and maintenance are completed on schedule.
-Support project teams in planning and procuring equipment, ensuring that equipment specifications meet the project s healthcare requirements.
-Provide guidance and technical input in the planning phase for procurement of new laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
Safety Operational Efficiency:
-Conduct regular safety checks to ensure that all equipment complies with health and safety regulations and operates efficiently.
-Evaluate the operational efficiency of equipment and recommend improvements or upgrades when necessary.
-Ensure that all equipment is safely decommissioned or disposed of at the end of its useful life.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

-Minimum of 15 years of experience in cost analysis of medical equipment or related fields.
-At least 7 years of experience in the medical or healthcare sector.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 2 projects.
-Experience working on Japanese ODA Loan Projects in any sector.
-At least 1 year of experience in SAARC or ASEAN regions (preferable).
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
-Strong knowledge of procurement processes and cost optimization techniques.

Role Responsibilities:
Cost Estimation Budgeting:
-Lead the estimation of preliminary project equipment costs during the basic design phase, ensuring accurate forecasting of all associated costs.
-Develop cost models and prepare detailed cost estimates for medical equipment procurement and installation.
-Identify and quantify the costs related to equipment, components, consumables, transportation, and installation work, ensuring that the budget is comprehensive and aligned with project objectives.
Survey Data Collection:
-Conduct surveys of existing or similar healthcare facilities to gather information on operational and maintenance costs of medical equipment.
-Assess the existing equipment in operational facilities to understand their functionality, lifespan, and associated costs to make informed decisions.
-Collect data on the cost of spare parts, consumables, and other supplies necessary for the proper functioning of medical equipment.
Evaluation of Local Distributors Service Providers:
-Survey local distributors for warranty services, maintenance contract availability, and pricing.
-Evaluate the reliability and service offerings of local vendors, ensuring they meet the operational needs of the project and provide cost-effective maintenance solutions.
Cost Breakdown Analysis:
-Collect and analyze detailed data on equipment-related costs, including main components, consumables, transportation costs, turnkey work, maintenance contracts, and other related services.
-Ensure a thorough understanding of all cost components and provide a comprehensive cost breakdown for each equipment item.
-Collaborate with procurement teams to optimize cost-efficiency and select the best value options for the project.
Tender Evaluation Compliance:
-Assist the Project Management Unit (PMU) in evaluating financial documents related to equipment tenders, ensuring that the costs are in line with the project s financial goals.
-Review tender submissions for compliance with project specifications, budget constraints, and cost-effectiveness.
-Provide recommendations on cost optimization and value for money, ensuring that all financial aspects of the tender align with project needs.
Cost Reporting Documentation:
-Prepare and maintain detailed reports on cost estimations, budgets, and financial evaluations related to medical equipment.
-Ensure that all cost reports are accurately documented and available for review by the project team and stakeholders.
-Track and report any changes in cost projections, identifying areas where cost savings or adjustments can be made.
Collaboration with Project Stakeholders:
-Work closely with the project team, including procurement specialists and clinical engineers, to align equipment cost management with overall project goals.
-Provide regular updates on cost estimations, procurement strategies, and cost optimization efforts to senior management and stakeholders.

Description:
Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Description:
Job Title: SAP BTP & Cloud Administrator
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore / Indore
Total Experience: 1012 years
Notice Period: Immediate joiner
Job Summary
We are looking for a senior SAP BTP Administrator to own the administration of SAP Business Technology Platform across our customer landscapes. The primary focus is BTP: global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, identity and access, connectivity and cloud-native runtimes. The role also carries SAP Basis and database administration responsibilities for the on-premise and hybrid systems that BTP connects to. The ideal candidate combines deep BTP operations experience with a solid Basis background and can work across cloud and on-premise SAP.
Responsibilities
SAP BTP Administration (primary focus)
Set up and govern the BTP global account structure: directories, subaccounts, and naming and tagging standards across development, test and production.
Manage entitlements, quotas and cost tracking, and raise capacity requests in line with project demand.
Administer Cloud Foundry orgs and spaces and Kyma environments, including deployments, service instances and runtime health.
Manage identity and access: trust configuration with SAP Cloud Identity Services and corporate identity providers, role collections, role templates and least-privilege access reviews.
Configure and maintain connectivity: Destinations, Cloud Connector setup and high availability, and private connectivity to on-premise systems.
Administer SAP HANA Cloud instances, SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Build and Work Zone as required by the customer landscape.
Manage BTP transports and content movement through Cloud Transport Management.
Monitor services, audit logs and alerts; set up and maintain BTP audit log retention.
Maintain the BTP CLI and automation scripts for repeatable provisioning and housekeeping.
SAP Basis Administration (secondary)
Perform day-to-day Basis administration across development, test and production systems.
Handle system monitoring, performance tuning and optimization for ABAP and HANA systems.
Manage user administration, security, authorizations and transport management between systems.
Plan and execute OSS note implementation, BDLS, system copies, client copies and refreshes.
Support SAP HANA upgrades and perform post-upgrade checks.
Provide Basis expertise during project cutovers and ensure stability through critical transition periods.
Database Administration (secondary)
Administer database instances supporting SAP systems, including backup and recovery, space management and housekeeping.
Monitor database performance, identify and resolve bottlenecks, and tune configurations.
Plan and execute database patching, version upgrades and migrations with minimal downtime.
Maintain database security, access controls and disaster recovery procedures, and test them periodically.
Communication and Documentation
Maintain clear documentation of configurations, changes, runbooks and procedures.
Communicate with project teams, stakeholders and end users, and provide regular status and health reports.
Work with customers to define BTP governance, onboarding and operating models.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
10–12 years of experience in SAP technical administration, with at least 4 years in SAP BTP administration.
Hands-on experience with BTP global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, Cloud Foundry and role-based access control.
Experience with Cloud Connector, Destinations and connectivity to on-premise SAP systems (ECC, S/4HANA, BW, CRM, SCM).
Strong working knowledge of SAP NetWeaver and SAP HANA, including HANA Cloud.
Solid SAP Basis experience: monitoring, transports, user administration, OSS notes, BDLS, system copies and HANA upgrades.
Working knowledge of database administration for SAP-supported databases (backup, recovery, performance and patching).
Familiarity with cutover processes and Basis support during critical project phases.
Strong problem-solving skills and clear written and verbal communication.
Ability to work independently and lead a team.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP BTP certification (for example, SAP Certified Technology Associate, SAP BTP) or SAP Basis certification.
Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Services and SAP Integration Suite.
Experience with Kyma, Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tooling for BTP.
Scripting skills in Shell, Python or the BTP CLI.
Familiarity with ITIL service management frameworks.
Experience with hyperscaler landscapes (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud) under BTP.
Working at HGS
At HGS our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.

Description:
About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia. Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option. Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity. We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs.
Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities. Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL. Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos. We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit.
Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered.
Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately.
Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal. Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure.
Managing cash (system & physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures.
Create new CUID in system &modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments & LoanClosure.
Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff & Customer Visits etc.
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents.
Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments.
Providing good customer service at everystep i.e. while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments.
Additional Responsibilities: Insummary, the Gold appraiser is responsible for the end-to-end transactionprocess for gold loans - from valuation to disbursal to closure, along withcustomer service.
CTC Upto 3 Lacs ( for Non-Metro) / 4.20 Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Description:
Role Overview:
Lead all engineering, technical maintenance, HSE, and AMC operations at The Client's Powai facility, ensuring a safe, compliant, and high-performing facility environment. Oversee critical building systems, statutory compliance, vendor management, and operational excellence as per Master Service Agreement requirements.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage all technical operations, maintenance, and uptime for site systems including MEP, HVAC, fire/life safety, BMS, DG sets, lifts, and water systems
Regularly review asset health, preventive maintenance schedules, system performance, and identify improvement opportunities
Plan and execute all technical preparations for meetings, conferences, client visits, and special events
Perform daily check-ins and inspections around facility to ensure high technical and safety standards
Ensure 100% compliance with all statutory and regulatory requirements including labour, fire, EHS, DG, lifts, FSSAI, and environmental laws
Maintain audit-ready documentation, statutory registers, and ensure timely submissions of compliance reports
Develop and enforce SOPs for technical operations, safety procedures, and emergency response protocols
Lead Business Continuity Planning (BCP) preparedness, conduct drills, and coordinate emergency response procedures
Coordinate and manage AMC vendor partners: validate contract compliance, oversee maintenance delivery, and schedule preventive and corrective work
Review vendor service reports, close technical findings, and ensure quality standards are met
Manage contractors and service providers: qualification checks, safety plan reviews, EHS document control, and ongoing performance monitoring
Conduct regular technical, safety, and risk audits; investigate incidents and drive corrective action closure
Provide staff HSE and safety training; promote safety culture across facility operations
Submit all compliance, audit, incident, and performance reports accurately and on time
Maintain operational and technical records as per contract and regulatory requirements
Drive sustainability initiatives, energy efficiency, technology adoption, and continuous service improvements
Collaborate with Facility Manager, site leadership, vendors, and client stakeholders on priorities, procurement, and budget management
Identify and implement best practices to help facility systems perform at optimal levels
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil) or related technical discipline
5-7 years of progressive experience in facilities management, engineering operations, or HSE leadership roles
Strong knowledge of building systems including MEP, HVAC, fire/life safety, BMS, DG sets, and critical infrastructure
Understanding of statutory compliance requirements including fire safety, EHS regulations, and environmental laws
Experience with AMC/vendor management, contract compliance, and service delivery oversight
Proficiency in audit management, documentation, and regulatory reporting
Working knowledge of digital FM tools, CMMS, and technical reporting systems
Strong problem-solving skills with ability to diagnose technical issues and implement effective solutions
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
Team leadership skills with capability to coordinate cross-functional teams and vendors
Tertiary qualifications in building management, facility management, or business management preferred
Certifications in safety, fire safety, or facility management are advantageous

Description:
Job Description

HGS has been assisting global customers since 2003 bringing data to life as their Trusted Analytics and Planning partner. At HGS, we have over 20 years of experience implementing analytics and planning solutions. We serve customers across multiple industries including, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Manufacturing, Technology, Higher Education and Public institutions. Majority of our customers are renowned Fortune 500 organizations.
Title : SAP Consultant
Skills: SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA & S/4HANA CDS Views
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore/ Indore
Total Exp: 03-08 Years
Notice Period: Joining in 1 to 2 months, FTE only
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled SAP Technical Consultant with strong expertise in SAP BW (BW on HANA / BW4HANA), Native HANA development, and S/4HANA CDS Views to support enterprise-wide analytics, reporting, and data integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 3-8 years of progressive SAP experience with hands-on exposure to data modeling, performance optimization, and cross-functional collaboration in modern SAP data landscapes.
Core Responsibilities
Technical Development & Implementation
Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and end-users to analyze requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
Design, develop, and implement technical solutions across SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Support migration and upgrade activities from legacy systems while maintaining data consistency, quality, and integrity
Participate in technical workshops with business users to gather requirements and contribute to SAP solution design
SAP BW Development & Data Modeling
Design and develop SAP BW/BW4HANA data models using InfoObjects, Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views
Build and maintain transformations, DTPs, and process chains for efficient data loading and delta management
Develop and optimize BEx queries and analytical reports to support operational and management reporting needs
Implement extraction using standard and custom ODP-based data sources, including SAP ERP/S4HANA extractors
Apply LSA++ modeling principles to design layered, scalable, and maintainable BW data architectures
S/4HANA CDS Views Development
Design and develop ABAP CDS (Core Data Services) views and entities with associations, annotations, and calculations
Implement data models using ABAP CDS views for operational reporting, embedded analytics, and real-time insights
Create and enhance customer-specific CDS views and analytical queries to meet business requirements
Optimize existing CDS views for improved performance and data modeling efficiency
Develop solutions using SAP BTP/BAS and S/4HANA Private Cloud/On-premise environments
Integrate CDS views with Fiori applications and other analytics platforms
Native HANA Development & Performance Optimization
Design and develop Native HANA solutions (HANA 1.0 and HANA 2.0 XSA) using Calculation Views, Attribute Views, and Analytic Views
Create SQL script solutions, stored procedures, and mixed modeling scenarios for analytics use cases
Support BWoH and BW4HANA modeling activities, including Advanced DSOs, CompositeProviders, and ODP extractors
Perform optimization and troubleshooting of Calculation Views and SQL queries using standard performance tuning techniques
Assist with ABAP to HANA SQL conversions and AMDP script implementations
Support HANA security models, transport management, and lifecycle management activities
SAP Functional Knowledge
Good understanding of core S/4HANA/ECC modules including SD, MM, FI/CO, HR, WM, PP, and supply chain processes
Basic knowledge of master data management and data governance practices
Education and Experience:
Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field, with a University degree (Master/Diploma/PhD) in IT, and strong independent, team-oriented, and accountable work ethic.
3-8 years of SAP development experience, focusing on SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS Views
Hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP BW/BW4HANA implementation
Working knowledge of ABAP CDS view development and Native HANA modeling
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team
This role is ideal for a motivated SAP professional who is passionate about leveraging SAP BW, Native HANA, and S/4HANA CDS technologies to deliver reliable, enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions as part of a collaborative technical team.
Application Process
Qualified candidates should submit:
Detailed resume highlighting project experience
Cover letter describing relevant technical achievements
Portfolio of completed data analytics projects (if available)
Professional references from previous SAP implementations
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Working at HGS
At HGS, our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.
Interested candidates please share your profile to ___________@teamhgs.com

Description:
Position: Azure Lead
Location: Hyderabad, Indore
Duration: Full time


Hinduja Global Solutions Ltd., (HGSL) is an Indian listed company and part of Hinduja Group serving fortune 500 companies for the last 40 years. It is a Digital Technology BPM company specialising into Consumer Engagement Services in the field of Technology, Telecom, banking, retail operations, Data Analytics and Digital Technology services. The Parent Co holds entities in the USA, Philippines, UK, Canada, South Africa, Colombia and Jamaica through subsidiaries and step-subsidiaries. With more than 18,000 employees spread across 9 countries, our mission is to make our clients more competitive by providing exceptional experience. Powered by peoples first philosophy and experience serving over 1100 of the world’s leading brands, HGS is the perfect place to build your future!
Position Summary:
We are looking for dynamic and result oriented cloud data engineers to join our fast-growing Cloud Analytics practice.
Candidate should be self-starters with a passion for business analytics and Data and use their excellent problem solving and analytical skills along with superb written and oral communication skills to develop solutions that delight our customers.
Keep reading if you have a strong desire to excel and are keen to work on end-to-end cloud analytics projects while further developing your career.
Key Responsibilities:
Understand existing landscape and business objectives of the customers.
Translate their explicit and implicit requirements into optimal, scalable, high performance Azure Analytics solution.
Modify existing solutions to enhance, optimize, or to incorporate new functionality.
Ensure high quality of deliverables from self and team.
Provide candid, meaningful feedback and regular progress updates to the team and customer.
Explore how the world of data has evolved and how the advent of cloud technologies is providing new opportunities for businesses to explore.
Learn the various data platform technologies that are available, and how to take advantage of the available technologies for organizational benefit.
Contribute to presales activities including proposals, POC and Demos.
Education:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; an MBA or master’s degree is preferred.
Experience & Requirements:
9-14 years of professional work experience with at least 6 years as cloud data engineer preferably in Microsoft Azure.
Well versed with relational databases, nonrelational databases, data streams, and file stores
Should be able to perform data-related tasks in Microsoft Azure cloud analytics platform.
Well versed with Azure Data Factory & Azure Databricks.
Must possess excellent programming skills with SQL, and Python.
Having experience working on spark platform
Should be able to use services and tools to ingest, egress, and transform data from multiple sources, including SAP, within Microsoft Azure.
Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and meet data requirements.
Ability to Design and implement Azure analytics solutions.
Manage, monitor, and ensure the security and privacy of data to satisfy business needs.
Having Azure data engineer associate certification is preferred.
Good to have experience in reporting tools like PowerBI.
Excellent communication skills
Demonstrated knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable).
Why choose us?
As an equal opportunity employer, HGS is dedicated to diversity, inclusivity and Equity. HGS does not discriminate on the basis of the race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran disability, or genetic information or any other reason prohibited by law in employment. We believe in the power of diversity to create an environment where every individual excels, and our diverse customer and colleague base is deeply understood.
Plus, working with HGS comes with benefits like:
Competitive renumeration
Excellent Benefits including – Shift allowance, Health, Accidental and Life coverage.
Excellent performance based annual increments.
Fast paced growth opportunities
International work experience
Opportunity to participate in various sports and CSR activities.

Description:
Project Role : Tech Delivery Subject Matter Expert

Project Role Description : Drive innovative practices into delivery, bring depth of expertise to a delivery engagement. Sought out as experts, enhance Accentures marketplace reputation. Bring emerging ideas to life by shaping Accenture and client strategy. Use deep technical expertise, business acumen and fluid communication skills, work directly with a client in a trusted advisor relationship to gather requirements to analyze, design and/or implement technology best practice business changes.

Must have skills :SAP HANA DB Administration

Good to have skills:NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification:15 years full time education

Summary:
As a Tech Delivery Subject Matter Expert, a typical day involves leading the integration of innovative approaches within project delivery, leveraging extensive expertise to influence both client and organizational strategies. This role requires active engagement with clients to understand their needs and translate them into effective technology solutions. The professional collaborates closely with various stakeholders to ensure that emerging ideas are effectively incorporated into business practices, thereby enhancing the overall value delivered. The position demands a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on involvement to drive impactful outcomes and strengthen the organization's reputation in the marketplace.

Roles & Responsibilities:

- Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
- Responsible for team decisions.
- Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
- Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
- Lead the development and implementation of best practices to improve delivery efficiency and quality.
- Mentor and support junior team members to foster professional growth and skill development.
- Coordinate cross-functional efforts to align project goals with client expectations and organizational objectives.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Must To Have Skills:
Proficiency in SAP HANA DB Administration.
- Strong knowledge of database architecture, performance tuning, and troubleshooting within SAP HANA environments.
- Experience in managing database security, backup, and recovery processes to ensure data integrity and availability.
- Ability to optimize system performance through monitoring and fine-tuning of SAP HANA databases.
- Familiarity with cloud-based SAP HANA deployments and hybrid infrastructure management.
- Skilled in collaborating with development and operations teams to support seamless integration and deployment.

Additional Information:

- The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in SAP HANA DB Administration.
- This position is based at our INDC1A - NON-STPI location.
- A 15 years full time education is required.

15 years full time education

Description:
Key missions of the position:
We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Service Engineer to join our team, specializing in the Troubleshooting of field complaint and perform installation, commissioning and maintenance of Wabtec systems. The candidate will require to have a strong understanding of mechanical, electrical and Pneumatic circuit diagrams, electronic components, and their working principles. This role requires hands-on experience in trou
bleshooting, repairing of Electrical, mechanical and pneumatic systems.
Roles and responsibility are as below:
Production Support: Assist in the Installation, commissioning, Testing of Wabtec system/Product in the rolling stock
Field Complaint Resolution: Troubleshoot and resolve the field complaints related to Wabtec systems, providing timely resolution and closure of the complaints. Such requirement relates to troubleshooting the Mechanical, electrical, electronics, pneumatic or maintenance related issues and relacing the defective part to close the complaint within the contractual timelines.
Installation and Commissioning: Support the installation and commissioning of the Wabtec product and performing the required testing. Enabling customer to perform the task in a right manner if needed.
Retrofit, Maintenance and Repairs: Perform retrofit, regular maintenance and emergency repairs on Wabtec products inline with procedure and site requirement.
Reporting and Documentation: Report and record the field interventions performed by himself and associated team. The service engineer would require making a report of the issue and also get the Joint notes or associated document as needed by customer contract. Daily, weekly and Monthly reports to be submitted to manager.
NCR and Failed Part Management: Maintain accountability for Non-Conformance Reports (NCR), maintain consumed spares/Failed part and site spares data. Organizing the dispatch of the defective parts from site to plant in co-ordination with plant team.
Customer Interaction: Communicate effectively with clients to understand their issues and provide clear explanations of the work performed. Follow up the closure of Nonconformity reports and work orders issued.
Travel: Willingness to travel across India to various sites as needed for warranty, installation & Commissioning, retrofit and maintenance service for the customer order.
Safety, Quality, and Compliance: Ensure all work is performed in accordance with our organizations strict safety, quality, and compliance standards.
Education/Training
Degree or Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical & electronics.
Professional Experience:
How many years of professional experience in a specific professional area are required for the position?
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar role (Field service) preferably in the transportation railways or Lifts and escalator with good troubleshooting skills
Key Competences (Transversal/Professional)
Reading and interpreting circuit diagrams : Intermediate
Knowledge on software installation : Novice
Troubleshooting & repair:Advanced
problem-solving abilities: Advanced
Microsoft Office:Intermediate
Communication: English speaking and writing:Intermediate
Languages:
English and Hindi & Any other regional language (is an added advantage)
Other Specifications:
Position will be initially in Eastern region, subsequently transferrable anywhere in the country
Ability to learn quickly. Agility to adapt to new environment/ business strategies
Collaborate with multiple departments
Passionate to lead and take initiatives
Good attitude and interpersonal relationship

Description:
A Head of Solar Projects leads the end-to-end execution of large-scale (MW-level) solar projects, managing design, procurement, site construction, and commissioning. They are responsible for project profitability, regulatory compliance, team leadership, and stakeholder management to ensure timely, safe, and quality delivery. Typical requirements include 18-28+ years of experience in solar project management, with a strong background in EPC operations and technical proficiency in PV technology.

Key Responsibilities
Project Execution & Management: Oversee the entire lifecycle from planning to commissioning, ensuring projects are on time and within budget.
Strategic Leadership: Develop project plans, manage P&L, and provide strategic direction for multiple projects.
Technical Oversight: Review designs, technology selection, and system configurations (civil and electrical).
Regulatory & Safety Compliance: Ensure adherence to safety standards and local, state, and national regulations.
Stakeholder Management: Coordinate with clients, contractors, and government agencies.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience: 18-28 years of experience in solar project management.
Education: Bachelors or Master's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Civil, or Mechanical).
Skills: Strong knowledge of EPC, project planning tools, ROW (Right-of-Way) management, and HT termination.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Proven track record in managing MW-scale or GW-capacity solar projects.
Excellent leadership and team management skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Description:
Job Summary
Risk Management is core to Bajaj Finance. Most of the decisions in Risk Management are data driven and analytical. Statistical models are required to look at multi-variate dimensions from a risk perspective including calculating the expected credit loss, scenario analysis, forecasting, Stress Testing etc. Statistical models are built and scorecards are prepared which assesses parameters like PD (probability of default), EAD and LGD which are critical from a regulatory perspective and forms important aspect of regulatory reporting purpose. This role gives an opportunity of going beyond the above and gives deeper insights on the Regulatory norms on Credit Risk. The role allows candidate work on areas such as Stress Testing, Expected Credit Loss, Macro Economic stress, Macro stress models/forecasting etc. Culture Anchor: Have high ambitions - Inspires the team to aim for higher targets and supports in achieving them. Own It - Acknowledges uncertainty and makes changes in own decisions/ actions for better outcomes.

Description:
Job Summary:We are looking for a dynamic and result-driven Sales Executive to join our team in the paint industry. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, meeting sales targets, developing new customer relationships, and ensuring customer satisfaction in their designated territory.

Key Responsibilities:
Promote and sell a wide range of decorative and industrial paints to dealers, contractors, architects, and end-users.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, and key clients.
Conduct regular market visits to identify business opportunities and gather market intelligence.
Ensure timely order booking, payment collection, and inventory management at dealer/distributor points.
Achieve monthly and annual sales targets as assigned.
Organise product demonstrations, on-site sampling, and training sessions for clients.
Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, sales, and follow-up actions using CRM or sales reporting tools.
Provide after-sales support and ensure customer satisfaction.

Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
Knowledge of the local market and dealer/distributor network.
Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Self-motivated and target-oriented.
AboutCompany:
Company Brief: British Paints

About Us:
British Paints is a well-established and trusted brand in the Indian paint industry, with a legacy dating back to 1919. After being acquired by Berger Paints India Ltd. in 1947, British Paints was relaunched in 2009 and has since expanded rapidly across the country.
We offer a comprehensive range of decorative and industrial paints, including emulsions, enamels, distempers, primers, and specialty coatings. Our products are known for innovation, quality, and durability, catering to residential, commercial, and industrial segments.
Head Office: New Delhi, India
Parent Company: Berger Paints India Ltd.

Why Join British Paints?
Legacy of trust and quality
Strong backing of Berger Paints
Dynamic and fast-growing organization
Opportunities for learning and advancement
Focus on employee engagement and growth

Position: Logistics Site Operation Leader

Description:
Project Role :Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description :Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
Must have skills :BMC Helix ITSM
Good to have skills :NA
Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary:
As a Custom Software Engineer, a typical day involves leading the initiative to design, develop, and configure software applications tailored to specific requirements. This role requires acting as the main liaison for project stakeholders, coordinating efforts across various teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery. The position demands a proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous collaboration to meet project goals and timelines effectively.

Roles & Responsibilities:
- Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
- Responsible for team decisions.
- Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
- Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
- Oversee the implementation of best practices and ensure adherence to quality standards within the team.
- Mentor junior team members to foster professional growth and enhance team capabilities.
- Coordinate cross-functional communication to align project objectives and deliverables.
- Continuously evaluate and improve development processes to optimize efficiency and effectiveness.

Professional & Technical Skills:
-
Must To Have Skills:
Proficiency in BMC Helix ITSM.
- Experience in application design, configuration, and customization within enterprise environments.
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and provide effective solutions.
- Ability to collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders to drive project success.
- Familiarity with software development lifecycle and agile methodologies.
- Excellent communication skills to articulate technical concepts clearly and concisely.

Additional Information:
- The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in BMC Helix ITSM.
- This position is based at our Indore office.
- A 15 years full time education is required.

Qualification
15 years full time education

Job Summary
Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking a motivated and dynamic individual for the position of Associate Agency Development Manager. The successful candidate will play a key role in driving the growth of our agency business by recruiting, training, and managing a team of insurance advisors. You will work closely with your team to develop strategic plans and execute initiatives that maximize sales performance and enhance customer satisfaction.

Excellent analytical skills to assess performance metrics and market data.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for reporting and presentations.
Knowledge of the insurance industry and regulatory environment.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-centric approach to service.
This position offers an excellent opportunity for career growth within a leading insurance organization. If you are passionate about building teams and driving sales in the insurance industry, we encourage you to apply.

Description:
Job Purpose
Responsible for evaluating and underwriting loan applications received via digital channels. Focus on quick, accurate decisioning with policy adherence, KYC verification, fraud checks, and coordination with stakeholders to achieve seamless, paperless disbursements.
Key Responsibilities
Evaluate digital loan applications within defined turnaround time (TAT) using scorecards and policy rules.
Perform digital KYC, bureau checks, income surrogates, and fraud screening; escalate suspicious cases.
Prepare concise credit notes/CAMs for non-STP or exception cases; recommend decisions as per DOA.
Ensure accurate documentation and track postdisbursement document (PDD) closure where applicable.
Coordinate with sales/operations for clarifications, rework, and smooth disbursement.
Monitor early vintage performance/FPD for approved cases and provide feedback to improve filters.
Adhere to underwriting policy, regulatory requirements, and internal audit standards, clear QA observations PDs of specific cases.
Skills Required
Strong analytical and decision-making skills.
Knowledge of retail lending credit policies and scorecards.
Proficiency in digital KYC, fraud control, and MIS tools.
Attention to detail and compliance orientation.
Educational Qualifications and Experience
Graduate / Post-Graduate in Finance, Commerce, or related field.
1-3 years in credit appraisal/underwriting; experience in digital/fintech lending preferred.

Description:
Responsible for following established procedures in ordering, receiving, storing, distributing and payment of items.
Assists in formulating an approved vendors list encompassing all categories.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 4-year bachelors degree in Fice and Accounting or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Managing Work, Projects, Policies, and Standards for Purchasing Across Departments
- Assists with generating and providing accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc
- Compiles, codes, categorizes, calculates, tabulates, audits, or verifies information or data.
- Assures sanitation compliance.
- Assists Executive Chef in all aspects of purchasing (eg, Food, Beverage and Controllable) to ensure quality and profitability.
- Orders all food and beverage based on business needs.
- Assists Executive Chef in maintaining/lower budgeted food/controllable costs.
- Assists in enforcing first in/first out inventory rotation for all storeroom products.
- Maintains sanitation and safety standards as specified in the brand guidelines.
- Ensures that proper safeguards are in effect for the security of the food and beverage storeroom assets.
- Enforces item use-up with storeroom personnel and kitchen management to keep inventory at lowest level possible levels.
- Communicates with kitchen, restaurant management and vendors to ensure timing of deliveries satisfies advanced food production needs.
- Checks invoice on goods received against shipment to ensure quantity, quality, weights and purchase specifications are as ordered.
- Uses existing computer programs to perform daily and period end food and beverage costs.
- Maintains inventory controls for proper levels, dating, rotation, requisitions, etc
- Completes administrative tasks on a timely basis (eg, C-7s, menu costing, general office duties).
- Completes period end inventory according to Food and Beverage and Accounting standard operation procedures.
- Calculates figures for food and beverage inventory.
- Ensures that price and product availability issues are communicated as needed to the F & B Director and Executive Chef.
- Assists in receiving and inspecting all deliveries.
- Maintains an accurate controllable log and beverage perpetual.
- Ensures accurate administration of all invoices, and adherence to proper bookkeeping procedures.
Demonstrating and Applying Accounting Knowledge to Purchasing Operations
- Demonstrates knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.
- Uses computers and computer systems (including hardware and software) to program, write software, set up functions, enter data, or process information.
- Uses relevant information and individual judgment to determine whether events or processes comply with laws, regulations, or standards.
- Keeps up-to-date technically and applying new knowledge to your job.
- Demonstrates knowledge and proficiency of A.
S.
I.
standards.
Maintaining Fice and Accounting Goals
- Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.
- Ensures profits and losses are documented accurately.
- Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Monitors all taxes that apply, ensuring that taxes are current, collected and/or accrued.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Interacts with kitchen staff, vendors and Executive Chef.
- Uses existing computer programs effectively to post invoices, update items and costs.
- Attends and participates in all pertinent meetings.
- Provide direction and assistance to other organizational units regarding accounting and budgeting policies and procedures, and efficient control and utilization of ficial resources.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Description:
Job Description Advertisement Sales
Location: Indore
Company: MY FM – Dainik Bhaskar Group
Department: Ad Sales & Marketing
Job Summary
We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented sales professional with experience in B2B and Corporate Sales to drive advertisement revenue by acquiring new clients and developing strong business relationships in Mumbai.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and acquire new corporate clients and business opportunities for advertising sales.
Develop and maintain relationships with corporate clients, brands, advertising agencies, and media planners.
Drive revenue through the sale of radio advertising solutions and integrated marketing campaigns.
Conduct face-to-face client meetings to understand business requirements and propose customized advertising solutions.
Prepare sales proposals, presentations, quotations, and media plans.
Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets and revenue goals.
Manage client accounts, negotiate commercial terms, and ensure client satisfaction.
Track market trends, competitor activities, and new business opportunities.
Eligibility Criteria
Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Sales or Marketing will be an added advantage.
Experience in B2B Sales, Corporate Sales, Advertising Sales, or Media Sales.
Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-management skills.
Ability to acquire new clients, generate leads, and close sales independently.
Comfortable with face-to-face client meetings and local travel across Mumbai.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates from radio, television, print media, digital media, advertising agencies, or other corporate B2B sales backgrounds will be preferred.
Interested candidates can share their updated CV for consideration.

The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks, dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score
Following the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Eye check-up & dispensing
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Product recommendation
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due
communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the
reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Achieving sales
Vs. Plan & SOP
adherence
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment
regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Store upkeep & maintenance

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart SalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence

Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling
services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward
the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day
tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the
customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a
conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick
up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of
the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is
expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the
overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of
stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
We're looking for energetic and customer-focused Sales Executives to visit customers' homes, conduct eye tests, and sell Lenskart spectacles.
As a Sales Executive, you'll:
Visit customers' homes based on scheduled appointments
Conduct eye tests using specialized equipment
Sell Lenskart spectacles and provide exceptional customer service
Carry a 20-25 kg bag with eye check equipment and eyewears
Meet sales targets and earn attractive commissions

Compensation Package:
Variable compensation based on sales performance
Travel allowances

Training:
30-days comprehensive training in Navi Mumbai on eye checkups and sales techniques
Candidates must be willing to stay/travel to the training location for 30 days
Support and product training

Requirements:
Graduate or Diploma holder
Fresher/Experienced
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to lift and carry equipment (20-25 kg)
Willingness to travel and work flexible hours
Must possess a valid driving license
Must own a bike (two-wheeler)
