Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Greet customers warmly as they enter the store, engaging them in conversation and understanding their eyewear needs.
Assist customers in selecting eyeglasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses, providing product information, recommendations, and demonstrations as needed.

Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

Description:
Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Officer for the role of CAT (Customer Analytics and Transformation) - Loyalty. The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing loyalty programs that enhance customer engagement and retention. This role involves analyzing customer data, identifying trends, and implementing strategies that foster long-term relationships with clients.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and implement loyalty programs that cater to customer needs and enhance overall satisfaction.
- Analyze customer data to identify patterns and preferences, using insights to drive decision-making.
- Collaborate with marketing and product teams to align loyalty initiatives with business objectives.
- Monitor the performance of loyalty programs and suggest improvements based on feedback and analysis.
- Engage with customers to gather insights and refine loyalty strategies, ensuring continuous improvement.
- Prepare reports and presentations for management to provide updates on loyalty program performance and impact.

Skills Required:
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with various stakeholders.
- Proficiency in customer analytics tools and techniques.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
- Detail-oriented with strong organizational and project management skills.

Tools Required:
- Familiarity with CRM software and customer analytics platforms.
- Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, or other relevant software.
- Experience with reporting and visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau.
- Knowledge of marketing automation tools will be a plus.

Candidates with a background in data analytics, customer experience, or marketing will be preferred for this position. Join Axis Max Life Insurance and contribute to building lasting customer relationships through innovative loyalty programs.

The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also
includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks,
dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has Customer focus: Driving Net.

Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.


Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.


Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage


Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred
Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities
Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
Internship Trainee

Location: Chennai, Pondicherry, Erode
Role Purpose
The Customer Service Officer (Internship Trainee) will be responsible for managing customer service operations for unsecured lending products while undergoing structured rotational training across service desk, complaint management, regulatory grievance handling, and quality functions.
The role is designed to build a strong compliance-oriented, customer-centric operations leader for future managerial responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities
1. Service Desk Operations
Handle inbound customer interactions related to loan applications, disbursement, EMI servicing, foreclosure, and account queries
Ensure high First Call Resolution (FCR) and adherence to defined Turnaround Time (TAT)
Maintain accurate call documentation in CRM/system
Deliver consistent customer experience aligned with company standards
Register and track customer complaints in the system
Maintain proper documentation for audit and inspection purposes
2. Regulatory & Compliance Adherence
Strict adherence to RBI guidelines and internal policies
Ensure zero tolerance toward mis-leading information or incorrect commitments
Maintain audit-ready documentation of customer communication
Escalate sensitive cases to Nodal / Grievance Officer as per defined escalation matrix
3. Customer Experience & Process Improvement
Identify recurring service gaps and suggest corrective actions
Support implementation of process improvement initiatives
Contribute to service quality enhancement programs

Training & Rotational Exposure (1218 Months)
The InternshipTrainee will undergo structured exposure to:
Service Desk Operations
Welcome Calling
Complaint Desk & Escalation Handling
Regulatory Grievance Management
Quality & Training Function
MIS & Process Governance
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
First Call Resolution (FCR)
Average Handling Time (AHT)
Complaint TAT Compliance
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
Audit & Compliance Score
Zero Regulatory Deviations
Qualification
Graduate (MBA in Finance / Operations / Marketing preferred)
02 years of relevant experience (Fresh MBA candidates may apply)
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Analytical and problem-solving ability
Customer-centric approach
Compliance-driven mindset
Ability to handle pressure and escalations professionally
Working knowledge of CRM systems

Job Description
Job Title: RA- Credit Life Reporting To- Manager - Credit Life
Location :
Will be responsible for managing a leading bank Loan Verticals and branches. Purpose of the Job (overall high level summary of the job)
Managing the Group credit life business, across locations and to achieve business volume (premium) and desired penetration. Regularly engage and provide market update, training & drive the ASCs (Loan Centre) to implement the set processes and ensuring seamless functioning of Grp Cr Life product within ASCs. He/she will be closely working with the Retail Asset Teams of the Bank to sell Group credit life Scheme along with the bank s primary product. He/she would plan, monitor, coach, communicate and execute sales strategies and gain mind share of the bank officials (at all levels) and then provide feedback. He/she will also in turn work with the Group Operations to follow up on issuance and clearing of pendency, if any.
Principal Accountabilities How they are achieved/measured
Manage the Group business with the Bank employees
Liaison with different departments for closure of the cases
Champion product and process to drive top line sales through business sales team and maintaining penetration levels of group insurance products with channel partner.
Coordinate and train key officials (ASSL, DSA, other bank officials) to enhance their understanding of the business to increase seller activisation
Provide market feedback on competition and other products in the market.
Manage and strengthen relationship through engagement with Partner s Zonal Leadership team, Ops & Credit Team, DSAs, SMs, Field Sales Staff at all levels and across functions. Values add in key initiatives to enhance attachment ration & business volume through training and service.
Tracking penetration performance and publishing dashboards, along with Group Operations.
To measure & monitor the various metrics (Files and sum assured Penetration rates, seller activation, Claim denial rates/ pending rates, rejection ratios , medical TATs etc), to minimize the same and adhere to TATs and contribute to product improvement.
Monitoring and control process of Post Sales.
Managing complete claims operation & end to end process.

Description:
Job description
Gold Plus Group Company Profile
Gold Plus Group is the second-largest glass manufacturing company in India, headquartered at Kings Mall, Rohini, Delhi. The Group operates Float Glass and Solar Glass manufacturing plants at Roorkee (Uttarakhand) and Kanagala, Belagavi (Karnataka), along with a processing plant at Kala Amb (Himachal Pradesh).
With a strong sales presence across India, the Group has an annual turnover of approximately INR 3,500 crore and a workforce of over 4,000 employees.

Website: goldplusgroup.com

Position Details:
Designation: Area Sales Manager (ASM)
Department: Sales & Marketing
Qualification: MBA (Regular)
Experience: Relevant experience in Sales / Channel Sales / Business Development
Location: Puducherry, Tirunelveli, Mangaluru, Trichy, Tirupati

Role & Responsibilities:
Manage and strengthen relationships with existing business associates and channel partners.
Identify, onboard, and develop new business associates within the assigned territory.
Drive business development and achieve assigned sales targets in tonnage.
Ensure timely collection of receivables and maintain healthy outstanding levels.
Coordinate with the Accounts team for reconciliation and resolution of discrepancies.
Build strong customer relationships and strengthen the company's brand presence.
Handle customer queries, complaints, and service-related issues effectively.
Guide and monitor the performance of Marketing Executives (MEs) reporting to the role.
Work closely with the RM/GM and take up additional responsibilities as required.

Requirements:
MBA (Regular) is mandatory.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Experience in channel sales, dealer/distributor management or business development preferred.
Strong customer relationship and negotiation skills.
Good understanding of the assigned market/territory.
Leadership and team-management abilities.
Target-oriented and result-driven approach.
Willingness to travel within the assigned territory.

Description:
What you ll do:
Product Design Engineer with specialized expertise in Low Voltage (LV) Switchgear, including Contactors, Overload Relays (OLR), Starters, Air Circuit Breakers (ACB), Molded Case Circuit Breakers (MCCB), Miniature Circuit Breakers (MCB), Residual Current Circuit Breakers (RCCB),Switch Disconnectors and Distribution boards.
The candidate should possess a comprehensive background in product development, hands-on experience in LV product type testing and test planning, and a strong understanding of IEC standards, particularly IEC:60947-1/2/3/4/5.
- Apply expertise in LV Switchgear to contribute to the design and development of LV products.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance product performance and reliability.
- Conduct hands-on testing of LV products and develop comprehensive test plans.
- Ensure compliance with industry standards and specifications, with a focus on IEC:60947-1/2/3/4/5.
- Develop verification and validation plans to ensure the robustness and reliability of LV Switchgear products.
- Implement testing protocols to validate product performance against defined criteria.
- Contribute to localization initiatives and Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) projects to optimize product efficiency and cost-effectiveness.
- Provide technical support to address production issues and challenges related to LV Switchgear.
- Collaborate with on-site teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues promptly.
- Liaise with external testing laboratories such as CPRI, ERDA, and UL to ensure compliance with global standards and certifications.

Description:
Change the world. Love your job.
Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesnt stop there. Were developing breakthrough technology to power the worlds future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us.

Application specific MCU industrial (ASM-IND) product line offers a broad range of high performance, innovative and cost-effective specialized MCUs for a wide range of applications across Motor control and Digital power. We enable powering next generation AI datacenters, provide motor control solutions for Humanoids, robotics, etc., build AI solutions for predictive diagnostics, improve performance, control and optimize energy efficiency.
We are looking for an application engineer who has the passion and excitement to continuously learn, innovate, take an active role in solving real time control. It is a fast paced, results driven environment requiring Microcontroller knowledge, system level understanding, software development, Motor control algorithms and system hardware skillsets. You will collaborate with worldwide accounts to solve their system challenges, enable them to go to market faster, work with marketing and business leadership to develop strategic technical solutions to enable TI business growth and impact the next generation of products.
Key responsibilities include:
Develop sensored and sensor less motor control algorithms to enable faster response, Smoother speed, less acoustic noise
Own specific IP s write technical reference manual, resolve customer issues through E2E platform and field engagement
Participate in customer calls to understand system requirements and help select the right devices and reference designs
Support customer design-in activities by:
Adapting our system reference solutions to their custom hardware design.
Meet customer across the globe to promote our technical benefits and resolve technical issues / Debug
Schematic and layout review of customer solutions for our device
Help with software porting, optimize software to improve performance.
Resolve production stop issues for customers
Design EVM and internal evaluation boards to support evaluation activities of new products.
Train Field Applications Engineers and customers on ASM Microcontrollers and reference designs
Write application notes and training collateral that explain features, implementation of motor control on ASM Microcontrollers.
Qualifications
Minimum requirements:
Master s degree in Electrical Engineering or related degree
3 years of application/system engineering experience
Motor control algorithm development
Strong knowledge of Microcontrollers
Experience in embedded C software development
Solid hardware and software debugging skills

Preferred qualifications:
PHD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Electrical Drive Systems
Hands-on experience working in motor control algorithm development
Knowledge on Matlab, Simulink and Plexim for simulation and model-based code generation
Digital control system design
Familiarity with field bus communication
Power electronic system design
Knowledge on functional safety, security and artificial intelligence
Ability to review schematics and PCB layout using CAD tools
Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
Self-driven and ability to take initiative and drive for results
Continuous learning mindset
Ability to produce high quality technical documentation
Good communication skillset to interface with customers and Field Applications Engineers

Description:
Job Title: US IT Recruiter Fresher to Senior Level
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu, Pondicherry
Experience: 0–5+ Years
Shift: Night Shift – US Staffing
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for US IT Recruiters at different experience levels — Freshers, Junior, Mid-Level, and Senior Recruiters — to join our recruitment team in Salem and Pondicherry.
The role will be assigned based on the candidate's experience, skills, and knowledge of the US IT Staffing process.
Freshers with good communication skills and a strong willingness to learn are welcome to apply. Experienced candidates should have hands-on experience in US IT Recruitment and candidate sourcing.
Key Responsibilities
Source IT professionals using Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, job boards, referrals, and other sourcing platforms.
Understand job descriptions and identify suitable candidates based on client requirements.
Search and identify candidates using Boolean search, keyword search, resume databases, and other sourcing techniques.
Review resumes and shortlist qualified candidates based on technical skills and experience.
Conduct initial candidate screening to assess skills, experience, communication, availability, location, work authorization, and interest.
Communicate job opportunities and requirements clearly to candidates.
Maintain regular communication and follow-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
Coordinate interviews and follow up on interview feedback.
Negotiate candidate salary/rate expectations within approved guidelines.
Collect required candidate information and documentation.
Submit qualified candidates to clients/account managers within the required timelines.
Maintain accurate candidate records, submissions, interview status, and recruitment activities in the ATS.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified IT professionals.
Meet daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment targets.
Maintain quality submissions and ensure timely completion of recruitment activities.
Experience-Level Expectations
Fresher / Junior (0–2 Years):
Good communication skills and willingness to learn US IT Recruitment.
Learn and perform candidate sourcing, resume screening, candidate calling, and interview coordination.
Previous recruitment experience or internship is an advantage but not mandatory for freshers.
Mid-Level (2–5 Years):
Independently manage assigned US IT recruitment requirements.
Strong experience in sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, submissions, and interview coordination.
Ability to manage multiple requirements and consistently achieve recruitment targets.
Senior Level (5+ Years):
Handle complex, niche, and high-priority US IT requirements independently.
Strong expertise in advanced sourcing, candidate screening, rate negotiation, and candidate management.
Ability to mentor junior recruiters and contribute to team performance and recruitment strategies.
Required Skills
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and candidate engagement skills.
Good analytical and organizational skills.
Ability to work in a target-driven and fast-paced environment.
Basic understanding of IT technologies and technical terminology.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Willingness to work during US business hours / night shift.
Preferred Skills – Experienced Candidates
Hands-on experience in US IT Staffing / US IT Recruitment.
Experience with Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, or similar sourcing platforms.
Knowledge of Boolean search and candidate sourcing techniques.
Understanding of W2, C2C, and 1099 hiring models.
Knowledge of US work authorization and visa categories such as H-1B, OPT, CPT, GC, and USC.
Experience with ATS platforms.
Knowledge of different IT skill sets and technical job requirements.
Experience working with VMS or client/vendor requirements is an advantage.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
MBA HR, B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA, or other relevant qualifications are preferred.
Freshers are welcome to apply.
Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates who are:
Interested in building or advancing their career in US IT Staffing.
Good at communication and relationship building.
Willing to work in a night-shift environment aligned with US business hours.
Target-oriented and committed to achieving recruitment goals.
Willing to learn and continuously improve recruitment skills.
Candidates will be considered for the appropriate level based on their experience, skills, and demonstrated recruitment capabilities.

Description:
What you ll do:
Manage the research, design, and development of critical components for Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear. Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of MV Switchgear portfolio.
"-Supervise VCB, RMU, AIS and GIS design activities for MV Switchgear
-Define and approve type and prototype test plans covering MV Switchgear components
-Coordinate type testing with accredited labs (KEMA, CESI, GCC Lab) and oversee in-house prototype validation.
-Lead root cause analysis of failures and ensure effective corrective measures across both product families.
-Guarantee compliance with IEC / 100 / 102 / 103 / 200 standards as well as customer-specific and utility requirements.
-Maintain technical documentation supporting certifications, approvals, and type testing for both MV Switchgear projects.
-Utilize DFMEA and reliability engineering methods to strengthen robustness and long-term quality of Switchgear components.
-Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, electrical, and quality teams to ensure industrialization of components for both MV Switchgear.
-Collaborate with suppliers and RD institutions to localize and qualify components, reducing costs and lead times across both product lines.
-Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them
-Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.
-Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost.
-Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations."

Description:
To know and develop proficiency in handling internal company software platforms, ie. iCABS, SCP and any other systems that may be introduced.
Must have a good knowledge of the branch territory.
To ensure that the Service Companion usage is maximised for all the service deliveries & should be always above 95%
Organisation of schedule and planning of all service (including contracts, jobbing, call outs, etc.) requirements on a daily, weekly and monthly basis for all technicians within the branch
To ensure that all the service companion devices are active and in use. All the devices should be active 100% at any given point of time
Priority-wise planning of all due for Renewals visits, enquiries, call outs and complaints. Pending visits should be negligible (Service backlogs). Emphasis on "On Time planning
Liaise with the Sales and Service team to best accommodate urgent service visit appointments and communicate changes to affected customers timely.
Ensure customer service-related complaints or termination notifications/STOP Services are attended to effectively and promptly.
Manage service documentation and ensure all customer/technician s feedback are followed up with actions
Enter correct (error free) consumption data and TOS in the SCP to ensure command centre account profitability reflects correct data customer wise.
Ensure all service data from dockets, log cards, service orders and other sources is updated accurately into business systems in timely manner
Coordinate with the IT team for new users, device issues etc.
Supports business transition from paper-based to system and digital-based planning, visit documents, whilst upholding documentation integrity. Follow callout process so as to ensure that the complaints are delivered only after raising the ticket
Review service reports with OM, OE and BM and highlight areas of concern critical backlog and weekly trend to manager.
Reviews and provides service compliance updates daily.
Assist & help AOM / OM / Assistant Branch Manager / Branch Manager in monitoring Technician service productivity and efficiency related KPIs
Maintain positive working relationship and effective communication with Sales & Service Colleagues, Supervisor, Technician, Operations staff for any service related issues. Coordinate with Sales for any available slots, time adjustment for new sales scheduling
Work with branch management to correct service areas distributed across the business based on annual revenue from areas, time on site, travel time & routine requirements
Utilise the Route technicians for jobbing only after the route technicians routine services are delivered
Expected to be knowledgeable about company safety policies and safety (SRA) requirements on the job, be able to read and understand company policies
Any unresolved issues should be quickly elevated to the next level of management for prompt resolution
Any other similar duties as and when specified by the manager
  REPORTING
Daily, weekly & monthly (SOS) State of Service for Branch. Residential GSS SOS should also be the priority
Weekly reporting of pending jobs, ageing profiles to ABM/BM
Monthly reporting of technician wise trends.
Maintain State of Service and productivity data per technician
Maintain visibility on complaints received and report on all call outs / critical incidents received from branch.
Annual Leave planning of technicians
Ensure that each technician service productivity is achieved as per set targets
Key Result Areas:
On time service planning with ZERO pending services every month
Monitoring SCP active devices & Usage on weekly basis
Minimum expectancy on SCP active device(100%) & usage >95%
Achieving progressive improvement in State of Service (SOS) and meet SOS targets assigned by the branch
Minimizing service backlog (meet our contractual obligations)
  Competencies (Skills essential to the role):
Be decisive
Attention to details and accuracy
Planning & organizing
Analytical skills
Customer oriented
Negotiation skills
Ability to work patiently in a dynamic service environment
  Educational Qualification / Other Requirement:
Minimum graduation with 1 to 3 years of relevant experience of managing team
Basic computer skills - for reporting/work management (Advanced computer skills would be an added advantage)
Communication - speaking on phone to external customers & internally with technicians, other Operations colleagues.
Knowledge of territory which is handled for planning
Occasional Travel required within the Division
Liaise with the Operations Manager, Operations Executive, Service Supervisors to establish service requirements and provide information, assurance and advice as required
Communicate all service issues in a timely manner to the ABM/BM, Operations Manager
AboutCompany:
Rentokil Initial, founded in 1925 and headquartered in Crawley, West Sussex, UK, is a global leader in pest control and hygiene services. Operating in over 80 countries, the company provides innovative solutions, including pest prevention, removal, and monitoring, as well as workplace hygiene and specialist disinfection services. Renowned for its sustainability efforts and technological advancements, such as smart pest control systems, Rentokil Initial serves a diverse clientele across industries like healthcare, hospitality, and food production. Its mission is to protect people and enhance lives by delivering essential, high-quality services that promote health and safety.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Maintenance Management
Plan and execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities for manufacturing equipment.
Ensure maximum machine uptime and minimize production losses.
Analyze equipment failures and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
Monitor machine performance and reliability indicators.
2. Equipment Maintenance
Maintain and improve the performance of:
Stator winding machines
Coil insertion machines
Commutator assembly machines
Rotor balancing machines
Press machines
Hydraulic and pneumatic systems
Conveyor systems
Assembly line equipment
Gear box, Index table, LM guides, Ball screws, clutches
Utility systems (air compressors, chillers, cooling towers, pumps, etc.)
Material handling equipment
3. TPM & Continuous Improvement
Drive TPM (Total Productive Maintenance) activities across production areas.
Implement Autonomous Maintenance (JH & PM Pillar) initiatives.
Conduct root cause analysis using 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, and Pareto Analysis.
Lead Kaizen and cost-reduction projects.
Support OEE improvement initiatives.
4. Planning & Scheduling
Develop annual, monthly, and weekly maintenance plans.
Coordinate maintenance schedules with production teams.
Ensure timely completion of shutdown maintenance activities.
5. Spare Parts & Inventory Control
Monitor critical spare inventory levels.
Coordinate procurement of maintenance spares.
Optimize spare consumption and maintenance costs.
Maintain proper records of equipment history and spare utilization.
6. Safety & Compliance
Ensure compliance with EHS policies and statutory requirements.
Conduct safety inspections and risk assessments.
Implement Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures during maintenance activities.
Ensure safe work practices among maintenance personnel and contractors.
7. Team Management
Lead, guide, and develop maintenance engineers, technicians, and trainees.
Conduct skill development and technical training programs.
Evaluate team performance and support succession planning.
8. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain maintenance records through CMMS/ERP systems.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly maintenance reports.
Track maintenance KPIs such as:
•MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)
•MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)
•OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
•Maintenance Cost per Unit
•Preventive Maintenance Compliance

Preferred candidate profile

Location: Puducherry; Candidates who are native of Puducherry are also welcome

Description:
AI Mode conversation: Software Tester (Automation Tester with Tricentis Tosca) Mandatory: Minimum 8 Years of IT experience and 2 years of working experience in the mandatory skills. Mandatory Skills 1. Candidate must have experience/knowledge of testing on web-based and mobile applications. 2. Expertise in Tricentis Tosca tool for automation testing. 3. Should be responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated test scripts to ensure the quality and functionality of our software applications. 4. Should generate and analyze test reports to provide insights into the quality of the software. 5. Experience with API testing and automation. 6. Should have a good understanding of Software Testing Life Cycle 7. Demonstrate the ability to derive the Test Scenarios from the Business Requirements. 8. Demonstrate working understanding in Test Design and writing detailed test cases based on user scenarios. 9. Develop, document, and maintain functional test cases and other test artifacts like the test data, data validation. 10. Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies and processes. 11. Responsible for performing test execution and test analysis. 12. Strong proficiency in Functional / Regression / Retesting / UI / Usability / Cross Browser testing. 13. Good reporting & documenting skills. 14. Experience working in an Agile/Scrum methodology. 15. Experience working in Azure DevOps or Jira 16. Tricentis Tosca certifications (e.g., AS1, AS2, AE1, AE2) are a plus. Primary responsibilities 1. Performing automated testing using Tricentis Tosca. 2. Integration of Test Scripts with the Continuous integration tool such as Jenkins. 3. Designing, developing and supporting frameworks for our test infrastructure and providing automation expertise to our development teams Contributing toward predictable delivery of quality releases 4. Write requirements and create scenarios for performance and load testing 5. Creation and maintenance of test data, tools and scripts. 6. Create test plans and suites from the user stories defined by product owners. 7. Review test plans and cases with developers and product owners. 8. Writing and maintaining test scripts 9. Execute test plans and conduct manual functional and exploratory testing. 10. Responsible for the quality of delivered products 11. Share test metrics after each execution. 12. Responsible for the timeliness of test automation scripts & product delivery 13. Making sure the products meet company standards, design specifications, and are within total quality management limits 14. Assist stakeholders in replicating reported issues and aid customer support and/or development in troubleshooting field issues 15. Provide clear bug description and useful debugging information, ideally for a complex system containing several moving parts 16. Continually update skills by learning new technologies relevant to the role. 17. Identifying issues, risks and dependencies escalating and managing where appropriate Requirements. Roles & Responsibilities
Production:
Assist in daily production activities and machine operations.
Monitor production output and achieve daily targets.

Good observation and communication skills.
Willingness to learn and work in shifts.
Knowledge of 5S, safety, and quality procedures is an added advantage.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Maintenance Management
Plan and execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities for manufacturing equipment.
Ensure maximum machine uptime and minimize production losses.
Analyze equipment failures and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
Monitor machine performance and reliability indicators.

2. Equipment Maintenance
Maintain and improve the performance of:
Stator winding machines
Coil insertion machines
Commutator assembly machines
Rotor balancing machines
Press machines
Hydraulic and pneumatic systems
Conveyor systems
Assembly line equipment
Gear box, Index table, LM guides, Ball screws, clutches
Utility systems (air compressors, chillers, cooling towers, pumps, etc.)
Material handling equipment

3. TPM & Continuous Improvement
Drive TPM (Total Productive Maintenance) activities across production areas.
Implement Autonomous Maintenance (JH & PM Pillar) initiatives.
Conduct root cause analysis using 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, and Pareto Analysis.
Lead Kaizen and cost-reduction projects.
Support OEE improvement initiatives.

4. Planning & Scheduling
Develop annual, monthly, and weekly maintenance plans.
Coordinate maintenance schedules with production teams.
Ensure timely completion of shutdown maintenance activities.

5. Spare Parts & Inventory Control
Monitor critical spare inventory levels.
Coordinate procurement of maintenance spares.
Optimize spare consumption and maintenance costs.
Maintain proper records of equipment history and spare utilization.

6. Safety & Compliance
Ensure compliance with EHS policies and statutory requirements.
Conduct safety inspections and risk assessments.
Implement Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures during maintenance activities.
Ensure safe work practices among maintenance personnel and contractors.

7. Team Management
Lead, guide, and develop maintenance engineers, technicians, and trainees.
Conduct skill development and technical training programs.
Evaluate team performance and support succession planning.

8. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain maintenance records through CMMS/ERP systems.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly maintenance reports.
Track maintenance KPIs such as:
MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)
MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)
OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
Maintenance Cost per Unit
Preventive Maintenance Compliance


Preferred candidate profile

Qualification filter: B.E./B.Tech/Diploma Mechanical Engineering
Experience filter: 5 to 12 years
Preferred industry: Automotive / Auto Components / Electric Motor Manufacturing / Engineering Manufacturing.

Immediate opening for HR Trainee @ Datamatics, Puducherry


Job Description:

Support employee onboarding and documentation
Coordinate with internal teams and candidates to ensure timely completion of HR processes.
Coordinate induction and onboarding training for new hires
Update and maintain employee information in HR systems and ensure data accuracy.
Prepare and maintain employee records, appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, and other HR-related documents.
Ensure confidentiality, accuracy, and proper maintenance of employee data and HR documentation.
Walk-in: 9:30 AM - 4:00 PM

Any further information, please feel free to reach us on

Call: 0413 2616966

Email: recruit.pdy@datamatics.com
AboutCompany:
About Datamatics:
Datamatics enables enterprises to go Deep in Digital to boost their productivity, customer experience, and competitive advantage. st EMI Resolution

years work experience only in Vehicle Sales

Market/Industry Knowledge
Analytical Skill
Product Knowledge

Execution Excellence
Customer Centricity

Should be comfortable to move in the market
Should have learning attitude
Should have bike and license
Should have good knowledge of RTO
Should have product knowledge

Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Competency- Customer Delight

Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support

Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Overview
Service Managers (SM) or Territory Managers (TM) are the frontline owner of fleet quality, safety compliance and ground-level service execution resulting in top-notch customer experience.
Core Responsibilities
Service Quality –
1. Completing daily in-bus inspections and fill the audit form to improve service delivery
2. Own audit score and bus-quality-complaints-per-trip metric, and zero compromise on safety violations
3. Ensure cleanliness, comfort and onboard amenities meet brand standard on every trip
4. Daily coordination with operator staff to get the work done and highlighting improvement areas
5. Calling unhappy customers daily and gather captain & crew feedback to close the loop; resolve issues at the right quality, not just speed
6. Working on reducing customer complaints related to bus condition, cleanliness and safety concerns
 Team Leadership & Accountability -
1. Recruit, train and manage the team of bus captains ensuring grooming standards and timely reporting
2. Own roster planning, week-offs, attendance and attrition control
3. Drive accountability through audits and performance evaluation; log corrective actions against the SOP checklist; keep behavioral complaints under check
4. Deliver on customer engagement targets of customer ratings and in-bus bookings
 Reporting & Continuous Improvement -
1. Own the reports assigned to this role, flag trends and make corrections
2. Monitor service and captain level performance through performance dashboards
3. Bus punctuality reports to be seen daily and making timely schedule/route corrections
4. Log daily checklist of SOPs and ensure team down the line improve on deliverables
 Required Skills & Availability
 Working knowledge of bus systems, fleet maintenance basics and safety regulations
 Proven people-management and training ability for a frontline team
 Composure and firmness enforcing standards under operational pressure, including the authority to hold a bus back from dispatch
 Strong coordination and stakeholder communication — captains, crew, customers and the operator
 Comfortable working late nights and staying reachable off-hours while services are running

Description:
Role Definition / Expectation:

CASA SALES EXECUTIVE

Officer Sales II- 1-2 yrs (Sales experience in any industry )
AM Sales : 2 yrs + Exp. in CASA/ BFSI / banking sector

** It is preferred that the candidate has banking exposure/ experience

Qualifications:
Graduation from a recognized institute

About the Role:
Business Development Executives are a part of the Bank's front line sales team.
Their primary responsibility is sales of banks products to new customers for the bank.
They will be required to take part in offsite marketing activities and travel locally to meet new customers as a daily activity.
They are responsible for selling banking and third party products to customers based on their needs.
They are responsible for handling customer queries.
Business Development Executives are required to achieve targets assigned by the bank within initial 6 months for confirmation of their service
Key Responsibilities:
Selling of banks and third party products to new customers.
Conducting marketing activities and travel locally to meet new customers as a daily activity.
Contacting existing customers for more deposits and cross selling of more products.
Achieve sales targets as assigned by the organization on a daily and monthly basis.
Complete all mandatory certifications required for the role (AMFI, EUIN etc.).
Complete all learning activities conducted by the bank from time to time.
Daily entry of interaction with customers in banks CRM system.
Follow all compliance guidelines (regulatory & legislative) for each activity.
Participate and follow all initiatives that are undertaken by the bank from time to time
Qualifications:
Graduation from a recognized institute

#ComeAsYouAre 'We are dil se open. Women, LGBTQIA+ and PwD candidates of all ages are encouraged to apply'

Expectations :
It is preferred that the candidate has a 2 wheeler and Driving License
AboutCompany:
At Axis Bank, we go much beyond addressing the financial needs of our customers. We give them reasons to strengthen their trust in us, at every step. This belief has paid us rich dividends, bringing with it steady growth, rapid expansion and an opportunity for you to propel your career further.
Axis Bank is expanding and with expansion comes the opportunity to grow and chart your own career path. So, if you are a self-motivated banking professional, looking for opportunities to redefine your career, you might just be the person we require.

Description:
Job Title: Store Manager Supermarket

Experience: 5 to 10 Years in Retail / Supermarket Industry
Qualification: Any Degree / Postgraduate
Job Location: Pondicherry

Salary: 30,000 40,000 per month + Incentives

Job Summary:
We are looking for an experienced and responsible Store Manager to oversee the daily operations of our supermarket/department store. The candidate will ensure smooth functioning, excellent customer service, and achievement of sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage day-to-day supermarket operations
Supervise and guide store staff
Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and achieve sales targets
Monitor inventory levels and coordinate stock replenishment
Handle billing, cash management, and store reports
Maintain store cleanliness, safety, and visual standards
Plan promotions and implement sales strategies
Resolve customer complaints effectively
Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures
Requirements:
Proven experience in retail or supermarket management
Strong leadership and team management skills
Good communication and interpersonal skills
Knowledge of inventory and billing systems
Ability to work under pressure and meet targets
Good command of English and Tamil (spoken and written)
Important Note:
Only candidates from the Retail industry are eligible to apply.
AboutCompany:
Welcome to your trusted destination for everyday essentials, where quality, variety, and value come together to create a seamless shopping experience. Our store is built with a simple mission to provide everything your household needs under one roof, with convenience and reliability at the heart of what we do.
We offer a wide range of carefully selected products across multiple categories including pantry staples, packaged foods, beverages, dairy products, snacks, personal care, home care, baby care, and healthcare essentials. Every product on our shelves is chosen to meet high standards of quality, ensuring that you and your family get only the best.
Our store is designed to make your shopping easy and enjoyable. With well-organized sections, a clean and comfortable environment, and a commitment to excellent customer service, we aim to give you a hassle-free experience every time you visit. Whether you are stocking up for the month or picking up daily essentials, you will always find what you need quickly and conveniently.
We take pride in offering competitive prices along with regular deals and special offers, helping you save more on your everyday purchases. Our focus is not just on selling products, but on building lasting relationships with our customers through trust, consistency, and satisfaction.
Driven by a passion for quality and service, we continuously strive to improve and expand our product range to meet the evolving needs of modern households. Your comfort, convenience, and confidence in shopping with us are what inspire us every day.

Description:
To create network of high performing Partner and promulgate initiatives within each Partner to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain Partner and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Identify and Recruit the prospective Partner.
Selection to on boarding of the Partner and responsible for Partner income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner and other day to day interactions
with support functions whenever required.
Engage initiatives to ensure Managing Partner - PO productivity
To achieve the assigned recruitment target of partner office; assigned through various
Recruitment activities
Actively involve the PPs in activities pertaining to Recruitment and New Agent Activation
Responsible for Advisor Activation, Creation and Retention
Ensure compliance to all internal processes and other compliance standards as set by the
Company or the Regulator.
Plan goals performance needs for Partner in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for Partner Office
Identify development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical,
product and skills training and coaching. Develop Partner in line with career development
training requirements of the Company.
Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with
Partner.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performances and arranging appropriate
team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills
of Partners.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company
information, address common problems and concerns and rally the Partner to achieve
goals.
Make necessary decisions based on Partner performance.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Min 2 years of sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of Insurance industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing customers to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.
Effectively leverages existing networks, professional referrals, and natural market opportunities to consistently generate quality leads for distribution expansion.
Demonstrates the ability to attract established and high-performing distributors or teams from competitor organizations by highlighting the unique advantages and growth opportunities the company offers.
Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Conduct daily CFT meetings and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Review and monitor production schedule adherence.
Review and monitor ILR status.
Monitor plant efficiency and identify areas for improvement.
Periodically review and update Control Plans, SOPs, Work Instructions (WI), and related documents.
Coordinate with supporting departments for facility-related requirements.
Coordinate and support IATF, TPS, PMI, OSHAS, VDA, and other system-related activities.
Carry out SAP BOM corrections and ensure accuracy of material-related data.
Carry out SAP Norms corrections and maintain accurate system data.
Ensure timely closure of Stop Advice Notes.
Monitor and ensure shift-wise NC closure.
Coordinate new product introduction / new product activities with the CFT.
Key Technical Responsibilities
The role also requires strong capability in PCBA manufacturing and final assembly, including single-piece flow and batch production, SOP/CP/PFMEA, quality problem-solving tools, line efficiency improvement, assembly rejection/rework control, defect analysis, FPY improvement, 5S/Kaizen, PCB Gerber data, through-hole and selective soldering, and electronic product manufacturing processes.
As a Senior Engineer in the Manufacturing department, you will play a crucial role in the development, optimization, and implementation of manufacturing processes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance production efficiency, ensure quality compliance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. The position requires a deep understanding of manufacturing principles, tools, and technologies, as well as strong leadership capabilities to mentor junior engineers and coordinate team efforts.

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

POSITION SUMMARY
Assist in monitoring/tracking employee relations issues including resolution and follow-up. Assist and support management and the leadership team with handling and resolving Human Resources issues. Monitor all hiring and recruitment processes for compliance with all local, state, and federal laws and company policies and standards. Inform Human Resources management of issues related to employee relations. Respond to questions, requests, and concerns from employees and management regarding company and Human Resources programs, policies and guidelines. Disseminate information to employees related to employer-employee relations, employee activities, and personnel policies and programs. Review and ensure accurate maintenance of all employee records and files (e.g., interview documents, I-9s). Assist in logistics, administration, and scheduling of annual employee surveys. Answer phone calls and record messages.

Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc
