Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Supervises and manages employees.
Managing all day-to-day operations.
Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Ensures employee recognition is taking place on all shifts.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees.
Monitoring and Supporting Progress Toward Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Collaborates with the Front Office Manager on ways to continually improve departmental service.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Office goals to produce desired results.
- Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans based on review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Displays outstanding hospitality skills.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Interacts with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Handles guest problems and complaints effectively.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Ensures compliance with all Front Office policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors and co-workers by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Functions in place of the Front Office Manager in his/her absence.
- Communicates critical information from pre- and post-convention meetings to the Front Office staff.
- Participates in department meetings.

Assists in the management of the daily functions of the department to provide protection of property assets, employees, guests and property.

Assists in the training of staff in established emergency procedures and implements accident and fire prevention procedures.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional area
OR
- Bachelor s degree from an accredited university in Criminal Justice or related major; 1 year experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Security/Loss Prevention Operations
- Assists in conducting hazard and risk assessments at the property to include quarterly OSHA/SAFETY audits, incident tracking, and the hazard abatement process.
- Complies with applicable federal, state and local law and safety regulations.
- Maintains logs, certifications and documents required by law and Standard Operating Procedures.
- Supervises and reviews initial incident investigations and promote a timely responses for all reported incidents.
- Follows proper key control guidelines in loss prevention and in the property.
- Assists with promotion and implementation of accident and fire prevention procedures.

- Appraises employee s productivity and efficiency for the purpose of recommending promotions or other changes in status.
- Provides for the safety and security of the employees or the property.
- Monitors employee attendance and records absences/tardiness.
- Helps direct supervisors to achieve their own development goals.
- Conducts annual performance appraisal with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Meets quality standards and customer expectations on a daily basis.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Inspects and critiques the performance of the loss prevention department to establish and maintain a high level of professionalism and customer service.
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Additional Responsibilities
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Develops liaison with local law enforcement and emergency services.
- Informs and/or updates executives, peers and subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Provides information to supervisors and co-workers by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

Description:
Responsible for the daily shift operations of Housekeeping, Recreation/Health Club and, if applicable, Laundry.
Directs and works with employees to verify property guestrooms, public space and employee areas are clean and well maintained.
Completes inspections and holds people accountable for corrective action.
Position assists in ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the housekeeping or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Housekeeping Operations and Budgets
Verifies guest room status is communicated to the Front Desk in a timely and efficient manner.
Inspects guestrooms on a daily basis.
Obtains list of rooms to be cleaned immediately and list of prospective check-outs or discharges to prepare work assignments.
Inventories stock to verify adequate supplies.
Supports and supervises an effective inspection program for all guestrooms and public space.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
Verifies all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
Communicates areas that need attention to staff and follows up to verify understanding.
Supervises daily Housekeeping shift operations and verifies compliance with all housekeeping policies, standards and procedures.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
Uses all available on the job training tools to train new room attendants and provide follow-up training as necessary.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and verifies employees do the same with them.
Schedules employees to business demands and for tracks employee time and attendance.
Verifies employees understand expectations and parameters.
Verifies property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process, where applicable.
Supervises staffing levels to verify that guest service, operational needs, and ficial objectives are met.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Verifies employee recognition is taking place on all shifts.
Participates in an on-going employee recognition program.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy, and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Celebrates successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Understands the brands service culture.
Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans to improve guest satisfaction.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Strives to improve service performance.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
As the original house of luxury, St.
Regis continues to redefine modern luxury through service.
At the core is the Butler program, an icon to our heritage and the heart and soul of new luxury.
It is high-touch, personalized, creative and original.
It is brought to life by all talent but serving as the primary face to the program is our Butler team, who are the ultimate luxury ambassadors.
The Senior Butler oversees the functioning and delivery of butler services.
You verify that there is a seamless approach to the pre-arrival, guest stay and at departure through St.
Regis brand standards.
You supervise the work of the Butler team - comprised of Butlers and Butler Valets - and drive strong coordination with other departments.
Responsibilities also include people management tasks including interviewing and hiring Butler team members and creating schedules to ensure optimal staffing levels.
While the St.
Regis brand is steeped in history with roots that can be traced back to the early 1900s, every team member is part of a trailblazing future to redefine modern luxury through service.
The Senior Butler s success is rooted in a deep passion for service, uncompromising standards, the ability to anticipate needs and impeccable interpersonal skills.
You will also be expected to create a safe workplace, follow company policies and procedures, uphold quality standards, and ensure your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Butler team members will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Butler team members - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
REQUIRE QUALIFICATIONS
Related Work Experience: 1 year related work experience required.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Managing Event Logistics and Operations

- Adheres to all standards, policies, and procedures.
- Ensures billing accuracy and conducts bill reviews with the clients prior to processing the final bill.
- Manages group room blocks and meeting space for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Identifies operational challenges associated with his/her group and determines how to best work with the property staff and customer to solve these challenges and/or develop alternative solutions.
- Uses his/her judgment to integrate current trends in event management and event design.
- Acts as liaison between field salesperson and customer throughout the event process (pre-event, event, post-event).
- Participates in customer site inspections and assists with the sales process as necessary.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.
- Solicits feedback from the property departments to identify areas for improvement to enhance the Event Planner s experience.
Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Delivers excellent customer service throughout the customer experience and encourages the same from other employees.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Coordinates and communicates event details both verbally and in writing to the customer and property operations.
- Makes presence known to customer at all times during this process.
- Oversees his/her customer experiences from file turnover through the post event phase until turnover back to sales.
- Follows up with customer post-event.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Uses personal judgment and expertise to enhance the customer experience.
- Stays available to solve problems and/or suggest alternatives to previous arrangements.
- Works to continually improve customer service by integrating obtained feedback and personal judgment into action plans.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Ensures hourly employees understand expectations and parameters for event activities.
Leading Event Management Teams
- Conducts formal pre- and post-event meetings as required to review/communicate group needs and feedback.
- Leads formal pre-event and post-event meetings for average to large-sized assigned groups.
- Facilitates various meetings as he/she perceives necessary (Banquet Event Order meeting, block review, etc).
Supporting and Coordinating with the Sales and Marketing Function
- Assists in the sales process and revenue forecasting for customer groups.
- Up-sells products and services throughout the event process.
- Forecasts group sleeping rooms and event revenue (catering and audio visual) for his/her groups.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Assists in the development and implementation of corrective action plans.
- Take initiative to use his/her experience to improve service performance according to his/her evaluation of the issue and resolution.
- Works with the property staff and customers to address operational challenges associated with his/her group.
- Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.

ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
Home
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
About the Role
An ATM Field Service Engineer is responsible for the entire lifecycle of ATMs, from pre-installation and setup to ongoing maintenance and repair. This includes training clients on ATM usage, performing preventive maintenance to avoid problems, troubleshooting malfunctions, and completing repairs to get ATMs back up and running quickly. They also interact directly with customers to address any concerns and provide excellent customer service. The role requires a proactive approach, responding immediately to all complaints and scheduling preventive maintenance to minimize downtime. For complex issues, collaboration with the customer support team and R&D department is necessary. A valid 2-wheeler license and motorbike are essential for travel to various ATM locations.
About the Company
Vortex Engineering is a Chennai, India-based Technology company focused on building innovative products for the ATM/self-service market. The company has a family of ATM HW & SW products with around 10K installations and a portfolio of software products for the management of multivendor ATMs and other value-added applications. Our customers include leading banks in India and a growing set of new customers in growth countries in Asia, ME & Africa.
Vortex Engineering is revolutionizing self-service product space with unique firsts in the industry

Lowest carbon footprint with ultra-low power design, making it viable for solar-powered deployments
Most sustainable, and the only commercially successful ATM to run on an open-source Linux platform
Only Indian company (and one of a few globally) to have developed and patented dispenser technology
Developing next-generation secured Hardware & Software products using IoT, AI, ML & 5G

The company has a partnership with IIT-Madras for R&D on the latest cutting-edge technologies and offers exciting career opportunities for dynamic individuals with a passion to innovate, lead, take larger responsibilities and grow with the company.

Description:
Job Title: Seller Business Development Associate (BDA)
Company: NoBroker Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
Job Type: Full-time | Field Sales
Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune
Experience: Minimum 1 year / Smart Freshers
Industry: Real Estate
Job Summary
We are looking for energetic and customer-focused Business Development Associates (BDA) to join our field sales team. You will interact with property owners and customers, conduct property/site visits, explain NoBroker services, and help drive successful property transactions.
Qualified leads will be provided by the company.
Key Responsibilities
Meet property owners and customers for property sales, rentals, and leases.
Conduct property visits and accompany buyers during site visits.
Explain property details, pricing, and NoBroker services.
Coordinate property photoshoots and ensure accurate property information.
Negotiate with buyers and sellers to support deal closure.
Onboard property owners and promote premium services where applicable.
Visit commercial properties and collect owner details.
Update property details through the NoBroker App or Google Forms.
Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
Eligibility
Diploma or Graduation is mandatory.
Smart Freshers or candidates with up to 2 years of field sales experience.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Comfortable with field sales and customer interaction.
Mandatory Requirements
Own bike and valid driving licence.
Smartphone.
Ability to communicate in at least one of these combinations:
English + Kannada
English + Telugu
English + Tamil
English + Hindi
English + Marathi

Role Overview-
As a Corporate Linkages Professional, you will serve as the bridge between trained students and potential employers. You will be responsible for developing and managing corporate partnerships,
identifying employment opportunities, facilitating placement activities, and supporting students throughout their career journey.

The role requires strong relationship-building skills, an understanding of evolving industry hiring trends, and the ability to work closely with students, training teams, educational institutions, and employers
to achieve placement outcomes.
Your primary objective will be to maximize student placements and contribute to the overall employability success of the programs.

Key Responsibilities-

1. Corporate Engagement & Partnerships

Identify, map, and connect with HR teams, recruiters, hiring managers, and industry leaders across sectors.
Build and maintain strong relationships with employers to generate placement opportunities for trained students.
Understand industry hiring requirements and workforce trends.
Develop and manage a robust employer network to support ongoing placement activities.
Represent TNSIF at industry events, networking forums, and employer engagement initiatives.

2. Student Placement & Career Support

Understand students' career aspirations, skills, and employment preferences.
Identify suitable job opportunities through corporate partnerships, professional networks, job portals, and recruitment platforms.
Conduct placement readiness sessions, career counselling, and employability guidance.
Support students in resume building, interview preparation, and professional communication.

3. Placement Drives & Recruitment Events

Plan and execute placement drives, recruitment campaigns, job fairs, career fests, and hiring events.
Coordinate with employers and educational institutions to ensure smooth execution of recruitment activities.
Facilitate interviews, assessments, group discussions, and selection processes.
Enable meaningful interactions between students and employers to improve placement outcomes.

4. Data Management & Reporting

Maintain accurate records of employer engagement, job opportunities, interviews, selections, and placements.
Update placement dashboards, trackers, and MIS reports regularly.
Analyse placement performance metrics and identify improvement opportunities.
Contribute towards achieving placement targets and program KPIs, including student joining and retention rates.

5. Post-Placement Support
Provide support to students during onboarding and joining processes.
Conduct regular follow-ups with placed students and employers.
Track student retention and career progression.
Address challenges related to onboarding, workplace adaptation, and job continuity.

6. Stakeholder Management

Collaborate closely with program teams, trainers, colleges, universities, and corporate partners.
Ensure alignment between student skill development initiatives and market requirements.
Maintain strong communication with internal and external stakeholders to drive placement success.


Preferred Skills & Experience-

27 years of experience in Corporate Relations, Placements, Talent Acquisition, Recruitment,
Business Development, Employer Engagement, or Industry Partnerships.
Experience working with educational institutions, skilling programs, employability initiatives, or workforce development programs is preferred.
Exposure to placements across sectors such as IT/ITeS, Manufacturing, Engineering, BFSI, Retail, Logistics, Healthcare, Emerging Technologies, or allied industries.
Strong corporate networking and relationship management skills.
Proven ability to organise placement drives and recruitment events.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; strong data management, reporting, and analytical abilities.
Ability to work independently in a dynamic and target-driven environment.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and placement tracking systems.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), containerization, and monitoring solutions to support large-scale enterprise applications.
Key Responsibilities
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
Automate build, deployment, and release management processes.
Manage and optimize Azure cloud infrastructure and services.
Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, ARM Templates, or Bicep.
Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
Monitor application and infrastructure performance using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
Collaborate with Development, QA, Security, and Operations teams to streamline software delivery.
Implement DevSecOps best practices and security compliance controls.
Troubleshoot deployment issues, system bottlenecks, and infrastructure incidents.
Ensure high availability, scalability, and reliability of cloud environments.
Maintain documentation for infrastructure, deployment processes, and operational procedures.

You ll interact with potential clients and existing members, ensuring a seamless experience while overseeing inventory, scheduling, and class management. Your passion for fitness and attention to detail will be key in creating a welcoming atmosphere and achieving your sales targets.




1. Sales:



Responsible for promoting and selling memberships to potential new clients

Walk-ins/Trials Responsible for achieving target by driving conversion -Responsible for Up-selling

Should maintain record of every interaction with new user

Should enter all details of customers, walk- ins on internal tools.



2. Operations:



Managing center experience and incremental enhancements

Timely Opening and Closing of the center -Inventory management: Ensure inventory of essentials, supplies and equipment, responsible for both stocking and re-ordering (first-aid,stationary, water, towels etc.)

Managing classes and workout

Ensuring punctuality of trainers and classes

Handle issues with respect to attendance, equipment and space availability

Customer interactions and troubleshooting

Interact with walk-ins and prospective clients

Improving member attendance through meet and greet, familiarity building and creating a welcoming atmosphere.

Take feedback from members and partners about classes and document the same -handle issues that may lead to consumer experience during or pre/post class.



Qualifications and Skills:



A Bachelor s degree

0-4 years of work experience

Passion for fitness and healthy living

People management skills

Good Communication skills(Proficiency in English)

Description:
The Customer Service Officer (CSO) is the face of the gym, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for members and visitors. They handle inquiries, manage memberships, resolve issues, and maintain a welcoming atmosphere. The role also involves maintaining cleanliness and hygiene standards to ensure the center looks and feels Always Newwith a Happy to Helpattitude.


Conducting tours for potential members

Guide new visitors, provide detailed facility tours, introduce trainers, and facilitate trial sessions

LMS adherence, CH-BT% (Trial/Walk-in conversion rate) - Membership Renewal & Retention

Follow up on expired/lapsed memberships, engage members for renewals

Renewal %, Net Promoter Score (NPS) - Member Engagement & Satisfaction

Regularly interact with members, resolve queries, gather feedback, and escalate concerns where necessary

Member retention rate, Customer satisfaction (NPS), Number of escalations per 100K footfall

Compliance & Documentation, Ensure compliance with checklists such as Wooqer reporting, safety guidelines, and CRM usage

Wooqer compliance fill rate >90%, FLS audit score

Facility & Equipment Maintenance, Monitor cleanliness, report facility issues via ODIN tickets, and ensure timely resolution.

ODIN ticket open %, ODIN SLA breach rate, AN audit score, -Smooth Daily Operations | Ensure the gym is operational on time, manage check-ins, and assist with customer concerns

On-time center opening %, CH-BT% (Trial/Walk-in attendance)

Handling Issues & Conflict Resolution, Address complaints/escalations related to membership, facility, and equipment | Escalations handled successfully, % class cancellations due to facility issues

Safety & Compliance | Adhere to fire, safety, and compliance regulations; Ensure timely injury reporting and staff training | Adherence to FLS training, Number of injuries reported timely

A Day in the Life of a CSO - Morning Opening Duties: Ensure gym cleanliness, readiness, and equipment functionality.

Member Engagement: Welcome early members, assist with check-ins, answer queries. - Sales & Renewals: Conduct gym tours for walk-ins, follow up on potential memberships. - Admin & CRM Updates: Process renewals, cancellations, and track inquiries.

Peak Hour Management: Handle member queries, facility concerns, and escalations. - Closing Duties: Ensure facility cleanliness, safety checks, and closing procedures
AboutCompany:

The brand combines technology with expert-led workouts, yoga, and therapy sessions to make healthy living accessible and engaging. With a strong focus on holistic wellness, Cult Fit empowers individuals to build sustainable fitness habits and improve overall quality of life.

What does this role entail?
PwC US Advisory Management Consulting
Our Management Consulting team works with our global clients to design and implement
growth, operational and customer focused strategies for sustainable competitive advantage.
Our thought leadership and unparalleled experience help clients turn formidable challenges



into market advantage across the value chain and around the globe. Additionally, our
extensive expertise in various industries allows us to serve clients with consulting services
with a focus on the most protable elements of the value chain to create scalable businesses
that will deliver increased sustainable prots.
Our Management Consultants work with the client and project teams to support global
engagements from India through activities that are driven towards delivering results:
conduct analyses and develop insights, prepare excel models, analyze large sets of data,
capture as-is processes, prepare work plans, design to-be processes, support project lead,
work directly with client teams and facilitate meetings to enable decision making, organize
and prepare recommendations on client issues, and participate actively in new business
development, thought leadership and rm building activities.
Competency Overview: Sector Ops - Health
The Sector Ops - Health team works with clients across healthcare, supporting engagements
in driving clients strategic vision and objectives, assessing market expansion and growth
strategies, researching key market trends and its impact on key stakeholders, driving
operational and process improvements, evaluating sustainable cost transformation
alternatives and enabling technology driven business success.
Our team supports a broad range of healthcare clients across Provider, Payer, and Pharma &
Life Sciences, with projects spanning operational improvement, organizational
transformation, growth strategy, technology, and data and analytics.
In the provider team, we work with health systems to design and implement organizational
transformations that improve performance and enable sustainable growth. Our work
includes labor and productivity assessments, portfolio rationalization, benchmarking,
process mapping and design, operating model design, project management, technology
eectiveness assessments, and market strategy.

Job Description Summary
Insurance Follow-Up:
Contact insurance companies via phone, email, or online portals to follow up on outstanding claims. Identify and resolve issues causing payment delays, such as claim denials or underpayments. Verify claim status, appeal denied claims, and resubmit claims when necessary.
Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of all communications and actions taken. Update account information and billing systems with payment details and follow-up notes. Generate reports on accounts receivable status, aging trends, and collection efforts.
Compliance and Regulations: Adhere to HIPAA regulations and guidelines to ensure patient confidentiality and data security. Stay informed about insurance policies, billing guidelines, and industry changes affecting reimbursement.
Team Collaboration: Collaborate with internal departments, including billing, coding, and collections teams, to resolve payment issues. Participate in meetings and discussions to improve revenue cycle processes and workflow.
PMS Experience: Epic HB or PB experience is Mandatory
Requirements: SP
Proven experience (1-3 years) in healthcare revenue cycle management, specifically in accounts receivable follow-up and collections.
Strong understanding of medical billing processes, insurance claims, and reimbursement methodologies.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively interact with insurance companies, patients, and internal stakeholders.
Proficiency in using billing software, electronic health records (EHR), and Microsoft Office applications.
Attention to detail and ability to prioritize tasks to meet deadlines.
Knowledge of medical coding (ICD-10, CPT) is a plus.
Experience Level: 1 to 3 years.
Shift timings: Flexible to work in night shifts (US Time zone)
Preferred Qualification: Bachelors degree in finance or Any Graduate

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Data Science Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will focus on leveraging advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets and drive data-driven decision-making. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will work on exploratory and descriptive analysis, statistical modeling, and creating data visualizations to help solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing data-driven strategies using machine learning, predictive modeling, and artificial intelligence
- Overseeing the creation and maintenance of data pipelines and data lakes to support large-scale data processing
- Collaborating with stakeholders to identify opportunities for leveraging data science to drive business growth
- Utilizing programming languages such as R and MATLAB to develop and refine data models and algorithms
- Promoting the use of innovative technologies and methodologies within data science teams
- Confirming data quality and integrity through rigorous data validation and troubleshooting processes
- Mentoring junior staff and fostering a culture of continuous learning and development within the team
- Engaging in strategic planning and execution to align data science projects with organizational goals
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Business Analytics, Computer and Information Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Programming, Data Processing/Analytics/Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Systems Engineering
- Demonstrating proficiency in data science algorithms and workflows
- Utilizing machine learning and deep learning techniques effectively
- Excelling in data-driven decision making and predictive modeling
- Managing data pipelines and confirming data quality
- Leveraging programming languages such as R and MATLAB
- Applying natural language processing and neural network methodologies

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Required Technical Skills
Programming & Application Support:
.NET Framework, Visual Basic (VB.NET), ASP.NET Web Forms, Windows Forms, WPF
UI & Integration:
iFrame-based application integration, web application embedding, HTML, JavaScript (basic troubleshooting)
Reporting & Data Integration:
SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), T-SQL
Database Support:
SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Views, Indexing, Query Optimization
Performance & Troubleshooting:
Visual Studio Debugger, SQL Profiler, Performance Monitor, Application Logs
Server & Deployment:
IIS, Windows Services, Scheduled Tasks, Windows Server
DevOps & CI/CD:
Azure DevOps, Jenkins, MSBuild, NuGet, Git, TFS
Monitoring & Logging:
Splunk, ELK Stack, Windows Event Viewer, Application Insights
Security & Compliance:
Authentication & Authorization, Role-Based Access Control, SSL/TLS, Secure Coding Practices
Key Responsibilities
1 Incident Management & Troubleshooting
Provide Level 2/3 support for applications built on .NET Framework and Visual Basic.
Troubleshoot application crashes, functional defects, and performance issues.
Debug issues related to assemblies, DLL dependencies, and configuration mismatches.
Analyze logs, Windows Event Viewer, and application traces to identify root causes.
Follow ITIL-based Incident, Change, and Problem Management processes using ServiceNow, JIRA, or Remedy.
2 Reporting & Data Integration Support
Support, troubleshoot, and enhance SSRS reports, subscriptions, and scheduled deliveries.
Debug and optimize SSIS packages for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL).
Resolve data accuracy, performance, and failure issues in SSIS jobs.
Support business users with reporting requirements and ad-hoc data requests.
3 Database & Query Optimization
Analyze and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and indexes.
Resolve database performance issues impacting application and reporting workloads.
Support data validation, reconciliation, and data consistency checks.
4 UI & Integration Support
Support applications leveraging iFrame-based integrations between internal and external systems.
Troubleshoot rendering, authentication, and session-related issues in embedded applications.
Collaborate with frontend and integration teams to resolve cross-application issues.
5 Performance Optimization
Identify performance bottlenecks in application code, database queries, and reporting layers.
Optimize application response times, report execution duration, and data refresh cycles.
Monitor application health and proactively address performance degradation.
6 Server & Environment Support
Deploy and support applications hosted on IIS and Windows Servers.
Manage Windows Services, batch jobs, and scheduled tasks supporting application workflows.
Coordinate environment-related fixes across Development, QA, and Production systems.
7 CI/CD & DevOps Support
Support build and deployment pipelines for .NET and SSIS/SSRS artifacts.
Assist with automated deployments using Azure DevOps, MSBuild, and release pipelines.
Maintain source control practices using Git or TFS.
8 Security & Compliance
Ensure applications and reports comply with enterprise security and compliance standards.
Support secure authentication, authorization, and data access controls.
Address vulnerabilities and audit findings related to application and reporting platforms.
9 Collaboration & Documentation
Work in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) environments supporting continuous improvement.
Maintain technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Development, Infrastructure, DBA, and Business stakeholders.

Leading data engineering workstreams for Databricks-based client solutions across data modernization initiatives

- Leading client-facing data modernization work through complex delivery
- Crafting data pipelines, modeling, and transformation solutions
- Coaching teams through ambiguity while solving technical issues

Description:
Data Lead
Location :: Bangalore , Chennai , Hyderabad
Years of exp :: 8+
3 days' Work from office
Job Description Summary

About this opportunity :
Join our Team as a Data Lead. You'll work within multi-functional product engineering teams to deliver top-quality data capabilities, demonstrating your engineering expertise and cloud opportunities
What youll be doing:
Implement scalable, resilient, low-latency data systems.
Ensure systems meet performance and reliability standards.
Collaborate with engineering leadership and stakeholders.
Set technical strategy and best practices for data engineering.
Deliver solutions for multiple entities within the group.
Ensure alignment with business needs and cloud opportunities.
Promote secure, high-quality data pipelines.
Implement standards for data integrity and compliance.
Identify and eliminate recurring issues through automation.
Improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
Provide guidance and technical leadership.
What youll need:
Extensive industry experience in designing, building and supporting distributed systems and large-scale data processing systems in production with a proven track record.
Expertise in GCP Data Products for storage, processing, analytics, and machine learning, enabling enterprises to manage, analyse, and derive insights from data at scale e.g. BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Composer.
Good hands on experience to Build Batch Data and Streaming Data Pipelines on Google Cloud
Proven experience and knowledge of automation and CI/CD – Jenkins, GitHub & Spinnaker.
Best practice coding/scripting experience developed in a commercial/industry setting (Python, SQL, Java, Scala or Go).
Strong working experience with operational data stores, data warehouse, big data technologies and data lakes
Experience in using distributed frameworks (Spark, Flink, Beam, Hadoop)
Good knowledge of containers (Docker, Kubernetes etc) and experience with cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS.
Strong experience working with (Real Time streaming), such as Kafka technologies.
Clear understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design, design patterns and core programming concepts.
Good understating of cloud storage, networking, and resource provisioning
And any experience of these would be really useful:
Certification in GCP “Cloud Architect”, “Cloud Developer”, “Professional Data Engineer”
Certification in Apache Kafka (CCDAK)

Description:
Years of Experience
5-9 Years

Position Requirements
Extensive SAP S/4HANA Finance & Controlling expert with hands-on solution design, configuration, testing and deployment experience; preferably with an accounts/finance and cost/management accounting background.
Strong, demonstrable expertise in CO sub-modules: CO-CCA (Cost Center Accounting), CO-PCA (Profit Center Accounting), CO-PC (Product Costing) product cost planning, standard cost estimates, cost estimate with/without quantity structure, mixed costing, variance analysis, WIP calculation, and settlement — Material Ledger (ML) and Actual Costing — multi-level actual costing run, periodic unit price, alternative valuation runs, parallel currencies/valuations — along with Profitability Analysis (CO-PA — costing-based and/or account-based), Internal Orders, and Overhead Cost Controlling, alongside FI-GL, FI-AR, FI-AP, Asset Accounting and ICMR.
Proven, hands-on experience configuring Controlling building blocks end-to-end: cost element/cost center hierarchies, activity types and planning, allocation cycles (assessment/distribution), costing sheets, cost component structures, Material Ledger activation and actual costing configuration, and profitability reporting structures.
Full lifecycle exposure to Product Costing and Material Ledger solutions — from requirement gathering and design (blueprinting/fit-gap), through configuration, unit/integration/UAT testing, cutover, and post-go-live deployment support.
Ability to mentor and manage multiple teams and projects, with CO, Product Costing, and Material Ledger design ownership across workstreams.
Participate in design discussions, providing deep expertise on SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling capabilities (e.g., universal journal-based CO-FI real-time integration, margin analysis, Material Ledger as the valuation backbone in S/4HANA).
Work with business/controlling users to understand requirements and propose alternative design solutions for cost allocation, product costing, inventory valuation, and profitability reporting.
Develop a collaborative, cohesive team culture with a “One Team” mindset.
Hands-on experience in Finance, Controlling and management accounting processes, with the ability to translate accounting requirements into system configuration.
Hands-on experience across S/4HANA Finance features with ability to design, develop, configure and test integrations between CO/Product Costing/Material Ledger and other modules — MM/SD/PS/PP/PM/IM — particularly cost flows from procurement, production, and project systems into Controlling and inventory valuation objects.
Knowledge of CFIN, and understanding of the elimination of ETL tools to enable real-time transactional-level matching.
Understanding of AIF, field value mapping, centralized transaction processing, payments, intercompany reconciliation, and group consolidation using S/4HANA Group Reporting.
Hands-on experience in S/4HANA Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation (ICMR), backed by a solid accounting, finance, and controlling background.
Demonstrated functional experience in Intercompany Reconciliation processes in SAP.
Knowledge and experience implementing SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting is an added advantage.

Preferred Knowledge
Hands-on, configuration-level knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling, including Product Costing and Material Ledger, other integration workstreams, CFIN, and ICMR, with the ability to drive projects through full design-configure-test-deploy cycles.
Understanding of different project delivery methodologies, especially Agile and Scrum frameworks, applied to CO, Product Costing, and Material Ledger design and testing cycles.

Preferred Skill
Hands-on configuration and design experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance, with demonstrable depth in Controlling (CO), Product Costing, and Material Ledger design, configuration and testing.
Familiarity with onsite/offshore delivery models and hands-on experience across system landscape environments (e.g., Dev/QA/Prod, transport management for CO/Product Costing/ML configuration).
Familiarity with Implementation, Support, Rollout, and Training delivery models — including testing phases specific to Product Costing and Material Ledger (cost estimate testing, actual costing run validation, integration testing across MM/SD/PP, UAT, and cutover/deployment support).
Familiarity with role matrix/role testing and ability to assist technical team members on CO/Product Costing/ML-related developments (reports, BAdIs, enhancements).
Familiarity with both Waterfall and Agile approaches to software/configuration delivery.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Ownership and commitment, flexible timings.
Expertise in JIRA and Agile delivery model.

Professional and Educational Background
Senior Associate — 5-9 years of experience.
5+ years of experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance with a strong Controlling, Product Costing and Material Ledger component, with a minimum of 2 end-to-end implementations involving CO/PC/ML design, configuration, testing and deployment.

Job Title
ETL Testing Engineer / Data Warehouse Tester
Experience
3 -10 Years
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled ETL Testing Engineer to validate data extraction, transformation, and loading processes in data warehouse and business intelligence environments. The ideal candidate should possess strong SQL skills, hands-on ETL testing experience, and expertise in data validation and quality assurance.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business and technical requirements related to data migration and ETL processes.
Design and execute ETL test cases, test plans, and test scenarios.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading from source systems to target databases.
Perform data integrity, completeness, and reconciliation testing.
Verify data mappings, transformation rules, and business logic.
Execute database testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects through defect management tools.
Perform regression, integration, system, and UAT support testing.
Validate data quality and consistency across multiple platforms.
Collaborate with developers, data engineers, business analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test metrics, reports, and test execution status updates.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of ETL Testing concepts and methodologies.
Hands-on experience with ETL tools such as:
Informatica
SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services)
Talend
DataStage
Ab Initio
Advanced SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation.
Experience with Data Warehouse concepts including:
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Fact and Dimension Tables
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
Experience with database platforms such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Teradata.
Expertise in data quality and data migration testing.
Familiarity with defect tracking tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps).
Preferred Skills
Automation experience using Python, Selenium, or ETL automation frameworks.
Experience with cloud data platforms:
Azure Data Factory (ADF)
Azure Synapse
AWS Glue
Snowflake
Databricks
Knowledge of Big Data technologies (Hive, Hadoop, Spark).
Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
Performance and volume testing experience.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
Certification in ETL, Data Warehousing, or Database technologies is a plus.

We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.

Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.

Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.

Description:
Job Description:

Production Support Engineer (AWS Support + Java Spring Boot + SQL)

Position
Production Support Engineer / Application Support Engineer

Experience
8 - 15 Years
Location
Bangalore / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai (as applicable)

Job Summary

We are looking for a Production Support Engineer with strong experience in AWS Cloud Support, Java Spring Boot applications, and SQL databases. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, application support, root cause analysis, and ensuring the stability and availability of production systems.
The ideal candidate should have experience supporting cloud-hosted applications, handling production incidents, analyzing logs, and collaborating with development and infrastructure teams.
Key Responsibilities
Provide L2/L3 production support for Java-based applications hosted on AWS.
Monitor application health, system performance, and business-critical services.
Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents within defined SLAs.
Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures.
Analyze application logs, server logs, and database issues.
Support deployment activities and release management processes.
Work with development teams to resolve recurring production issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, and change requests through ticketing tools.
Monitor AWS infrastructure and application services.
Create and maintain support documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.
Participate in on-call support and production release activities.

Description:
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Saleforce DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Salesforce DevOps practices and tools such as Copado, Git, and Azure DevOps (ADO). The candidate will play a key role in designing, implementing, and managing CI/CD pipelines, enabling efficient, reliable, and scalable release management across Salesforce environments.
Key Responsibilities
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce using Copado and ADO.
Manage source control strategy with Git (branching, merging, conflict resolution).
Automate deployments across multiple Salesforce environments, ensuring alignment with governance and compliance requirements.
Collaborate with development teams to define DevOps best practices and enforce coding standards.
Support release management activities, including planning, monitoring, and issue resolution.
Integrate testing, code quality checks, and security scans into the deployment pipeline.
Provide troubleshooting support for deployment issues and perform root cause analysis.
Create documentation, knowledge base articles, and training to upskill development teams.
Work closely with stakeholders (functional, technical, QA, and business) to ensure seamless delivery.
Required Skills & Experience
48 years of overall IT experience with 3+ years in Salesforce DevOps.
Hands-on experience with Copado (mandatory).
Strong knowledge of Git-based workflows (feature branching, pull requests, code review).
Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) pipelines and work item tracking.
Familiarity with Salesforce metadata, SFDX, and package-based deployments.
Knowledge of release management processes in large-scale enterprise environments.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot deployment failures.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery models.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Gearset, AutoRABIT, or other Salesforce DevOps tools.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization concepts.
Knowledge of test automation tools (Selenium, Provar, etc.) integrated with CI/CD.
Salesforce certifications (Admin/Platform Developer) and Copado certifications.

Description:
Position: PLM Support Engineer
Experience: 3 to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai / Hyderabad (or as applicable)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.
CAD & Integration Support
Provide support for CAD integrations with Siemens NX, CATIA, and related engineering applications.
Troubleshoot CAD data loading, synchronization issues, and integration failures.
Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.
Workflow & System Administration Support
Troubleshoot workflow integration issues, dispatcher failures, workflow processing delays, and PDF generation errors.
Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.
Participate in release validation, patch deployment, and post-deployment support activities.
Required Technical Skills
PLM Technologies
Strong experience in at least one or more PLM applications:
Teamcenter
Aras Innovator
SmarTeam
Functional Knowledge
Engineering Change Management (ECR/ECO/ECN)
Product Structure Management
BOM Management
Workflow Management
Release Management
Document Management
CAD Integration
Siemens NX
CATIA
CAD Data Management
Technical Skills
SQL Queries and Database Fundamentals
PLM Data Model Understanding
Workflow Configuration and Troubleshooting
Dispatcher Monitoring
PDF Generation Processes
Job Server and Vault Management
Application Log Analysis
Support Tools
ServiceNow / Jira / Remedy
Incident & Change Management Tools
Monitoring and Reporting Tools
Desired Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3 to 8 years of experience in PLM application support.
Experience in global production support environments.
Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
ITIL certification is preferred.
Required Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work with global and cross-functional teams.
Customer-focused approach with strong ownership mindset.
Ability to work in rotational shifts and provide production support when required.
Strong documentation and reporting skills.
Preferred Skills
Teamcenter BMIDE knowledge.
Teamcenter Active Workspace exposure.
Aras administration/support experience.
Understanding of manufacturing and engineering business processes.
Exposure to deployment and release management activities.
Experience in performance tuning and application monitoring.

Description:
Role & responsibilities:
Proactively assist in the management of a portfolio of clients, while reporting to Senior Managers and above.
Be involved in the financial metrics.
Be actively involved in business development activities to help identify and research opportunities on new/existing clients.
Contribute to the development of your own and teams technical acumen.
Use data and insights to inform conclusions and support decision-making.
Adherence to SLAs, experience in incident management, change management and problem management.
Develop new skills and strategies to solve complex technical challenges.
Assist in the management and delivering of large projects.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Design and implement real-time integration strategies connecting SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, and Ariba to ensure seamless data flow across systems.
2. Deploy and manage SAP AI Core and Generative AI technologies to automate and optimize core business processes.

As a Manager, youll work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience, helping our clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution. Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Basic ABAP knowledge and SAP BTP Knowledge
If SLD knowledge is there than it will be an added advantage.

Description:
We are currently hiring for Sales Specialist for our Apple Retail Stores in India.


Do you love how it feels to encourage others? As a Part-Time Specialist, you help create the energy and excitement around Apple products, providing the right solutions and getting products into customers hands. You understand that the Apple Store is dedicated to delivering a customer experience thats unlike any other. It starts with you discovering customers needs. And with the support of your store team members, you match those needs with the right products. Every day is an opportunity for you to turn another Apple Store visitor into a loyal Apple customer.


Role & responsibilities

Deliver excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy products.
Understand and proactively stay up to date on Apples products, services, purchase options and Product Zone sales processes.
Support your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apples products, services and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities. Maintain accuracy and follow guidance.
Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.
Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each others differences and having the curiosity to learn.
Demonstrate Apples values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.



Preferred candidate profile

Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services.
Personalise solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apples core values.
You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

This is a Part-Time opportunity, requiring you to work 4 Days in a week for 5 hours each day i.e 20 hours in a week.


Location

Bangalore , Delhi, Noida
