Description:
Position - Senior Enterprise AI Architect GenAI, Agentic AI & Enterprise Applications
Location : Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai (Hybrid / Work from Office as per project requirement)
Experience : 15–25 Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly experienced Enterprise AI Architect who can drive the design and implementation of AI/GenAI solutions across large-scale enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should have experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise business platforms such as:
SAP (S/4 HANA, SAP BTP, SAP AI Core)
Oracle (Oracle ERP, Oracle CX, Oracle Cloud)
Salesforce
ServiceNow
PEGA
The role requires a blend of Enterprise Architecture, AI Strategy, Agentic AI, GenAI, Platform Integration, and Business Transformation.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise AI Transformation
Define Enterprise AI strategy and target-state architecture.
Drive AI adoption across enterprise applications and business processes.
Build AI-led transformation roadmaps aligned to business objectives.
Enterprise Platform Integration
Design and implement AI solutions integrated with:
SAP
Oracle
Salesforce
ServiceNow
PEGA
Generative AI & Agentic AI
Architect GenAI and Agentic AI solutions using:
OpenAI
Azure OpenAI
AWS Bedrock
Anthropic Claude
Gemini
Llama
Design autonomous and multi-agent workflows.
Implement enterprise-grade RAG architectures.
AI Solution Architecture
Build scalable and secure AI platforms.
Define reference architectures, governance frameworks, and reusable AI patterns.
Establish LLMOps, MLOps, observability, evaluation, and monitoring mechanisms.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business leaders, CIOs, CTOs, Enterprise Architects, and Product Owners.
Conduct architecture reviews and technical governance.
Lead client workshops, solutioning discussions, and strategic transformation initiatives.
Must-Have Skills
AI / GenAI
Generative AI
Agentic AI
RAG
LangChain
LangGraph
LLM Integration
Prompt Engineering
AI Governance
Enterprise Platforms (Critical)
Strong hands-on experience in at least one or more:
SAP
Oracle
Salesforce
ServiceNow
PEGA
Cloud Platforms
Azure
AWS
GCP
Architecture
Enterprise Architecture
Solution Architecture
Microservices
API-led Architecture
Cloud-native Design
Preferred Skills
SAP AI Core / SAP BTP
Oracle ERP / Oracle CX
Salesforce AI initiatives
ServiceNow AI integrations
TOGAF Certification
BFSI, Retail, Healthcare, Telecom, Manufacturing experience
AI Center of Excellence leadership
What We Are Looking For
Candidates who have successfully implemented:
AI + SAP
AI + Oracle
AI + Salesforce
AI + ServiceNow
AI + PEGA
rather than profiles that are purely focused on standalone GenAI, Data Science, or AI research.
Summary -
"We are looking for a Senior Enterprise AI Architect who has implemented GenAI/Agentic AI solutions on top of enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, PEGA. The role is focused on enterprise transformation, AI integration, and business process automation rather than standalone AI development."
Detailed Job Description
Position Overview
Tech Mahindra is hiring Senior AI Architects across Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, and Bangalore. This role is for senior technology leaders who can define AI architecture strategy, design enterprise-grade solutions, and guide teams from concept to production at scale.
The position combines strategic advisory responsibilities with hands-on architecture and implementation leadership. It is suited to professionals who can connect business priorities, enterprise platforms, cloud ecosystems, and AI engineering practices into scalable and reusable solution patterns.
Role Purpose
The Senior AI Architect will shape and validate AI-led transformation programs for enterprise clients, with a strong focus on scalable architecture, reusable assets, and outcome-driven solution design. The role is expected to bridge business stakeholders, enterprise architects, platform teams, data and AI engineering teams, and delivery leadership across global engagements.
This role requires practical judgment on how AI should be embedded into enterprise landscapes, including business applications, integration layers, governance controls, and production operations. Strong communication with CXOs and cross-functional stakeholders is central to success in this role.
Key Responsibilities
Define target-state AI and data architecture aligned to business outcomes, enterprise architecture standards, and transformation roadmaps.
Design end-to-end AI solution architectures covering data pipelines, model development, deployment, monitoring, security, and integration with enterprise applications.
Build scalable and reusable assets, accelerators, reference architectures, frameworks, and patterns for enterprise AI adoption.
Evaluate and validate solution options across cloud, AI, and enterprise application platforms such as SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, and Salesforce.
Lead architecture reviews, technical due diligence, feasibility studies, and proof-of-concept direction for AI initiatives.
Collaborate with business leaders, delivery teams, product owners, security teams, and global stakeholders to shape credible and implementable solutions.
Establish good practices for testing, deployment, observability, lifecycle management, and production support of AI systems.
Drive architectural governance across responsible AI, compliance, privacy, model risk, and enterprise security requirements.
Mentor engineering and architecture teams, influence critical technology choices, and support executive-level solution positioning.
Required Experience
12+ years of overall experience in enterprise technology, architecture, or digital transformation, with strong recent experience in AI/ML solution architecture and delivery.
Proven hands-on experience designing and implementing production-grade AI or ML solutions for enterprise use cases.
Experience across more than one enterprise platform, preferably SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or adjacent enterprise ecosystems.
Experience working in architecture consulting, transformation programs, or complex enterprise modernization engagements.
Demonstrated ability to work with CXOs, business stakeholders, and multidisciplinary global teams to influence architectural decisions.
Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, API-led architecture, security, scalability, and non-functional design principles.
AI And Technical Skills
AI Architecture
End-to-end AI/ML architecture, including data ingestion, feature engineering, training pipelines, model serving, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Experience with generative AI architecture, including LLM-based applications, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt orchestration, guardrails, and evaluation patterns.
Ability to define reference patterns for recommendation, forecasting, NLP, computer vision, intelligent automation, and enterprise copilots.
Cloud And MLOps
Strong architecture experience on one or more cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
Working knowledge of enterprise MLOps and LLMOps practices such as experiment tracking, model registry, pipeline orchestration, deployment automation, and model monitoring.
Experience with tools and platforms such as Azure Machine Learning, Amazon SageMaker, Vertex AI, Databricks, MLflow, Kubeflow, DVC, Airflow, or equivalent ecosystems.
AI Engineering Stack
Hands-on familiarity with Python and common AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar tools used in enterprise AI delivery.
Understanding of vector databases, knowledge retrieval patterns, API orchestration, agent frameworks, and model integration approaches for production AI systems.
Experience integrating AI services with enterprise applications, data platforms, and middleware layers using secure and scalable design patterns.
Enterprise Platform Expectations
Candidates should bring hands-on architecture or implementation exposure across at least two enterprise platforms or transformation ecosystems. Preferred experience includes SAP BTP or SAP AI capabilities, Oracle enterprise applications and data services, ServiceNow workflow and automation platforms, Salesforce ecosystem integrations, and broader enterprise application modernization patterns.
The role values professionals who can embed AI into enterprise process landscapes rather than treating AI as a standalone lab initiative. Strong grounding in business process transformation, platform interoperability, and enterprise-scale rollout models is important for success.
Leadership And Consulting Skills
Executive presence and the ability to articulate architecture choices, trade-offs, risks, and value realization clearly to senior business and technology stakeholders.
Strong consulting mindset with structured problem solving, solution framing, estimation support, and transformation roadmap definition.
Ability to lead cross-functional workshops, align distributed teams, and drive decisions in complex, fast-moving programs.
Practical, solution-oriented approach with the confidence to challenge weak designs and strengthen architecture quality before implementation.
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline is required. A master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.
Preferred Certifications
AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud architecture certifications.
AI/ML specialty certifications on major cloud platforms.
Enterprise architecture or platform certifications across SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or related ecosystems.
Work Locations
Hyderabad | Chennai | Pune | Bangalore

About Us
Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.

You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.

MAKE AN IMPACT
Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.

#BEYOURSELFATWORK
Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.

CAREER ADVANCEMENT
With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION
We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.

Job Description:
IRR Business Analyst
Key Responsibilities
The role holder is required to perform a range of activities across the specific sub-workstreams including:
Produce & maintain Process documentation
Design, Implement and Capture Controls on Helios
Capturing the Data Dictionary & Data Lineage
Capturing the Data Quality controls
Capture the Regulatory Rules & Interpretations applied by the Business for the returns
The role holder will work closely with the Process and Control Owners to obtain their sign-off. The role holder will be required to provide updates on the work progress to the central IRR delivery streams and, where appropriate, the other workstreams to ensure delivery to plan.

Required Qualifications
Experience in, and thorough understanding of, managing, overseeing and applying controls across a Finance function, including those underpinning SOX and Operational Risk frameworks
Good relationship management, collaboration and influencing skills
Good interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral.
Confident and comfortable and experienced in engaging senior stakeholders
A leader, comfortable taking initiative
Drive, commitment and focus on operational excellence
Experience of resolving issues and problems by a systematic approach
Data and process analysis skills
Committed to continuous improvement, self-motivated, confident, creative and capable of working effectively autonomously as well as part of a team
Prior experience of designing and implementing new controls and processes
Experience in change and transformation programme.
Cross-Finance knowledge and experience.
Knowledge of MREL regulatory reporting an advantage.

Description:
Data Engineer
Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Gurgaon, Chennai
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Building the machine learning production System(or MLOps) is the biggest challenge most large companies currently have in making the transition to becoming an AI-driven organization. This position is an opportunity for an experienced, server-side developer to build expertise in this exciting new frontier. You will be part of a team deploying state-of-the-art AI solutions for Fractal clients.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
As MLOps Engineer, you will work collaboratively with Data Scientists and Data engineers to deploy and operate advanced analytics machine learning models. You ll help automate and streamline Model development and Model operations. You ll build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring, and operations. You ll also troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation Develop scalable ML pipelines
Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry
Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML E2E PaaS/SaaS
Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components
Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud(AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem Be an integral part of client business development and delivery engagements across multiple domains.
QUALIFICATIONS: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
3-12 years experience building production-quality software
Strong experience in System Integration, Application Development or DataWarehouse projects across technologies used in the enterprise space
Basic Knowledge of MLOps, machine learning and docker
Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions
Team handling, problem solving, project management and communication skills & creative thinking
Foundational Knowledge of Cloud Computing either one AWS, Azure or GCP
Hunger and passion for learning new skills
Recommended (not mandatory): completion of Fractal Data Science Professional Certificate" with this - https: / / www.coursera.org / professional-certificates / fractal-data-science
EDUCATION:
B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent.
AboutCompany:
Fractal Analytics Ltd is a global analytics and AI company that provides advanced decision-making solutions to enterprises. Its careers page highlights roles in data science, engineering, consulting, and product development, reflecting its focus on leveraging AI, machine learning, and analytics. The company emphasizes innovation, client-centric insights, and technology-driven strategies to help businesses improve efficiency and competitiveness.

Description:
M&A and Private Equity Consulting - ConsultantPractice:Accenture Strategy - M&A and Private Equity Consulting (Global Network)
Location:Gurgaon / Mumbai / Bangalore

About Practice
Accenture's Transaction Advisory team sits at the heart of strategic value creation across the deal lifecycle. We support both Private Equity (PE) and Corporate clients, partnering on initiatives from target screening and due diligence to integration, separation, and portfolio value enhancement.
This team works in close collaboration with Capability Network Industry/Functional teams, Client Account Teams, and Global M&A/PE Leadership across geographies - offering unmatched opportunities to lead and shape high-impact consulting engagements.
What You'll Do -
Key Responsibilities
Deliver strategic engagements across the full M&A lifecycle:
Pre-Deal:Target screening, sector/company research, commercial/operational/technology due diligence, synergy assessment
Deal Execution - Day 1 Planning, synergy and value creation planning, business model evaluation, go-to-market and product strategy assessment
Post-Deal:Integration/separation planning and execution, operating model alignment, cost/value capture realization, portfolio transformation initiatives, and functional scaling and readiness of entities across areas like supply chain, finance, HR, and IT
Work across both Functional M&A (such as operating model shifts, supply chain optimization, commercial acceleration, workforce and org redesign, harmonization of legal and other operational processes, etc.) and Tech M&A (IT/cyber due diligence, platform assessment, tech separation/integration) depending on client need
Collaborate with account teams and global leadership to shape opportunities and deliver client orals and proposals
Develop and contribute to new IP, accelerators, POVs, and brown bag sessions to drive practice development
Role-Specific Expectations
Project Workstream Execution:Collaborate with managers to define deliverables, lead workstreams, manage timelines, and ensure high-quality outputs
Tech M&A:Exposure to either pre-deal (e.g., platform diligence) or post-deal (e.g., IT integration/separation) is acceptable
Functional M&A:Must have hands-on experience in post-deal execution, including integration/separation of functions
Engagement Support:Prepare client decks, support RFPs and thought capital development
Industry Focus (Preferred)
Experience working with clients in one or more of the following sectors is preferred:
CMT, Financial Services, Resources, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Consumer Goods & Services, Retail
Must-Have Skills
Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities with issue-based thinking
Experience in direct client interactions, including presenting findings and driving stakeholder discussions.
Experience with value creation strategies, growth and cost levers, and digital or tech transformation in deals
Business acumen and knowledge of M&A trends, investment models, and PE-backed transformation mandates
Deal Lifecycle Expertise Breakdown
Deal Stage
Functional M&A
Tech M&A
Pre-Deal
Commercial DD, Ops DD, Target Screening
Tech DD, Cyber DD, Digital DD (for digital product-based companies)
Deal Planning and Execution
Day 1 Planning, IMO
Day 1 Planning, IMO
Post-Deal
Functional Integration & Separation - Planning & Execution (Finance, HR, Supply Chain/Procurement functional exposure as good to have)
IT Integration & Separation - Planning & Execution
Why Join Us?
Work on some of the most strategic deals in the market with global clients and PE firms
Develop deep expertise across industries, technologies, and the full M&A lifecycle
Be part of a rapidly growing and entrepreneurial practice, with leadership exposure and growth opportunities
Access world-class learning and global collaboration in a high-performing, supportive culture


Qualification
Experience Required:
Consultant:3.5+ years post-MBA
Education:Full-time MBA from Tier 1 institute

Description:
Job Description
This role is part of the Marketing function and is responsible for driving strategy, market development, commercialization, and lifecycle management across assigned products and therapeutic areas. The Marketing team partners closely with Sales, Research & Development, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Finance, Operations, and regional stakeholders to identify growth opportunities, accelerate adoption, and deliver sustainable business results through customer-focused strategies.
This position is based in Gurgaon, India and operates in a Flex work model, combining on-site and remote work based on business needs. Travel of approximately 35-40% is expected to support customer engagement, market development activities, internal collaboration, and business initiatives across regions.
The Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and executing product, portfolio, and market strategies that drive commercial growth and customer impact. This individual will translate customer, market, and competitive insights into actionable strategies, lead commercialization initiatives, and influence cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. The role requires strong strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and accountability from opportunity identification through execution.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
Develop and execute product, portfolio, and market strategies aligned with commercial and business objectives.
Analyse customer, market, competitive, and business data to identify growth opportunities, unmet needs, and emerging market trends.
Lead product planning, commercialization, launch execution, market development, and lifecycle management 
initiatives.
Define customer segmentation, product positioning, value propositions, and go-to-market strategies to improve market performance.
Partner with Sales, Research & Development, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Finance, Operations, and regional teams to deliver strategic priorities.
Monitor business performance, evaluate return on investment, and optimise marketing programmes, resource allocation, and investments.
Influence stakeholders across functions and geographies to build alignment, support decision-making, and drive execution of key initiatives.
Manage project timelines, budgets, risks, and resources to ensure successful delivery of high-impact programmes.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline and 10+ years of experience in marketing, product management, commercial strategy, market development, or related commercial roles; MBA from a premier business school required.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing product, portfolio, or commercial strategies that delivered measurable business results.
Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and business functions.
Strong analytical capability with experience translating market, customer, competitive, and business insights into strategic recommendations.
Experience managing commercialization, product launch, market development, or lifecycle management activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience within MedTech, healthcare, medical devices, diagnostics, biotechnology, or life sciences industries.
Experience leading regional or multi-country marketing initiatives and influencing stakeholders across geographies.
People leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, or managing marketing professionals.
Experience with portfolio optimisation, market access strategies, and customer engagement planning.
Advanced proficiency in business analytics, forecasting, market assessment, and strategic planning methodologies.
AboutCompany: Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

Description:

Location:Gurgaon / Mumbai / Bangalore

About Practice
Accenture's Transaction Advisory team sits at the heart of strategic value creation across the deal lifecycle. We support both Private Equity (PE) and Corporate clients, partnering on initiatives from target screening and due diligence to integration, separation, and portfolio value enhancement.
This team works in close collaboration with Capability Network Industry/Functional teams, Client Account Teams, and Global M&A/PE Leadership across geographies - offering unmatched opportunities to lead and shape high-impact consulting engagements.
What You'll Do -
Key Responsibilities
Deliver strategic engagements across the full M&A lifecycle:
Pre-Deal:Target screening, sector/company research, commercial/operational/technology due diligence, synergy assessment
Deal Execution - Day 1 Planning, synergy and value creation planning, business model evaluation, go-to-market and product strategy assessment
Post-Deal:Integration/separation planning and execution, operating model alignment, cost/value capture realization, portfolio transformation initiatives, and functional scaling and readiness of entities across areas like supply chain, finance, HR, and IT
Work across both Functional M&A (such as operating model shifts, supply chain optimization, commercial acceleration, workforce and org redesign, harmonization of legal and other operational processes, etc.) and Tech M&A (IT/cyber due diligence, platform assessment, tech separation/integration) depending on client need
Collaborate with account teams and global leadership to shape opportunities and deliver client orals and proposals
Develop and contribute to new IP, accelerators, POVs, and brown bag sessions to drive practice development
Role-Specific Expectations
Project Workstream Execution:Collaborate with managers to define deliverables, lead workstreams, manage timelines, and ensure high-quality outputs
Tech M&A:Exposure to either pre-deal (e.g., platform diligence) or post-deal (e.g., IT integration/separation) is acceptable
Functional M&A:Must have hands-on experience in post-deal execution, including integration/separation of functions
Engagement Support:Prepare client decks, support RFPs and thought capital development
Industry Focus (Preferred)
Experience working with clients in one or more of the following sectors is preferred:
CMT, Financial Services, Resources, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Consumer Goods & Services, Retail
Must-Have Skills
Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities with issue-based thinking
Experience in direct client interactions, including presenting findings and driving stakeholder discussions.
Experience with value creation strategies, growth and cost levers, and digital or tech transformation in deals
Business acumen and knowledge of M&A trends, investment models, and PE-backed transformation mandates

Why Join Us?
Work on some of the most strategic deals in the market with global clients and PE firms
Develop deep expertise across industries, technologies, and the full M&A lifecycle
Be part of a rapidly growing and entrepreneurial practice, with leadership exposure and growth opportunities
Access world-class learning and global collaboration in a high-performing, supportive culture

CFO&EV includes the below domains: CFO Value Strategies - Defining strategies to uncover, assess, architect and capture value across the enterprise including M&A, investment decisions, operating model considerations and strategic cost reduction initiatives. Digital Risk and Compliance - Actively engage with clients to prepare and protect their enterprise in an increasingly volatile world, enabling business outcomes over the short, medium, and long term. The differentiating Capabilities of CFO&EV Practice combines the broad focus of CFO Strategy with agile planning, sustainable growth, data driven thinking and automation to drive value creation.
Accenture CFO&EV Practice has expertise in delivering Shared Services Transformations, Target operating model definition, Zero Based Organization/Zero Based Spend Full Cycle, Intelligent Enterprise Platforms Transformation/Automation, Enterprise Performance Management Strategy implementation, F&PA Process Design and Blueprints, AI-Powered Planning & Forecasting, Digital Reporting & Analytics, Enabling Technologies, Tax Process Automation, Treasury Strategy, Working Capital Optimization, Risk Strategy and Assessment, Cyber Resilience and Security, Financial Crime & Regulatory Compliance, Data Driven Consulting, Client Value Analysis, SAP BPC and S/4 HANA green field and brown field transformations with 150+ projects per year.

Seeking for candidates with strong and deep finance knowledge, process, and operational acumen in various aspects of finance coupled with strong consulting skills around problem identification, creative thinking, problem solving, strong and clear communication and presentation skills, stakeholder management, etc. Candidate will be operating in one of the above domains with opportunities to move across domains over the years. Opportunities to make a difference within exciting client initiatives coupled with Accentures leading assets, are limitless in this ever-changing business landscape. Developing detailed and actionable business cases and plans which reflect our practices deep industry, functional and business process acumen to leverage our assets and capabilities for greatest strategic impact. Working in multi-disciplinary teams to shape, sell, communicate and implement programs. Assisting leadership teams in developing offerings and assets

Should possess advanced excel skills and PPT skills with minimum 2+ years of working experience. Ability to convert complex data into effective displays that are consumable by clients/end-users.
Well-versed in Finance processes with 2 to 3 years of basic experience. Required Soft Skills: Demonstrate analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and creativity to solve non-standard analytics problems. Ability to collaborate with geographically dispersed teams. Strong communication and presentation skills. Attention to detail and accuracy. Self-starter with strong organizational, time management and multi-tasking skills. Job Title: Senior Alteryx Developer
Locations: Bangalore, Pune, Chennai, Hyderabad, Gurgaon, Mumbai

About Us
Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consulting firm. Awarded with Consultancy of the year in the British Bank Award and has been ranked Top 100 Best Companies for Women in India 2022 by Avtar & Seramount. With our presence across 32 cities across globe, we support 100+ clients across banking, financial and Energy sectors. We are recognized for our deep transformation execution and delivery.

WHY JOIN CAPCO?
You will work on engaging projects with the largest international and local banks, insurance companies, payment service providers and other key players in the industry. The projects that will transform the financial services industry.

MAKE AN IMPACT
Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.

#BEYOURSELFATWORK
Capco has a tolerant, open culture that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity.

CAREER ADVANCEMENT
With no forced hierarchy at Capco, everyone has the opportunity to grow as we grow, taking their career into their own hands.

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION
We believe that diversity of people and perspective gives us a competitive advantage.

Job Description:
Senior Alteryx Developer (15-25 Years Experience)
Key Responsibilities
Proven Alteryx experience (workflow, macros, applications)
Integration skills (Python/SQL/VBA are a bonus)
Strong, independent problem-solving abilities is a must

Responsibilities:
Design and maintain Alteryx workflows to automate data extraction, transformation, validation, and submission for regulatory reports.
Integrate Alteryx with other technology stacks (Oracle DB, REST APIs, APPIAN) to create seamless data pipelines and eliminate manual data processing / ETLs.
Develop Python/SQL scripts for the automation of regulatory reporting production processes along with audit trail generation.
Implement automated controls to monitor completeness and accuracy of regulatory report production processes.
Ensure workflows comply with internal control and regulatory standards by embedding self-documenting logic and error logs.
Partner with reporting team and IT to deploy Tableau/Power BI dashboards for report variance analysis and executive insights.
Train non-technical teams on Alteryx utilization ("code-free" analytics) and foster a culture of automation.

Description:
Its fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.
5-8 years of as a Data Scientist with deep expertise in GenAI, NLP/LLM technologies. The candidate should have hands-on experience ML model building as well as training and fine-tuning large language models from the ground up. This role requires a strong technical background in machine learning, deep learning, and practical experience with modern AI frameworks.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and implement advanced solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs).
Take full ownership of initiatives, delivering end-to-end solutions with minimal supervision.
Stay current with the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG systems, and applied research.
Build and maintain reusable code libraries, tools, and frameworks to accelerate AI development.
Participate in code reviews to ensure high-quality, maintainable, and scalable solutions.
Contribute across the entire software development lifecycle-design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align AI solutions with business goals, integrate contributions into core systems, and influence roadmaps.
Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to design efficient solutions for complex business challenges.
Communicate effectively across technical and non-technical teams, ensuring transparency and alignment.
Own business impact of AI solutions, including adoption, accuracy, latency, and cost efficiency
Translate ambiguous business problems into structured AI solution approaches and measurable outcomes
Drive solution success metrics (e.g., productivity gains, automation %, decision accuracy)
Engage directly with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, present solutions, and influence decision-making
Communicate solution architecture and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Contribute to client discussions, PoCs, and proposal development.
Design scalable, modular, and production-grade AI systems (APIs, pipelines, orchestration layers)
Define architecture patterns for LLM applications (RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, hybrid systems)
Make trade-offs across latency, cost, accuracy, and maintainability
Build reusable accelerators, frameworks, and components that can be leveraged across multiple use cases and clients
Contribute to internal IP creation (assets, templates, reference architectures)
Ensure reliability and robustness of LLM systems through evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and fallback strategies
Design safe and responsible AI systems (hallucination mitigation, bias handling, governance)
Optimize cost-performance trade-offs in large-scale deployments
Identify when NOT to use LLMs and propose alternative approaches
Contribute to code reviews, design reviews, and mentorship of junior team members
Drive quality standards and best practices across projects
Stay ahead of advancements in GenAI and proactively evaluate their applicability to business problems
Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, training, and capability building.

Must-Have Skills:

Generative AI & NLP:

SaaS-based LLMs: LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases, prompt engineering (CoT, ReAct, agents), Azure OpenAI function calling, multimodal models.
Open-Source and SaaS LLMs: Azure OpenAI, Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-3.5 Turbo, GPT-4, etc.
At least one agentic Generative AI framework: CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph, n8n, LangFlow, SmolAgents, Semantic Kernel.
Advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems: hybrid retrieval, knowledge graph-based retrieval, multi-hop RAG, hierarchical/contextual retrieval strategies, evaluation/monitoring of RAG pipelines.
Classical NLP: text classification, topic modeling, Q&A systems, conversational AI/chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, content generation, and Named Entity Recognition (NER).
Databricks ecosystem: Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, AgentBricks
MS Copilot Studio and knowledge on no-code/low-code app development.
MCP server, tools, skills and creation and maintenance of reusable componets.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

Description:
Process all guest check-ins, verifying guest identity, form of payment, assigning room, and activating/issuing room key.
Set up accurate accounts for each guest according to their requirements.
Enter Marriott Rewards information.
Ensure rates match market codes, document exceptions.
Secure payment prior to issuing room key, verify/adjust billing.
Compile and review daily reports/logs/contingency lists.
Complete cashier and closing reports.
Supply guests with directions and property information.
Accommodate guest requests, contacting appropriate staff if necessary.
Follow up to ensure requests have been met.
Process all payment types, vouchers, paid-outs, and charges.
Balance and drop receipts.
Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift.
Obtain manual authorizations and follow all Accounting procedures.
Notify Loss Prevention/Security of any guest reports of theft.
Assist management in training, evaluating, counseling, motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process.
Develop/maintain positive working relationships; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to employee concerns.

Welcome and acknowledge guests; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation.
Speak using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
Ensure adherence to quality standards.
Enter and locate information using computers/POS systems.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
About the Role
Are you a strategic operational leader with a strong track record in managing external service providers and driving operational excellence within a shared services environment? We are seeking a highly capable Regional BPO Manager to take ownership of all contractual and performance aspects of our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and Shared Service Centre (SSC) partners.
In this strategic management role, you will act as the vital bridge between our regional business stakeholders and our external BPO service provider across multiple outsourced process streams. While functional Tower Leads manage day-to-day process execution, you will ensure our BPO partners deliver against contractual commitments, achieve financial efficiency targets, maintain high customer satisfaction, and execute seamless process transitions.
Key Responsibilities
Contract & Commercial Management: Manage and coordinate all aspects of the BPO partner contract for the region. Oversee invoicing, timesheets, FTE approvals, volume modifications, service onboarding, and the tracking of contractual cost savings.
Relationship & Governance Ownership: Serve as the primary operational contact between internal regional business leadership and service provider management, driving alignment and acting as the escalation point for issue resolution.
Performance Management: Implement and maintain performance management frameworks using contractual KPIs and SLAs to ensure alignment with organizational benchmarks.
Regional Service Reviews: Lead regular Regional Service Reviews covering performance evaluations, issue mitigation, and future continuous improvement initiatives across all regional markets.
Transition Management: Oversee the onboarding and implementation of newly outsourced process workstreams into standard Business-As-Usual (BAU) operations.
Change Governance: Develop and execute the formal change note approval process for contractual and scope updates.
Customer Satisfaction & Insights: Implement periodic internal customer satisfaction survey processes, translating stakeholder feedback into joint action plans with service providers to address operational gaps.
Financial & Budgetary Control: Manage annual and in-year financial budgets for shared service operations, ensuring partner costs accurately reflect productivity gains, scope shifts, and volume changes.
Risk & Quality Framework: Establish risk and control processes governing vendor activities while championing standard process documentation across provider teams.
Role Deliverables
Outsourced process operations delivered consistently within contractually agreed KPIs and SLAs.
Measurable productivity and efficiency savings achieved through structured process improvements.
Transparent, budget-aligned service provider costs reflecting volume dynamics, expanded scope, and savings targets.
Successful execution of the annual Customer Satisfaction Survey process with clear action plans implemented.
Required Skills and Experience
Outsourcing Expertise: Proven experience in managing complex, large-scale outsourced process operations across multi-location environments.
Performance Management: Track record of developing, monitoring, and driving vendor performance using structured KPI and SLA frameworks.
Process Transformation: Demonstrated ability to deliver process efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives through SSC and BPO models.
Financial & Commercial Acumen: Hands-on experience developing and managing operational budgets, complex commercial contracts, and vendor change notes.
Functional Knowledge: Practical working knowledge of core Finance and HR process flows.
Stakeholder & Negotiation Skills: Excellent negotiation and bridge-building capabilities with the ability to translate complex process problems into clear, actionable, high-impact strategies for internal leadership and external partners.

Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.
Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization
Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Exp: 2 to 5 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Certification(s) Preferred:
Active Workday certification (HCM/Compensation)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM and Advanced Compensation certification.
At least 4 years of relevant Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up compensation elements like grades, grade profiles, sticks plans, bonus plans, merit plans etc.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring compensation grid, managing new and existing plans while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on stock grants and updates, Processing Bonus Events, One-time payments, Future payments, consolidated Merits.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Recruiting, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Compensation modules.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Compensation areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Recruiting, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Description:
#ACN Song GN Reinvention Services Customer Service Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Job Title Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Management Level: L07 Manager
Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai (India; global remit)
Experience: 10+ Years (L07)
Must have skills: Retail Service Reinvention / Customer Service Strategy Transformation; a blend of industry and consulting experience with deep understanding of the end-to-end retail value chain and how it drives service demand, volume and exceptions; experience shaping AI-native / agentic service operating models.
The Practice A Brief Sketch
The practice works with clients across their marketing, commerce, sales and service functions to reinvent how they engage customers. As part of the Reinvention Services Customer Service team, you will help the worlds leading retailers transform service from a reactive, cost-driven function into an intelligence-led, AI-native capability that senses signals in real time, resolves issues before they escalate, and continuously improves from every interaction across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystem driving customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience.
Job summary
As a Retail Service Reinvention Senior Manager / Associate Director, you will advise C-suite executives, shape AI-native service operating models, and lead end-to-end transformation for the worlds leading retailers. Reporting to the Customer Service Managing Director, you will build and lead a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts and carry accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M. The role requires a strong blend of retail domain expertise, consulting leadership, end-to-end value chain understanding, executive stakeholder management, and business development capability to shape and deliver scalable, future-ready retail service solutions.
Roles and responsibilities
Service Strategy Advisory
Define enterprise and omnichannel service strategy across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystems.
Shape AI-native service vision, target operating models and multi-year transformation roadmaps.
Develop business cases, prioritize investment and establish value-realization frameworks.
Advise boards and C-suite on where to sequence quick wins against enterprise-scale change.
Experience Design
Map end-to-end journeys for shoppers (order, delivery, returns, loyalty, complaints), associates (store, picker, contact centre) and suppliers (onboarding, purchase orders, invoicing, disputes).
Blueprint services across people, process, data and technology layers.
Identify moments of truth and design service recovery for stock-outs, failed deliveries, substitutions and disputed refunds.
Define channel strategy spanning mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social, store desk and associate/picker devices.
Operating Model Process Transformation
Design target operating models spanning shopper services, supplier services, store workforce services, and fulfilment/ecosystem services.
Design the workforce across shoppers, store associates, pickers and inventory teams, contact-centre specialists and leads, supplier account teams, and delivery partners/dispatchers.
Establish governance frameworks policy and business rules, approval/escalation thresholds, SLAs and entitlements, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
Build KPI and performance frameworks tied to customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience outcomes.
Technology AI Transformation
Set CRM and CCaaS platform strategy (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect).
Shape knowledge and case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk).
Design conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow) intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs and decisioning/policy engines.
Integrate across order, store and supply-chain systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, supplier/EDI portals) and IoT/GPS-enabled field and delivery tracking.
Build service analytics, predictive/prescriptive models and root-cause analysis capability.
Human + Agentic Operations
Design hybrid workforce models blending advisors, associates, AI copilots and autonomous agents across the shopper, supplier, store and fulfilment domains.
Design agents for high-volume service capabilities order status, substitutions, returns, refunds, delivery orchestration, supplier collaboration and dispute resolution.
Lead change management, upskilling and adoption programmes for frontline and support teams.
Establish AI governance, ethics and bias controls, and ongoing model/agent performance oversight.
Enterprise Transformation Delivery
Lead end-to-end programmes from strategy through implementation, adoption and value realisation.
Orchestrate multi-workstream delivery across business, experience, operations, technology and data/AI teams.
Manage executive steering committees and track value against committed business cases.
Practice Building
Develop market-leading thought leadership and intellectual property.
Build reusable methods, accelerators, assets and AI workflows for retail reinvention services.
Coach and mentor consulting teams.
Support business development and strategic pursuits collaborating with Song leadership to identify new opportunities and with Songs Consulting, Technology and Data AI teams for delivery.
Professional Technical Skills
Deep expertise in grocery, apparel or large omnichannel retail, with working knowledge of the end-to-end value chain merchandising and assortment planning, inventory and price management, promotions execution, digital commerce, in-store operations, supplier and partner operations, and last-mile fulfilment and how each stage drives customer demand, service volume and service exceptions.
First-hand practitioner experience inside leading grocery, apparel or omnichannel retailers (not advisory-only) having lived these operations, partnered with frontline teams, and redesigned them at enterprise scale.
Proven track record across service strategy advisory, experience design, operating model transformation, technology AI transformation, and enterprise delivery; consulting background is valuable but strong industry leadership experience counts equally.
Hands-on shopper/customer service experience across the lifecycle: order status and delivery-exception handling; substitutions, out-of-stock and refund/credit resolution; returns and reverse-logistics servicing; loyalty, rewards and membership servicing; complaint, feedback and social/review response; and multi-channel delivery (mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social) with consistent resolution regardless of entry channel.
Supplier and partner service experience: onboarding, compliance and account management; forecast, purchase-order and inventory collaboration; quality issues, disputes and score-carding; invoice, payment and reconciliation servicing; and supplier/partner portals, EDI exchanges and account-management workflows.
Store and workforce service experience: inventory accuracy, price integrity and promotion execution at store level; pick, pack and in-store fulfilment; store-to-contact-centre escalation and case hand-off; associate empowerment tools (store apps, picker/associate devices, knowledge assistants); and workforce scheduling, service standards and frontline performance management.
Fulfilment and ecosystem service experience: delivery orchestration, routing and ETA/live tracking; failed-delivery, missed-slot and delivery-recovery workflows; reverse logistics and returns-to-warehouse operations; driver, dispatcher and 3PL partner management; and last-mile SLAs, on-time performance and partner score-carding.
Working knowledge of core retail service processes order-to-delivery, returns refunds, complaint case management, store-to-contact-centre escalation, substitution/refund workflows and supplier dispute resolution with the SLAs and benchmarks that define operational excellence, and fluency in how cases move end-to-end (detect, triage/categorise, route/assign, investigate/enrich, decide/approve, orchestrate, execute/communicate, confirm/close).
Exposure to the retail service technology and AI stack: CRM CCaaS (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect); knowledge case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk); conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow); systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, PIM/MDM, pricing and promotions engines); supplier/EDI portals and IoT/GPS-enabled tracking; and the underlying AI/ML stack (intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs, policy/rules engines, predictive/prescriptive models, decisioning/optimisation and root-cause analytics).
Experience designing target operating models that combine human and AI/agentic capacity reusable service capability design, hybrid workforce design, and governance/guardrail frameworks (policy business rules, approvals escalation, human-in-the-loop controls, SLAs entitlements, privacy consent, security access, compliance audit, model/agent performance governance, ethics bias controls, and data quality traceability).
Demonstrated track record of driving measurable outcomes customer value (NPS/CSAT, trust, advocacy); growth (repeat purchase rate, average order value, attach rate, customer lifetime value); service quality productivity (first-contact and overall resolution, reduced cost-to-serve and contact volume, higher associate productivity); and availability resilience (in-stock rate, on-time delivery/payment, margin protection, and supply/compliance resilience).
Executive stakeholder management, communication and storytelling; ability to build and defend a business case at board level; fluency across business, experience, operations, technology and AI/data teams; and comfort translating complex operating models into a clear enterprise narrative.
Additional information
Experience in retail, customer service or enterprise service transformation, including large-scale programmes delivered end-to-end from strategy through implementation; the ideal candidate blends industry and consulting experience.
Reports to the Customer Service Managing Director; builds and leads a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts, with accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M.
Employment type: Permanent. Work arrangement: remote / hybrid / onsite, flexed to client and project needs; travel expectation varies by client engagement.
MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred. Relevant certifications a plus CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking, or platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).



Qualification
Experience in Retail industry (physical + digital) - Grocery, Apparel or large omnichannel retail sector experience
Good to have skills: relevant certifications (CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking) and platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).
Educational Qualification: MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred; MBA or equivalent degree in Business, Strategy, Sales Marketing.

Location : Gurgaon | Bangalore
About the Team
PayU provides payment gateway solutions to online businesses through its cutting-edge and award-winning technology. In India, PayU serves more than 4,50,000+ merchants with over 100+ payment methods and is the preferred payment partner for e-commerce merchants, including all leading e-commerce companies and a majority of airline businesses.
We are the 7th largest fintech company globally and poised to become a leader

Problem solving and structured thinking
Ability to design programs from scratch

Program management skills
Critical Behavioral Competencies
Ownership and accountability
Collaboration
Never Settle attitude
Willingness to go beyond

6+ years of experience in Total Rewards, compensation, and benefits.
Proven track record in designing and leading large-scale rewards programs in fast-paced organizations.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate business strategy into effective rewards solutions.
Experience in market benchmarking, job evaluation, and implementing best practices in compensation and benefits.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership.
Key Skills Competencies
Strategic thinking with strong execution rigor
Influencing and stakeholder management at senior levels
Data-driven decision-making and analytical mindset
Strong communication and storytelling skills
High ownership, agility, and bias for action

About The Role  

About The Role



Job Title - S&C Global Network - AI - Healthcare Analytics - Consultant



Management Level:9-Team Lead/Consultant

Job

Summary:

This role involves driving strategic initiatives, managing business transformations, and leveraging industry expertise to create value-driven solutions.





Roles & Responsibilities:
Deliver strategic advice to clients by providing data-driven recommendations that enhance business outcomes.
Independently manage communications with clients, ensuring clear understanding of project objectives and progress updates.
Design and implement GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, or traditional AI/ML algorithms tailored to address specific business challenges within the healthcare and life sciences sector.
Demonstrate knowledge of life sciences datasets and maintain strong domain expertise to drive the development of robust analytics solutions.
Support the delivery of consulting projects for global clients, working as part of a small to medium-sized team or as an individual contributor as required.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, leveraging skills in data engineering, data science, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Apply design thinking principles and business process optimization to recommend and implement innovative, value-driven solutions.
Engage in ongoing learning to develop consulting acumen, industry knowledge, and technical capabilities.





WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
An opportunity to work on high-visibility projects with top Pharma clients around the globe.
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners, and business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge, and capabilities.
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.





What you would do in this role
Support delivery of small to medium-sized teams to deliver consulting projects for global clients.
Responsibilities may include strategy, implementation, process design, and change management for specific modules.
Work with the team or as an Individual contributor on the project assigned which includes a variety of skills to be utilized from Data Engineering to Data Science
Provide Subject matter expertise in various sub-segments of the LS industry.
Develop assets and methodologies, point-of-view, research, or white papers for use by the team and the larger community.
Acquire new skills that have utility across industry groups.
Support strategies and operating models focused on some business units and assess likely competitive responses. Also, assess implementation readiness and points of greatest impact.
Co-lead proposals, and business development efforts and coordinate with other colleagues to create consensus-driven deliverables.
Execute a transformational change plan aligned with the client’s business strategy and context for change. Engage stakeholders in the change journey and build commitment to change.
Make presentations wherever required to a known audience or client on functional aspects of his or her domain.



Who are we looking for?
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Quantitative field.
Extensive GenAI expertise with a track record of creating and deploying GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
Proven experience (4+ years) in working on Life Sciences/Pharma/Healthcare projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Excellent understanding of Pharma data sets – commercial, clinical, RWE (Real World Evidence) & EMR (Electronic medical records)
Leverage one’s hands on experience of working across one or more of these areas such as real-world evidence data, R&D clinical data, digital marketing data.
Hands-on experience with handling Datasets like Komodo, RAVE, IQVIA, Truven, Optum etc.
Hands-on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modeling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Proficiency in Programming languages such as Python, SQL, Spark, etc.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings/insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL.
Experience with any of the cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Experience with any of the Data Visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, Qlikview, Spotfire is good to have.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, etc.
Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.
Strong writing skills to build points of view on current industry trends.
Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills



Professional & Technical

- Relevant experience in the required domain.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.






Additional Information:

- Opportunity to work on innovative projects.

- Career growth and leadership exposure.

Instructional Design - Analyst

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:11 - Analyst

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 2-3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:2-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Management Level 11 - Analyst

LocationGurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore

Must have skills Banking, Fintech Industries

Good to have skills Marketing

ExperienceOverall experience of 2+ years with at least 1 year of experience in the Banking/Fintech domains, delivering insights with a focus on designing & executing customer-centric initiatives.


Educational QualificationPost-Graduation (Preferably MBA)

Job

Summary You will work closely with our clients as consulting professionals who design, build and implement initiatives that can help deliver hyper-personalized experiences for their customers and enhance business performance within Banking and Fintech landscape.

Roles & Responsibilities
Collaboration and Stakeholder Management

o Collaborate with various client teams (including marketing, sales, and product) to align customer value management strategies with the respective teams' and overall organization's business goals.

o Communicate effectively with internal ACN leaders, SMEs and teams to ensure a cohesive and client-centric approach.

o Manage relationships with key partners to ensure compliance and smooth execution of all partner-related initiatives.

Data Analysis

o Monitor trends to identify anomalies, promptly flagging them to stakeholders and ensuring follow-up to resolution.

o Analyze data to uncover growth opportunities and recommend potential improvements.

o Track performance metrics and marketing interventions, highlighting key insights and resolving critical issues to support business objectives .

Project Management

o Plan , execute, and oversee projects, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business goals.

o Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and budgets, proactively addressing risks and mitigating issues.

o Monitor project performance, report progress to stakeholders, and implement process improvements for efficiency.

Retention / Churn Reduction Strategies

o Design and implement customer retention programs that are aligned to the unique challenges and opportunities of the Banking/Fintech/Insurance sectors to reduce churn and increase customer lifetime value leveraging data and analytical models.

o Work closely with product and marketing teams to create hyper-personalized campaigns and promotions to engage and retain customers.

Cross-Sell and Upsell Initiatives

o Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling based on segment-level behavior and preferences tailored to the banking / e-commerce / retail sectors.

Business Development

o Create business cases, solution deals and develop proposals to bring the best of Accenture's capabilities to clients.

 Qualification 

Professional & Technical

Skills:
Strong analytical skills and data-driven mindset to drive results-oriented decisions.

In-depth knowledge of industry from banking / fintech.

Strategic Thinking - Capability to align projects and processes with long-term business goals.

Crisis / Risk Management - Ability to effectively manage and lead during crises or challenging project situations by implementing contingency plans

Strong understanding of marketing processes & operating models

Good project management skills – The ability to plan, execute, and oversee projects to ensure that projects are completed on time, within budget, and meeting the specified goals.

Additional skills

o Excellent oral and written communication skills

o Proven success in navigating global matrixed environments and / or experience in client facing roles

o Ability to work effectively in a remote, virtual, fast-paced & unstructured global environment


Additional Information


An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients


Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.


Ability to embed responsible business into everything"”from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.



Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities


Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.
