Description:
We're looking for an experienced QA Automation Engineer to lead API quality for a Spring Boot microservices platform hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You'll design, build, and maintain scalable API automation frameworks using Java, RestAssured or Karate, and BDD practices, while integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
In this role, you'll collaborate with developers, product teams, architects, and integration partners to shape testable designs, identify quality risks, and ensure services meet functional, performance, and security standards. You'll help define QA strategy and team practices, manage test cases and execution using Jira and Xray, and use AI-enabled tools to support test design, automation, and analysis.
The ideal candidate brings strong Java and API testing expertise, experience with Spring Boot, cloud-native technologies, Docker, Kubernetes, and GCP, plus familiarity with Agile delivery, databases, Git, and CI/CD tools. Knowledge of API security, contract or performance testing, monitoring tools, and eCommerce is an advantage. A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field is preferred.
1. Leadership and Strategy
Develop and execute a comprehensive API automation strategy aligned with the organization's quality goals.
Identify and introduce innovative testing approaches, tools, and technologies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of QA processes.
Stay current with trends in API automation, AI-assisted testing, and cloud-native testing, and apply them where they add value.
Promote a culture of quality ownership and accountability within the team.
2. API Automation Development
Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable API automation frameworks using Java, RestAssured (or Karate), and BDD principles (Cucumber/Gherkin).
Write clean, well-documented, maintainable automation scripts to validate API functionality, performance, and security.
Implement data-driven testing strategies to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI) for continuous testing.
Build reusable frameworks and integrate SaaS frameworks to improve scalability and efficiency.
Perform API testing and exploration with tools such as Postman, Swagger, Hoppscotch, or ReadyAPI.
Apply API security testing principles (for example, OWASP) and validate data quality, including with large datasets.
3. AI-Enabled Testing
Use a range of AI models in day-to-day testing, including generating test cases and identifying test scenarios.
Set up and configure AI agents to automate testing tasks and speed up test design, execution, and analysis.
Evaluate new AI models and tools, and recommend how the team should adopt them.
4. Test Management with Jira and Xray
Create, organize, and maintain test cases in Xray.
Integrate Xray with Jira to provide traceability between requirements, tests, executions, and defects.
Build and manage test catalogs and test sets in Xray.
Plan and track test execution and report results in Jira and Xray.
Keep test plans, procedures, scripts, results, and configuration documented in Git, Confluence/SharePoint, and Jira.
5. Collaboration and Communication
Work with developers, product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure testability.
Participate in design and architecture reviews to give feedback on testability and flag quality risks early.
Work with extended integration partner teams to define and execute exploratory and automated API tests.
Communicate test results and quality metrics to stakeholders clearly and concisely.
Take part in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and contribute to product design and architecture discussions.
6. Quality Assurance and Best Practices
Establish and enforce QA guidelines, best practices, and standards across the team.
Review code actively to ensure software quality and functional accuracy.
Ensure all code follows secure coding practices and maintains code coverage of at least 70%.
Write and maintain unit tests with JUnit or TestNG where applicable.
7. Coding and Development
Complete coding tasks to design specifications, with high quality and on schedule.
Work under the guidance of a Technical Architect and contribute to the overall system design.
Use Git and collaboration platforms such as GitHub, Bitbucket, or GitLab for version control and code reviews.
8. Cloud and Platform Testing
Validate microservices built with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud, including RESTful APIs and dependency-injection-based components.
Test services deployed on GCP (for example, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions), using Docker and Kubernetes environments.
Validate data in relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL datastores (MongoDB, Cassandra).
9. Operational Support
Handle operational issues with minimal oversight, and troubleshoot and resolve problems quickly.
Use monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) to diagnose issues where available.
10. Nice-to-Have Contributions
Implement contract testing with Pact or similar frameworks.
Run performance tests with JMeter or Gatling.
Apply eCommerce domain knowledge to improve test scenarios and coverage.
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience
8-12 years of experience in software development and quality assurance, with a strong focus on API automation.
Experience working in Agile teams and taking part in sprint ceremonies.
API Automation
Extensive hands-on experience with RestAssured for API testing.
Proficiency in BDD frameworks such as Cucumber/Gherkin.
Experience with API testing tools such as Postman, Swagger, Hoppscotch, or ReadyAPI.
Knowledge of API security testing principles and tools (for example, OWASP).
Experience designing data-driven tests and building reusable automation frameworks.
AI Tools and Automation
Familiarity with a range of AI models and their strengths.
Comfortable using AI models in day-to-day testing, including creating test cases and identifying test scenarios.
Experience setting up AI agents for test automation.
Java and Spring Boot
Strong proficiency in Java and related open-source technologies.
Hands-on experience with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud for building microservices.
Working knowledge of dependency injection, RESTful APIs, and other core Spring concepts.
Cloud Technologies
Solid understanding of cloud-native technologies and architectures.
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, and Cloud Functions.
Testing Frameworks and Tools
Experience with unit testing frameworks such as JUnit and TestNG.
Proficiency with IDEs such as Eclipse or IntelliJ IDEA.
Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI.
Test Management (Jira and Xray)
Strong working knowledge of Jira and Xray.
Experience creating test cases in Xray and integrating Xray with Jira.
Experience creating test catalogs and test sets in Xray.
Experience using Git, Confluence/SharePoint, and Jira for documentation, scripts, results, and configuration.
Databases and Data Quality
Basic knowledge of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL datastores (MongoDB, Cassandra).
Experience with data quality testing and working with large datasets.
Version Control and Collaboration
Proficiency with Git.
Experience with GitHub, Bitbucket, or GitLab.
Quality and Secure Coding
Ability to follow secure coding practices and maintain code coverage of at least 70%.
Experience reviewing code for quality and functional accuracy.
Experience writing and maintaining test plans, procedures, and scripts.
Soft Skills
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills.
Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Eagerness to learn the product's design and architecture and to take part in ceremonies that influence both.
Ability to handle operational issues with minimal oversight.
Nice to Have
Contract testing with Pact or similar frameworks.
Performance testing with JMeter or Gatling.
Monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK.
Good understanding of the eCommerce domain.

Description:
VP Project Management / Delivery

Location: [Mumbai /Pune/Chennai)

About the Role:
We are looking for a seasoned delivery leader to head large-scale content and learning solution projects across global EdTech clients. The AVP will own end-to-end program delivery, drive operational excellence, ensure client success, and scale delivery teams for high-quality, on-time, and profitable execution. This role requires a strong blend of strategic leadership, client management, and delivery governance in a fast-paced, multi-project environment.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Delivery Leadership
Own end-to-end delivery of digital learning, curriculum, and content development programs
Manage multiple large and mid-sized projects across enterprise and university clients
Ensure delivery within scope, schedule, cost, and quality benchmarks
Establish scalable delivery frameworks, SOPs, and governance models
2. Program & Portfolio Management
Oversee a portfolio of projects with cross-functional teams (IDs, SMEs, media, tech, QA)
Drive effective resource planning, utilization, and capacity forecasting
Monitor risks, dependencies, and escalations; implement mitigation strategies
Track delivery KPIs, SLAs, and financial performance (margin, cost, productivity)
3. Client & Stakeholder Management
Act as executive delivery SPOC for key enterprise and EdTech accounts
Lead client reviews, QBRs, and governance calls
Manage expectations, change requests, and long-term engagement growth
Partner with Sales/Presales for solutioning and transition of new projects
4. Team Leadership & Capability Building
Lead and mentor Delivery Managers, Project Managers, and cross-functional leads
Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability and outcomes
Drive capability development in instructional design, digital content, and learning technologies
Set performance goals and career paths for delivery teams
5. Process Excellence & Quality
Define and enforce delivery standards, quality frameworks, and review mechanisms
Drive continuous improvement using metrics, retrospectives, and automation
Implement tools and best practices in project tracking, collaboration, and reporting
Ensure compliance with client, data security, and process standards

6. Financial & Operational Ownership
Own delivery P&L levers: effort estimation, cost control, margin optimization
Improve productivity through process optimization and AI-enabled workflows where applicable
Support budgeting, forecasting, and revenue realization
Qualifications & Experience:
Bachelor’s degree
15–20 years of experience in Project / Program / Delivery Management
Digital learning / eLearning development
Curriculum and content production workflows
Proven experience managing large teams (30–100+) and multi-million-dollar portfolios
Experience working with global clients
Strong understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models
Key Competencies
Strategic delivery leadership
Executive stakeholder management
Program & portfolio governance
Risk & escalation management
People, leadership, and talent development
Data-driven decision making
Operational excellence mindset

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, validation, and deployment.
Work with large datasets to perform data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis.
Deploy AI/ML models into production using cloud platforms and ML Ops practices.
Monitor model performance and retrain models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
Research and implement the latest advancements in AI, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning.
Ensure adherence to data security, governance, and ethical AI standards.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Statistical Modeling.
Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
Knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems, or Agentic AI.
Familiarity with Spark, Databricks, and big data technologies.
Location
Bangalore (Hybrid/Onsite/Remote)
Employment Type
Full-time

Job description
Roles and Responsibilities
Manage key client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention.
Develop and execute account plans to drive business growth and revenue expansion.
Collaborate with internal teams to deliver exceptional client service and support.
Identify new opportunities for upselling and cross-selling within existing accounts.
Analyse market trends and competitor activity to inform strategic decision-making.
Desired Candidate Profile
4 -8 years of experience in Key Account Management or a related field (e.g., Client Account Management).
Proven track record of success in managing multiple clients simultaneously.
Strong understanding of Key Client Management principles, including relationship building, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work effectively under pressure, prioritising tasks efficiently while meeting deadlines
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles

Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience
Generic Data Analyst or Data Steward profiles without SAP MDG experience

Description:
Job Description: iOS Developer
Job Title: iOS Developer
Experience: 5to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled iOS Developer to design, develop, and maintain high-quality iOS applications. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Swift, iOS SDK, and mobile application development with a focus on performance, scalability, and user experience.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain iOS applications using Swift and UIKit/SwiftUI.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend developers to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party libraries/services.
Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and security.
Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following coding standards.
Participate in code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
Ensure applications comply with Apple's App Store guidelines.
Work in Agile/Scrum teams and contribute to sprint planning and delivery.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Swift.
Expertise in iOS SDK, UIKit, and/or SwiftUI.
, Interface Builder, and iOS development tools.
Good understanding of MVC, MVVM, VIPER architecture patterns.
Experience integrating REST APIs, JSON parsing, and networking frameworks.
Knowledge of Core Data, SQLite, UserDefaults, and data persistence.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and version control systems.
Understanding of mobile security, memory management, and performance optimization.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Firebase services (Analytics, Crashlytics, Push Notifications).
Knowledge of XCTest, Unit Testing, and UI Testing.
Experience with CocoaPods, Swift Package Manager, or Carthage.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
Published applications on the Apple App Store.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Nice to Have
Experience working in Agile environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Keywords: Swift, Objective-C, iOS SDK, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, REST API, Core Data, Firebase, MVVM, Mobile App Development, Git, XCTest, App Store Deployment.

A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.

Area

Manage artifacts in JFrog Artifactory, including versioning, promotion, and retention policies.

Practical experience with Docker for build and runtime environments.
Expertise managing software artifacts with JFrog Artifactory.
Familiarity with static code analysis and quality tools (e.g., CodeSonar, SonarQube, Coverity).
Solid scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Groovy) and comfort with YAML and REST-based integrations.
Working knowledge of release management and SDLC practices using tools like Jira and Confluence (IBM RTC a plus).
Able to work from Bangalore.
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
A systems thinker who connects code, builds, tests, and releases into a seamless flow.


Skills
Jenkins CI/CD pipelines
Git and code review workflows (Gerrit preferred)
Docker for build and runtime environments
JFrog Artifactory
Static code analysis tools (CodeSonar, SonarQube, Coverity)
Scripting (Python, Bash, Groovy)
YAML and REST-based integrations
Jira and Confluence (release management and SDLC practices)

Client Service
Maintain and build internal and external client relationships by providing exceptional client service
Commit to  proactively connecting and building rapport with both internal and external clients

Invoicing
Maintain client codes in the firms proprietary accounting software based on information provided by the partner and/ormanager .
 Validate the job record billing details and add projects to the job, if required
Confirm invoicing arrangements with the client representative prior to issuing the first invoice to ensure high accuracy
Monitor WIPs, review engagement letters to determine fees to be charged, and liaise with practice managers to capture out of pocket expenses

Prepare, finalize and issue credit notes

Update and manage billing schedules 
WIP Management

Monitor the partner’s overall financial investment, including WIP, A/R and cash collection actuals to target and develop action items to achieve these
Track fees against budgetto confirm proper WIP valuation
Generate reports using the firm’s proprietary accounting software to help monitor a partner’s  engagement economics Advise on unusual WIP activities or budget rates that fall outside of the normal thresholds
Update and maintain billing schedules 
Respond to queries  in relation to engagement financial performance
Prepare and maintain Year-to-Date fee summaries as required
Accounts Receivables
Monitor partners’ monthly cash collection target and actual cash to support achievement of target
Respond to requests from National Finance with respect to cash allocations
Initiate reminders to clients and diligently follow up to ensure timely resolution, as directed by manager/partner
Pull monthly aged A/R reports and review with partner to determine actions required for aging accounts
Work with your manager to escalate outstanding collections with Third Party Collections, as directed bypartner

Review the Electronic Funds Transfer database and post dated cheques log regularly, and action tickets as required

Description:
Strong hands-on expertise in cloud-native architecture (AWS/Azure/GCP), microservices and event-driven design, containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and API-led integration patterns. Proficient in designing for scalability, resilience, high availability, and observability, with strong command of DevOps/CI-CD practices and security protocols (OAuth2, JWT, mTLS). Familiarity with integration frameworks (Kafka, MQ, ESB) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation). Working knowledge of the banking and payments domain, including ISO 20022-based payment architectures, payment hubs (e.g., FIS OPF), and core banking platforms (e.g., Finacle, Temenos, Flexcube), is a plus, but secondary to the core technical architecture skill set.
Technical Architecture Skills
Strong businesstechnology alignment, with the ability to translate business capabilities into target architecture and solution architecture blueprints
• Ability to articulate complex architecture constructs (microservices, distributed systems, integration patterns) to business and technical stakeholders
• Expertise in driving architecture governance, design reviews, and ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards
• Analyze system landscapes, legacy architectures, and technical constraints to design scalable, resilient, and cloud-native solutions
• Demonstrate technical leadership, ownership, and accountability while mentoring teams and enforcing engineering best practices
• Strong analytical and decomposition skills to break down monolithic systems into modular, loosely coupled services
• Proficient in creating architecture artifacts such as HLDs, LLDs, sequence diagrams, data flow diagrams, and integration mappings
• Apply design principles (SOLID, DRY, domain-driven design) and architecture patterns (event-driven, API-led, microservices)
• Strategic mindset with the ability to evaluate technology stacks, platform capabilities, and build vs buy decisions
• Strong focus on non-functional requirements (NFRs) including scalability, performance, security, availability, and observability
• Experience in stakeholder management and leading architecture discussions, solutioning workshops, and technical roadmaps
• Support pre-sales and solutioning through effort estimation, architecture proposals, and RFP responses
• Ability to work in Agile/DevOps environments, collaborating across cross-functional squads and driving CI/CD and automation practices
• Proficiency in architecture and modeling tools (Visio, Draw.io, ArchiMate, UML) and documentation platforms
Hands-on expertise in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)
Proficient in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK)
Experience with API gateways and service-mesh security (mTLS, OAuth2/OIDC), and designing for serverless and event-driven compute models.
Banking & Payments Domain Knowledge (Secondary)
Working knowledge of ISO 20022 message standards and end-to-end payment flows (pain, pacs, camt, admi)
Familiarity with global payment schemes such as SEPA, SCT Inst, UK Faster Payments, and cross-border (SWIFT)
Exposure to payment hubs/frameworks (preferably FIS OPF) and their integration with core banking systems
Understanding of core banking functions (accounts, deposits, loans, CASA lifecycle) and platforms such as Finacle, Temenos, or Flexcube
Awareness of regulatory and compliance requirements (PSD2, AML, KYC) impacting system design
Prior experience in banking/payments engagements is preferred but not mandatory for candidates with strong technical architecture depth
Technical Architecture Skills (Primary)
Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture (AWS/Azure/GCP)
Strong command of microservices architecture and design patterns
Skilled in API design and integration (REST, GraphQL, gRPC)
Experience with event-driven and messaging systems (Kafka, MQ, event streaming)
Hands-on with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Proficient with service mesh and API gateways (Istio, Kong, Apigee)
Working knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
Experience driving CI/CD and DevOps automation
Familiarity with observability and monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK)
Strong understanding of:
High-volume, low-latency distributed systems design
Security architecture (OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, Zero Trust)
Resilience patterns (circuit breaker, bulkhead, retries)
Banking & Payments Domain Knowledge (Secondary)
Working knowledge of ISO 20022 message formats and payment flows
Familiarity with payment schemes (SEPA, SCT Inst, UK Faster Payments, cross-border/SWIFT) and payment hubs (e.g., FIS OPF)
Understanding of core banking functions (accounts, deposits, loans, CASA lifecycle)
Exposure to core banking platforms (e.g., Finacle, Temenos, Flexcube)
Awareness of regulatory and compliance considerations (PSD2, AML, KYC) is a plus, but not a primary requirement
Consulting & Leadership Skills
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Ability to translate business requirements into technical architecture
Experience leading distributed teams and large-scale implementations
Strong documentation and presentation skills
Good to Have
Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF)
Exposure to DevOps, CI/CD pipelines
Knowledge of data architecture and real-time analytics
Prior consulting experience in Big4 or similar firms
Tools & Technologies
API tools: Swagger, Postman
Architecture tools: Visio, Draw.io
Dev tools: Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes
Requirements tools: Jira, ConfluenceRole & responsibilities

Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine what's possible. Join us and help the world's leading organizations


Your Role

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Technical Architect with 15 years of experience in Salesforce development and architecture to design, lead, and deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing Salesforce solutions. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, project managers, and development teams to translate business requirements into robust technical architectures while driving best practices, governance, and innovation across the Salesforce ecosystem.






Your Profile

Minimum 7 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development and solution architecture.
Strong expertise in Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura Components, and Salesforce APIs.
Proven experience in designing and implementing complex enterprise-scale Salesforce solutions.
Strong understanding of Salesforce security model, data architecture, sharing mechanisms, and integration patterns.
Experience integrating Salesforce with external platforms using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware solutions.
Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Application Architect, Salesforce Certified System Architect, or Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA).
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working within Agile development methodologies.



What You'll Love About Working Here

Shape your career with flexible career paths and internal mobility across the Capgemini Group.
Access comprehensive wellness benefits, including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top-ups, elder care, partner coverage, and new-parent support.
Work on cutting-edge Salesforce projects with global clients, contributing to solutions that address complex business, societal, and environmental challenges.

Description:
Technology Strategy and Transformation Senior Manager AI driven SDLC strategy

Join our team in Technology Strategy Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients realize exceptional value from AI in software delivery, a boardroom priority for organizations globally and be at the forefront of shaping how enterprises adopt AI-native software engineering

Practice: Technology Strategy Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: AI Native SDLC Strategy, Agentic AI Architecture, Agentic Software Engineering, Engineering Productivity, AI Platform Tooling Strategy
Level: Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad

Years of Exp: 10-15 years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native eraAre you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AIAre you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.

The Practice A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clientsmost strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, Software Engineering Transformation and AI-led Reinvention, where you will work with key global clients to shape the next evolution of enterprise software delivery. As part of this high-performing team, you will help organizations move from experimentation with AI coding tools to enterprise-wide AI Native SDLC transformation. These are some of the initiatives you will support:

AI Native SDLC Strategy and Roadmap: Assess current SDLC maturity, AI readiness, engineering productivity, application landscape assessment for AI driven delivery, toolchain landscape and delivery bottlenecks; define target-state AI Native SDLC vision and pragmatic adoption roadmap Engineering Productivity and AI Readiness Diagnosis: Diagnose developer experience, flow of work, quality gates, release throughput, automation levels, technology debt, test coverage, knowledge fragmentation and value leakage across large engineering organizations Use Case Identification and Prioritization: Identify and prioritize AI and agentic use cases across requirements, backlog, architecture, design, coding, refactoring, testing, code review, security, release, documentation and run/operate interfaces; segment applications and teams where adoption makes business and technology sense AI Native SDLC Platform and Tooling Strategy Architecture: Define architecture principles, reference architecture and tooling strategy across IDEs, repositories, CI/CD, DevSecOps, testing, knowledge systems, model gateways, context layer, RAG, agent orchestration, MCP, observability and governance Value Case and Benefits Framework: Define productivity, velocity, quality, cost, risk and developer experience outcomes; establish measurement model, value case, benefits tracking and AI cost governance Delivery Operating Model and Change: Design target-state engineering operating model considering AI native software delivery and help organization transition to new operating model Executive Advisory and Scale Strategy: Shape CxO narratives, transformation roadmaps, investment choices, vendor strategy and scale-up plan for enterprise-wide AI Native SDLC adoption

Role Overview

We are looking for a visionary leader in Technology Strategy and Software Engineering Transformation who can help enterprises redefine how software is delivered in an AI-native world. The role requires a senior consulting practitioner with strong understanding of enterprise SDLC, AI/ GenAI and Agentic architecture, engineering productivity, Agile, CI/CD and DevSecOps.

The successful candidate will lead strategic advisory work across the AI Native SDLC transformation journey from current-state maturity and AI readiness assessment to target-state SDLC design, AI use case prioritization, platform and tooling strategy, value case development, benefits framework, roadmap definition and operating model change.

The role requires executive presence, strong consulting capability and the ability to independently engage CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, engineering leaders and product/platform teams. The candidate should be able to shape compelling transformation narratives, facilitate senior stakeholder alignment and translate AI-powered software delivery ambition into practical, business-aligned decisions and measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

AI Native SDLC Strategy and Advisory


Lead current-state SDLC maturity, AI readiness and engineering productivity assessments across large engineering organizations

Define target-state AI Native SDLC ambition and strategy across all stages of fotware delivery and software maintenance

Conduct application landscape assessment to Identify applications, products and teams best suited for AI-native and agentic SDLC adoption based on value, feasibility, risk and readiness

Identify, structure and prioritize AI and agentic use cases across the software delivery lifecycle, linking them to engineering productivity, quality and measurable outcomes

Facilitate senior stakeholder alignment on the adoption priorities, transformation choices and approach


Target-State SDLC Design, Architecture and Tooling Strategy


Design AI-Native delivery workflows and agentic patterns across all stages of SDLC

Define AI Native SDLC platform reference architecture across ALM, IDEs, repositories, CI/CD, DevSecOps, testing, observability, knowledge systems, model gateways, RAG/context layer, MCP/tool interfaces and guardrails with responsible AI frameworks pre-built in the design

Advise clients on AI platform, toolchain and vendor strategy, including integration approach, security, data/IP considerations, cost and developer adoption

Define architecture principles, reusable patterns, guardrails, governance constructs and agentic evaluation criteria required to scale AI-Native engineering responsibly

Work with architecture, platform, security and engineering teams to connect strategy with implementation realities while maintaining an advisory and transformation-planning focus


Value Realization, Productivity Measurement and Engineering Operating Model


Build AI Native SDLC value cases covering various dimensions across productivity, quality, risk, experience and cost

Description:
Star Bucks is looking for Store Operations to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

The Store Operations Specialist is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the daily operations of our retail stores. They play a vital role in ensuring a seamless customer experience, managing inventory, and implementing operational processes to enhance store efficiency. This role requires a detail-oriented individual with strong organizational and communication skills. Key Responsibilities : Customer Service : Provide exceptional customer service by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive shopping experience. Train and mentor store staff on customer service best practices. Inventory Management : Monitor and manage store inventory levels to prevent stockouts and overstock situations. Coordinate with suppliers for timely replenishment of inventory. Conduct regular stock audits and maintain accurate inventory records. Store Layout and Merchandising : Collaborate with the visual merchandising team to ensure attractive and effective product displays. Optimize store layout for a smooth flow of customers and improved product visibility. Operational Efficiency : Develop and implement operational procedures to streamline store processes and reduce operational costs. Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to store operations. Loss Prevention : Implement loss prevention strategies to minimize theft and ensure the security of store assets. Conduct periodic security audits and recommend improvements as needed. Employee Training and Development : Train and coach store staff on operational procedures, customer service, and product knowledge. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Compliance and Safety : Ensure the store complies with all safety and regulatory requirements. Implement safety protocols and conduct regular safety drills.

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Locations- Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida, Kochi, Coimbatore

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Description: Java Spring Boot Developer

Job Title: Java Spring Boot Developer

Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated Java Spring Boot Microservices Developer to design, develop, and support scalable, high-performance enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices Architecture, REST APIs, and cloud-native application development.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Build scalable Microservices-based applications following industry best practices.
Develop and consume RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party systems.
Collaborate with architects, business analysts, QA teams, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.

Participate in code reviews, unit testing, integration testing, and deployment activities.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and availability.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Work in Agile/Scrum teams and contribute to sprint planning and estimations.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Java 8/11/17.
Expertise in Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Security.
Hands-on experience in Microservices Architecture.
Strong knowledge of RESTful Web Services and API development.
Experience with Hibernate/JPA and ORM frameworks.
Strong understanding of SQL databases such as Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
Experience with Git, Maven, Gradle, and version control practices.
Knowledge of Design Patterns, OOP Concepts, and SOLID Principles.
Familiarity with JUnit, Mockito, and automated testing frameworks.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Spring Cloud, Eureka, Config Server, Feign Client, API Gateway.
Hands-on experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other messaging systems.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization technologies.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud platforms.
Understanding of distributed systems, resilience patterns, and service monitoring.
Nice to Have
Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Cassandra.
Knowledge of ELK Stack, Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana.
Experience in Banking, Financial Services, E-commerce, Healthcare, or Telecom domains.
Certification in Java, Spring, or Cloud Technologies.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
Keywords

We are looking for a skilled .NET Developer with experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise applications using Microsoft technologies. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in .NET Framework/.NET Core, C#, SQL Server, and web application development.

Design, develop, test, and deploy applications using .NET technologies.

Experience with Microservices Architecture.

Description: We are looking for a Billing Platform Techno-Functional Consultant with hands-on experience in implementing, configuring, customizing, and supporting Billing Platform solutions for enterprise Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) transformation programs. The ideal candidate will possess a balanced blend of functional and technical expertise across the end-to-end billing lifecycle, including subscription management, pricing, usage-based billing, invoicing, payments, collections, and revenue processes. The candidate will be responsible for analyzing business requirements, conducting fit-gap analysis, preparing functional and technical designs, configuring the Billing Platform application, developing customizations, integrations, workflows, reports, and data migration solutions, and supporting unit, system, and user acceptance testing. The role also involves troubleshooting production issues, performing root cause analysis, and ensuring high-quality solution delivery aligned with industry best practices. The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, functional consultants, technical teams, integration teams, and client stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing Billing Platform solutions. The role requires strong consulting, communication, and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to contribute across the full project lifecyclefrom requirements gathering and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Years of Experience: 5 - 8 Years Position Requirements: Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, conduct fit-gap analysis, prepare functional and technical specifications, and recommend scalable Billing Platform solutions aligned with Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) business processes and industry best practices Configure Billing Platform features including subscription management, pricing, billing, invoicing, payments, collections, and revenue processes. Develop customizations, workflows, reports, integrations, and data migration components to meet business requirements. Perform unit testing, support system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT), resolve defects, validate solution quality, and support deployment, cutover, and post-production stabilization activities. Work closely with solution architects, functional consultants, technical teams, QA, integration teams, and client stakeholders to ensure successful solution delivery, timely issue resolution, and adherence to project milestones. Prepare technical and functional documentation, support knowledge transfer and user training, troubleshoot production issues, contribute to reusable assets and accelerators, and continuously improve delivery quality, productivity, and client satisfaction. Develop technical solutions using Billing Platform scripting, APIs, and configuration capabilities. Build and maintain billing workflows, rating rules, invoicing, taxation, payments, collections, and revenue-related processes. Configure product catalog, pricing, subscriptions, usage billing, Tax configuration and billing schedules. Design and develop integrations between Billing Platform and enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, CRM systems, Payment gateways, Tax engines and Data warehouses Develop REST/SOAP API integrations. Strong hands-on experience with billing platform and experience with APIs, integrations, and data reconciliation. Working knowledge of SQL and reporting tools. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to lead business discussions with customers, discover requirements, frame a problem statement, lead solution workshops and deliver a Technical solution Must be a strong team player with excellent communication skills at the business and technical level, able to collaborate as part of a team to deliver exceptional customer results in a rapid paced implementation environment Nice to have skills on Zuora Billing, Oracle ORMB, SAP BRIM, or other similar billing applications.

Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.
Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization
Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery – spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 1–3 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Description:
Job Description
As a WS practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients overcome their transformation challenges by developing their compensation strategies through analysis of industry benchmarks, company policies and culture, and employee performance. As part of the team, you will support in preparing job architecture framework, executive pay packages, Incentives design, equity valuations, compliance and regulatory requirements, and financial planning and reporting.
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to)
Role & responsibilities
As a Senior Associate in Workforce Solutions -5-8 years Rewards, you will engage with clients to analyze their reward and benefits strategies, design competitive compensation structures, and develop attractive benefits packages. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on providing consulting services related to human resources, talent management, and organizational development. You will work closely with clients to optimize their workforce, enhance employee engagement, and drive organizational effectiveness.
As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems and manage assigned workstreams. You will develop deliverables within client service engagements, using your understanding of the firm's methodologies and technology resources. You will also have the opportunity to build meaningful client relationships and mentor Associates and other junior team members. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will support clients in overcoming transformation challenges by developing compensation strategies through analysis of industry benchmarks, company policies, and employee performance. You will also prepare job architecture frameworks, executive pay packages, and incentives design, while engaging with client leadership to translate workforce insights into actionable business recommendations.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client needs to develop comprehensive compensation strategies and solutions
- Designing competitive and equitable compensation structures and benefits packages
- Interpreting market and organizational data to assess the impact of rewards decisions
- Developing global guidelines and methodologies that align with business strategies
- Engaging with client leadership to translate workforce insights into actionable recommendations
- Leading business data evaluation to draw conclusions and develop insightful rewards strategies
- Identifying and tracking key risks, project KPIs, and opportunities for project planning
- Assisting practice leadership with client proposals and thought leadership initiatives
- Benchmarking client data using market compensation survey databases
- Utilizing analytical tools like Alteryx, Tableau, and PowerBi for data analysis and reporting
- Managing tasks in a fast-paced and flexible environment to support client needs
- Collaborating within a team setting to foster efficient and innovative ways of working

Rewards Specialized certifications preferred
- Excelling in compensation plan design and analysis
- Experience in Global Compensation/Total Rewards Managemen
- Working knowledge of analytical tools like Alteryx, Tableau, PowerBi
- Demonstrating strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities
- Supporting engagement manager in delivering client needs
- Demonstrating capability to work independently and collaboratively
- Fostering efficient and innovative ways of working
- Possessing Rewards Specialized certifications
- Managing tasks in a fast-paced, flexible environment

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:Driving NetPromoter Score

Ability to adapt to a changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
Reporting to Area Operations Manager

About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store.

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent -> Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Job Introduction:
Job Introduction / Roles Responsibilities
As a professionally trained Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. You would be conducting foot or vehicle patrols, controlling access at points of entry, securing equipment and people, responding to emergencies, monitoring CCTV, surveillance operative and helping to identify and prevent criminal activity.
Protect premises, property, and information
Reporting daily to the supervisor with all daily reports as per procedures
Ensuring all Policies and Procedures are adhered to at all times
All Health, Safety, and Environment instructions are to be adhered to at all times
Operating and monitoring security systems
Control the entry and exit of individuals, materials, and vehicles
Patrol on foot searching for any situations or conditions hazardous to the property or safety of a person at a site
Patrol all outside parking areas as required to ensure vehicle safety and to detect an unauthorised person
Write appropriate reports as required
Benefits and Advantages of Joining G4S
Career growth
G4S standard uniform
Job training and consistent upskilling
Salary on the 7th of every month
27 annual leaves
Annual Bonus of max 1-month salary
Gratuity (after 5 years of service)
Accidental insurance up to INR 3 lakhs
EPF 12% from the employer and 12% from the employee
ESI Health Coverage for self family
Pension applicable after 10 years continues services (Retirement age 58 years)
In case of death during the services, pension applicable of nominee and 2 children till 25 years of age and INR 75k ex-gratia and INR 3,62000/- EDLI benefits
Ideal Candidate
Minimum Education qualifications is 10th Pass
Minimum Height 5 feet and 7 inches (5 7 ) for men and 5 ft for women
Age between 18 and 35 for a fresher and up to 40 for an experienced security guard
Physically and medically fit and look like a mature person
