Description:
Field HR Associate JD
Role Summary:
The Field HR Associate will support and execute human resources activities at the ground
level across logistics sites such as warehouses, fulfillment centers, and delivery hubs. The role
involves blue-collar hiring, attendance and payroll support, engagement activities, labor
compliance tracking, and issue resolution for site-based workforce.
Key Responsibilities:
Recruitment & Onboarding
Coordinate daily/weekly hiring of warehouse associates, loaders, delivery staff, etc.
through vendors and local channels.
Manage candidate screening, document collection, and induction processes.
Maintain trackers for manpower deployment and contractor rotation.
Attendance, Payroll & HR Ops
Monitor daily attendance through biometric/manual systems.
Collate and validate attendance data for payroll input in coordination with central HR
ops.
Assist in issuing ID cards, onboarding kits, and HR documentation at the site.
Compliance & Labor Law Support
Support contract labor compliance (e.g., ESI/PF records, CLRA documentation).
Coordinate with compliance teams and vendors to ensure audit readiness at the site.
Maintain updated personnel records as per labor law norms.
Employee Engagement & Grievance Handling



Conduct engagement activities (e.g., weekly briefings, rewards, celebrations).
Act as the first point of contact for associate grievances related to wages, safety, shift
timings, etc.
Escalate unresolved issues to regional HR.
HR Reporting & Coordination
Maintain HR MIS, hiring status, attrition reports, and daily dashboards.
Coordinate between warehouse operations, vendors, and HR leadership.
Support audits, safety drills, and training rollouts.
Qualifications:
Graduate in any discipline; PG Diploma in HR preferred
13 years of experience in field HR roles (logistics, manufacturing, retail, or facility
management)
Freshers with relevant internship experience may be considered
Language: Local language fluency + basic English required
Comfortable with fieldwork and managing blue-collar workforce
Key Skills:
People-centric and proactive
Basic knowledge of labor laws and HR documentation
Strong coordination and reporting ability
Comfortable with MS Excel and attendance software



High integrity, discipline, and site ownership mindset
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.

Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.

8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:
QR & Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role: 
To sell products or services for a company and represent their brand. Also, to manage relationships with customers, serving as the key point of contact, from initial lead outreach to when a purchase is ultimately made.

Expectations/ Requirements:
1. Must have Smart Phone, Bike & Helmet
2. Candidate must have a zeal for Growth
3. Candidate should have good market knowledge
4. Must have done a Channel Sales Role before with 5 Member Sales Team handled before
5. Must understand concepts of distribution, expansion, metrics
6. Must have experience in getting team earn Lucrative Incentives

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role:
1. More than 3 years experience in Channel & Distribution
2. Team handing experience is a must
3. Good in Excel & data tools required in Sales

Education:
Graduate or above / Post Graduation preferred.

Why join us:
1. A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology
2. Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
3. A solid 360-degree feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals
4. Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story.

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Designation: Staff Nurse
Location: Jammu

Clinical Work Provide direct & indirect patient care in emergency care situations. On a rotational basis, perform all nursing related work with utmost courtesy, dignity & empathy towards patients/donors, in the following stations - USG Room/OT/Injection Room/Ward/PCPNDT Room.

USG Room
Provide any & every detail about the procedures, medications, and answer patient queries & subsequent follow-up.
Position and cover the patient/donor for the procedures.
Reporting & documenting USG findings/treatment plan in File/Portal.
Documenting the prescribed mediation/Stimulation/HRT drugs etc. & in file/portal/ providing Trigger time.
Executing all Donor Related Activity, in association with Donor Coordinator.

Injection Room
Administer injection to patient/donor, as prescribed in file.
Maintain stock of all required injections/drugs.
Ensure Cold Chain, as required. Documentation & Reporting
Elicit accurate & relevant patient/donor medical history.
Co-ordinate procurement of necessary documents from patient/donor, per PCPNDT regulations.
Update all patient records in both physical, as well as digital format.
File all regulatory forms/consents before each procedure.
Submit PCPNDT forms timely, as required by PCPNDT office.
Maintain records of usage/supply of injections/drugs/equipment's, for audit purposes

Communication & Co-operation
Identify & provide for physical, emotional, and developmental needs of patients.
Counsel patients & their families; explain procedures planned for them.
Address patient & staff issues by using multidisciplinary team strategies.

Quality Management & Continuous improvement
Ensure all procedures are carried out as per the SOP, and are compliant with the Policies on Universal Protection, Biomedical Hazard & Infection Control.
Ensure a clean and safe environment always.
Always provide for and respect patients privacy and confidentiality.
Adherence to therapeutic standards; ensuring quality health care outcomes against patient care goals & regulatory standards.
Safeguard & keep inventory of equipment and supplies, as required.
Care and maintenance of linen and equipment.
Participate in emergency drills along with other staff like CPR/fire drills.
Responsible for infection control function for the centre, and will be responsible for all infection control related tasks

Interested candidate can share updated resume on sheetal.devadiga@indiraivf.in

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Job Description
 Position: Marketing Specialist Builder Partnerships (MBA Fresher)
Location: Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bangalore
Department: Alliances & Partnerships
Company:Livspace
About the Role
Livspace is looking for energetic and customer-focused MBA graduates to join our Alliances & Partnerships team.
As a **Marketing Specialist*, you will be stationed at assigned premium builder projects and will act as the face of Livspace at the property. You will own the complete customer journey—from the first interaction at the builder site to the final home interior booking.
This is a high-ownership role where you will collaborate with builder sales teams, engage prospective homeowners, drive Experience Centre visits, coordinate with Livspace designers, and ensure an exceptional customer experience throughout the buying journey.
---
Key Responsibilities
 Project Ownership
* Own one or more assigned builder projects end-to-end.
* Build strong working relationships with builder sales, CRM, and project teams.
* Ensure seamless execution of all Livspace partnership activities at the assigned property.
Customer Engagement
* Represent Livspace at the builder sales office.
* Engage with prospective homebuyers visiting the project.
* Explain Livspace's exclusive partnership benefits, offers, and interior solutions.
* Capture customer information and qualify potential interior requirements.
Experience Centre (ECV) Conversion
* Drive customers to visit the Livspace Experience Centre.
* Schedule appointments and coordinate customer visits.
* Follow up consistently to maximize Experience Centre visit conversions.
 Sales Coordination
* Work closely with Livspace Design Consultants and Sales teams after the customer's Experience Centre visit.
* Ensure smooth handover and continuous customer engagement.
* Track customer progress through every stage of the sales funnel until booking.
Customer Relationship Management
* Act as the single point of contact for customers throughout their interior journey.
* Resolve customer concerns by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
* Deliver an outstanding customer experience to improve conversion rates and customer satisfaction.
Stakeholder Management
* Maintain strong relationships with builder stakeholders.
* Coordinate marketing activities and partnership initiatives at the project.
* Share regular project performance updates with internal teams.
AboutCompany: Livspace is Asias largest and fastest-growing omnichannel home interiors and renovation platform. Founded in 2014, we are a high-growth, unicorn startup backed by top-tier global investors like KKR, Goldman Sachs, and Jungle Ventures. By seamlessly combining cutting-edge technology, certified design talent, and a trusted marketplace of vendors and contractors, we deliver an end-to-end, predictable home design experience across India, Singapore, and the Middle East. At Livspace, we are redefining an unorganised industry into a structured digital ecosystem. We thrive on innovation, speed, and customer-centricity, offering an entrepreneurial environment where builders, creators, and technologists can make a massive impact at scale.

Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle
Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.

Description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting monthly disbursement targets.

Key Responsibilities & KRAs

Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by the company.
Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired portfolios.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for extensive field travel.

What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive structure.
Travel allowances.
Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.

Description:
The B2B College Connect Sales role is responsible for driving institutional sales across engineering colleges and universities. The role focuses on acquiring new academic partners, expanding existing accounts, and positioning L&T EduTechs industry-aligned skilling and learning solutions to higher education institutions. The incumbent will manage end-to-end sales cycles, engage academic stakeholders, and ensure sustained business growth within the assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities
Drive B2B institutional sales for College Connect programs across assigned regions.
Identify and engage with engineering colleges, universities, and academic institutions to promote L&T EduTech offerings.
Build strong relationships with Principals, Directors, Deans, HODs and academic leadership.
Understand institutional needs and propose solution-based skilling programs aligned to curriculum enhancement and employability outcomes.
Manage the complete sales lifecycle including lead generation, proposal submission, negotiation, and deal closure.
Achieve assigned revenue, acquisition, and growth targets consistently.
Ensure repeat business and account expansion within existing partner institutions.
Coordinate with internal teams (content, delivery, operations, finance) to ensure smooth program onboarding and execution.
Track and maintain sales pipeline, forecasts, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and NEP-driven changes to refine sales pitches and proposals.
Participate in academic events, conferences, and institutional meetings to strengthen brand presence.

Reporting: Head College Connect Sales

Educational Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering (Preferred)
MBA / Postgraduate qualification in Marketing or Business Management (Preferred)

Domain & Functional Expertise
Strong experience in B2B institutional sales, preferably in EdTech or higher education solutions. Good understanding of engineering education ecosystem and campus buying processes.

Behavioral & Professional Skills:
Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Relationship-driven approach with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders.
Result-oriented mindset with strong ownership and execution focus.
Professional demeanor with high ethical standards.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

Territorial Scope: Regional / Location (as assigned)
AboutCompany: L&T EduTech is an initiative of the Larsen & Toubro Group focused on bridging the gap between academia and industry. It works with universities, colleges, enterprises, and professionals to deliver industry-aligned learning, skilling, assessments, and certification programs. L&T EduTech leverages the Groups extensive industry expertise to develop practical, future-ready skills and improve employability across engineering, technology, and other professional domains.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs.
plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development
(Attrition
Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards
Preferred candidate profile :
Candidate should has to 4 to 10 Years of Experience in store managing

Perks and benefits
ESI and PF
Family insurance policy
Incentive policy : Daily - weekends - monthly - festival incentive program.
Professional Training : 25 Days training in Bangalore post selection in Lenskart Academy .

Description:
Profile : Wealth Manager

Location : Mumbai

Job Summary :
As a Wealth Manager, you will be responsible for providing personalized financial advice and guidance to high net worth individuals. You will play a crucial role in managing and growing our clients' wealth portfolios, while ensuring excellent customer satisfaction. This is a dynamic role that requires a deep understanding of financial markets, strong analytical skills, and exceptional interpersonal abilities.

Responsibilities:

Understanding the financial need & risk appetite of the client & recommending suitable
products from the array of financial products available with us like - Mutual Funds, PMS,
Bonds,NCD, Structured Products, Equity, AIF,Private Equity, Real Estate, Life
insurance, General Insurance etc (We work as an Open Architecture).

Advising Affluent clients on their Investments across a gamut of wealth products and
managing their overall financial portfolio.
Analyse client portfolios and make necessary suggestions.
Seek to establish a level of trust and confidence with the client so that any financial need
can be addressed and solutions offered.

Achieving financial goals and maintaining organization brand value.

Ensure highest levels of customer service and experience to these customers.

Interact with clients to update them on research calls and advising on asset allocation within their financial portfolio and guide them on their investment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field
Proven experience as a Wealth Relationship Manager or similar role in the financial services
industry
Strong knowledge of investment products, financial planning strategies, and wealth
management practices

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Requirements:

Team Leading Experience of minimum 5-8 years in Wealth Management.

Existing book and client relationship preferable.

In depth knowledge of various products of Wealth Management.

Knowledge of relevant Taxation applicable to the Wealth Management.

Good Oral and written communication Skills.

SAP ABAP S/4 HANA Consultant/Developer

Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)

Experience:
JL4: 2-5 Years
JL5: 5-9 Years


About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP ABAP S/4HANA Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting SAP ABAP applications in S/4HANA environments.
The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in ABAP Development, RICEF Objects, Adobe Forms, Smart Forms, BAPI, BADI, Enhancements, Reports, Interfaces, and S/4HANA development frameworks. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, and support projects is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Develop and enhance SAP ABAP programs based on business requirements.
Design and build RICEF objects including Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, and Forms.
Develop Adobe Forms, Smart Forms, SAP Scripts, and Interactive Forms.
Create and enhance BAPIs, BADIs, User Exits, Customer Exits, and Enhancement Framework objects.
Design and develop ALV Reports, Classical Reports, and Interactive Reports.
Work with Functional Consultants to understand and translate business requirements.
Analyze and optimize existing ABAP programs for performance improvement.
Develop inbound and outbound interfaces using IDoc, RFC, Web Services, and APIs.
Support S/4HANA migration and custom code remediation activities.
Prepare Technical Specifications and Design Documents.
Conduct Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, and Production Support activities.
Resolve production incidents within SLA timelines.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Collaborate with cross-functional SAP teams during project delivery.
Ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.

Qualifications

B.E / B.Tech / MCA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP ABAP and S/4 Hana experience for JL4.
Minimum 5 years of SAP ABAP experience for JL5.
Strong understanding of SAP technical architecture and development lifecycle.

Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
bout the Role
Are you a strategic recruiter who thrives in high-volume, dynamic environments? We are looking for a Recruitment Lead to drive end-to-end frontline manpower hiring across west region. In this role, you will lead high-impact hiring initiatives, optimize sourcing channels, build grassroots partnerships, and ensure a seamless pipeline from candidate selection to onboarding and training.
If you excel at execution, community outreach, and balancing quality with speed, we want to hear from you.
Key Responsibilities
Direct Recruitment Planning (20%)
Review rolling 3-month hiring targets (location, quantity, skill requirements) and develop actionable recruitment plans.
Optimize sourcing channels, combining walk-ins, mass drives, digital recruitment, and specialized outreach programs (e.g., homecoming drives).
Identify resource requirements for hiring events and gain alignment/sign-off with leadership.
Recruitment Process Execution & Monitoring (80%)
Mobilize recruitment teams and lead execution of scheduled hiring drives and events.
Ensure full compliance with internal company policies, statutory regulations, and labor laws governing recruitment.
Issue Letters of Intent (LOI) to selected candidates and actively follow up to ensure seamless transition to training centers with required documentation.
Coordinate directly with training schools on candidate rosters and arrival schedules.
Track hiring event effectiveness, course-correct plans as needed, and maintain accurate recruitment MIS and reporting.
Stakeholders & Relationships
Internal: Hub & Branch Operations Teams, ISM Officers, Recruitment Lead.
External: Prospective candidates, Government/State agencies, Gram Panchayats, local community authorities, and NGOs.
What We Are Looking For
Qualifications & Experience
Education: Graduate degree or equivalent (minimum required).
Experience: 5-7 years of relevant HR experience with a strong background in managing volume recruitment processes.

Experience: 4 - 5 years
Compensation: 20 LPA 25 LPA

Financial Accounting & Closure: Manage day-to-day general ledger accounting, plant/project accounting, and ensure timely month-end financial closure for the Cable Division.

Job Summary
For Sartorius India Pvt. Ltd, we are looking for a Field Account Manager to join our team in Ahmadabad Pune Mumbai. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the growth of revenue by proactively managing a range of accounts throughout Maharashtra, Gujrat, and Goa by developing and maintaining strong KOL relationships. The goal is to achieve individual and assigned group sales target within the financial year for BioAnalytics product portfolio.
Main Responsibilities Tasks:
Initiate and manage the full sales process within the assigned territory and product range
BioAnalytics group consist of BLI (Octet), SPR (SF3), Live Cell Analysis system (Incucyte), Flow Cytometer (iQue), and Cell Selection and retrieval system (CellCelector).
Maintain the CRM with relevant and up-to-date customer and sales opportunity information in SFDC.
Develop and achieve account targets understanding customer needs and future plans.
Be customer-centric ensuring customer satisfaction without compromising the business.
Expand networks and sellupsell additional products and services.
Provide trainings, technical and commercial support to Sales Reps and customers in relevant products and processes.
Actively contribute to sales growth by identifying new opportunities at customer site.
KOL Management and development.
Identify and implement appropriate action plans to track key accounts consumption patterns.
This is an Individual contributor role.
Qualification Skills:
Master in life sciences (Biotechnology, Microbiology or Biochemistry), With a PhD preferred. Experience in the industry from Bioasay group or Biosimilar groups preferred.
Minimum 5 years of field sales experience in the west region. Candidates with international experience are an addition.
Experience in handling Live Cell imagers, Confocal microscopes, Flow Cytometry, SPR or from the Cell Biology field will be preferred.
Relevant technical knowledge and extensive industry knowledge (eg. Biotech, Pharma, etc.)
Experience in selling capital instrumentation is an addon.
Result-oriented and highly motivated.
Capable of providing outstanding customer service.
Ability to manage complex issues using innovation and processes.
A track record of strong compliance and customer reference is required.
Ability to manage and work in Matrix organization.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! Long Description: You will be the first point of contact for guests, responsible for ensuring smooth check-ins, check-outs, and addressing guest inquiries throughout their stay. You play a key role in making guests feel welcome, ensuring that all their needs are met and that any issues are resolved promptly. As a Front Office Associate , you re not just ensuring a seamless check-in and check-out process - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Previous experience in a guest service or front office role within the hospitality industry.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to handle guest inquiries and complaints professionally.
Proficiency in hotel property management systems (PMS) and general front office procedures.
Excellent multitasking skills and the ability to remain calm and professional in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
A positive attitude and a genuine passion for providing exceptional guest service.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Deliver a warm welcome: Greet guests upon arrival and complete the check-in process, including verifying details, assigning rooms, issuing keys, and providing welcome materials or bell service assistance
Support efficient check-out: Process guest departures by verifying charges, handling payments, issuing receipts, and using the point-of-sale system accurately
Provide hotel and local knowledge: Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of hotel offerings, room types, rates, promotions, and local area information to assist with guest inquiries
Promote hotel services: Use up-selling techniques to recommend hotel amenities and maximize room and service revenue
Delight our guests: Respond to guest requests, resolve concerns with care and urgency, and effectively manage messages and communications

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Description
 Position: Marketing Specialist Builder Partnerships (MBA Fresher)
Location: Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bangalore
Department: Alliances & Partnerships
Company:Livspace
About the Role
Livspace is looking for energetic and customer-focused MBA graduates to join our Alliances & Partnerships team.
As a **Marketing Specialist*, you will be stationed at assigned premium builder projects and will act as the face of Livspace at the property. You will own the complete customer journey—from the first interaction at the builder site to the final home interior booking.
This is a high-ownership role where you will collaborate with builder sales teams, engage prospective homeowners, drive Experience Centre visits, coordinate with Livspace designers, and ensure an exceptional customer experience throughout the buying journey.
---
Key Responsibilities
 Project Ownership
* Own one or more assigned builder projects end-to-end.
* Build strong working relationships with builder sales, CRM, and project teams.
* Ensure seamless execution of all Livspace partnership activities at the assigned property.
Customer Engagement
* Represent Livspace at the builder sales office.
* Engage with prospective homebuyers visiting the project.
* Explain Livspace's exclusive partnership benefits, offers, and interior solutions.
* Capture customer information and qualify potential interior requirements.
Experience Centre (ECV) Conversion
* Drive customers to visit the Livspace Experience Centre.
* Schedule appointments and coordinate customer visits.
* Follow up consistently to maximize Experience Centre visit conversions.
 Sales Coordination
* Work closely with Livspace Design Consultants and Sales teams after the customer's Experience Centre visit.
* Ensure smooth handover and continuous customer engagement.
* Track customer progress through every stage of the sales funnel until booking.
Customer Relationship Management
* Act as the single point of contact for customers throughout their interior journey.
* Resolve customer concerns by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
* Deliver an outstanding customer experience to improve conversion rates and customer satisfaction.
Stakeholder Management
* Maintain strong relationships with builder stakeholders.
* Coordinate marketing activities and partnership initiatives at the project.
* Share regular project performance updates with internal teams.
AboutCompany: Livspace is Asia's largest and fastest-growing home interiors and renovation platform. Leveraging its proprietary technology, the company delivers end-to-end home interior and renovation solutions, encompassing modular solutions, furniture, false ceilings, soft furnishings, dcor, civil works, and more. The company serves homeowners across diverse market segments in India and Singapore.

Description:
Job Description

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Company Secretary to join our Australian Operations team. The candidate will assist with company formations, corporate compliance, client onboarding, and company secretarial activities for Australian entities.

Key Responsibilities

Assist with Australian company registrations, formations, and related documentation.
Handle ASIC-related compliance, annual reviews, and company updates.
Manage client onboarding, documentation, and compliance requirements.
Maintain statutory registers, corporate records, and company information.
Coordinate with Australian clients and internal teams for pending documents and compliance matters.
Monitor statutory deadlines and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
Assist with corporate restructuring, changes in directors, shareholders, and registered office details.
Support the team in improving compliance procedures and maintaining accurate records.

Candidate Requirements

CS Qualified or CS Professional/Executive level candidates.
02 years of relevant experience.
Freshers with strong technical knowledge are welcome to apply.
Basic understanding of corporate laws and compliance requirements.
Good communication, coordination, and organisational skills.
Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn Australian corporate regulations.
Prior experience in Australian corporate compliance or ASIC matters will be an advantage but is not mandatory.
AboutCompany: NAS Bookkeeping Plus provides offshore bookkeeping, payroll and accounting support services to Australian accounting firms and businesses. We are looking for a detail-oriented professional with hands-on Australian payroll experience to join our growing team.

Description:
About the Program:

Grow is a flagship program of Dr. Reddy’s Foundation designed to skill youth of India. This position aims to develop employability skills among the unemployed youth who are 12th pass or graduates, so that they can be employed in the private sector jobs. Core employability skills include Communicative English, Digital literacy, Soft Skills, Communication Skills, Digital Problem Solving, Sector & Work Readiness, and interview skills.

Roles and Responsibilities :
Following the predefined session plan while delivering training to the identified youth 
 Develop skills and knowledge on the identified subjects based on the curriculum that is designed 
Prepare learners to face interviews confidently 
 Conduct concurrent assessments as per the plan to continue to measure the progress of the students 
Maintain data with respect to training and related activities. 6. Participate in center activities (such as organizing Parents meet, doing retention follow up, collecting training feedback etc.) along with the other staff members to make the center successful.

Key Skills Required:
0-1 year of experience in teaching or training in a similar field (education/training).
Strong knowledge of English language and communication skills.
Ability to design engaging lesson plans that cater to diverse learning styles.
Excellent interpersonal skills with ability to build rapport with students from different backgrounds.
Fluency  in Gujrati and English is necessary.

2. Opportunity to work alongside and learn from some of the best commercial stalwarts
3. Competitive Pay & Benefits
4. Meritocratic and Rewarding Environment
5. Opportunity to do unconventional lending products with distinct USPs (Best TAT, Broader Client Coverage, Higher Risk Appetite, Superior Client Experience, etc.)

Our product portfolio includes a broad range of economical and innovative alternatives to traditional pipe, duct, and tray supports. Additionally, our accessories allow for the adaptation of clamping systems to various applications and site conditions, except for high-temperature or high-pressure installations.

Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. Job Description: Regional Manager Automobile Sales

Company: CARS24
Locations: Ahmedabad, Pune, Rajkot
Contact Person: Kavita Dangwal
Team: People & Culture | CARS24
Phone: 9311243497
Email: kavita.dangwal@cars24.com

About the Role

CARS24 is looking for a dynamic and results-driven Regional Manager to lead automobile sales and retail operations across the assigned region. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in automotive sales, business development, team leadership, and achieving sales targets, preferably in the used-car or new-car dealership industry.

Key Responsibilities
*Regional Sales Management: Drive automobile sales and business growth across multiple locations within the assigned region.
*Business Development: Develop strategies to increase vehicle sales, procurement, revenue, and market share.
*Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and mentor sales managers and frontline sales teams to achieve business objectives.
*Dealer & Partner Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with new-car dealerships, used-car dealers, and other automotive business partners.
*Target Achievement: Monitor sales performance, conversion rates, inventory movement, and key business KPIs to ensure targets are met.
*Market Expansion: Identify new business opportunities, strengthen market presence, and expand the regional dealer network.
*Customer Experience: Ensure a smooth customer journey and maintain high standards of service and customer satisfaction.
*Performance Monitoring: Analyse regional sales data, identify performance gaps, and implement corrective action plans.
*Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to company processes, sales policies, and operational standards.
*Cross-functional Coordination: Work closely with procurement, operations, and other teams to improve business performance.
Candidate Requirements
*2-8 years of experience in automobile sales, preferably in the used-car, new-car dealership, automotive retail, or automotive e-commerce industry.
*Prior experience in managing sales teams and driving regional or multi-location business performance.
*Strong understanding of automobile sales, dealer relationships, vehicle procurement and retail operations.
*Proven ability to achieve sales targets, improve conversions, and drive revenue growth.
*Excellent leadership, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
*Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on business KPIs.
*A go-getter mindset with the ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
What Were Looking For
A strong sales leader with a passion for the automobile industry who can drive regional growth, build high-performing teams, strengthen dealer partnerships, and deliver sustainable business results.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Sales Approach and Target Orientation: The desired RMH candidate must have an excellent aptitude for sales and marketing and must be very focused towards generating quality leads with maximum probability for conversion. He/she must have a strong orientation to generate and bring new customers to the branches and add new customers to our fold.
2. Exceptional Planning and Execution Skills: RMH must plan and execute the local flavored activities for the branches of the Region allocated to the RMH to ensure that the branches achieve their monthly and quarterly business targets of New Customer Acquisition for Gold Loan and Other Financial Products. New customer acquisition (new KYC) is the primary metric on which an RMHs effectiveness will be measured and hence RMHs primary focus must be to ensure his/her Region achieves its new KYC target without fail.
3. Monitoring Skills: RMHs must coordinate with the branches and the vendors on a regular basis to ensure the proper execution of the sanctioned regional BTL activities. He/she should have the ability to take branch staff along and ensure the BTL activities are conducted effectively and collectively to create top quality leads. He/she should also have the ability to foresee if there are any possible leakages or misreporting being done at agency level and should be able to check it, plug it and correct it.
4. Competition Tracking & Monitoring: RMH should proactively visit branches of competitors and prepare a counter competition strategy on a monthly / Quarterly basis to highlight what competitors are doing in his Region at BTL level and how does he/she plan to counter it.
5. Branch visits: All branches of in his/her Region must be visited by the RMH at least once in every Quarter to understand the on-ground issues, faade related branding issues, use/misuse of branch collaterals and merchandise, understand the branchs catchment area, competitors active in the respective branchs neighborhood and then finally plan and execute effective marketing initiatives which are specific to the branch, to address identified issues.
6. Branch Branding and Visual Branch Merchandise: RMH must ensuring effective branch branding, ensuring every branch in his Region stands out and is well-equipped with prominent and well-placed lit Glow Sign Boards (GSBs and Vertical GSBs), suitable quantity of branch merchandise, collaterals etc It is also his/ her responsibility to ensure that no branch has abundance of marketing collaterals / marketing material which lies unused or gets wasted later. Thus, his / her role does not end with just supplying this material but also includes their best utilization to drive business impact and ensure nil wastage.
7. Branch Launch: Whenever a new branch is being opened, RMH is entrusted with preparing a detailed report on the available opportunity in the branch’s catchment area and once the branch opening date is finalized, he/she is expected to plan a detailed marketing plan with various new branch opening activities that create awareness in the neighborhood and also drives footfall and business conversion for the new branch.
8. Vendor Management: RMH is expected to bring with him/her a good network of vendors, marketing agencies, partners, and collaborators with whom he can work closely to execute his marketing plans. He/she should also have good negotiation skills to ensure he gets the best out of his partners without compromising quality of execution.
9. Lead Management: RMH must also ensure that branches follow-up on leads generated through BTL activities timely and effectively. He must ensure leads so generated are entered in CRM under correct marketing activity source and converted aggressively to achieve targets.
10. Coordination for ATL Activities: RMH must coordinate with Corporate Office and monitor the execution of the ATL Activities such as Newspaper Ad releases, Outdoor Campaigns, Cable TV activities, TV Ads in Regional Channels etc Effectively and bring to the notice of seniors at CO North Marketing department in case he/she observes any anomalies.
MIS: RMH must prepare a monthly MIS of the response generated by the local BTL Activities along with other monitoring of ATL/BTL Campaigns. Timely execution of BTL activities as per CRM schedule, sharing of periodic reports with 100% execution photographs is also an important part of his / her role.


Preferred candidate profile
1. Graduation / Post Graduation
2. Minimum 2-3 years of relevant work experience in marketing domain, preferably with BFSI / Retail exposure. Professionals with increased work experience will be treated differently.
3. Good communication skills, fairly good in written and spoken English
4. Excellent knowledge of MS Office
5. Extremely honest, committed and must possess highest degree of integrity.

Description:
Job Description: Consultant Operations Excellence / Business Process Reengineering (BPR)
1. Role Overview
The Consultant serves as the execution layer of client engagements, responsible for conducting analyses, developing solutions, supporting implementation, and ensuring disciplined execution of project workstreams. The role involves working closely with client functional teams to identify improvement opportunities, redesign processes, and drive operational efficiency through data-driven decision-making and digital enablement.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
Conduct diagnostic assessments to identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for operational improvement.
Perform data-driven analyses to support problem-solving, root cause analysis (RCA), and business decision-making.
Support Business Process Reengineering (BPR), process redesign, and implementation initiatives.
Develop process maps, value stream maps, and workflow documentation to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
Support productivity improvement, operational excellence, manufacturing excellence, and supply chain optimisation initiatives.
Assist in digital transformation, process automation, and Generative AI (GenAI) enablement initiatives.
Develop client-ready deliverables, including analytical reports, presentations, dashboards, and recommendations.
Coordinate with client functional teams to drive project execution and implementation activities.
Maintain action trackers, status reports, project documentation, and PMO deliverables.
Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies to enhance process efficiency.
Leverage advanced Excel, Power BI, and other analytical tools to generate insights and monitor performance.
Support change management activities and develop an understanding of business requirements and operating models.
3. Experience Requirements
Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience preferred.
Experience in sales is preferred, as specified in the role requirements.
Experience in management consulting, operations excellence, manufacturing excellence, supply chain, industrial engineering, or digital transformation is desirable.
Candidates with exposure to manufacturing environments, shop-floor operations, or business consulting will be preferred.
4. Educational Qualifications
Mandatory: B.Tech/B.E. in a core engineering specialisation, such as Mechanical, Electronics, Production, Metallurgy, Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline.
Preferred: MBA/PGP in Operations, Supply Chain, Analytics, Manufacturing, or a related discipline.
5. Functional and Technical Skills
Core Functional Skills
Business Process Reengineering (BPR)
Operations Excellence and Manufacturing Excellence
Digital Transformation and AI Enablement
Process Mapping and Value Stream Mapping
Productivity Improvement and Root Cause Analysis
Lean Management and Six Sigma
Process Automation and Digital Operating Models
Change Management and Business Process Improvement
PMO Support, Action Tracking, and Status Reporting
Technical Skills
Advanced Microsoft Excel Mandatory
Power BI – Mandatory
Tableau
Basic SQL
Microsoft PowerPoint
GenAI fundamentals and prompt engineering
Digital productivity tools and process automation solutions
AI and digital transformation certifications will be considered an added advantage.
6. Key Competencies
Structured problem-solving
Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities
Effective written and verbal communication
Stakeholder coordination and presentation skills
Ownership and accountability
Adaptability and willingness to learn
Understanding of business processes and change management
Ability to manage defined work packages and execute project deliverables within timelines
7. Industry Background
Candidates from the following backgrounds will be preferred:
Management Consulting
Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering
Operations and Supply Chain
Operational and Manufacturing Excellence
Business Process Reengineering and Process Improvement
Digital Transformation and AI Enablement

With in-depth domain expertise in the field of healthcare, it has strong capabilities across the spectrum of the pharmaceutical value chain. From formulations to active pharmaceutical ingredients and animal healthcare products to wellness products, Zydus has earned a reputation amongst Indian pharmaceutical companies for providing comprehensive and complete healthcare solutions.

One of the salient features of Zydus is its rich history and lineage. The origin of the company dates all the way back to the 1950s. The company was founded in the year 1952 by Mr. Ramanbhai B. Patel (late), a first-generation entrepreneur and a doyen in the field of Indian Pharmaceuticals.

In 1995, the group was restructured and thus was formed Cadila Healthcare under the aegis of the Zydus group. From a humble turnover Rs. 250 crores in 1995 the group witnessed a significant financial growth and registered a turnover of over Rs. 17,000 crores in FY-21.

Adhering to its brand promise of being dedicated to life in all its dimensions, Zydus continues to innovate with an unswerving focus to address the unmet healthcare needs. Simultaneously it rededicates itself to its mission of creating healthier, happier communities across the globe.

CAM (Flat Products)

Location

This position is responsible for business for assigned geography. Proficient in sales process and achieve sales objectives (ABP) sales & revenue targets for the products, efficient in sales planning & execution as per plan.

Key Result Areas (Key Performance Indicators)
Streamline and improve existing sales to maintain JSW share-of-business

Execution excellence: Should be systematic and organized; should follow up rigorously, report and escalate issues (if required) and problem solve to increase speed of execution.

Key Success Factors Challenges
Data Management / Data feasibility
Adherence to timelines while maintaining quality of deliverables

Job Listing Detail
With over 80 years as an industrial technology leader, Kennametal Inc. delivers productivity to customers through materials science, tooling and wear-resistant solutions. Customers across aerospace, earthworks, energy, general engineering and transportation turn to Kennametal to help them manufacture with precision and efficiency. Every day approximately 10,000 employees are helping customers in more than 60 countries stay competitive. Kennametal generated nearly $2.4 billion in revenues in fiscal 2019. Learn more at www.kennametal.com. Follow @Kennametal: Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.

Role Overview
To grow the Kennametal India Ltd. (KIL) share in new and existing market segments. Identify new business opportunities in segments and provide product and process solutions. Application specialists are essentially a regional resource to focus on new business opportunities through Process Optimization Services, CPR and Projects in the respective territory. Applications specialists are like business development engineers who should focus on high value opportunities, penetrate new product sales, drive sales engineers and distributor sales engineers training needs, conduct in-plant seminars, create new leads through cold calling and successfully close the opportunity identified in the respective segment in defined time frame.

Key Responsibilities

He should set an example to sell Kennametal products on technical grounds by making successful product -process machining recommendations.
He should develop field sales engineers competencies related to new products through training and on the job demonstration.
Submit monthly report as per the prescribed format to Territory manager covering segment related market intelligence.
Submit a case study on the best trial conducted once in a month for recommendation and circulation.
Support sales engineers in important projects or for solving problems that will require the highest level of technical expertise.
He should look for process re-engineering at customers shop floor to retool up the spindles with KIL tools.
Drive sales growth in the identified low share Key accounts in that segment through POS, CPP, etc.
To grow the KIL share in the assigned segment through conversion and penetration, POS, Projects, etc., He is responsible for growth initiatives and application support for the segment.
Grow KIL share in High potential low share key accounts.
Five Number of Documented customers TPR savings in INR.
Identify opportunities for new projects and generate sales growth in the segment.
Generate new product sales through Conversion, Penetration and Retention (CPR) actions.
Submit project proposal to customer on new components
Submit CPC proposal to Customer
Prove out of CPC model, continuous process and product upgrades to improve profitability.

Qualifications

The Incumbent should hold a Bachelor of Engineering degree or Equivalent with specialization either in Mechanical Engineering or in Production Engineering. He should have minimum 8 years of experience either in Cutting tool sales / application function or in Process engineering. Machine programming experience will be an added advantage. He should have sound knowledge on Machining fundamentals, Process design, Process re-engineering, fundamentals of fixturing, etc. He should be willing to travel and meet customers in various geographic locations. Communication skill with good command in English (oral & Verbal) is preferred for this position. Experience: 8 – 10 years in engineering industry. He should be a go-getter with self-motivation and positive attitude.
As part of our core values, Kennametal is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all people. We are an Equal Opportunity employer.

Kennametal Inc. (NYSE: KMT) brings together materials science, technical expertise, innovative thinking and superior customer service to help the world fly, drive, power and build. Kennametal is built for performance, and every day approximately 8,700 employees are helping customers in more than 60 countries stay competitive. Kennametal generated $2.0 billion in revenues in fiscal 2022.

* Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot histopathology equipment, including tissue processors, embedding stations, microtomes, automated stainers, and related instruments.

* Perform quality control checks and ensure adherence to defined SOPs and quality parameters.

* Coordinate with pathologists regarding specimen quality, slide preparation, repeat sections, and special investigations.

* Maintain accurate records of samples, blocks, slides, reagents, quality control (QC), and equipment maintenance.

* Monitor reagent and consumable inventory and coordinate timely replenishment.

* Follow biosafety, infection-control, biomedical waste management, and laboratory safety guidelines.

* Participate in internal quality assurance, audits, CAP/NABL-related activities, and corrective/preventive actions wherever applicable.

* Ensure timely turnaround time (TAT) for all assigned cases.

* Support implementation and adherence to laboratory policies and process improvements.

* Train and guide junior technicians/trainees on histopathology procedures when required.

Good to Have skills, Pathology, Cytopathology, Histopathology

Description:
Job Title: Nursing (GDA) Trainer
Department: Training / Allied Healthcare
Job Locations: Delhi and Vadodara
Job Summary:
The Nursing (GDA) Trainer will be responsible for conducting training programs for General Duty Assistant (GDA) students, designing and delivering curriculum and learning materials, assessing training needs, and managing all phases of training interventions.
The trainer will ensure educational activities essential for GDA (General Duty Assistant) or Nursing Care Assistants in hospital and home environments. The role involves teaching GDA courses using different instructional methods, reviewing and updating course curriculum, conducting in-service training, and evaluating performance and knowledge levels.
Key Responsibilities:
Build training programs and prepare teaching plans.
Develop classroom handouts, instructional materials, teaching aids, and manuals.
Prepare course materials, syllabi, assignments, and handouts.
Deliver GDA training courses and monitor the quality of learning outcomes.
Conduct orientation sessions and training for new hires.
Assess training effectiveness and ensure the application of taught skills and techniques.
Demonstrate patient care in clinical departments of corporate or government hospitals.
Review and update ongoing training programs to reflect relevant changes.
Keep up to date with developments in the Allied Healthcare field.
Evaluate training programs and students’ performance and knowledge levels.
Qualification:
B.Sc. Nursing is preferred, with relevant teaching/training experience.
GNM candidates with a minimum of 5 years of teaching/training experience may also be considered, as per the JD.
Experience Required for This Requirement:
Minimum 1 year of clinical experience.
Minimum 1 year of teaching/tutor/training experience.
Candidate Profile:
Current and up-to-date nursing skills.
Knowledge of GDA training and patient care.
Familiarity with traditional and modern training methods.
Good presentation, communication, decision-making, and organisational skills.
