Description:
Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. Its your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Principal Accountabilities / Key Responsibilities
F Develop, obtain approval and implement a strategic sales and marketing plan for domestic and export markets, with focus on PP Compounding and non-auto plastic applications.

F Drive Metal-to-Plastic and polymer material replacement projects
F Manage key accounts to achieve sales targets and customer satisfaction
Customer, Key Account Management & Relationships:
F Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers and Non-Auto OEM accounts.
F Understand customer needs in terms of products, technologies, processing (injection moulding) and service expectations.
F Act as a senior interface between the Co. and key non-auto customers.
F Managing key client relationships and ensuring consistent sales performance across all regions.
F Coordinate customer requirements, forecasts, dispatches and inventory planning
F Participate in exhibitions, seminars, technical presentations and customer meetings

People Management & Leadership

Preferred candidate profile
1. BE with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics (PBT/ PA/ PP/ PC/ ABS/ ASA /PET/ PMMA/ Nylon/ Poly/ POM Blends) or chemical raw materials.
2. Proven experience in new project development
3. Strong technical understanding of polymer applications and material selection
4. Strong sales, business development and negotiation skills
5. Strong exposure to Plastic Injection Moulding processes and their linkage with material performance.
6. Hands-on experience handling Non- Auto Industry suppliers and OEM businesses.
7. Proven sales track record and experience in customer support (preferred).
8. Strong communication and negotiation skills.
9. Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain strong client relationships.
10. Effective time management and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
11. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
12. Willingness to travel PAN India

General Manager Sales & Marketing (Engineering Polymers / Plastics)
You are responsible for leading the commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds.
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P&L (Profit & Loss), and building B2B partnerships and oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics (e.g., Nylon, PEEK, Polycarbonates, customized polymer compounds) across target industrial segments.

Strategic & Financial Leadership
F P&L Management: Own revenue targets, gross contribution margins, pricing strategies, and annual budgeting for engineering polymer lines.
F Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Formulate and execute regional or global business development plans to scale market presence.
F Market & Competitor Analysis: Track raw material pricing volatility (petrochemical trends), freight costs, and competitor benchmarks.
Business Development & Key Accounts
F OEM & Processor Relationships: Build direct relationships with major OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 suppliers, and injection moulders/converters.
F Product Substitution: Drive metal-to-plastic or standard-to-engineering polymer conversion initiatives.
F Channel Management: Establish, evaluate, and manage distributor and channel partner networks.
Commodity Market Analysis
F Monitor petrochemical pricing fluctuations, global supply chain bottlenecks, global commodity trends (PP, PE, PVC, PET), currency fluctuations, and competitor pricing to manage risk and optimize trading margins.
B2B Brand Management
F Build brand equity and trust among suppliers (refineries/producers), logistics providers, and industrial buyers.
Commercial Strategy & Trading
F Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for trading commodity and engineering polymers.
Technical & Cross-Functional Coordination
F Technical Sales Support: Collaborate with R&D, production, and quality assurance teams to define technical specifications (MFI, density, impact, tensile strength, fillers) and manage customer trials.
F Product Development: Guide sample testing, custom grade development, and compliance validation for client applications.
Team Management
F Leadership & Mentoring: Direct, coach, and evaluate regional sales managers, technical application engineers, and account executives.
F Performance Tracking: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including sales volume in metric tons, customer acquisition rates, and collection cycles.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.
Risk-adjusted Return on Capital (RAROC): Management of credit cycles, inventory holding, and trade logistics.
Gross profit margins on plastic raw materials and compounding resins.
Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

1. 2. Strong grasp of polymer rheology, resin properties, application engineering, and ERP/CRM tools (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).
3. B2B contract negotiation, high-volume account management, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven forecasting
4. Proficiency in data-driven decision-making, supply-demand forecasting, and CRM utilization.
5. Ability to communicate complex market intelligence to C-suite executives and board members.
6. Decisive leadership when navigating volatile commodity markets or supply chain crises.

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Assistant Vice President – Global Direct and Indirect Tax
Managing end-to-end direct taxation (corporate income tax, transfer pricing) and global indirect taxation (GST, customs, cross-border VAT/service tax), backed by legal interpretation and regulatory compliance.
Key Responsibilities
1. Direct Tax & International Taxation
F Corporate Tax & Compliance: Oversee computation of corporate income tax, advance tax calculations, deferred tax, and annual corporate tax return filings.
F Transfer Pricing: Manage international transfer pricing policies, benchmarking studies, Master File/Local File documentation, and TP audits.
F Cross-Border Transactions: Evaluate tax positions, Permanent Establishment (PE) risks, double tax avoidance agreements (DTAA), and foreign remittance compliances (such as Form 15CA/15CB).
F Handle TDS/TCS compliance, reconciliations, and reporting.
F Manage tax assessments, appeals, and litigation before tax authorities, CIT(A), ITAT, and higher forums.
Monitor changes in direct tax law (Income Tax Act, Finance Act) and assess business impact.
2. Global Indirect Tax
F GST & Customs: Ensure compliance with Goods and Services Tax (GST returns like GSTR-1, 3B, 9/9C, input tax credit reconciliations), e-invoicing, and customs/import-export regulations.
F Global/Multi-Jurisdictional Tax: Monitor and research changes in global indirect tax legislation, digital services tax, and cross-border trade impacts.
F Optimization: Drive Input Tax Credit (ITC) optimization and supply chain tax efficiency.
F Oversee customs duty matters, including import/export compliance, FTA benefits, and SEZ/EOU compliance if applicable.
F Handle indirect tax audits, assessments, and litigation (GST authorities, CESTAT, etc.).
F Advise on classification, valuation, and place-of-supply issues.
3. Litigation, Assessments & Legal Advisory (LLB Focus)
F Tax Litigation: Represent or manage representation before tax authorities, Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) [CIT(A)], Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT), or GST/CESTAT authorities.
F Notice & Scrutiny Management: Draft legal replies, appeals, and submissions for complex scrutiny assessments, search/seizure, or audit notices.
F Commercial & Legal Advisory: Partner with business, finance, and legal teams to structure mergers, acquisitions (M&A), corporate restructurings, and new product rollouts from a tax-risk perspective.
4. Strategic & Advisory
F Develop and implement tax-efficient structures for business transactions, new markets, and M&A.
Partner with business teams on contract structuring, pricing, and new product/service launches from a tax lens.
F Liaise with external consultants, auditors (statutory/tax), and legal counsel.
F Manage relationships with tax authorities and represent the company in assessments/hearings.
F Drive automation and process improvement in tax compliance and reporting.
F Ensure robust internal controls and SOPs for tax processes; support SOX/internal audit requirements.
F Monitor and report tax risk exposure and contingent liabilities to leadership/board.
F Support statutory audit, tax audit (Form 3CD), and financial statement tax disclosures (current/deferred tax, effective tax rate).
5. Governance, Risk & Controls
F Risk Mitigation: Identify contingent tax liabilities, monitor tax governance frameworks, and maintain SOX or internal process controls.
F Stakeholder Management: Liaise with statutory auditors, external tax counsels, and regulatory bodies.
6. Team Leadership:
F Build, mentor, and manage the direct and indirect tax team.
F Set team goals, review performance, and build technical capability.
F Coordinate with Big 4/consulting firms for specialized advisory and litigation support.

Preferred candidate profile
1. LLB with specialization in tax laws is Mandatory with 8 to 12+ years of experience in corporate tax, big-four consulting, or in-house tax functions within banking, financial services, or multinational enterprises.
2. Deep mastery of the Income Tax Act, Transfer Pricing, Finance Act, GST laws, international tax treaties, and case law analysis.
3. High-level stakeholder influence, cross-functional communication, analytical rigor, and crisis/litigation management.
4. Strong experience handling litigation and representing before tax authorities/tribunals.
5. Sound understanding of accounting standards (Ind AS) as they relate to tax.
6. Excellent stakeholder management with CFO, business heads, auditors, and external counsel.
7. Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills.
8. Experience with ERP systems (SAP/Oracle) and tax technology tools is an advantage.
9. Ability to work under regulatory deadlines and manage a lean team efficiently.
Key Performance Indicators:
A. Zero/minimal non-compliance penalties or interest.
B. Effective tax rate optimization within legal framework.
C. Timely closure of assessments/litigation with favorable outcomes.
D. Reduction in tax risk exposure and contingent liabilities.
E. Process automation and turnaround time improvement in compliance.

About this opportunity:
Ericsson is looking for a diligent and competent Domain Support Specialist. to strengthen our Service Delivery team. In this role, you will ensure seamless Operations & Maintenance (O&M), manage incidents and emergencies, and provide advanced technical troubleshooting.

- Deliver O&M support, ensuring availability and performance of core and cloud systems.
- Lead incident and emergency handling, providing timely resolution and RCA for critical events.

- Ensure MIR release and user access controls in line with Ericsson standards.
- Interface with regional and global support teams for escalated issues and knowledge sharing.

- 2-5 years in Telecom O&M, Service Delivery, or Customer Support.
- Hands-on experience with Ericsson Charging System preferred.
- Exposure to AI/ML-driven operations or automation frameworks is an advantage.
- Familiarity with incident, problem, and change management processes.
- Intelligent Networks (IN), CAMEL, INAP.
- Voice Call & Signaling Routing, Network Architecture & Protocols.
- End-to-End Performance Audit & Optimization.
- Knowledge of AI-based monitoring and data analytics tools.
- ITIL, Oracle, CCNA, Red Hat.
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
The role involves converting 3D CAD models and engineering data into high-quality 2D illustrations, exploded views, assembly illustrations, installation/removal procedures, and procedural graphics.

The illustrations must comply with applicable technical documentation standards and support the development of Interactive Electronic Technical Publications (IETP), Repair Parts and Illustrations List (RPIL), Illustrated Parts Data (IPD), and Component Maintenance Publications (CMP).

Qualifications and Experience
B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or an equivalent discipline.
3-5 years of relevant experience in technical illustration and engineering documentation.
Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, CATIA, or equivalent tools.
Strong understanding of technical drawing and documentation standards, including ATA iSpec 2200 and S1000D.
Proven experience in creating technical illustrations compliant with S1000D standards.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent technical illustration tools.
Experience in Illustration Content Number (ICN) management and associated technical publication workflows.
Experience with RPIL, Repair Parts Support (RPS) development, and IPD illustrations is highly advantageous.
Familiarity with IETP standards and Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) deliverables is highly desirable.
Experience working with engineering databases and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools such as Teamcenter, SAP, Agile PLM, Windchill, or 3D Via.
Proficiency in workflow and work-tracking tools such as JIRA.

Key Responsibilities
Create accurate 2D technical illustrations from 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, and technical references.
Develop detailed illustrations, including exploded views, assembly views, section views, detail views, and installation/removal procedures.
Produce procedural graphics and illustrations for technical manuals, maintenance manuals, service manuals, assembly instructions, and parts documentation.
Develop illustrations for IETP, RPIL, IPD, and CMP deliverables.
Use Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent software to create high-quality, vector-based technical illustrations.
Interpret CATIA 3D models to understand product structures, components, assemblies, and engineering designs.
Ensure accuracy in geometry, orientation, proportions, and component relationships.
Apply appropriate line weights, colour shading, hatching, callouts, symbols, arrows, and graphical conventions in accordance with applicable standards.
Analyse complex engineering data, including drawings, specifications, CAD models, bills of materials (BOMs), schematics, wiring diagrams, and Service Bulletins, to develop technically accurate illustrations.
Collaborate with engineers, technical authors, designers, subject-matter experts, and the wider Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) team to clarify technical information and validate content.

Key Relationship Manager Wealth Management

Job Overview
We are looking for an experienced Key Relationship Manager to manage and grow relationships with HNI and UHNI clients. The ideal candidate will have strong wealth management knowledge, excellent client relationship skills, and a proven track record in client acquisition and portfolio growth.

Strong understanding of investment products and financial markets.
Proven ability to manage HNI/UHNI relationships and acquire new clients.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Strong sales orientation with the ability to achieve business and revenue targets.

Description:
Open Locations - Kolkata/Bangalore/Pune/Noida/Kochi
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Managed Services Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EYs global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
Key Requirements
As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands-on implementation experience (desirable)
Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the asset or liability cashflows
Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software such as Prophet / Axis / MG Alpha. Advanced level experience in one of these softwares will be valuable
Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
Good experience of preparing PPT decks
In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of one or more geographies
iduals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
Skills and attributes for success
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus
Ideally, youll also have
Good actuarial exam progress
Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes for GenAI projects.
- Collaborate with data scientists and software engineers to implement machine learning models and algorithms.
- Optimize data infrastructure and storage solutions to ensure efficient and scalable data processing.
- Implement event-driven architectures to enable real-time data processing and analysis.
- Utilize containerization technologies like Kubernetes and Docker for efficient deployment and scalability.
- Develop and maintain data lakes for storing and managing large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
- Implement and integrate LLM frameworks (Langchain, Semantic Kernel) for advanced language processing and analysis.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement solution architectures for GenAI projects.
- Utilize cloud computing platforms such as Azure or AWS for data processing, storage, and deployment.
- Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and systems to ensure smooth and uninterrupted data flow.
- Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in GenAI technologies and recommend innovative solutions to enhance data engineering processes.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
- Document data engineering processes, methodologies, and best practices.
- Maintain solution architecture certificates and stay current with industry best practices.
Requirements:
Python Proficiency: Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience building applications with Python.
Scalable System Design: Solid understanding of designing and architecting scalable Python applications, particularly for Gen AI use cases, with a strong understanding of various components and systems architecture patterns to make cohesive and decoupled, scalable applications.
Web Frameworks: Familiarity with Python web frameworks (Flask, FastAPI) for building web applications around AI models.
Modular Design & Security: Demonstrated ability to design applications with modularity, reusability, and security best practices in mind (session management, vulnerability prevention, etc.,).
Cloud-Native Development: Familiarity with cloud-native development patterns and tools (e.g., REST APIs, microservices, serverless functions).
Cloud Deployments: Experience deploying and managing containerized applications on Azure/AWS (Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Instances, or similar).
Version Control (Git): Strong proficiency in Git for effective code collaboration and management.
CI/CD: Knowledge of continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) practices on cloud platforms.
3-5 years of relevant technical/technology experience, with a focus on GenAI projects.
Strong programming skills in Python.
Experience with data processing frameworks like Apache Spark or similar.
Proficiency in SQL and database management systems.
Preferred Skills:
Gen AI Frameworks: Experience with LLM frameworks or tools for interacting with LLMs such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex
Data Pipelines: Experience in setting up data pipelines for model training and real-time inference.

Description:
Job Summary
Meet the Team
Join a team thats helping some of the worlds largest enterprises successfully deploy AI into production. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), youll work at the intersection of software engineering, customer engagement, and product innovation. Youll partner closely with customers to solve complex technical challenges while collaborating with Product and Engineering teams to improve the platform based on real-world customer needs.
Youll work on some of the most challenging AI deployments in the industry, partnering with Fortune 100 organizations to bring cutting-edge AI systems into production. Every engagement influences not only customer success, but also the future direction of the product. If you enjoy solving hard engineering problems, working directly with customers, and building technology that scales beyond a single implementation, wed love to hear from you.


Your Impact
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
Partner with enterprise customers to understand technical requirements and business goals.
Design scalable AI solution architectures and guide customers through production deployments.
Build integrations, prototypes, and reusable tools that accelerate customer success.
Lead technical workshops, architecture discussions, and troubleshoot complex production issues.
Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to share customer feedback and influence future product enhancements.
Create documentation, reusable best practices, and technical assets that benefit future deployments.


Minimum Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
7+ years of strong software engineering experience building production-grade applications, or Masters + 4 years of related experience, or PhD + 1 year of related experience.
Experience with APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or backend development.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across multiple layers of the technology stack.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with enterprise customers.
Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
Interest in AI, Machine Learning, or developer platforms.


Preferred Qualifications
Experience deploying or supporting Generative AI, LLM, or Machine Learning applications in production.
Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, observability, or MLOps.
Experience building customer-facing technical solutions or integrations.
Experience creating reusable developer tools, frameworks, or open-source contributions.
Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Customer Success experience in enterprise environments.


Disclaimer
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
begin with screening or an interview
originate from a Cisco email address, and
be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx
Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than the Cisco official career site, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, drivers license, or passport.
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

Job Title IMU Digital Commerce Manager
Management Level: 07 Manager
Location: NCR / Mumbai / Bangalore
Must have skills: Digital commerce strategy execution, Category / portfolio management, Customer experience optimization, D2C/Marketplaces/Omnichannel/Quick Commerce, Data driven decision making, Stakeholder Management across cross-functional teams, Team leadership delivery ownership
Good to have skills: Working knowledge of digital marketing, Product management, understanding of emerging technologies, AI / GenAI applications in commerce, Commerce platforms MarTech exposure
Job Summary:
We are looking for a strategic and execution-focused Digital Commerce Manager to own and drive performance across D2C, marketplaces, omnichannel and quick commerce platforms. This role requires strong business ownership with hands-on experience in running digital commerce or a major category, with accountability for revenue, traffic, conversion, AOV/ATV, and customer experience metrics. The ideal candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams across business, marketing, technology, design, supply chain, customer support, etc. to deliver seamless digital shopping experiences and drive revenue growth. Product management capability is a valuable additional skill, and exposure to AI / GenAI or advanced analytics-led initiatives is a strong differentiator.


Roles Responsibilities:

Own end-to-end performance of digital commerce and drive growth for our clients
Deliver revenue growth by enhancing the customer experience and optimizing for conversion, engagement and retention
Lead and manage a team to deliver business outcomes
Define and execute category strategies (assortment, discovery, content, visibility, etc.)
Partner with cross-functional teams to enable and deliver experiences / journeys
Use data, insights, and experimentation to prioritize and solve problems
Stay up-to-date with e-commerce and digital trends to guide innovation
Contribute to product roadmap and platform enhancements where applicable
Champion best practices in UX and customer journey design
Professional Technical Skills:
Strong knowledge of digital commerce ecosystems and customer journeys
Strong grasp of digital commerce KPIs and operating levers
Ability to translate customer needs into functional and technical execution plans
Strong analytical mindset with experience in A/B testing and data visualization
Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills with execution discipline
Proficient in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and product analytics dashboards

As a Client Account Lead, you will be responsible for driving sales growth, revenue expansion, and client value creation in the domestic India market. This role demands a strong ability to originate and structure deals, build long-term trust with C-suite executives, and position Accenture as a strategic partner for transformation and innovation. Originate and pursue new business opportunities with existing and potential clients in telecom, media, and Software Platforms, Hi Tech \ semiconductor sectors.

Strong C-suite relationship management, with ability to influence executive decision-making and drive strategic partnerships.
Consulting and IT services sales expertise, preferably with domestic consulting experience in the India market across any Telecom, Media, Hi Tech, Software Platforms organisation.
Commercial acumen with experience in PL management, deal structuring, and innovative commercial pathways.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, enabling persuasive client engagement and closing complex deals.
Leadership and team management skills, with ability to inspire, guide, and deliver results through high-performing teams.

Job summary
As a Data AI, Manager within the India Market Unit, you will help drive client value creation by combining industry context with Data AI, analytics, and cloud-led delivery. You will partner closely with client stakeholders and internal teams to translate business priorities into well-governed data assets, high-quality insights, and scalable solutions.
In this role, you will own standards and best practices for data analysis, profiling, modeling, mapping, and query governance; ensure data quality and accuracy across delivery initiatives; and support release/change management by understanding end-to-end data flows, dependencies, lineage, and access controls. You will also help shape and deploy predictive and machine-learning solutions using platforms such as Python/Spark and cloud services, while maintaining alignment to organizational data principles and guidelines.

Understand client business priorities, leadership agenda, and industry landscape.
Build and manage strong client relationships, providing strategic insights and industry expertise.
Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency across all delivery initiatives.
Lead data analysis, profiling, modeling, mapping, and query design activities.
Review and govern data queries and DML to maintain performance and compliance.
Define and enforce standards and best practices for data analysis, modeling, and query development.
Develop and maintain an enterprise data dictionary aligned with business glossary and data assets.
Define and manage the organizations data landscape, including overlays with technology architecture, end-to-end data flows, transformations, and lineage.
Partner with the data governance team to ensure adherence to organizational data principles and guidelines.
Delivery experience in industries like Resources, Consumer Goods, Life sciences
Professional Technical Skills:
Proven experience in predictive analytics and data science modeling.
Hands-on expertise with at least one major analytics product/platform.
Strong understanding of big data, data lakes, machine learning, and conversational AI.
Experience deploying models on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Prior consulting experience, preferably with exposure to C-suite stakeholders.
Build, train, and deploy data science models using Python, Spark, and cloud platforms.
Drive analytics initiatives using platform-/cloud-based approaches.
Ability to articulate a clear point of view on analytics trends and services.

K12 Techno Services Pvt. Ltd. is a leading education service provider in India, offering a dynamic suite of academic support, services and solutions to schools. K12 enables schools to leverage its expertise, technology and services to deliver a global approach towards education.
About School
ORCHIDS The International School is a leading chain of progressive schools in India, committed to providing quality education that fosters the holistic development of students.

Energetic, extroverted and target-driven personality. Ability to build relationships with parents, partners and external stakeholders. Willingness to work in the field and achieve business targets.
Details
Work Mode: Onsite / Field-based (School Branch) Working Days: 6 days per week (with 1 rotational day off) Compensation: Competitive salary + Performance-based incentives

Description:
style="margin-bottom: 0px;"> Sous Chef-Indian Cuisine
F&B Production 7-8 Years Full-time Leh, Ladakh
Job Summary:
Job Summary

The Sous Chef - Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting the Executive Chef in managing the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires strong knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, menu execution, and kitchen procedures, along with proven leadership skills and the ability to manage a team effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Key Responsibilities

Assist the Executive Chef in managing the day-to-day operations of the Indian kitchen.
Supervise and coordinate the work of Chefs de Partie, Commis Chefs, and other kitchen team members.
Prepare and oversee the preparation and cooking of Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, portion control, and overall food quality.
Conduct regular quality checks and ensure all dishes meet the required standards before service.
Plan and supervise mise en place and ensure adequate preparation for daily operations and service.
Assist in menu planning, development of new dishes, and implementation of seasonal and special menus.
Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling, and rotation of food items in accordance with FIFO practices.
Monitor ingredient quality, freshness, and availability and coordinate with the relevant departments for timely replenishment.
Control food wastage and assist in maintaining food-cost targets through effective production and portion control.
Ensure strict compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.
Maintain cleanliness, organization, and discipline across the Indian kitchen and assigned work areas.
Assist in managing buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, special events, and other culinary requirements.
Train, guide, and develop junior kitchen team members in Indian cooking techniques, hygiene, and standard operating procedures.
Allocate daily duties and ensure efficient deployment of kitchen personnel during service.
Monitor kitchen equipment and report maintenance requirements, malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to the Executive Chef.
Take responsibility for the Indian kitchen in the absence of the Executive Chef, ensuring uninterrupted and efficient operations.
Work closely with other kitchen sections and service teams to ensure smooth coordination and timely food delivery.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 7-8 years of experience in a professional Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Previous experience in a Sous Chef, Junior Sous Chef, or senior Chef de Partie position is preferred.
Strong knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines.
Proven experience in supervising and leading a kitchen team.
Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, ingredients, and regional cuisines.
Strong leadership and team-management skills.
Ability to maintain consistency and quality during high-volume service.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet service timelines.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good understanding of food cost, portion control, and wastage management.
Ability to train, motivate, and develop junior kitchen team members.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Ability to maintain a clean, disciplined, and professional kitchen environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Description:
Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh (HIAL) is an upcoming Alternative Institute for Mountain Development which follows Contextual Learning and Experiential Pedagogy where students learn by doing and earn while they learn. It aims to develop Ladakh into a benchmark of sustainable living for the mountain world, where all children receive a meaningful education that prepares them for a life of dignity in harmony with nature. It believes in collaborative exercise between learners and facilitators. Instead of solving problems with the conventional 3Rs (Reading, writing, and arithmetic), the learners are encouraged to solve problems using the 3Hs: Bright Head, Kind Heart, and Skilled Hands. The institute is promoted by the renowned leaders in entrepreneurial education in India and attracts talent and grants from leading corporates and Government bodies in India.

Description:
Job Description:
The Purchase Manager will be responsible for end-to-end management of the Sheshyon shop. This includes establishing and maintaining supplier relationships, negotiating favorable deals, overseeing inventory, ensuring timely purchases and sales, handling invoices, tracking budgets, and managing records. The role requires an individual who is highly organized, skilled in negotiation, and capable of fostering efficient and cost-effective operations.

Key Responsibilities:

1.Supply Chain Management:
Establish and maintain relationships with suppliers to ensure a reliable flow of quality goods.
Identify new suppliers and vendors when necessary, expanding options to meet the shop's diverse needs.
2.Negotiations and Vendor Relations:
Negotiate terms, pricing, and conditions with suppliers to achieve cost-effective procurement.
Report on supplier performance to ensure adherence to quality and service standards.
3.Procurement and Inventory Control:
Make timely purchases based on the needs of HIAL, public customers, and budget guidelines.
Manage stock levels, reorder points, and work with suppliers to prevent stockouts.
4.Billing, Budgeting, and Accounting:
Prepare and manage invoices, maintain bill records, and ensure accurate accounting for all purchases and sales.
Track and report on budget allocations, and provide regular updates to management.
5.Customer Service and Sales:
Serve as the main point of contact for both internal HIAL departments and external customers. Ensure a high standard of customer satisfaction and timely responses to inquiries.
6.Returns, Charges, and Price Adjustments:
Assist in the return of goods to suppliers when necessary and handle related documentation. Review carriage charges, price increases, and communicate changes to relevant departments.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's/ Master's or MBA in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field.
Proven experience in purchasing, vendor management, and inventory control.
Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in accounting and budgeting.
Ability to multitask and work in a dynamic environment.

Description:
Position Overview:
HIAL is looking for a dynamic and people-centered HR Manager who can lead and manage the institute's human resource functions in a proactive, empathetic and organized manner. The ideal candidate should be passionate about creating an inclusive, growth-oriented and values-driven work culture while aligning HR practices with the institute's mission.

Key Responsibilities:

1. HR Strategy & Policy Development:
Design, review and implement HR policies and procedures that reflect the institute's ethos and ensure legal compliance.
Support long-term HR planning, including workforce planning, succession planning and talent development.
2. Recruitment & Onboarding:
Lead the end-to-end recruitment process for faculty, administrative and support staff.
Develop effective strategies for talent acquisition, including campus outreach and collaborations.
Ensure smooth onboarding and orientation of new employees.
3. Performance Management & Capacity Building:
Design and implement fair and constructive performance appraisal systems.
Identify training needs and coordinate internal and external capacity-building initiatives.
Support managers in developing individual growth plans for their teams.
4. Employee Engagement & Culture:
Foster a healthy, inclusive and collaborative work environment rooted in mutual respect and collective purpose.
Plan and execute employee engagement activities, feedback mechanisms and team-building initiatives.
Serve as a bridge between staff and leadership, ensuring two-way communication.
5. HR Operations & Compliance:
Maintain accurate and confidential employee records including attendance, leave and service history.
Manage HR-related documentation, including contracts, policies and compliance with labor laws.
Oversee payroll coordination, benefits and timely employee reimbursements in collaboration with the Finance team.
6. Conflict Resolution & Welfare:
Address staff grievances with empathy and fairness, ensuring timely resolution.
Promote mental health and staff well-being initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human Resource Management, Organizational Development, or related field.
Minimum 5 years of progressive HR experience; prior experience in an academic or social sector organization is preferred.
Strong understanding of HR laws, best practices and systems.
Excellent interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work in a multicultural, high-altitude and mission-driven environment.
Desirable Attributes:
Sensitivity to local culture and a passion for sustainable development in the Himalayan region.
Adaptability and willingness to live and work in a remote, cold desert setting.
Experience with HR tech platforms and digital tools.
Ability to handle both strategic HR planning and hands-on operational tasks.

Description:
The Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Finance Head to lead our finance department. As the Finance Head, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the financial stability and success of our organization. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining financial forecasting models, supervising a team of accountants, and identifying cost-saving solutions. Additionally, you will collaborate with senior management to explore alternative funding options, manage resource allocation, and ensure compliance through audits.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Forecasting:
Develop and maintain forecasting models for monthly, quarterly, and annual financial results to provide accurate and timely financial insights to the organization.
Team Leadership:
Provide strong leadership and supervision to a team of accountants, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in all financial transactions. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development within the team.
Cost Optimization:
Identify opportunities for cost-saving solutions to optimize financial performance, enhancing the financial sustainability of the organization.
Funding Exploration:
Collaborate with senior management to explore alternate funding options for projects and initiatives, including grants, partnerships, and investment opportunities.
Resource Management:
Oversee resource allocation and cash flow management to maintain financial stability and ensure that the organization can meet its financial obligations and strategic goals.
Budget Approval:
Review and approve budgets, ensuring they align with the organizational goals and financial constraints. Monitor budget performance and recommend adjustments when necessary.
Vendor Payments and Payroll:
Ensure timely payments to vendors and the punctual release of employee salaries, maintaining strong vendor and employee relationships.
Financial Integrity and Compliance:
Conduct regular audits to maintain financial integrity and compliance with relevant laws and regulations. Develop and implement corrective measures as needed.

Qualifications:
Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. MBA or a relevant advanced degree is preferred.
Proven experience in financial management, including forecasting, budgeting, and cost analysis.
Strong leadership and team management skills with a minimum of 5 years of supervisory experience.
Proficiency in financial modeling, accounting software, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of funding opportunities in the nonprofit sector is a plus.

Description:
Experience Level: Senior (5+ years in relevant field)

Role Summary:
We are seeking a passionate and experienced Senior Architect who is not only a practitioner of sustainable and context-responsive architecture but also an inspiring educator. The candidate will teach, mentor, and lead hands-on learning experiences that embody HIAL's philosophy of learning by doing. The role involves working closely with fellows, interns, and students to design and build passive solar-heated structures, lead community-based projects and organize flagship events such as the Sun and Earth Festival.

Key Responsibilities:

Academic & Teaching:
Design and deliver academic courses on sustainable architecture, passive solar design, earth architecture and responsible construction practices.
Facilitate experiential, hands-on and site-based learning that connect theory with real-world application.
Guide students, fellows, and interns in their individual projects, research and thesis work.
Evaluate learning outcomes and contribute to curriculum development.

Project Leadership & Mentorship:
Lead the design and construction of buildings at HIAL using eco-responsive methods (e.g., mud, stone, rammed earth, straw clay, solar).
Mentor architecture interns, fellows and visiting professionals on live projects.
Supervise and guide interdisciplinary teams on construction, prototyping and innovation in high-altitude building.

Events & Outreach:
Plan and lead events such as the Sun and Earth Festival, celebrating innovation in sustainable building and traditional knowledge.
Facilitate workshops and hands-on training programs for local communities, visiting institutions, and professionals.
Represent HIAL in national and international forums related to sustainable architecture and climate-responsive design.

Required Qualifications & Experience:
Master's degree in Architecture, Sustainable Architecture or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of professional experience, preference will be given to applicants having experience in high-altitude or climate-responsive architecture.
Proven track record in passive solar building design, use of local materials and responsible construction practices.
Prior experience in teaching, training, or community-based capacity building is highly desirable.
Strong design sensibility with the ability to translate concepts into actionable, buildable plans.

Key Skills & Attributes:
Passionate about sustainability and grounded in hands-on, practical problem-solving.
Comfortable working in remote, high-altitude environments and engaging with diverse stakeholders from villagers to international students.
Excellent communication, mentoring and facilitation skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and lead interdisciplinary teams.
Commitment to HIAL's values of innovation, inclusivity and ecological responsibility.

Preferred Qualities:
Familiarity with vernacular Ladakhi architecture and indigenous construction techniques.
Experience working with natural building materials such as adobe, cob, stone and wood.
Inclination towards experiential education and design/build pedagogy.

Description:
Job description
This is a full-time on-site Executive Chef role at Lchang Nang Retreat located in Nubra. The Executive Chef will oversee the culinary operations and manage a team of chefs. The Executive Chef will be responsible for creating and developing recipes, preparing menus, managing inventory, managing costs and ensuring that the highest standards of food quality, presentation, and service are met. They will also be responsible for training and mentoring their team members, and ensuring that the kitchen is clean and well-maintained.

The most important role will be to experiment with locally available produce and work on local cuisine. The Chef should be able to experiment and improvise with local cuisine and should be able to communicate the efforts to guests.
Qualifications

Culinary Arts Degree or equivalent experience
Experience as an Executive Chef, Sous Chef, or similar role
Excellent knowledge of culinary techniques and practices
Proven ability to effectively manage a team of chefs, and to train and mentor colleagues
Experience in menu planning, recipe development, and inventory management
A thorough understanding of food safety and sanitation practices, and the ability to ensure compliance
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work well under pressure
A passion for food, and a creative approach to menu development
Experience with catering and events, and the ability to adapt to different settings and cooking environments

Description:
Finance 2-4 Years Full-time Leh, Ladakh
Job Summary:
About the Role

The Abduz Group is looking for a detail-oriented and dependable Finance Associate to support the day-to-day accounting and financial operations of the organization

The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of basic accounting principles, be proficient in Tally, and have the ability to maintain accurate financial records while ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures

Key Responsibilities

Record and maintain financial transactions accurately in Tally

Process invoices, receipts, payments, and journal entries

Assist in accounts payable and accounts receivable management

Reconcile bank statements, cash accounts, and vendor ledgers

Maintain organized financial records and supporting documentation

Assist in monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities

Verify bills, expense claims, and supporting documents for accuracy

Prepare basic financial reports and summaries as required

Coordinate with various departments to collect and verify financial information

Support statutory compliance and audit requirements by maintaining accurate records

Ensure confidentiality and security of financial information

Identify discrepancies and report them promptly to the Finance Manager

Requirements

Minimum 1 3 years of experience in accounting, finance, or a related role

Sound knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping practices

Proficiency in Tally ERP/Tally Prime is mandatory

Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy

Good analytical and numerical skills

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other MS Office applications

Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines

Strong organizational and record-keeping skills

Honest, reliable, and capable of handling confidential information

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Experience in the hospitality industry will be an added advantage

Familiarity with GST, TDS, and basic statutory compliance requirements is preferred

Description:
Job Title: DataStage Developer
Experience: 2-8 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a talented IBM DataStage Developer with 23 years of experience in ETL development, data integration, and data warehousing projects. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in IBM InfoSphere DataStage, SQL, and database technologies, with the ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL solutions that support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy ETL jobs using IBM InfoSphere DataStage.
Develop and maintain data integration workflows for loading data from multiple source systems into data warehouses and data marts.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical ETL solutions.
Implement data cleansing, validation, and transformation logic.
Optimize DataStage jobs for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support UAT activities.
Troubleshoot ETL job failures and resolve production issues.
Work closely with database administrators, business analysts, and data architects.
Maintain technical documentation and adhere to development standards.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with organizational policies.
Required Skills
2 - 8 years of hands-on experience in IBM InfoSphere DataStage development.
Strong experience in ETL design and development.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Knowledge of DataStage components including:
Designer
Director
Administrator
Manager
Parallel Jobs
Sequence Jobs
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Description:
I hope you are doing well.
I am reaching out regarding an exciting opportunity with BD (Becton, Dickinson and Company) for the position of Deputy Manager Medical Affairs based in Chandigarh.
This role is ideal for a healthcare professional who enjoys engaging with clinicians, building KOL relationships, driving clinical education initiatives, and partnering closely with commercial teams to enhance healthcare outcomes.
About the Role
As a Deputy Manager Medical Affairs, you will play a key role in executing clinical strategies across the region by:
To execute and implement Clinical Strategies for MDS in the respective regions / territory in line with the market requirements and the country business plan with the purpose of creating clinically differentiated market position.
Principal Responsibilities
Conduct Clinical Marketing Education Programs, Seminars, Promotional Events and In-service Programs in the respective region in order to improve BD MDS value proposition amongst both clinical and economic buyers, by engaging KOLs towards MDS business outcome and achieve regional business objectives.
Clinical capability building (administering trainings, continuous evaluation) amongst regional MDS direct selling organization and amongst channel partners in line with the country clinical objectives in order to enhance their ability to adequately differentiate the brand MDS in the market and thus achieve targeted business outcomes.
Creating and implementing the regional calendar of engagements with the potential / existing customers in order to create strong brand awareness and creating door openers at the relevant levels.
Support / assist sales organization with product evaluations, clinical audits in hospitals, setting protocols and processes in hospitals and 'critical to business' technical challenges (including but not limited to troubleshooting and product applications) in order to attain high levels of product penetration, query resolution and trouble free product application.
Leading edge key customer relationship management and creation of regional KOL network in order to ensure usage of full array of BD MDS products by leading client organizations and using these customer relationships to drive the conversions.
Coordinate on the timely completion of clinical /economic studies initiated in the region in order to ensure that the clinical / economic studies planned for the year are completed within the stipulated timelines.
Conduct Induction Training Programs (Clinical & Product Training) to Sales Organization, provide clinical Updates, annual / quarterly Product refreshers and run Clinical Proficiency Tests on a need basis / from time to time.
Preferred Background
We are particularly interested in professionals with:
MBBS qualification (MBA preferred)
3-5 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
Medical Affairs
Clinical Affairs
Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL)
Clinical Education
Scientific Affairs
Clinical Applications / Clinical Specialist roles
Strong experience in:
KOL development and physician engagement
CME/CNE programs
Clinical training and education
Hospital stakeholder management
Product demonstrations and evaluations
Cross-functional collaboration with commercial/sales teams
Exposure to:
Medical Devices
Diagnostics
MedTech
Pharma
Critical Care
Infusion Therapy
Infection Prevention
Vascular Access
Willingness to travel extensively (70-80%) across North India.
Why Consider BD?
BD is a global leader in medical technology, advancing the world of health by improving medical discovery, diagnostics, and the delivery of care. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with leading hospitals, clinicians, and healthcare decision-makers while contributing to meaningful patient outcomes.
If this opportunity aligns with your experience and career aspirations, I would be happy to connect and share further details.
Please feel free to reply with your updated resume and a suitable time to speak.
Looking forward to hearing from you.
AboutCompany: BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world and is advancing the world of healthTM by improving medical discovery, diagnostics and the delivery of care. The company supports the heroes on the frontlines of healthcare by developing innovative technology, services and solutions that help advance both clinical therapy for patients and clinical process for healthcare providers. BD and its 75,000 employees have a passion and commitment to help enhance the safety and efficiency of clinicians' care delivery process, enable laboratory scientists to accurately detect disease and advance researchers' capabilities to develop the next generation of diagnostics and therapeutics. BD has a presence in virtually every country and partners with organizations around the world to address some of the most challenging global health issues. By working in close collaboration with customers, BD can help enhance outcomes, lower costs, increase efficiencies, improve safety and expand access to healthcare.

About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Admission Counselor to guide working professionals in choosing the right upGrad programs based on their career goals and professional experience.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with working professionals through calls and other communication channels to understand their career and learning requirements.
Counsel prospective learners about upGrad programs, courses, eligibility, and career benefits.
Follow up with leads and convert prospective learners into enrolled students.
Achieve assigned monthly admission and revenue targets.
Maintain regular follow-ups and build strong relationships with prospective learners.
Handle queries and objections related to programs, fees, eligibility, and career outcomes.
Maintain accurate lead and conversion records in the CRM.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth admission and enrollment process.

Requirements
0-3 years of experience in Inside Sales, EdTech Sales, Admission Counseling, Telesales, or Business Development.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong convincing, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities.
Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics.
Ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable learning programs.
Good follow-up and relationship-management skills.
Candidates from EdTech, Education, BFSI, Telecom, or other sales-driven industries are preferred.
Willingness to work from the Pune office.
AboutCompany:
Started in 2015, upGrad is one of Asia's largest integrated Learning, Skilling, and Workforce Development Majors. It offers a range of online & hybrid skilling, pathway and study abroad courses, Certifications, and Bootcamps under its B2C portfolio. It also facilitates top Indian and global universities to offer their Diploma, Masters and Executive Doctorates. Additionally, select programs are tailored for Enterprise clients under the corporate skilling division, along with other recruitment and staffing services.
Origin: Co-founded by Ronnie Screwvala, Mayank Kumar, and Phalgun Kompall, upGrad was born to bridge the gap between imparting skills and employability, and is committed to providing affordable, accessible and high-quality lifelong learning at scale to millions worldwide. It caters to the end-to-end learning requirements of freshers to seasoned professionals in the age group of 18-60+ years who would use constant learning to enhance their skill sets while also receiving career acceleration.

Impact: To bridge the gap between academia and the industry, upGrad has built an immersive and 360-degree integrated learning solution that rests upon strong pillars like Content, Technology and Deep Personalization, further accelerating stronger career outcomes for learners. It enjoys a wide brands credibility and recall within India Inc. and globally, and continues to command strong course completion rates as high as 80%+ and higher Repeat and Referral rates annually. The skilling major has achieved two consecutive years of remarkable growth, closing FY23 and FY24 with over 55,000 successful career transitions, further establishing the credibility and mettle of the online higher education segment in India and globally.

Description:
Job Summary

Delhivery is looking for an experienced operations leader to head Fulfillment Center (FC) Operations, drive operational excellence, improve productivity, optimize costs and ensure seamless end-to-end fulfillment. The role requires strong expertise in large-scale warehouse operations, supply chain management, inventory control, process improvement and team leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and oversee end-to-end fulfillment center operations, including inbound, receiving, put-away, storage, inventory management, picking, packing, dispatch and returns.
Develop and implement operational strategies to improve productivity, throughput, order accuracy, service quality and overall efficiency.
Drive operational excellence through process standardization, automation, technology adoption and continuous improvement initiatives.
Manage operational budgets, cost optimization, resource utilization and productivity targets to achieve business objectives.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including fulfillment accuracy, inventory accuracy, turnaround time, throughput, SLA adherence and cost per shipment.
Lead large operations teams, build leadership capability and drive a performance-oriented culture across fulfillment centers.
Drive capacity planning, manpower planning, infrastructure utilization and peak-season readiness in line with business volumes.
Collaborate with transportation, linehaul, first-mile, last-mile, technology, planning and customer experience teams to ensure seamless end-to-end operations.
Leverage warehouse management systems (WMS), data analytics and automation to improve operational visibility and decision-making.
Ensure adherence to operational SOPs, safety standards, statutory requirements and audit processes.
Identify operational bottlenecks, conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Lead facility expansion, operational transformation and scalable process implementation to support business growth.


Required Qualifications and Experience

Proven experience managing large-scale fulfillment or warehouse operations, preferably across multiple facilities or locations.
Strong understanding of end-to-end warehouse processes, inventory management, order fulfillment and distribution operations.
Demonstrated success in improving operational KPIs, productivity, service levels and cost efficiency.
Experience in budget management, capacity planning, resource optimization and operational governance.
Proven ability to lead large teams and develop senior operational leaders.
Strong analytical, strategic planning, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.
Experience with warehouse management systems, operational dashboards and process improvement methodologies.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider. With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
CompanyAddress: PLOT NO. 5 SECTOR 44 GURGAON , GURGAON, Haryana, India
