Description:
Position responsible for all the food and beverage operations, which includes all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
Oversees guest and employee satisfaction, maintaining standards and meeting or exceeding ficial goals.
Demonstrates knowledge and proficiency of all applicable food and beverage laws and regulations.
Develops and implements business plan for food and beverage.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Developing and Maintaining Budgets
- Develops and manages all ficial, employee engagement and guest satisfaction plans and actions for Food and Beverage departments.
- Maintains a positive cost management index for kitchen and restaurant operations.
- Utilizes budgets to understand ficial objectives.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Manages the Food and Beverage departments (not catering sales).
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Oversees all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
- Creates and nurtures a property environment that emphasizes motivation, empowerment, teamwork, continuous improvement and a passion for providing service.
- Provides excellent customer service to all employees.
- Responds quickly and proactively to employees concerns.
- Provides a learning atmosphere with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Provides proactive coaching and counseling to team members.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Monitors and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Sets clear expectations with the employees and team leaders and verifies that appropriate rewards are given if expectations are exceeded.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides excellent customer service.
- Responds quickly and proactively to guests concerns.
- Understands the brands service culture.
- Drives alignment of all employees, team leaders and managers to the brands service culture.
- Sets service expectations for all guests internally and externally.
- Takes ownership of a guest complaint/problem until it is resolved or it has been addressed by the appropriate manager or employee.
- Verifies all banquet functions are up to standard and exceed guests expectations.
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Manages day-to-day operations, drives quality, and verifies standards are meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Conducts performance reviews in a timely manner.
- Promotes both Guarantee of Fair Treatment and Open Door policies.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Develops an action plan to attack need areas and expand on strengths based on employee engagement and guest satisfaction results.
Additional Responsibilities
- Complies with all corporate accounting procedures.
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Drives effective departmental communication and information systems through logs, department meetings and property meetings.

Description:
1. Background of The Hans Foundation
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust working towards creating an equitable society and enhancing the quality of life of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. THF works to improve the health and wellbeing of remote and underserved populations, with additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women, alongside education and livelihood development.
2. Project Overview: Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre project aims to strengthen access to essential healthcare for rural and hard-to-reach communities in Meghalaya. In its first phase, THF has committed to supporting 50 Sub-Centres through gap assessment, provision of equipment and facilities, deployment of skilled human resources, training, regular operations and monitoring. The project seeks to improve grassroots health services and contribute to better health outcomes, including maternal health.
3. General Information Position MIS Associate Project Hans Health & Wellness Centre (HWC), Meghalaya Location To be specified based on project requirement (e.g., assigned HSC / Project Office) No. of Positions 1 (or as per approved project requirement) Employment Type Contractual for one year; renewable based on performance and project requirements Reporting To Project Manager 4. Key Duties and Responsibilities A. Data Collection, Entry and Management
Collect, compile and enter data received from HSCs in approved registers, Excel sheets, MIS platforms and reporting formats.
Provide data-entry and documentation support to HSC staff, Project Manager and MEL Manager, as required.
Maintain an updated and organised database of HSC-wise service delivery, beneficiary and programme information, as applicable to approved project indicators.
Ensure that records are complete, legible, accurate and updated within prescribed timelines.
B. Data Quality and Verification
Review submitted data for completeness, consistency, duplication, missing entries and obvious errors; seek clarification or corrections from the concerned HSC staff.
Cross-check digital data with source registers and records wherever required.
Maintain proper documentation and an audit trail for corrections and updates; do not alter clinical records without authorisation.
Flag data gaps, discrepancies and delayed submissions to the Project Coordinator for timely resolution.
C. Reporting and MIS
Prepare and submit regular HSC-wise and consolidated project progress reports as per the reporting calendar and formats approved by THF.
Compile monthly and periodic data on service delivery and project indicators, as applicable and approved by the project team.
Support preparation of summary tables, charts, dashboards and presentations for internal reviews and management meetings.
Share verified data with the Project Coordinator and authorised stakeholders within stipulated timelines.
D. Record and Document Management
Maintain and organise registers, reporting files, attendance records and other programme documentation assigned to the role.
Ensure systematic filing, version control, safe storage and timely retrieval of records, in both digital and physical formats.
Support documentation of data-related observations, follow-up actions and reporting submissions.
E. Coordination and Field Support
Coordinate with MLHPs, GNM/ANMs and other HSC personnel to obtain timely and accurate data and clarify reporting requirements.
Follow up on pending reports and support staff in understanding prescribed data formats and reporting timelines.
Participate in project review meetings, trainings and data-verification visits as assigned.
Undertake other MIS, data management and administrative responsibilities relevant to the HWC project, as assigned by the reporting officer.
F. Confidentiality and Compliance
Maintain confidentiality and protect personal and health-related information of beneficiaries in accordance with THF policies and applicable requirements.
Share data only with authorised personnel and use approved systems and formats for storage and transmission.
Adhere to THF policies, professional conduct standards and instructions issued by the project management team.
5. Educational Qualifications
Graduate in any discipline from a recognised institution.
Diploma or certificate in Computer Applications / IT is preferred.
6. Experience and Technical Skills
Preferably 2-3 years of experience in MIS, data entry, reporting, programme support or a related role. Fresh graduates with strong computer skills may also be considered.
Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, email and data-entry systems; ability to maintain structured spreadsheets and prepare basic summaries is essential.
Experience in health programmes, public health reporting or work with healthcare facilities would be an advantage.
Ability to check data for accuracy, maintain organised records and meet recurring reporting deadlines.
7. Behavioural and Other Requirements
Good communication, coordination and follow-up skills.
Attention to detail, integrity, reliability and respect for confidentiality.
Ability to work with frontline health staff and manage multiple reporting tasks within deadlines.
Proficiency in English and Hindi; knowledge of the local language/dialect is desirable.
Willingness to travel to assigned HSCs or project locations, as required.
8. Equal Opportunity Statement
The Hans Foundation is an equal opportunity employer and encourages women, persons with disabilities and individuals from economically and socially excluded communities who meet the requisite skills and qualifications to apply. THF does not discriminate on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or any other such matter.

Description:
Field Associate - West Garo Hills (Garo Language)
Location: West Garo Hills, Meghalaya (Onsite)
Experience Level: 1-3 years (Relevant fellowships in enterprise/livelihoods considered)
Salary Band: 5-6 LPA
Job Summary
Ground Zero is looking for an independent, field-driven Field Associate based in West Garo Hills to strengthen women-owned Producer Groups (PGs) through our Women s Enterprise Support System (WESS). Working directly with community members and state livelihood frameworks, this role provides handholding support in day-to-day business operations, member engagement, governance, procurement, and market linkages across rural enterprises (agri-business, spices, etc.).
Responsibilities
Community Mobilization & Member Engagement: Mobilize and engage women producer group members (~20 members per group) for collective business actions, including produce procurement, aggregation, and marketing.
Business Operations & Planning: Help set up ground-level business operations for agri-business and value chains. Coordinate with input suppliers, buyers, transporters, and local service providers.
Governance & Financial Records: Assist PG leaders in maintaining accurate books of accounts, meeting resolutions, governance registers, and financial discipline.
Capacity Building & Training: Facilitate block and district-level training sessions for producer groups and community cadres.
Strategic Linkages & Coordination: Build institutional linkages with local government departments, market actors, and financial institutions under the guidance of the senior team.
Reporting & Field Surveys: Conduct ground-level surveys, market studies, and maintain routine field reports on operational progress, issues, and financials.
Qualifications & Candidate Profile
Education: Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Rural Management, Development Studies, or a related field (Master s/MBA preferred).
Experience: 1-3 years of experience in rural development, SHGs/PGs, collective enterprises, or livelihood promotion. Candidates with recognized fellowships in rural enterprise development will also be considered.
Language Mandatory: Excellent written and spoken command of Garo is mandatory. Basic ability to communicate in English and Hindi is preferred.
Key Competencies: Strong community mobilization skills, basic computer literacy (MS Word, Excel), and willingness to conduct rigorous field travel.
Logistics: Having a personal two-wheeler/bike is highly advantageous for field mobility. Candidates must be open to occasional travel to Shillong and Guwahati for official meetings.
Diversity: Female candidates are preferred, though qualified male candidates are also encouraged to apply.
Hiring Process
Round 1: HR & Program Team Interview
Round 2: Practical Assignment
Round 3: Final Interview based on Assignment (with Program Lead)
Hiring Note: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills
THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

Description:
Field Associate - West Jaintia Hills (Khasi Language)
Location: Meghalaya
Experience Level: 1-3 years (Relevant fellowships in enterprise/livelihoods considered)
Role Overview
Ground Zero is seeking an energetic Field Associate to empower women-owned Producer Groups (PGs) under our Women s Enterprise Support System (WESS). The candidate will work independently on the ground, driving member participation, enterprise governance, local business operations, procurement, and market linkages in agri-business and rural commodities.
Key Responsibilities
Community Mobilization & Member Engagement: Mobilize women producer group members (~20 members per group) for collective business activities, procurement, aggregation, and local marketing.
Business Operations & Planning: Assist PG leaders in executing business plans across local value chains (agri-commodities, spices, etc.). Coordinate with input suppliers, buyers, and logistics service providers.
Governance & Financial Records: Guide PG leaders in maintaining financial discipline, books of accounts, meeting documentation, and governance records.
Capacity Building & Training: Organize and conduct block- and district-level training sessions for women entrepreneurs and producer group leaders.
Strategic Linkages & Stakeholder Support: Facilitate market, credit, and institutional linkages with government departments and community institutions with strategic guidance from senior leadership.
Field Monitoring & Reporting: Conduct needs assessments, value chain studies, and submit regular updates on field progress, financials, and operational challenges.
Qualifications & Candidate Profile
Education: Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Rural Management, Social Work, or a related discipline (Master s/MBA preferred).
Experience: 1-3 years of experience in rural development, livelihood promotion, SHGs/PGs, or enterprise development. Candidates from development/enterprise fellowship programs are also eligible.
Language Mandatory: Fluency in written and spoken Khasi is mandatory. Basic proficiency in English and Hindi is desirable.
Key Competencies: Strong field facilitation skills, basic computer proficiency (MS Excel, Word), and a proactive approach to solving field challenges.
Logistics: Owning a personal two-wheeler/bike is highly preferred for rural movement. Periodic travel to Shillong and Guwahati for strategic reviews will be required.
Diversity: Female candidates are preferred, though eligible male candidates are welcome to apply.

Description:
Location: Meghalaya, India
Experience: Minimum 7 Years
Department: Laboratory / Quality Control
Qualification: M.Sc. in Microbiology / Biotechnology or relevant discipline


Job Summary
ITC Labs is looking for an experienced and skilled Microbiologist to manage microbiological testing, quality control, and laboratory operations at its Meghalaya location. The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise in microbiological analysis, laboratory quality systems, testing procedures, and compliance with applicable standards.


Key Responsibilities
Conduct microbiological testing of food, water, raw materials, finished products, and other relevant samples as per laboratory requirements.
Perform microbial enumeration, pathogen detection, and sterility testing wherever applicable.
Handle microbiological techniques such as media preparation, microbial culturing, incubation, colony counting, and identification.
Ensure compliance with applicable testing standards, SOPs, GLP, GMP, and laboratory quality management systems.
Operate, maintain, and calibrate microbiology laboratory equipment.
Maintain accurate testing records, worksheets, and laboratory documentation.
Investigate out-of-specification (OOS) results, deviations, and non-conformities, and support root cause analysis and corrective actions.
Ensure proper handling, storage, and disposal of microbiological samples and biohazardous waste.
Maintain laboratory hygiene, biosafety, and contamination-control practices.
Support internal and external audits, method validation, proficiency testing, and accreditation requirements, wherever applicable.
Guide junior team members and ensure timely completion of testing activities.


Required Skills
Strong knowledge of microbiological testing and analytical techniques.
Hands-on experience in food, water, pharmaceutical, or other relevant testing laboratories.
Knowledge of relevant BIS, FSSAI, ISO, or other applicable testing standards.
Familiarity with laboratory documentation, SOPs, quality control, and audit procedures.
Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and manage laboratory testing schedules.


Eligibility Criteria
Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in microbiology.
Sc. in Microbiology, Biotechnology, or a relevant scientific discipline.
Prior experience in a commercial testing laboratory or NABL-accredited laboratory will be preferred.
Experience in food and water microbiology will be an added advantage.
Company-provided accommodation in Meghalaya.
Competitive compensation based on experience and skills.

A. About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Manager/ Senior Analyst Management Consulting (Commercial) to support the execution of a consultancy assignment with Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited (MeECL) and its subsidiaries viz. Meghalaya Power Generation Corporation Limited, Meghalaya Power Transmission Corporation Limited and Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited. The role involves supporting the Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited in supporting in day to day commercial activities such as monitoring the billing, collections, identification of energy and revenue leakages etc.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on Commercial function. Key responsibilities include:

Business Process Re-engineering
Review the existing process of reporting of key commercial parameters of the Distribution utility.
Prepare a Standard Operating Procedure for reporting of the key parameters along with responsibility matrix.
Engage with all the Stakeholders and get the feedback from them on the proposed SOP including middle and lower management.
Assist in the implementation of the Standard Operating Procedure within timeframes as approved by the Management.
Provide on recommendations on digital interventions along with the probable solutions along with the cost benefit analysis.
Formulate standardized daily, weekly and monthly reporting formats on key parameters with diagnostic analysis along with probable interventions to capture adverse deviations.

Billing and Collection
Monitoring the effective of billing and facilitating in ensuring 100 % billing.
Formulating Process of Billing Quality check. like- Under billed consumers, Overbilled, never billed.
Preparing of Billing, Collection & customer data Management Information reports from the billing Master data.
Billing & Collection Analysis of consumers of various categories.
Suggesting Changes & improvement of Billing system to minimize errors and system gaps.
Work in close coordination with the Unified Billing System provider.
Analyze the data of Smart Metered Consumers in terms of key parameters and prepare a report on the deviations along with the corrective actions. The report is to be circulated to all lower, middle and top management and vigilance team for corrective actions.
Suggesting the utilities on best practices in the industry for billing and collection checks.
Coordinate with Distribution Franchisee operator for submission of monthly MIS as per the contract document.

Management Review
Prepare presentation at sub-division level for the review meeting by management highlighting the key parameters along with the diagnostic analysis and suggestions for improvement.
Coordinate with the sub-divisions level officers for the Action Taken Report after each review meeting.

C. Required skill set:
Strong technical and commercial knowledge about the power distribution business.
Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
Experience in handling smart meter data
Working knowledge of key regulatory interventions effecting the commercial parameters of DISCOM.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
BE/ B. Tech/ MBA/ M. Tech (Candidates with B. Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
Knowledge of advanced MS Excel and Microsoft Power point is highly preferred.
Atleast 5 Years experience in Commercial Matters of DISCOM or consultancy company.

E. Location:
Shillong, Meghalaya.
The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.

Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd. (Mercados) is a specialist consultancy firm, exclusively focused on business solutions in the energy and environment domain. Since the beginning of its operations in India in 2008, Mercados has been supporting clients across the energy sector value chain. We strive to promote efficient and sustainable energy markets; design effective regulations and assist energy businesses to succeed. Our approach integrates innovative, state-of-the-art techniques with practical, tailor-made solutions to solve current energy sector challenges. We have permanent offices in New Delhi (head office), Gurugram, Mumbai, Ahmedabad and Lucknow and various Project offices across India.

Our Consulting portfolio envelopes diverse segments like ‘Strategy and Business Growth’, ‘Policy, Economic Analysis and Regulations’, ‘Planning, Energy Markets & Simulation Models’, ‘Transaction Advisory Services’, ‘Integrated Energy Supply Services’ and ‘Performance Improvement (Utility Management Services)’.

Description:
Quality Assurance Specialist (Food)
Meghalaya MSc./B.Tech/B.Sc. 7+ years
Location: Meghalaya
Employment Type: Fixed
Experience: 7+ years
Joining: Immediate joiner preferred


Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced Quality Assurance Specialist with strong food testing and regulatory expertise to lead quality assurance activities at our Meghalaya facility. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in an NABL-accredited food testing laboratory and in-depth knowledge of FSSAI regulations, and can ensure analytical accuracy, compliance and audit readiness.


Key Responsibilities
Implement, maintain and continually improve the Quality Management System (QMS) in line with ISO/IEC 17025 and NABL requirements.
Ensure compliance with FSSAI Act, Rules and Regulations, including food safety standards, labelling, contaminants and residue limits.
Prepare, review and control SOPs, quality manuals, work instructions, formats and records.
Plan and conduct internal audits, and coordinate NABL, FSSAI and customer audits, including closure of non-conformances (NCs) with CAPA.
Oversee method validation and verification, measurement uncertainty, and equipment calibration and maintenance schedules.
Manage proficiency testing (PT) and inter-laboratory comparison (ILC) programs and evaluate results.
Monitor internal quality control (IQC) activities and review test data, reports and certificates of analysis for accuracy and compliance.
Handle customer complaints, deviations, out-of-specification (OOS) and out-of-trend (OOT) investigations.
Maintain document control, traceability of reference standards and records, and data integrity.
Conduct training for technical and quality staff on QMS, food safety and regulatory updates.
Support management reviews and prepare MIS and quality performance reports.
Track regulatory updates from FSSAI and other authorities and implement changes in a timely manner.


Qualifications
M.Sc. in Food Technology, Food Science, Chemistry, Microbiology or a related discipline (B.Tech/B.Sc. in Food Technology with relevant experience may be considered).
Minimum 7 years of experience in quality assurance in the food industry or an NABL-accredited food testing laboratory.


Technical Skills
Strong working knowledge of ISO/IEC 17025:2017 and NABL guidelines.
Thorough understanding of FSSAI regulations, standards and licensing/notification requirements.
Familiarity with HACCP, GMP, GHP and food safety management systems (FSSC 22000 / ISO 22000 is an advantage).
Experience with food testing parameters (chemical, microbiological, residue and contaminant analysis).
Knowledge of statistical tools, uncertainty estimation and method validation.
Good command of MS Office and report writing.


Desired Attributes
Lead assessor or internal auditor certification (ISO/IEC 17025, ISO 22000) preferred.
Strong documentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and leadership abilities.
Willingness to work and stay in Meghalaya for the contract duration.
Ability to join immediately.


What We Offer
Opportunity to lead quality systems in a regulated food testing environment.
Company-provided accommodation in Meghalaya.
Competitive compensation based on experience and skills.

Customer focus: Driving NPS and lower Detractor %
Greeting customers when they enter the store and coaching the team to do the same Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Description:
About Virohan

Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal , Virohan is an education-to-industry partner building the workforce powering India s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry-aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real-world employability.

At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms. Our model combines academic learning with hands-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles. Today, Virohan has trained 13,000+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
Backed by global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan) , we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare - two of India s fastest-growing sectors.

At our core, we are guided by a strong set of values that define how we work, build, and grow together - from ownership and bias for action to empathy, continuous learning, and raising the bar. If you re excited about building something meaningful at scale and solving real-world problems, you ll find yourself at home at Virohan.

Role Overview

The City Admission Manager will own Virohan s end-to-end performance in the assigned city-driving admissions, centre operations, team productivity, student experience, partner coordination, and local brand growth. This person will act as the single accountable business owner for the city, ensuring that all city-level teams deliver against growth, quality, and profitability goals.

What you ll be responsible for

Conduct market surveys alongside competitors.
Identify additional offerings for students.

Description:
Role Overview
The Infrastructure Finance Expert will provide financial and economic expertise to support the planning and appraisal of infrastructure and risk reduction interventions, with a focus on long-term resilience and efficiency.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Overall Evaluate the financial and economic benefits of infrastructure and disaster risk reduction interventions, including assessment of avoided losses and long-term impacts.
Undertake cost-benefit analysis and economic analyses to support investment decisions for resilient infrastructure and risk mitigation measures.
Support preparation and review of financial and economic appraisal documents, models, and justification notes for government review and approval.
Provide technical inputs to prioritisation and decision-making processes based on economic viability, sustainability, and value for money.
Educational Qualifications:
CA/CMA or MBA (Finance)/Master of Finance and Control /M.Com /PGDBM (with specification in Finance).
Skills and Experience:
Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience in the field.
Experience of working on at least one externally funded project (such as ADB, AFD, WBG, etc.)
Prior work experience across Himalayan regions with exposure to multiple hazards in India, Nepal, Bhutan, etc.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Job Purpose
To lead and manage all store operations within the cement plant, ensuring efficient receipt, storage, preservation, inventory control, and issuance of materials, spare parts, consumables, and capital items. The role is responsible for maintaining inventory accuracy, optimizing stock levels, supporting uninterrupted plant operations, and ensuring compliance with company policies, safety standards, and audit requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. Store Operations Management
Oversee day-to-day store activities including receipt, inspection, storage, preservation, and issue of materials.
Ensure systematic storage and identification of all inventory items.
Implement best practices in warehouse and store management.
Maintain proper housekeeping and safety standards within store premises.
2. Inventory Management
Monitor inventory levels and ensure availability of critical spares and consumables.
Optimize stock holdings to balance operational requirements and inventory carrying costs.
Conduct regular stock verification, cycle counting, and annual physical inventory.
Analyze slow-moving, non-moving, obsolete, and surplus inventory and recommend corrective actions.
3. Material Receipt & Dispatch
Ensure timely receipt and documentation of incoming materials.
Coordinate with procurement, quality, and user departments for material inspection and acceptance.
Manage material issuance as per approved procedures and authorization matrix.
Monitor transportation and dispatch activities where applicable.
4. ERP & Documentation Control
Ensure accurate and timely transactions in ERP systems (SAP/Oracle/other ERP platforms).
Maintain inventory records, stock registers, material movement records, and statutory documents.
Generate periodic MIS reports related to inventory, stock valuation, consumption trends, and KPI performance.
5. Coordination & Stakeholder Management
Liaise with procurement, maintenance, production, finance, and project teams for material planning and availability.
Support plant shutdowns, overhauls, and project activities through effective material management.
Coordinate with vendors and logistics partners regarding deliveries and material discrepancies.
6. Compliance, Audit & Governance
Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, and statutory requirements.
Facilitate internal, external, and statutory audits.
Implement inventory control procedures to prevent losses, pilferage, and material deterioration.
Ensure adherence to ISO, safety, environmental, and quality management systems.
7. Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop store personnel.
Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence within the stores function.
AboutCompany: We are driven by not just our core business of producing superior quality cement, but also the desire to create a positive impact in peoples lives, as well as the environment. Hence, along with world-class labs for quality control, we have a built-in, self-regulating mechanism to encourage a positive impact on the environment, employees, local communities and stakeholders. Sustainability initiatives form a major part of our corporate social responsibility policy and strive to improve living conditions in surrounding areas.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To carry out chemical analysis and quality control activities for raw materials, intermediate products, clinker and cement to ensure compliance with defined quality standards and specifications. The role will be responsible for XRF analysis, laboratory testing, monitoring chemical parameters and supporting consistent product quality throughout the manufacturing process.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Chemical Analysis & Quality Control
Conduct chemical analysis of limestone, additives, raw mix, kiln feed, clinker, gypsum, fly ash, slag and cement.
Perform routine and non-routine chemical testing as per established laboratory procedures.
Monitor key chemical parameters such as:
CaO, SiO, AlO and FeO
MgO, SO, KO, NaO and other relevant parameters
LOI and other quality indicators
Ensure test results are accurate, reliable and recorded properly.
B. XRF Operations
Operate and perform routine analysis using X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) equipment.
Prepare samples and pellets/beads as required for XRF analysis.
Perform calibration, standardization and routine checks of the XRF equipment.
Monitor instrument performance and identify abnormal readings or deviations.
Maintain XRF-related records, standards and calibration data.
Coordinate with the concerned team for troubleshooting and maintenance of XRF equipment.
C. Cement & Clinker Quality Monitoring
Monitor the chemical quality of clinker and cement at different stages of production.
Analyze and report quality deviations promptly to the concerned departments.
Support production teams in maintaining required chemical parameters.
Ensure final cement quality meets applicable BIS/IS specifications and internal quality standards.
Assist in maintaining consistency in cement quality.
D. Raw Material & Process Control
Analyze incoming raw materials and monitor their chemical characteristics.
Monitor raw mix and kiln feed quality.
Evaluate chemical variations and communicate deviations to the concerned team.
Support optimization of raw mix and process parameters based on laboratory results.
E. Laboratory Management
Ensure proper functioning, cleanliness and housekeeping of the chemical laboratory.
Maintain laboratory equipment, instruments, chemicals, reagents and standards.
Maintain proper records of test results, calibration, analysis and equipment maintenance.
Ensure safe handling, storage and disposal of laboratory chemicals.
Follow laboratory safety procedures and applicable environmental and safety requirements.
F. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain daily laboratory test reports and quality records.
Prepare and communicate test results to the concerned HOD/Manager.
Ensure timely reporting of critical quality deviations.
Maintain documentation as per departmental SOPs and quality systems.
Participate in internal/external quality audits whenever required.
3. Required Skills & Competencies
Hands-on experience in XRF analysis in a cement manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of cement chemistry and quality control.
Good understanding of raw mix, clinker and cement chemical parameters.
Knowledge of laboratory testing procedures and quality standards.
Ability to interpret XRF results and identify quality deviations.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to coordinate effectively with Production, Process, Mines and Quality teams.
Good documentation and reporting skills.
Strong attention to accuracy and detail.
Knowledge of laboratory safety and chemical handling procedures.
4. Preferred Experience
Candidates should preferably have:
4+ years of relevant experience in a cement manufacturing plant.
Strong hands-on exposure to XRF operation and analysis.
Experience in cement/clinker/raw material chemical analysis.
Experience working in a Quality Control / Quality Assurance laboratory of a cement plant.
Exposure to BIS/IS standards and cement quality specifications.
Experience with laboratory instruments and calibration/standardization activities.
5. Key Performance Areas (KPIs)
Accuracy and reliability of laboratory/XRF test results.
Timely completion and reporting of chemical analysis.
Compliance with cement quality specifications.
XRF equipment uptime and proper maintenance.
Reduction of testing errors and quality deviations.
Proper maintenance of laboratory records and documentation.
Compliance with laboratory safety procedures.
Effective coordination with Production and Process departments.
Candidate Profile
Minimum Experience: 4+ Years
Mandatory Industry: Cement Manufacturing
Mandatory Technical Skill: XRF Analysis
Qualification: B.Sc./M.Sc. Chemistry or equivalent
Department: Quality Control
Ideal Candidate: A technically sound Chemistry professional with 4+ years of hands-on experience in a cement plant, particularly in XRF operation, clinker/cement chemical analysis, raw material testing and quality control, with the ability to independently handle routine laboratory operations and support process-quality improvement.
AboutCompany: We are driven by not just our core business of producing superior quality cement, but also the desire to create a positive impact in peoples lives, as well as the environment. Hence, along with world-class labs for quality control, we have a built-in, self-regulating mechanism to encourage a positive impact on the environment, employees, local communities and stakeholders. Sustainability initiatives form a major part of our corporate social responsibility policy and strive to improve living conditions in surrounding areas.

Description:
Purpose of the role

The face of the D2C platform in the physical market. Visit mechanics, roadside garages, small workshops, and truck operators in an assigned territory. Demonstrate the platform, register new buyers, facilitate the first purchase, and ensure the buyer can use the app independently. This role converts an unorganized market buyer into a digital platform user.

Key Responsibility
Cover assigned pin codes daily visit mechanics, garages, and small fleet operators to introduce the D2C platform
Register new buyers on the platform (app install + profile creation) target 15+ new registrations per day
Demonstrate app search (by vehicle model and part name), part selection, payment, and delivery tracking
Facilitate the buyer's first online spare parts purchase stay with them through the transaction
Follow up within 7 days of first purchase to ensure delivery satisfaction and resolve any issues
Capture buyer feedback on platform gaps: parts not found, confusing UX, delivery complaints report weekly
Maintain a daily activity log: shops visited, registrations done, first purchases facilitated
Attend weekly territory review with Category Manager / Lead BD
Participate in platform training sessions when new features or categories are launched

Qualification & Experience

13 years in field sales, FMCG distribution, insurance agency, or fintech outreach roles
Knowledge of commercial vehicles or spare parts market strongly preferred
Smartphone proficiency; able to demonstrate app fluently in local language
High energy and comfort with ground-level market work workshops, roadside interactions
Local language fluency essential; Hindi and regional language preferred
Diploma Holder from Mechanical Background

Kitchen Support Experts play an important role in support of several hotel functions.
These associates may work across departments (eg, kitchen, food and beverage, employee dining room) to support cleaning and basic kitchen preparation needs.
Whether preparing fresh clean linen and spotless dining ware for guests to enjoy, operating and maintaining cleaning equipment and tools (eg, dishwashing machines, hand wash stations), or transporting dishware across the hotel, these associates do whatever it takes to get the job done.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintece needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications.
Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards.
Speak with others using clear and professional language.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: No high school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

Proactive Problem Solving

AboutCompany:
Jindal Power Limited (JPL) is a leading Indian power company with a diverse energy portfolio encompassing thermal and renewable sources. With an impressive installed capacity of 4300 MW, JPL has been instrumental in meeting the nation's growing power demands. Pioneering the establishment of an Independent Power Plant (IPP) in 2007 with its 4x250 MW thermal power unit in Chhattisgarh's Raigarh district, JPL has continued its expansion in Tamnar with a 2400 MW (4X600 MW) thermal power plant.

JPL energy portfolio includes 3400 MW at Tamnar, Chhattisgarh and 600 MW at Simhapuri Andhra Pradesh & 300 MW at Shirpur, Maharashtra. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies and best practices, JPL has set new standards in India's power sector.
The company's vision is to emerge as a significant player in the industry, contributing to the nation's development. Committed to renewable energy sources, JPL aims to substantially increase the share of power generated through sustainable means. As the 5th largest integrated power producer in India, based on million units of generation, and with three captive mines, JPL stands as a key player in the sector. The company envisions establishing benchmarks in renewable energy, carbon emissions, and environmental protection. Furthermore, JPL is a trailblazer in community development and welfare initiatives.

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
F&B and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our F&B Service Experts is skilled in a wide range of event functions and able to take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests experience is well taken care of from start to finish.
Whether setting tables and event materials communicating with the kitchen, interacting, and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the F&B Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintece needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications.
Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards.
Speak with others using clear and professional language.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals.
Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
The position is accountable for proactively soliciting and handling sales opportunities. Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Assists in leading all day-to-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives. Achieves personal sales goals.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales Opportunities
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings. Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Provides accurate, complete and effective turnover to Event Management.

Managing Sales Activities
- Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).

Using Knowledge of Market Trends and Target Customer Information to Maximize Revenue
- Identifies new business to achieve personal and location revenue goals.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for the location based on market conditions and location needs.
- Gains understanding of the location s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.

Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Supports the company s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes and supports the company s customer service standards.
- Provides excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the company.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Kitchen Support Experts play an important role in support of several hotel functions. These associates may work across departments (e.g., kitchen, food and beverage, employee dining room) to support cleaning and basic kitchen preparation needs. Whether preparing fresh clean linen and spotless dining ware for guests to enjoy, operating and maintaining cleaning equipment and tools (e.g., dishwashing machines, hand wash stations), or transporting dishware across the hotel, these associates do whatever it takes to get the job done.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: No high school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Reportingto Store Manager
SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Group Company: JSW Steel Limited
Designation: Shift Incharge
Job Brief: JSW Steel Limited is seeking a highly skilled and experienced professional to oversee and manage operations within the Steel Melting Shop (SMS). This role demands a proactive leader responsible for ensuring efficient production processes, maintaining safety standards, and optimizing resource utilization in a high-volume manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will coordinate shift activities, lead a team of operators and technicians, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to meet production targets while adhering to quality and environmental standards.
Responsibilities:
Supervise and coordinate all activities during the assigned shift in the Steel Melting Shop to ensure smooth and efficient operations.
Monitor and control the steel melting process parameters to maintain product quality and meet production schedules.
Lead, mentor, and manage the shift team, including operators and technicians, ensuring adherence to safety protocols and operational procedures.
Implement and enforce strict compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations within the shop floor.
Analyze production data and generate shift reports highlighting performance metrics, deviations, and corrective actions.
Collaborate with maintenance teams to schedule and oversee preventive and corrective maintenance activities to minimize downtime.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying bottlenecks, recommending process optimizations, and implementing best practices.
Coordinate with other departments such as Quality Control, Logistics, and Engineering to ensure seamless workflow and timely resolution of operational issues.
Manage inventory of raw materials and consumables required for the melting process, ensuring availability and minimizing wastage.
Conduct regular training sessions and safety drills to enhance team competency and emergency preparedness.
Skills:
Steel Melting Process Control
Shift Operations Management
Team Leadership and Development
Safety and Environmental Compliance
Production Planning and Scheduling
Root Cause Analysis
Preventive Maintenance Coordination
Data Analysis and Reporting
Inventory Management
Continuous Improvement Methodologies
Emergency Response Management
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field from a recognized institution.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in steel manufacturing operations, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or shift leadership role within a Steel Melting Shop or similar heavy manufacturing environment.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Process all guest check-ins, verifying guest identity, form of payment, assigning room, and activating/issuing room key. Set up accurate accounts for each guest according to their requirements. Enter Marriott Rewards information. Ensure rates match market codes, document exceptions. Secure payment prior to issuing room key, verify/adjust billing. Compile and review daily reports/logs/contingency lists. Complete cashier and closing reports. Supply guests with directions and property information. Accommodate guest requests, contacting appropriate staff if necessary. Follow up to ensure requests have been met. Process all payment types, vouchers, paid-outs, and charges. Balance and drop receipts. Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift. Obtain manual authorizations and follow all Accounting procedures. Notify Loss Prevention/Security of any guest reports of theft.
Assist management in training, evaluating, counseling, motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Develop/maintain positive working relationships; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Follow company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure personal appearance is clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Ensure adherence to quality standards. Enter and locate information using computers/POS systems. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. Description:
Title - Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About Lenskart

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Customer focus
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Product recommendation
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick- up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Store upkeep & maintenance
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Title Store Manager

Reporting to Area Operations Manager

About Lenskart

With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

We are looking for a passionate and driven Support Services Executive to join our dynamic team at Manipal Hospitals!

About Us:
As a pioneer in Healthcare, Manipal Hospitals is among the top healthcare providers in India serving over 5 million patients annually. Today we stand as an integrated network with a pan-India footprint of 49 hospitals across 19 cities with 10,500 beds, and a talented pool of over 7,200 doctors and an employee strength of over 20,000.

Ensure cleanliness and hygiene across all patient care areas, including Wards, ICUs, OPDs, public areas, and back-of-house, in line with hospital standards.

Ensure compliance with hospital policies, SOPs, quality standards, infection control practices, statutory regulations, and accreditation requirements.
Monitor departmental service quality and patient satisfaction indicators, implement corrective actions, and drive continuous service improvement.
Coordinate with internal departments and external vendors for smooth execution of support service activities.
Train, guide, and supervise support staff, conduct regular briefings, and ensure adherence to operational standards.

Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory

Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.
