Description:
Role Overview
The Assistant Professor - General Surgery is an early-career faculty and clinical role combining undergraduate teaching, supervised postgraduate training, patient care, operative practice, academic contribution, and departmental service. The position reports to the Head of the Department of Surgery and supports safe, evidence-informed surgical care across outpatient, inpatient, emergency, and operation-theatre settings. A NABH-accredited tertiary teaching hospital integrating patient care, undergraduate education, postgraduate training, research, and multidisciplinary surgical services. The appointee is expected to model professional conduct, strengthen learner competence, contribute to service continuity, and accept responsibilities assigned within the scope of General Surgery.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver structured undergraduate lectures, tutorials, demonstrations, and case-based sessions aligned with the approved curriculum and departmental teaching plan.
Conduct undergraduate clinical classes using bedside, outpatient, ward, skills-laboratory, and discussion-based methods while protecting patient dignity and consent.
Assess learner progress through appropriate formative and summative activities, provide actionable feedback, and maintain accurate academic records as assigned.
Manage scheduled outpatient consultations by obtaining focused histories, examining patients, planning investigations, documenting decisions, and arranging follow-up or admission when indicated.
Evaluate inpatients admitted under the assigned unit, review clinical progress, coordinate treatment plans, and respond promptly to referrals from other departments.
Attend emergency surgical patients during rostered on-call periods, support timely stabilization and escalation, and document assessment, consent, treatment, and handover decisions.
Perform and assist surgical procedures within demonstrated competence, granted privileges, institutional protocols, and the supervision arrangements applicable to the case.
Attend assigned operation-theatre schedules, complete preoperative preparation, participate in operative decision-making, and ensure appropriate postoperative review and continuity of care.
Supervise postgraduate trainees in theatre and clinical areas, matching responsibility to competence while maintaining patient safety and accountable faculty oversight.
Coordinate multidisciplinary care with anaesthesia, critical care, radiology, pathology, nursing, rehabilitation, and other specialties when patient needs require collaborative management.
Maintain complete, timely, and confidential clinical documentation and follow applicable requirements for infection prevention, surgical safety, quality assurance, ethics, and incident reporting.
Cover the defined duties of other Assistant Professors during approved leave, subject to departmental rosters, clinical competence, workload, and safe service arrangements.
Develop accurate public-education articles on surgical health topics for approved media channels, using evidence-based language and appropriate institutional review processes.
Undertake other academic, clinical, administrative, research, quality-improvement, and departmental responsibilities assigned by the Head of Surgery within the role's lawful scope.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical institution recognised for registration and practice in India.
MS in General Surgery or DNB in General Surgery from a recognised awarding body, with equivalence documentation where applicable.
Eligibility for appointment as Assistant Professor under the Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations, 2025 and subsequent applicable NMC directions.
Current, valid registration with the National Medical Commission or the relevant State Medical Council, with no unresolved restriction affecting the proposed duties.
Documentary evidence supporting qualifications, registration, experience, appointments, relieving dates, and the specific NMC eligibility pathway claimed.

Required Experience
Minimum experience: The candidate must meet an applicable NMC Assistant Professor pathway. Under the standard pathway, this includes 1 year as Senior Resident in General Surgery in a recognised medical institution after the relevant postgraduate qualification. Candidates relying on another permitted pathway must provide complete evidence satisfying the conditions attached to that pathway; institutional verification remains mandatory.
Relevant experience must demonstrate active General Surgery work across outpatient assessment, inpatient management, interdepartmental referrals, emergency or on-call coverage, operative participation, postoperative care, clinical documentation, and undergraduate teaching. Experience should be supported by verifiable appointment, tenure, duty, and experience records rather than self-description alone.
Preferred experience: Documented clinical teaching, resident supervision, research, audit, patient-safety work, or quality improvement beyond the regulatory minimum will strengthen suitability but does not replace mandatory NMC eligibility.

Technical and Functional Skills
General surgical assessment, differential diagnosis, risk stratification, investigation planning, perioperative decision-making, and evidence-informed patient management.
Outpatient, inpatient, referral, emergency, on-call, preoperative, intraoperative, postoperative, and discharge-care workflows relevant to General Surgery.
Operative assisting and operating capability appropriate to training, recent experience, documented competence, supervision level, and institutional clinical privileges.
Safe surgery practices covering consent, identification, checklist compliance, antibiotic stewardship, blood-product awareness, infection prevention, and structured handover.
Undergraduate curriculum delivery, clinical demonstration, bedside teaching, case discussion, learner assessment, feedback, and maintenance of academic documentation.
Postgraduate supervision that calibrates delegation to trainee competence and preserves direct faculty accountability for patient care and escalation.
Interpretation and application of relevant clinical records, laboratory results, imaging reports, pathology findings, and multidisciplinary recommendations.
Use of electronic or computerised medical records, presentation software, online academic resources, and routine departmental communication systems.
Clinical audit, research ethics, literature appraisal, scientific writing, public health communication, and preparation of accurate surgical education material.
Working knowledge of NMC faculty eligibility, medical education expectations, institutional policies, ethical practice, confidentiality, and professional documentation.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Clear, respectful communication with patients, families, learners, colleagues, and multidisciplinary teams, including difficult conversations and safe handovers.
Professional judgement, integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and willingness to disclose uncertainty or seek senior support when required.
Calm prioritisation during emergencies, changing theatre demands, competing clinical responsibilities, and on-call escalation.
Patient-centred empathy and culturally respectful behaviour without compromising clinical standards, consent, safety, or documentation.
Teaching presence that encourages questions, corrects errors constructively, and differentiates supervision according to learner competence.
Reliability, punctuality, collegiality, adaptability, and readiness to provide approved cross-coverage within safe workload limits.
Commitment to continuous learning, reflective practice, audit, research, quality improvement, and feedback-driven professional development.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Completed recognised training in medical education, biomedical research, research methodology, clinical audit, or evidence-based medicine.
Peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, surgical audits, teaching innovations, or verified contributions to public surgical education.
Experience in a tertiary-care teaching environment managing diverse elective and emergency General Surgery presentations.
Demonstrated participation in surgical safety, morbidity and mortality review, infection prevention, antimicrobial stewardship, or accreditation activities.
Readiness to complete faculty-development or research courses within the timelines required by the applicable NMC pathway or institutional policy.

Professional Tenure and Background
An appropriate background includes a documented progression from MBBS and recognised postgraduate General Surgery training into Senior Residency or another valid NMC pathway, followed by increasingly accountable clinical, teaching, and operative duties. Appointment and experience records should clearly identify institution, department, designation, dates, employment status, bed-strength or recognition evidence when relevant, and responsibilities supporting eligibility.
Experience in recognised medical institutions, teaching hospitals, or appropriately documented government-hospital pathways is valued because it supports verifiable exposure to structured education, governance, multidisciplinary care, and clinical accountability. Selection will be based on regulatory eligibility, evidence of competence, role relevance, and verified accomplishments rather than employer prestige alone.

Compensation and Benefits
The selected candidate will receive competitive, role-aligned remuneration and benefits in accordance with institutional policy, verified credentials, experience, responsibilities, and the final terms of appointment. Exact financial terms will be communicated through the formal selection process.

Application Instructions
Submit an updated resume with the role title, MBBS and postgraduate qualification details, registration status, complete employment chronology, Senior Residency or alternate-pathway evidence, teaching and operative experience, publications or audits, and current contact details. Candidates may apply through email, LinkedIn message, or WhatsApp using the contact information stated in the LinkedIn outreach post. Shortlisting and appointment remain subject to document verification, NMC eligibility review, reference checks, and institutional selection requirements.

Description:
Role Overview

Position Details: Associate Professor - Paediatrics; 2 positions; Department of Paediatrics; reports to the Professor / Head of Unit; work location: Gangtok, Sikkim.

This mid-senior academic-clinical role combines undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, supervised clinical service, assessment, research guidance, and assigned unit administration. The incumbent will help MBBS students, interns, and postgraduate medical students build safe, evidence-informed paediatric knowledge and practical competence. The role supports high-quality outpatient, inpatient, emergency, NICU, and PICU care while contributing to patient satisfaction and continuous improvement. The Associate Professor works under the Professor / Head of Unit and may lead unit activities when authorised.

Employer Profile: A confidential tertiary-care academic teaching hospital integrating paediatric care, medical education, clinical training, and research.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver competency-based lectures, tutorials, bedside teaching, demonstrations, and clinical discussions for MBBS students, interns, and postgraduate medical students.
Formulate the rotational undergraduate teaching schedule and coordinate faculty inputs to maintain complete, timely academic coverage.
Plan, conduct, and document internal examinations and periodic assessments using approved standards, blueprints, records, and constructive learner feedback.
Supervise seminars, case presentations, journal clubs, clinical postings, procedural learning, and academic mentoring across paediatric services.
Provide outpatient and inpatient paediatric care with the unit team and support evidence-informed diagnosis, treatment, discharge, and follow-up decisions.
Serve as first on call for paediatric emergencies on assigned duty days and escalate difficult or unstable cases promptly.
Supervise or perform appropriate procedures in the NICU, PICU, outpatient department, wards, and emergency settings within authorised privileges.
Report complex, high-risk, and emergency cases to the Unit In-charge or Head of Department and document decisions accurately.
Cover assigned consultant responsibilities during approved leave or service gaps to maintain continuity of teaching and patient care.
Lead assigned unit administration, including duty rosters, work allocation, coordination, and staff guidance, when delegated.
Support need assessment, specification development, procurement inputs, and responsible utilisation of paediatric medical equipment.
Guide learner and departmental research through question development, protocol review, ethical practice, analysis, writing, and dissemination.
Advance patient satisfaction, safety, quality indicators, infection prevention, audit, and continual clinical-service improvement.
Maintain academic, clinical, research, and statutory records while completing other duties assigned by the Head of Department.

Required Qualifications
The candidate must hold an MBBS degree and an NMC-recognised MD or DNB in Paediatrics, or another qualification formally accepted as equivalent under the regulations in force. A valid NMC or State Medical Council registration is mandatory. The candidate must satisfy the applicable Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations, including prescribed research-publication, biomedical-research, and medical-education training requirements, as verified at appointment.

Required Experience
The standard academic pathway requires 4+ years as Assistant Professor in Paediatrics at an NMC-recognised medical institution; 5+ years is required where the candidate's applicable NMC route prescribes the longer threshold. Any alternative statutory pathway must be fully documented and independently verified. Relevant experience must include formal undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, learner assessment, clinical supervision, and paediatric patient care. Demonstrated exposure to NICU, PICU, outpatient, inpatient, and emergency services in a teaching-hospital environment is essential.

Technical and Functional Skills
Paediatric clinical assessment, decision-making, documentation, referral, discharge planning, and escalation across OPD, wards, NICU, PICU, and emergencies.
Competency-based medical education, lesson planning, teaching schedules, internal assessment, question setting, evaluation, feedback, and academic recordkeeping.
Clinical supervision of learners and safe oversight of authorised paediatric and neonatal procedures within institutional protocols.
Research methods, ethics, literature appraisal, protocol development, data interpretation, manuscript guidance, and NMC-compliant publication evidence.
Quality improvement, patient safety, infection prevention, audit, duty-roster planning, equipment inputs, and multidisciplinary coordination.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Clear academic communication, structured feedback, learner mentorship, and respectful collaboration with students, faculty, nurses, and allied teams.
Compassionate family communication, ethical judgement, cultural sensitivity, confidentiality, and calm leadership during paediatric emergencies.
Accountability, dependability, adaptability, prioritisation, conflict resolution, and commitment to continuous professional development.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Preference will be given to candidates with a strong teaching portfolio; completed NMC-recognised faculty-development courses; eligible research publications; demonstrable academic or clinical quality-improvement work; experience guiding postgraduate research; and additional documented competence in neonatology, paediatric intensive care, medical education, or clinical research. These preferences do not replace mandatory NMC eligibility.

Professional Tenure and Background
Expected progression includes recognised postgraduate training, Senior Residency or an accepted equivalent pathway, and an Assistant Professor appointment meeting the applicable 4+ years or 5+ years NMC threshold. Candidates should show sustained paediatric service, measurable teaching contributions, documented research, and ethical conduct in recognised teaching institutions.

Compensation and Benefits
The selected candidate will receive a competitive, role-aligned compensation package and institutional benefits based on verified qualifications, experience, responsibilities, and internal policy. Exact figures and salary ranges are intentionally not disclosed in this document.

Application Instructions
Submit an updated resume identifying the role, together with MBBS and postgraduate qualification records, medical-registration details, complete teaching-experience certificates, research-publication evidence, and applicable faculty-development certificates. Shortlisting and appointment remain subject to credential, experience, publication, registration, and NMC-eligibility verification.

AboutCompany:
Sikkim Manipal University was established in 1995. It is the first Government-Private initiative in the region and first ever Public Private Partnership (PPP) in the country for higher Education and Health Care services.
The University has two campuses: Health Sciences (Tadong) and the Technology campus (Majitar). All courses run by SMU are approved by the regulatory bodies like National Medical Commission (NMC), Nursing Council of India, Indian Association of Physiotherapy, All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) ,UGC and the Distance & Online Education Council.

Description:
Role Overview
The Assistant Professor - Forensic Medicine & Toxicology is a full-time academic faculty position responsible for teaching, assessment, medico-legal practice, research, and departmental service. The role supports undergraduate MBBS students, postgraduate medical students, and interns through competency-based instruction, supervised practical learning, and reliable academic evaluation. Reporting to the Head of Department, the incumbent will contribute to autopsy services, expert opinions, court duties, curriculum delivery, and institutional responsibilities. The position requires sound professional judgment, ethical conduct, accurate documentation, and the ability to connect forensic principles with clinically and legally relevant practice.

Key Responsibilities
a. Deliver structured lectures, practical demonstrations, tutorials, seminars, and supervised training for MBBS, postgraduate medical students, and interns.
b. Design teaching schedules, lesson plans, learning resources, competency maps, and assessment activities aligned with the approved curriculum and applicable NMC standards.
c. Conduct medico-legal autopsies and related examinations within authorized scope, maintaining accuracy, dignity, biosafety, evidence integrity, and complete contemporaneous records.
d. Prepare clear post-mortem reports, medico-legal opinions, certificates, and advisory inputs for authorized public authorities when formally required.
e. Attend court proceedings, present impartial medical evidence, explain findings within professional competence, and maintain secure case documentation.
f. Develop and administer internal assessments, practical examinations, viva voce evaluations, university examinations, feedback processes, and remediation plans.
g. Guide student research, dissertations, presentations, and scholarly projects while ensuring ethical approval, methodological rigor, and responsible research conduct.
h. Undertake independent and collaborative research, contribute to publications, and participate in seminars, webinars, conferences, workshops, and continuing professional development.
i. Maintain the departmental museum, specimens, displays, registers, inventories, teaching aids, and associated documentation in accordance with safety and ethical requirements.
j. Coordinate assigned departmental activities, academic records, accreditation evidence, timetables, examination duties, and other responsibilities delegated by authorized institutional leadership.
k. Complete or maintain applicable faculty-development requirements, including biomedical research and medical-education training prescribed by current regulations or institutional policy.
l. Uphold confidentiality, impartiality, chain-of-custody controls, professional ethics, infection prevention, quality systems, and respectful interprofessional collaboration.

Required Qualifications
MBBS and MD/DNB in Forensic Medicine and Toxicology from institutions and programmes recognized for faculty eligibility under current National Medical Commission requirements are mandatory. The candidate must hold active registration with the relevant State Medical Council or NMC-recognized registration authority, as applicable. DNB candidates must satisfy any additional teaching-equivalence or Senior Residency requirement applicable to the awarding institution and prevailing regulations. All degrees, registrations, experience records, and equivalence documents must be valid and independently verifiable.

Required Experience
The minimum requirement is one year of qualifying post-PG experience in the concerned subject, normally as a Senior Resident in a recognized medical institution, or another pathway expressly recognized under current NMC regulations. Recognized alternatives may include eligible postgraduate Tutor experience, qualifying Armed Forces experience, or qualifying government-hospital service, subject to documentary verification and the conditions prescribed for that pathway. Candidates should demonstrate relevant exposure to medical teaching, medico-legal autopsy work, report preparation, court processes, and departmental administration. A total of 2-4 years of relevant post-PG teaching or medico-legal experience is preferred.

Technical and Functional Skills
The role requires working knowledge of forensic pathology, toxicology, thanatology, medical jurisprudence, autopsy technique, injury interpretation, preservation and dispatch of samples, chain of custody, medico-legal documentation, expert opinion, and courtroom testimony. The candidate should be able to apply competency-based medical education, curriculum planning, student assessment, feedback, research methodology, ethics, scientific writing, and basic biostatistical interpretation. Proficiency with presentation software, digital learning platforms, academic records, literature databases, and routine office applications is expected.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Essential behaviours include integrity, impartiality, discretion, attention to detail, calm decision-making, clear written and oral communication, and respect for legal and ethical boundaries. The incumbent must teach complex or sensitive material with maturity, collaborate effectively with students, clinicians, administrators, laboratory teams, law-enforcement personnel, and judicial stakeholders, and manage competing academic and medico-legal priorities. Reliability, empathy, cultural sensitivity, accountability, and commitment to continuous learning are central to success.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Preference may be given to candidates who have completed the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and relevant medical-education or faculty-development training; have verifiable publications, conference presentations, or student-guidance experience; and have handled court testimony, curriculum development, university examinations, accreditation documentation, or museum curation. Training in research ethics, good clinical practice, educational technology, simulation, or quality improvement will strengthen the candidature.

Professional Tenure and Background
An appropriate career path includes MBBS, recognized postgraduate specialization in Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, and qualifying post-PG experience. The preferred profile offers 2-4 years of relevant exposure in recognized medical colleges, teaching hospitals, authorized medico-legal services, or other institutions accepted under current NMC pathways. Progressively responsible teaching, autopsy, court, research, assessment, and departmental assignments are valued.

Compensation and Benefits
The appointment offers competitive, role-aligned compensation and faculty benefits governed by institutional policy, qualifications, verified experience, and internal parity. Applicable benefits and any professional-development, conference, or research support will be communicated during the selection process.

Application Instructions
Applicants should submit a curriculum vitae, qualification certificates, registration proof, eligibility and experience records, publication list, and verifiable evidence of teaching, autopsy, court, research, and academic administration. Applications must be accurate and complete; eligibility and experience will be verified.

Description:
Role Overview
The Associate Professor of General Surgery is a senior academic-clinical faculty position responsible for undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, supervised surgical training, patient care, assessment, research, and departmental service. The role reports to the Head of Department or Professor and works across classrooms, bedside clinics, outpatient and inpatient services, emergency duty, and operation-theatre schedules. This is an on-site appointment in Gangtok, Sikkim. The appointee will strengthen learner competence, safe surgical practice, clinical governance, and patient satisfaction through disciplined teaching and continuous improvement. The employer is a confidential tertiary teaching hospital integrating patient care, education, clinical training, and research.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver structured lectures, tutorials, demonstrations, and clinical classes for MBBS students in alignment with the approved curriculum.
Conduct postgraduate seminars, case discussions, journal clubs, clinical meetings, and bedside teaching for General Surgery trainees.
Mentor interns, residents, and postgraduate students in clinical reasoning, procedural competence, professional conduct, documentation, and patient communication.
Plan and implement competency-based teaching, formative feedback, workplace-based assessment, and remedial support for learners requiring improvement.
Serve as an internal or external examiner when appointed and contribute to fair, confidential, and evidence-based undergraduate and postgraduate assessment.
Attend scheduled outpatient clinics, evaluate new and follow-up patients, establish management plans, and maintain timely clinical records.
Manage inpatients admitted under the assigned unit and respond appropriately to interdepartmental referrals requiring surgical evaluation.
Provide emergency surgical assessment and treatment during allocated on-call duties, escalating complex cases through established clinical pathways.
Perform scheduled and emergency operations within credentialed privileges while supervising postgraduate trainees according to competence and patient-safety requirements.
Lead perioperative planning, informed-consent practice, antibiotic stewardship, infection prevention, morbidity review, and safe discharge coordination.
Coordinate with anaesthesia, critical care, radiology, pathology, nursing, allied health, and other specialties to deliver multidisciplinary care.
Contribute to ethically approved research, indexed publications, clinical audits, conferences, continuing medical education, and departmental academic output.
Advance patient satisfaction and service quality by reviewing feedback, resolving care concerns, monitoring outcomes, and implementing measurable improvements.
Provide reasonable faculty coverage during colleagues leave and undertake additional academic, clinical, administrative, or public-education duties assigned by the Head of Department.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from an institution recognised under applicable Indian medical-education requirements.
MS or DNB in General Surgery from a recognised institution; DNB equivalence must satisfy the conditions applicable to teaching appointments.
Valid medical registration under applicable law and eligibility to practise the specialty without restriction.
Documented eligibility for appointment as Associate Professor in General Surgery under current National Medical Commission requirements.
Completion of required Basic Course in Medical Education and Basic Course in Biomedical Research, or a valid pathway permitting completion within the prescribed period after appointment.

Required Experience
The standard teaching pathway requires at least 4 years of documented experience as Assistant Professor in General Surgery in a recognised medical institution, together with the research and faculty-development requirements applicable under current NMC regulations. Candidates qualifying through another expressly permitted NMC pathway, including the relevant cumulative post-postgraduate government-hospital experience route, may also be considered after documentary verification. Experience must include independent and supervised operative care, OPD and inpatient management, emergency surgery, undergraduate teaching, postgraduate teaching, learner assessment, and postgraduate supervision. All experience, appointment orders, relieving records, teaching evidence, registration records, publications, and course certificates must be verifiable.

Technical and Functional Skills
Broad-based general surgical assessment, diagnosis, decision-making, operative planning, and postoperative management.
Independent performance of procedures within credentialed scope and safe supervision of trainee participation.
Emergency surgery, trauma evaluation, resuscitation coordination, escalation, and perioperative risk management.
Outpatient, inpatient, referral, critical-care interface, discharge, follow-up, and continuity-of-care workflows.
Competency-based medical education, curriculum delivery, bedside teaching, assessment design, feedback, and remediation.
Clinical documentation, informed consent, medical records, patient confidentiality, medico-legal awareness, and ethical practice.
Research methods, literature appraisal, clinical audit, manuscript development, publication ethics, and academic presentations.
Quality improvement, infection prevention, antibiotic stewardship, morbidity-and-mortality review, and patient-safety systems.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Clear teaching, listening, feedback, counselling, accountability, and interdisciplinary communication.
Calm, respectful, ethical leadership with sound judgement, adaptability, empathy, and appropriate escalation.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Laparoscopic or minimally invasive surgical expertise, plus additional achievement in trauma, critical care, education, simulation, research, quality, digital systems, or mentoring.

Professional Tenure and Background
Preferred candidates will show progressive responsibility through senior residency and faculty service, with at least 4 years as Assistant Professor unless another current NMC-permitted pathway applies. Evidence should include operative exposure, academic work, ethical practice, sound outcomes, and dependable service in recognised teaching or comparably governed institutions.

Compensation and Benefits
The selected candidate will receive a market-aligned academic-clinical package and institutional benefits based on verified experience, credentials, and internal policy. Detailed terms will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

Application Instructions
Applicants should submit an updated curriculum vitae with qualification, registration, experience, appointment, publication, and course records. Candidates must state the role and ensure every claim is verifiable. Appointment remains subject to credential review, current NMC eligibility, clinical privileging, references, and approval.

Description:
Role: Consultant Nephrologist

Organization Overview
This position is with a nationally accredited, 500-bed, multi-super speciality teaching hospital located in a major regional capital city. Established decades ago, the facility stands as the primary healthcare landmark for the Northeast region, housed in a nine-storied structure with over 300,000 square feet of floor space. The institution is academically affiliated with a prominent, decades-old University renowned for excellence in medical education and healthcare.

The hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including 13 general specialities, multiple super-speciality departments, and 12 dedicated operation theatres. It provides comprehensive 24x7 services, including a fully equipped trauma care unit and advanced diagnostic imaging featuring 1.5 Tesla MRI, 64-slice CT scan, and digital X-ray facilities. Critical care capabilities are extensive, supported by 46 well-equipped ICU beds (covering ICU, SICU, NICU, PICU, CCU, and ITU) and round-the-clock emergency services.

Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Nephrologist to join our team as a Clinical Practitioner. The successful candidate will manage the diagnosis and treatment of kidney-related diseases, providing expert care to inpatients and outpatients. While the role is primarily clinical and does not require an extensive academic portfolio, the institution places a high priority on candidates who possess relevant work experience within recognized university or medical college hospital settings.

Key Responsibilities
Clinical Management: Provide comprehensive clinical care for patients with acute and chronic kidney diseases, electrolyte imbalances, hypertension, and other renal disorders.
Dialysis Services: Oversee and manage the Dialysis Unit, which is equipped with modern hemodialysis machines (currently 8 units, including isolation facilities) and expertise in Continuous Ambulatory Peritoneal Dialysis (CAPD).
Critical Care Nephrology: Collaborate with the intensive care team to manage complex cases requiring renal replacement therapy (CRRT, SLED) in the 46-bed ICU setup.
Patient Consultation: Conduct regular outpatient consultations, providing holistic treatment plans that include lifestyle modification and dietary guidance in coordination with nutritionists.
Interdepartmental Collaboration: Work closely with General Medicine, Cardiology, Urology, and other specialities to ensure a multidisciplinary approach to patient care, particularly for diabetic and hypertensive nephropathy.
Procedures: Perform necessary nephrological procedures such as renal biopsies and placement of temporary vascular access for dialysis.
Quality Assurance: Adhere to national accreditation standards (NABH protocols) and hospital policies to ensure the highest quality of patient safety and care delivery.

Qualifications and Experience
Essential Post-Graduate Qualification: M.D. or DNB in General Medicine or Paediatrics from a recognized institution.
Required Super Speciality Qualification: D.M. in Nephrology (Recognized by the National Medical Commission) / M.Ch Nephrology.
Experience: 1 to 4 years of experience post-completion of the super specialization (D.M.) / M.Ch Nephrology.
Experience Preference: Crucially, priority will be given to candidates who have gained their experience in recognized university or teaching hospital settings.
Note: Experience is strictly counted only after the completion of the super specialization.

Compensation
Salary Range: INR 3.5 Lakhs to INR 4.5 Lakhs per month.
Determination: Final offer will be commensurate with the candidate's specific post-DM / M.Ch experience and expertise.

Additional Information
Nature of Role: This is a full-time Clinical Practitioner position.
Academic Profile: While an academic profile (publications, research) is not mandatory, the clinical expertise gained in an academic environment is highly valued.
Facility Highlights: The selected candidate will practice in a facility that acts as a tertiary care referral centre for the entire state and neighbouring regions, backed by comprehensive support services including a 24-hour central laboratory and blood bank.

Description:
Job Title: Head of Department (HoD) Psychology (Professor/Associate Professor)

Role Overview
The Head of the Department of Psychology will provide visionary leadership to build a high-impact, industry-relevant, and research-driven department. The role requires balancing academic rigor with innovation, student employability, and institutional growth, while ensuring compliance with UGC norms and alignment with NEP 2020.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic & Academic Leadership
Develop and execute a growth strategy for the department (new programs, student intake, branding)
Design industry-aligned curriculum (e.g., clinical practice, organizational psychology, behavioural data science, counselling)
Introduce value-added certifications and interdisciplinary courses
Drive NAAC/NIRF rankings contributions and accreditation readiness

2. Program Development & Innovation
Integrate technology in psychology (e.g., psychometrics tools, data analytics, AI applications in behaviour studies)

3. Faculty Leadership & Talent Building
Implement performance-driven culture (KPIs: teaching quality, publications, student feedback, placements)
Mentor faculty for research output, consulting, and executive education

4. Research, Consulting & Revenue Generation
Build a research and consulting ecosystem (corporate training, assessments, mental health services)
Secure funded projects, consultancy assignments, and collaborations
Establish labs/centres (e.g., Behavioural Lab, Counselling Centre)
Promote publications in Scopus/Web of Science indexed journals

5. Student Outcomes & Employability
Ensure strong placement and internship pipelines (Hospitals, NGOs, EdTech, corporates)
Develop career-oriented training (soft skills, psychometric testing, counselling skills)
Track and improve student success metrics (placements, higher education, certifications)

6. Industry & Institutional Partnerships
Build MoUs with hospitals, corporates, NGOs, schools, and wellness centers
Organize guest lectures, workshops, and live projects
Promote international collaborations and exchange programs

7. Administration & Operations
Manage departmental budgets with a focus on ROI and efficiency
Ensure smooth academic operations, timetabling, and compliance
Handle student grievances and maintain discipline
Contribute to university committees and strategic initiatives

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications
B.A/B.Sc & MA/M.Sc in psychology & Ph.D. in Psychology (mandatory, as per UGC/AICTE norms)
Minimum 815 years of experience in teaching/research/industry
At least 3–5 years in academic leadership roles (HoD/Program Head/Coordinator)
Strong research and publication record

Key Skills & Competencies
Leadership with a focus on growth and revenue generation
Strong networking and industry engagement skills
Ability to balance academic quality with market relevance
Data-driven decision-making and innovation mindset

Description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP CAR Consultant with expertise in SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR), CAR Planning, and UDF (Unified Demand Forecast) solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in retail business processes, demand forecasting, replenishment planning, inventory optimization, and SAP CAR implementations/support projects.

Total Exp - 6yrs to 20yrs
Location - Mumbai/Pune/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Kolkata/Gandhinagar
Mandatory Skill set - SAP CAR , UDF,Implementation


Key Responsibilities
SAP CAR Implementation & Support
Participate in end-to-end SAP CAR implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into SAP CAR functional solutions.
Configure and support SAP CAR modules including:
POSDTA (Point of Sale Data Transfer & Audit)
OAA (Omnichannel Article Availability)
DDF (Demand Data Foundation)
UDF (Unified Demand Forecast)
CAR Planning & Forecasting
Forecasting & Replenishment
Design and configure forecasting models using SAP UDF.
Support demand planning, inventory planning, and replenishment optimization processes.
Analyze sales trends, seasonality, promotions, and forecast accuracy.
Develop forecast strategies to improve inventory availability and reduce stock-outs.
Integration
Integrate SAP CAR with:
SAP S/4HANA / ECC
SAP Retail
SAP BW/4HANA
SAP F&R
SAP IBP (preferred)
POS systems and third-party applications
Support master data and transactional data integration.
Business & Functional Activities
Conduct workshops, fit-gap analysis, and solution design sessions.
Prepare functional specifications and work with technical teams for developments.
Perform SIT, UAT, and production deployment activities.
Provide post-go-live support and issue resolution.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business users, architects, and development teams.
Provide recommendations for process optimization and system enhancements.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions

SAP Project Manager S/4HANA Public Cloud
Location - Mumbai , Pune , Bangalore , Gandhinagar

Flexible / Hybrid / Remote

Experience
8-15 years in SAP Project Management with at least 2 end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementations.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Project Manager to lead SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing project delivery, stakeholder engagement, budget oversight, risk management, and ensuring successful deployment of SAP best practices using the SAP Activate methodology.
The Project Manager will collaborate with business stakeholders, SAP consultants, system integrators, and technical teams to drive projects from initiation through go-live and hypercare support.
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and resources.
Drive project governance and ensure compliance with SAP Activate methodology.
Facilitate requirement gathering, fit-to-standard workshops, and solution design discussions.
Coordinate cross-functional teams including Functional, Technical, Integration, Data Migration, and Change Management workstreams.
Monitor project progress and provide regular status reporting to leadership and steering committees.
Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment with business objectives.
Identify and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies.
Oversee testing cycles including SIT, UAT, and Go-Live readiness activities.
Support cutover planning, deployment, hypercare, and project closure activities.
Ensure delivery quality, adherence to best practices, and customer satisfaction.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
8+ years of SAP project management experience.
Minimum 2 full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Strong understanding of SAP Activate methodology and Cloud ERP deployment models.
Experience managing global or multi-country SAP programs.
Proven expertise in project planning, budgeting, risk management, and vendor management.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with Agile, Hybrid Agile, and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP Activate Project Manager Certification.
PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, or Agile certifications.
Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Signavio.
Knowledge of finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, or HR business processes.

Job Description:
Data Architect-Data Fabric
Location: Bangalore / Pune
Experience: 13+ Years
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Data Architect with strong expertise in data modelling and enterprise data architecture to design scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions. The role will work closely with business, technology, data engineering, and governance teams to define data architecture and deliver strategic data initiatives.

Principal Responsibilities
Define and implement enterprise and solution-level data architecture aligned with business and technology strategy.
Develop and review conceptual, logical, and physical data models across complex business domains.
Establish data modelling standards, principles, naming conventions, and reusable patterns.
Design architectures for data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, and analytical platforms.
Define data integration patterns across ETL/ELT, APIs, batch, and real-time data pipelines.
Assess and recommend appropriate databases, cloud platforms, and data technologies.
Ensure solutions address data quality, governance, security, scalability, and performance.
Partner with data engineers, developers, architects, and business stakeholders to ensure effective implementation.
Review existing data landscapes and define target-state architecture and modernisation roadmaps.
Produce architecture documentation, data models, design standards, and technical recommendations.

Requirements
13+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Data Modelling, Database Architecture, or related roles.

Description:
IMMEDIATE JOINERS || 4-7 years || Pune / Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities:
As a member of the CLE ADB Productization the associate will be responsible for development and maintenance of Live Procedures handled by SAF team.
The Procedure Expert needs the skill set required to support a range of SAP systems including ABAP, Java stack, Non-NetWeaver systems. The associate would be responsible to Plan / Validate / Maintain the Procedures according to the ECS standard and sometimes non-standard procedures as requested by the stakeholder.
Associate will be majorly responsible for
Monitor the Procedure execution and identify the task errors and reason
Get feedback from Delivery Team, SEO and Service Owners and identify scope of Procedure enhancement.
Prepare and maintain the Task failure analysis report and track ‘First time Success Rate’.
Propose solution and suggest modification in Procedure by discussing with PO’s.
Drive the procedure enhancement by coordinate with developers / SEO / PO / Developer.
Coordinate with developers and support them with required inputs.
Perform Validation and report the issues encountered while running the procedures in VLAB environment with the concerned procedure owner to ensure the issue doesn’t reoccur in PROD Environment.
Sharing the feedback of the Task documentation if unclear or needs to be modified
First level of issue analysis encountered in the procedure by troubleshooting the underlying procedure along with the PO by understanding the basic ECS architecture, newly released features of the tools involved etc
Support Delivery colleagues in case of Procedure failure and propose immediate work around
Proactive follow-up on the tickets created for the issues encountered
Knowledge sharing within the team and with larger audience of the technical and process aspects
Maintaining documentation of the above deliverables
Expectations and Tasks:
Understand the SAF Basis Team functioning and process model.
Knowledge ECS support tools - LVM, SPC, JIRA, CRT , Customer Launch Pad ,Service Now, TIC and Etc.
Develop a deep understanding of the Enterprise Cloud solution architecture and productization model along with the tools within 6-8 months of onboarding.
Associate should be capable of delivering the targets in Scope of work however is not limited to it solely
Know the point of contact in each team for issue resolution
Capable to independently troubleshoot, reproduce, determine the root cause for repetitive issues
Other General OPO support activities include
Handling of Run procedure automation failure with PO/SEO/SMEs
Good understanding of the service lifecycle and deep idea on the automation cycles
Basic understanding of Landscape Virtualization Manager is needed
Work Experience:
Strong Basis knowledge (ABAP, JAVA, non-NetWeaver etc) with experience in Installations and migrations.
Knowledge of HANA and Linux is a must
Knowledge of High-Availability scenarios especially Pacemaker (SLES and RHEL)
Knowledge of various OS/DB combinations and related troubleshooting is desirable
Associate must have a very strong desire to keep up to date with technical developments in basis, DB and Server management area within ECS Delivery and SAP
Commitment to detailed planning, documentation and quality assurance processes, especially change control, which will support the timely implementation of enhancements to the server environment whilst maintaining the highest levels of operational service
High levels of self-motivation and focus to work with the minimum of supervision and deliver against agreed targets
Strong customer service awareness to keep the customers’ requirements constantly in mind and ensure that activities align closely with these requirements
Hands-on or know-how of Migration and different types of Migration ( OS/DB).
Skills and Competencies:

Full SAP life-cycle experience using HANA, DB2 database (Desirable) technologies
Strong hold on SAP NetWeaver 7 or higher
Good experience on Basis, OS and DB flavors
Minimum 2 years specialist technical skill in one or more SAP areas (5+ Years recommend)
Minimum 2 years’ experience with Pacemaker based SAP Solutions
Proven SAP experience running on HANA (must), DB2 (desirable) platforms
Migration Experiece
Strong Communication skills, project management skills
I od team playerI

Description:
About the Role
Were building and growing our hyperlocal (on-demand) logistics business within Delhivery, and are for someone who can take ownership from day zero acquiring customers, shaping the GTM motion, and building a repeatable revenue engine.
You will operate as a full-stack sales owner — from identifying opportunities within SMEs and enterprises to closing deals and ensuring long-term account success. The role requires a mix of hunting (acquisition) and farming (growth & retention), with a strong bias toward building from scratch.

What You’ll Do
Own the end-to-end sales cycle: prospecting pitching closing account growth for leads with monthly wallet potential of 5L to 10L
Acquire and onboard SMEs and enterprise customers onto Delhivery’s hyperlocal logistics platform
Build a strong pipeline through outbound efforts, partnerships, and market mapping
Work closely with operations to ensure a seamless fulfillment experience for customers while providing top-notch customer assistance
Drive account expansion and retention, identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities
Develop a deep understanding of customer supply chains and last-mile needs
Contribute to GTM strategy, pricing inputs, and product feedback as an early member of the business
Lay the foundation for scaling this business line and becoming a trusted + reliable logistics partner for our customers
Who We’re Looking For
2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, with a strong focus on acquisition-led roles
Prior experience in logistics, on-demand delivery, or supply chain platforms
Strong exposure to both SME and enterprise sales
Hands-on experience with solution selling (not just transactional sales)
High ownership mindset — comfortable operating in 0-1 environments
Strong understanding of last-mile logistics, fulfillment challenges, and operational nuances

What Makes This Role Different
You’re not inheriting a book of business — you’re building it
Direct impact on shaping a new vertical within Delhivery
Opportunity to scale into a larger role as the business grows

Job Title: SAP PP VC (Variant Configuration) Consultant

We are looking for an experienced SAP PP VC Consultant with a minimum of 5 years of SAP experience, including strong expertise in SAP Variant Configuration (VC) within the SAP Production Planning (PP) module. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in implementing and supporting configurable products, class characteristics, dependencies, and production planning processes.

Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements and design SAP PP-VC solutions to support configurable products.
Configure and maintain SAP Variant Configuration (VC) components including:
Characteristics
Classes
Configurable Materials
Super BOMs
Super Routings
Object Dependencies (Procedures, Constraints, Preconditions, Selection Conditions)
Work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into functional specifications.
Support end-to-end implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support projects.
Perform integration activities with SAP modules such as SD, MM, QM, and PP.
Conduct unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing.
Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with technical teams for developments and enhancements.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolution.
Support master data setup and configuration activities related to VC.

Required Skills
Primary Skill (Must Have)
SAP Variant Configuration (VC)
Functional Skills
SAP Production Planning (PP)
Configurable Materials
Class & Characteristic Management
Dependency Modeling
Super BOM and Super Routing
Material Master and BOM Management
Production Orders and Planning Execution
Sales Order Configuration Process
SAP Technical & Integration Knowledge
Integration of VC with SAP SD, MM, and PP modules
Knowledge of pricing integration with Variant Configuration
Experience in functional testing and defect management

Preferred Skills
Experience in SAP S/4HANA Variant Configuration.
Knowledge of Advanced Variant Configuration (AVC).
Experience in manufacturing industries such as Automotive, Industrial Machinery, High-Tech, or Consumer Products.
Exposure to Agile project methodologies.

Description:
Job Summary
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager
Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President
Location: Mumbai, India
Role Description
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures - but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That s why we are Investors for a new now .
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients financial future. And in return, we ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.
About DWS Investment Risk
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.
Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritisation of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.
Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organisational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Description:
Job description: SAP BW4/HANA L3 Support and Enhancement.
A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. This role requires deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA architecture, data modelling and troubleshooting techniques. Key responsibilities include analysing and resolving critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development teams for long-term solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting and Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues related to SAP BW/4HANA, often involving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system errors.
Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures.
Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability.
System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems.
Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers.
Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution.
System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability.
Required Skills & Experience:
Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams.
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security.
Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation.
Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred.
Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required.

Description:
Role Overview

CBRE seeks a Project Lead for Real Estate Portfolio Valuations to join the Valuation Excellence (VALEX) Team. This role combines strategic portfolio management, stakeholder coordination, and deep valuation expertise. You will oversee pan-India portfolio valuations for REITs, InvITs, and RE investment funds while driving innovation and automation across the valuation delivery model.

Core Responsibilities

As Project Lead, you manage complex, high-stakes valuation assignments for institutional clients across India across REITs, InvITs, funds, and private investors.
Serve as the central coordinator between clients (often CFOs and investment committees) and internal regional teams, ensuring seamless communication, delivery and quality. You will be the single point of accountability.
Own project timelines and quality standards. Deliver valuations on schedule and in compliance with CBRE's quality frameworks.
Build and maintain client relationships to secure repeat business and identify upsell opportunities.
Provide asset-specific insights and market knowledge to clients. Translate technical valuations into clear, actionable recommendations.
Lead active involvement in valuation discussions and finalization with regional teams across North, South, East, and West India.
Review all reports for content quality and compliance with CBRE standards before client delivery.
Lead or support VALEX innovation initiatives that drive automation and improve team efficiency.
Identify opportunities to standardize processes, reduce manual work, and implement new valuation tools.


Required Qualifications
To succeed in this role, you must bring:

A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in real estate valuation within India.
Proven track record valuing core assets (office, retail, warehousing, hospitality, residential) across multiple Indian cities.
Strong financial modeling and analysis skills; comfort with DCF, income approach, and comparable sales analysis.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders and complex projects with competing priorities.
Clear communication skills; ability to explain valuation methodologies and findings to non-technical clients.
Educational background in civil engineering, real estate, architecture, or a related field (B.Tech, M.Tech, or equivalent).


Desired Qualifications

MRICS (Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors) or equivalent professional certification.
Experience in REIT and InvIT valuations across key metros.
Familiarity with CBRE's valuation processes, tools, or technology platforms.
Prior experience managing a small team or mentoring junior valuers.
Background in capital markets transactions or investment advisory.
Willingness to travel across regions for client meetings and team coordination.

Key Competencies

Success in this role requires a blend of technical expertise and leadership skills:

Valuation Mastery : Core technical expertise in DCF modeling, market research, and comparable analysis for multiple asset classes.

Project Management: Ability to juggle multiple portfolios, meet strict deadlines, and coordinate across distributed teams.

Client Relationship Management : Proven ability to build trust, manage expectations, and convert engagements into long-term partnerships.

Analytical Thinking : Comfort with complex real estate datasets, spotting trends, and translating numbers into strategic insights.

Collaboration: Works effectively with regional teams, senior leadership, and external stakeholders; no siloed mentality.

Adaptability : Open to learning new technologies, valuation approaches, and market dynamics; willing to upskill continuously.

Communication: Can articulate complex financial concepts in clear, jargon-free language for diverse audiences


Your Impact on VALEX

The VALEX team is CBRE's centralized excellence unit for real estate valuations. As a Project Lead, you will:
Drive consistency in valuation standards across all 400+ team members and multiple regions.
Identify bottlenecks in current delivery workflows and champion automation initiatives.
Move beyond regional expertise. Coordinate pan-India complexity. This breadth is rare and globally marketable
Mentor junior team members on best practices, portfolio management, and client engagement.
Serve as a subject matter expert on specific asset classes and geographies.
Contribute to the continuous improvement culture that underpins VALEX's mission.
Build a skill set that makes you invaluable: master every Indian asset class, become fluent in REIT/InvIT structuring, develop advanced modeling skills and lead teams.

Learning and Growth

This role offers deep opportunity for professional development. You'll be expected to stay current on:

Advanced financial modeling techniques and emerging valuation methodologies.
Real estate market dynamics, sector trends, and macroeconomic factors affecting India's asset classes.
CBRE's proprietary tools, technology platforms, and analytics dashboards.
Team leadership and mentoring skills to support junior professionals.
Automation and workflow optimization to reduce manual workload and improve efficiency.

Why Join CBRE VALEX?

Work with India's most sophisticated real estate portfolios across REITs, funds, and institutional investors.
Be part of a high-performing centralized team focused on innovation, consistency, and excellence.
Access to world-class training, CBRE's global knowledge, and leading technology platforms.
Clear career path: grow your technical expertise, build team leadership capabilities, and move into senior roles.
A culture of continuous learning; CBRE invests in upskilling and professional certifications.
Collaborative, multi-regional environment with exposure to diverse asset classes and market geographies.

Position description: Join Jindal Ferrous Limited's Blast Furnace Operation team as an entry-level engineering professional dedicated to supporting the efficient and safe functioning of blast furnace processes. This role involves hands-on involvement in monitoring furnace operations, assisting in process optimization, and ensuring compliance with safety and environmental standards within the mining and metals industry. The position offers a unique opportunity to develop technical expertise in metallurgical operations and contribute to the production of high-quality ferrous materials in a dynamic industrial environment.

Primary Responsibilities:
Assist in the daily monitoring and control of blast furnace operations to ensure optimal performance and output quality.
Support senior engineers in analyzing process data and identifying areas for operational improvements and efficiency gains.
Conduct routine inspections and maintenance checks on furnace equipment to prevent downtime and ensure safety compliance.
Collaborate with the operations team to implement safety protocols and environmental regulations specific to blast furnace activities.
Participate in troubleshooting and resolving operational issues under the guidance of experienced engineers.
Maintain accurate records of operational parameters, maintenance activities, and incident reports for audit and review purposes.
Contribute to the preparation of technical reports and documentation related to furnace performance and process adjustments.
Engage in continuous learning and training programs to stay updated with industry best practices and technological advancements in blast furnace operations.
Support inventory management of raw materials and consumables used in the blast furnace process to ensure uninterrupted production.

Process Data Analysis

Description:
Your Role
Are you confident, well-spoken, presentable and passionate about working with people?
We are looking for a Front Office Executive cum HR Associate who can confidently represent our organization at the front desk while supporting the HR team in recruitment and employee coordination.
This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to build practical experience across HR, Recruitment, Administration and Client/Guest Management.

What Youll Do

HR & Recruitment
Post vacancies on recruitment platforms and social media.
Source and screen potential candidates.
Conduct preliminary/telephonic interview rounds.
Coordinate interviews with candidates and hiring managers.
Follow up with candidates regarding interviews, selection, documentation and joining.
Maintain recruitment trackers, HR records and employee files.
Coordinate the movement and proper filing of HR documents.
Assist with joining formalities and other HR activities.

Front Office & Administration
Welcome and professionally assist clients, guests, candidates and visitors.
Handle incoming calls, enquiries and visitor coordination.
Coordinate meetings and appointments with relevant departments.
Maintain visitor records and front-office documentation.
Ensure the reception area and front office are maintained professionally.
Support the HR/Admin team in day-to-day office coordination.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:
Confident & professionally presentable
Excellent in communication skills
Good at understanding instructions and situations
Polite, warm and approachable
Strong in follow-ups and coordination
Organized and detail-oriented
Comfortable interacting with candidates, employees, clients and senior professionals
Proficient in MS Office / Google Workspace
A positive learner who is willing to take ownership

Why This Role?
One role. Multiple skill sets.
Gain hands-on exposure to:
Recruitment HR Operations Administration Client Handling Professional Communication

If you are looking for a role where you can learn, interact, coordinate and grow, we’d love to meet you!

Interested candidates can share their updated CV with the hrd@cayana.co.in.
AboutCompany: Cayana Infratech Pvt. Ltd. is a leading real estate company known for delivering premium residential projects. With 15+ years of excellence, we are committed to create spaces that combine aesthetics, innovation, and functionality. We are now looking for a Creative Designer cum Video Editor who matches that energy someone with not just skills, but a design mindset, initiative, and the ability to bring brands to life visually.

Description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Onco-Reconstructive Surgery: Perform complex plastic, microvascular, and reconstructive surgical procedures following major oncological resections, including head and neck, breast, musculoskeletal, and soft tissue reconstructions.
Microvascular Procedures: Plan and execute free tissue transfers, pedicled flaps, and microsurgical vessel anastomoses to restore form and function in post-cancer resection cases.
Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Participation: Collaborate closely with surgical oncologists, head and neck surgeons, surgical mammologists, and medical/radiation oncologists in pre-operative planning and tumor boards to design comprehensive treatment paths.
Wound & Lymphedema Management: Oversee advanced wound care, complex tissue defect management, skin grafting, and surgical intervention for cancer-related lymphedema.
Inpatient & Post-Operative Care: Lead post-operative flap monitoring, ICU care, and rehabilitative planning to ensure flap survival and optimal functional recovery.
Quality & Accreditation Compliance: Uphold institutional surgical safety checklists, infection control protocols, clinical documentation standards, and NABH guidelines.

Preferred Candidate Profile
Education: MCh or DrNB in Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery following an MBBS and MS in General Surgery.
Experience: Above 5 years of post-qualification experience in Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery, with significant exposure to onco-reconstruction and microvascular techniques in a tertiary care or dedicated cancer hospital.
Technical Expertise: High procedural skill in free flap transfers, pedicled flap harvests, microsurgery, and aesthetic/functional tissue restoration.
Clinical & Soft Skills: Fine manual dexterity, strong clinical decision-making during complex multi-stage procedures, empathetic patient communication, and a strong collaborative mindset across surgical specialties.

Roles & Responsibilities
Surgical Uro-Oncology: Perform complex open, laparoscopic, and minimally invasive surgical procedures for urological malignancies, including radical prostatectomies, radical cystectomies with urinary diversions, partial/radical nephrectomies, retroperitoneal lymph node dissections (RPLND), and penile/testicular cancer resections.
Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Participation: Lead urological discussion in multidisciplinary tumor boards alongside medical oncologists, radiation oncologists, radiologists, and pathologists to formulate tailored multimodal care plans.
Comprehensive Diagnostic Workup: Conduct specialized diagnostic procedures including flexible/rigid cystoscopy, image-guided prostate biopsies, transurethral resection of bladder tumors (TURBT), and urodynamic evaluations.
OPD & IPD Clinical Management: Provide expert outpatient consultations, manage surgical admissions, oversee perioperative ICU care, and drive recovery pathways for urologic cancer patients.
Complication & Emergency Management: Handle complex urological emergencies, post-operative surgical complications, and oncological issues such as malignant urinary tract obstructions or acute hematuria.
Quality & Accreditation Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to surgical safety protocols, infection control guidelines, electronic medical record documentation, and NABH standards.
Academics & Clinical Research: Guide residents, surgical fellows, and nursing staff in urologic oncology protocols, and participate in clinical trials and institutional research.

Preferred Candidate Profile
Education: MCh In Urology with a dedicated Fellowship in Uro-Oncology (or equivalent focused clinical training in urological cancers).
Experience: Above 5 years of post-qualification experience in Uro-Oncology, preferably within a high-volume tertiary care hospital or dedicated cancer center.
Technical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in laparoscopic and complex open uro-oncological procedures, urinary diversion techniques, and endourological interventions.
Clinical & Soft Skills: Strong surgical judgment, high precision, clear and empathetic communication with patients and families, and a collaborative team-first approach.

Description:
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Graduate freshers
