Description:
Territory-Specific Responsibilities
Drive Cummins aftermarket channel sales across the Bihar and Jharkhand region.
Lead dealer teams to improve per-engine revenue and overall business performance.
Drive sales campaigns, promotional activities, and business growth initiatives through dealer networks.
Act as the key interface between Cummins and customers to ensure superior customer experience and satisfaction.
Manage strategic key accounts, including large industrial and mining customers such as Tata Steel, Thriveni Earthmovers, and other major private mining customers.


Education, Licenses, Certifications:
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Sales, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant sales experience.
Export control or sanctions-related licensing may be required depending on business requirements.

Skills & Experience
Intermediate level of relevant sales or business development experience.
Proven experience in territory sales, account management, or channel sales.
Experience managing dealer networks and driving aftermarket business is preferred.
Strong customer relationship management and key account management skills.
Experience handling commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, and contract execution.
Ability to analyze sales data, forecast demand, and manage sales pipelines effectively.
Working knowledge of CRM systems and sales management tools.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams.
Experience in industrial, automotive, heavy equipment, mining, or related sectors will be an added advantage.

Apart from above pre-requisites, the candidate will have responsibility of below points:-
Driving Cummins after-market channel sales in Bihar & Jharkhand Region
Leading dealer team for improving per Engine revenue
Leading dealer team for running sales campaigns and business initiatives
Ensuring Customer satisfaction by acting as a bridge between Cummins and Customer
Key account management of big ticket customers, such as Tata Steel, Thriveni Earthmovers, Private mining customers etc

Description:
Job Responsibility

1. Grievance handling for all bargainable employees:
Interact with employees to identify and effectively resolve all issues
Effective predicting of issues that pose a threat to smooth functioning of organization & prioritize accordingly
Prevent employee grievances from turning into bigger IR issues that can hamper production
Conduct regular meetings like IRC (Industrial Relations Committee) to capture all employee grievances.
2. Ensure maintenance of Internal Discipline:
Ensure that there is good understanding & acceptance for all rules and regulations mandated by the Management.
Take necessary preventive actions and measures of counselling wherever necessary
Take necessary disciplinary actions wherever required to ensure harmonious and productive environment on the shop floor.
Lead Quality Circle, SDT, improvement projects.
Ensure Statutory Compliance of the factory he/she is responsible for : Monitoring Statutory compliances such as ESI,PF, Minimum wages, maternity benefit, Bonus Act & Submission of returns
3. Liaise with employees, Union Leaders, line managers, divisional heads & factory heads:
Work closely with line managers for improvement in production, interacts with shop supervisors, managers, function heads.
Implement long term settlements, wage negotiations clauses, Bonus settlements, union elections and other critical items as and when they are due & manage industrial relations.
Provide inputs to the ER head for preparing management demands.
Provide cross-functional support to administration, communication and productivity services, safety team.
Resolve ER issues at the plant level striving for no/minimum loss to business/ corporate image.
Maintain cordial relations with all stake holders in order to ensure smooth functioning on the shop floor.
Implement location level ER priorities in consultation with Factory Head, Shop heads & ER Head.
Identify risks and opportunities in the respective factory location and put in place plans to mitigate the same.

A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up

Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively

Product recommendation

right time to pitch the recommended solutions

Personalattributes&competencies

Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn

Description:
About the role
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead the development of a world-class franchise model. The ideal candidate will be responsible for generating leads, managing the sales funnel, onboarding new franchisees, and ensuring both the growth and retention of franchise stores. In this role, you will play a critical part in expanding our franchise network by onboarding 50 new stores per month and driving sustainable revenue growth across the franchise portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Franchise Acquisition & Expansion

• Strategic Acquisition Planning: Design and execute a comprehensive franchise acquisition strategy aligned with organizational growth targets.
• Pipeline Leadership: Oversee and optimize the full acquisition funnel, ensuring consistent inflow of high-quality prospects and timely conversions.
• Market Penetration: Identify high-potential markets and expansion zones, developing region-specific growth plans.
• Channel Diversification: Leverage digital, on-ground, partnerships, and referral ecosystems to expand franchise reach and strengthen lead quality.

Franchise Onboarding & Set-Up
• End-to-End Launch Ownership: Lead the onboarding and operational go-live of new franchise stores, ensuring all SOPs, processes, and compliance standards are met.
• Scale Management: Ensure successful onboarding of 50+ franchise stores per month, maintaining quality and standardization at scale.
• Capability Building: Establish robust training, enablement, and support frameworks to set new franchise partners up for long-term success.

Franchise Performance, Retention & Revenue Growth
• Portfolio Management: Oversee performance of the entire franchise portfolio, using data-driven insights to enhance store productivity and profitability.
• Retention & Engagement: Develop franchise retention programs, strengthen partner relationships, and proactively resolve operational challenges.
• Business Growth Initiatives: Drive revenue optimization initiatives, implement performance-improvement plans, and roll out business interventions to support consistent growth.
• Operational Excellence: Ensure adherence to brand standards, operational guidelines, and customer experience expectations across all franchise stores.

Qualifications
• Experience: Minimum 5+ years in Business Development, Franchise Management, or Multi-Unit Operations within FMCG, retail, food, logistics, or telecom
• Skills: Strong leadership, stakeholder management, strategic planning, communication, negotiation, and analytical capabilities.

Description:
About IIFL Finance
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia. Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option. Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity. We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs.
Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities. Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL. Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos. We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit.
Job Title Customer Care Executive (Gold Loans)
Job Description -
Responsible toacquire New Customers for generating Gold Loan business and for other cross sell products.
Participate in field- marketing activities toimprove the brand visibility of IIFL Finance Limited branch in the catchment areas and generate leads of prospective customers.
Drive & ensure continuous customer engagement through various channels.
Maintaining quality portfolio by tracking& controlling ROI .
Provide after salesservice to existing customers and obtain references from them to increase thecustomer base.
Strong follow up on interest collectionsto keep NPAs (non-performing assets) under control.
Desired Candidate Profile (CCE) -
Candidateswith 6 months of sales experience in Banking & Financial Services can applyfor the role.
Fresherswith flair in Sales can also apply.
In summary,the role focuses heavily on sales - acquiring new customers, engaging withexisting ones, ensuring portfolio quality, and collecting payments to minimizedefaults. Brand building through field marketing is also a key component.
CTC Upto 2.37 Lacs ( for Non Metro) / 2.8Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Description:
Position: Customer Relationship Executive (CRE)
Gender: Female candidates only
Location: jaipur - mi road , bais godam c scheme
Job Type: Full-time
Department: Client Relations / Customer Support
timings - 10;30-8;00
Role Overview
We are seeking a clear, articulate, and customer-focused Female Customer Relationship Executive (CRE) to join our team. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our clients, responsible for managing client interactions, addressing queries, building positive long-term relationships, and ensuring a seamless client experience. High proficiency in English communication (both verbal and written) is mandatory.
Key Responsibilities
Client Interaction & Engagement: Act as the main liaison between the company and clients, handling inbound and outbound calls, emails, and meetings.
Relationship Management: Build, maintain, and strengthen trust-based relationships with new and existing clients.
Query & Issue Resolution: Timely respond to client inquiries, provide accurate information, and resolve complaints or issues efficiently.
Client Onboarding & Support: Assist new clients through the onboarding process and guide them on company products/services.
Feedback Collection: Gather client feedback and coordination with internal teams to continuous improve service quality.
Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate records of client interactions, correspondence, and feedback in the CRM database.
Key Requirements & Qualifications
Gender: Female candidate required.
Education: Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
Experience: [0-2 years / 2+ years] of experience in customer service, client relationship management, or front-desk administration.
Language Skills: Fluency in English (verbal and written) is mandatory. Outstanding tone, grammar, and articulation.
Interpersonal Skills: Warm personality, active listener, empathetic, and strong negotiation/problem-solving abilities.
Technical Skills: Basic knowledge of MS Office (Excel, Word) and familiarity with CRM software is an added advantage.
Key Competencies
Excellent telephone etiquette and professional demeanor.
Strong multitasking and time management capabilities.
Ability to stay calm and composure under pressure or when handling difficult client situations

Description:
Job Purpose
The Technical Manager (TM) is responsible for managing the technicalcollateral evaluation process at branch and regional levels, ensuringtimely property valuations, APF/CF approvals, vendor management, and TATadherence . The role focuses on risk mitigation, query reduction, andoperational excellence , while supporting Zonal Technical Managers inportfolio quality management.
Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Execution
Conduct and review APF, Non-APF, and CF property cases withindelegated authority.
Ensure site visits, valuations, documentation, andrecommendations are complete and accurate.
Flag high-risk or red-category cases to RTM / ZTM for review.
2. TAT & QualityCompliance
Monitor TAT adherence for branch submissions and vendor reports.
Track First-Time-Right (FTR)performance , identify rework areas, and implement corrective measures.
Support query resolution and queryreduction initiatives .

3. Vendor Management
Coordinate with vendors forvaluations and technical reports .
Track vendor performance,cost, and quality , escalating issues to RTM / ZTM.
Support vendor onboarding,training, and periodic review .
4. Branch & BusinessSupport
Support branches in APF/CFgeneration within approved limits .
Visit properties exceedingthreshold amounts (e.g., >1 Cr.) and support high-value case assessments .
Provide feedback to RTM/ZTM onbranch-level risk trends, exceptions, and performance gaps.

5. Compliance & AuditSupport
Ensure branch-level activitiescomply with technical policies, regulatory norms, and audit standards .
Support internal and externalaudits with documentation and clarifications .
6. Reporting & Insights
Prepare branch/regional MISreports on TAT, FTR, vendor performance, and query trends.
Highlight operational bottlenecks and recommend processimprovement

Collections Management - P1

Secondary skill - Order to Cash (OTC) - P2

You will be provided detailed to moderate level of instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instruction on new assignments.
The decisions that you make would impact your own work.
You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team, with a predetermined, focused scope of work.

As you'll discover, our culture supports diverse perspectives, driven by a shared sense of purpose.
Margin Operations is responsible for minimizing Deutsche Bank's counterparty credit risk on its collateralized derivatives portfolio. We aggregate the Bank's exposure across trading activity globally, administer the margin terms dictated in bilateral ISDA and CSA (Credit Support Annex) Agreements and facilitate exchange of permissible collateral (cash or securities) with our clients or central clearing counterparties. The team also manages Margin Disputes, regulatory Portfolio Reconciliation and Data Control flowing into the margining systems for APAC, EMEA and US regions.
Your key responsibilities
Be a central point of contact for external clients on valuations and responding / resolving their queries / disputes in a timely and professional manner and having to build strong working relationships with various front and back offices departments globally
Coordinate with such areas as Trading, Sales, Product control and Middle Office to resolve escalated customer inquiries and disputes
Close interaction with regional and global teams to ensure consistency in procedures and policy and to stay aware of organizational objectives
Keep Management informed of the exceptional occurrences, to enable appropriate action
Manage risks relating to specific processes and identify any deviations from established policies and guidelines
Re-engineering the current process to meet the changing needs of the business. Leading/contributing to various projects which are kicked off in the department to increase efficiency in the process.
Manage operational risk by checking strength of existing controls and recommend/implement new or improved controls
Expected to monitor KPIs and KRIs of the process.
Lead and contribute to Global initiatives that could be strategic and tactical in nature
Knowledge of TriResolve, Acadiasoft is must
Knowledge of Tableau, Alteryx and other self-service analytical and data interpretation tools will be an advantage
Your skills and experience
Strong organisational skills; ability to identify and prioritise multiple tasks based on criticality, impact and franchise importance.
Exceptional communication skills - verbal, written and presentation.
Independent problem solver who demonstrates accountability as well as execution capability.
Ability to independently coordinate and manage work requirements across multiple business areas and functions.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
Ability to connect with people as well as desire to learn process flows. Dedication to servicing a demanding internal and external client base.
Ability to mentor and coach the new joiners. Professional skills
Degree educated in Finance, Commerce or related field, or have a minimum of 6 years of work experience in a Banking/Finance environment.
Experience working in a global, cross matrix reporting organization
Should have detailed understating of Derivatives, Trade Life Cycle, UnCleared Margin Rules, reconciliations and settlements processes
Microsoft Excel skills to a good standard.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Description:
Skill required: Procure to Pay - Invoice Processing

Designation: Procure to Pay Operations Associate

Qualifications:BCom

Years of Experience:1 to 3 years

About Accenture

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song- all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

What would you do?
You will be aligned with our Finance Operations vertical and will be helping us in determining financial outcomes by collecting operational data reports, whilst conducting analysis and reconciling transactions.
boosting vendor compliance cutting savings erosion improving discount capture using preferred suppliers and in confirming pricing and terms prior to payment Responsible for accounting of goods and services through requisitioning purchasing and receiving Also look after order sequence of procurement and financial process end to end The Accounts Payable Processing team focuses on designing implementing managing and supporting accounts payable activities by applying the relevant processes policies and applications The team is responsible for timely and accurate billing and processing of invoices managing purchase and non purchase orders and two way and three way matching of invoices
Refers to the systematic handling and management of incoming invoices within a business or organization.
It involves tasks such as verifying the accuracy of the invoice, matching it with purchase orders and delivery receipts, and initiating the payment process.
Automated systems and software are often employed to streamline and expedite the invoice processing workflow, improving efficiency and reducing the likelihood of errors.

What are we looking for?
Primary skill - Invoice Processing - P3

Roles and Responsibilities:
In this role you are required to solve routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines.
Your expected interactions are within your own team and direct supervisor.
You will be provided detailed to moderate level of instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instruction on new assignments.
The decisions that you make would impact your own work.
You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team, with a predetermined, focused scope of work.
Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

Description:
Job Summary
Risk Management is core to Bajaj Finance. Most of the decisions in Risk Management are data driven and analytical. Statistical models are required to look at multi-variate dimensions from a risk perspective including calculating the expected credit loss, scenario analysis, forecasting, Stress Testing etc. Statistical models are built and scorecards are prepared which assesses parameters like PD (probability of default), EAD and LGD which are critical from a regulatory perspective and forms important aspect of regulatory reporting purpose. This role gives an opportunity of going beyond the above and gives deeper insights on the Regulatory norms on Credit Risk. The role allows candidate work on areas such as Stress Testing, Expected Credit Loss, Macro Economic stress, Macro stress models/forecasting etc. Culture Anchor: Have high ambitions - Inspires the team to aim for higher targets and supports in achieving them. Own It - Acknowledges uncertainty and makes changes in own decisions/ actions for better outcomes.

Description:
About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia. Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option. Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity. We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs.
Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities. Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL. Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos. We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit.
Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered.
Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately.
Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal. Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure.
Managing cash (system & physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures.
Create new CUID in system &modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments & LoanClosure.
Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff & Customer Visits etc.
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents.
Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments.
Providing good customer service at everystep i.e. while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments.
Additional Responsibilities: Insummary, the Gold appraiser is responsible for the end-to-end transactionprocess for gold loans - from valuation to disbursal to closure, along withcustomer service.
CTC Upto 3 Lacs ( for Non-Metro) / 4.20 Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

With a strong presence across India, IIFL emphasizes trust, transparency, and customer-centric financial planning. Its career opportunities highlight roles in advisory, sales, technology, and operations, reflecting its commitment to growth and innovation in the financial sector.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive team member training and development programs to enhance team skills and performance; assessing training needs, designing and updating training courses to ensure that the training content matches the team members job responsibilities and career paths; managing training budgets to ensure maximum return on training investment. As a Learning & Development Manager , you re not just managing training initiatives for hotel team members - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Minimum 3 years in L&D or HR, with a strong track record in designing, delivering, and evaluating training programs.
Degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Hospitality Management, or related field preferred.
Skilled in instructional design, adult learning principles, and modern training methods (e. g. , e-learning, blended learning).
Proficient in assessing training effectiveness and aligning programs with business goals.
Experienced with Learning Management Systems (LMS), digital training tools, and Microsoft Office.
Strong verbal and written skills; able to engage and motivate diverse teams.
Committed to continuous learning and staying updated on emerging training trends.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally to identify needs and support performance improvement.
Capable of managing training teams and multiple projects effectively.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Develop training programs: Design, plan, and deliver hotel training programs in alignment with corporate goals and industry standards, inclusive of topics such as harassment-free workplace, diversity, new team member orientation, leadership, and service
Monitor and review performance: Conduct meetings with department managers, trainers, and team members to review performance trends, develop action plans, and recognize achievements
Deliver continuous improvement: Assess existing training initiatives, identify opportunities for enhancement, and recommend solutions to address specific department needs
Manage training records: Track, maintain, and audit individual team member training records using designated systems and tools
Oversee departmental training programs: Manage and monitor department-specific training programs such as alcohol awareness, food safety, job skills checklists, and educational assistance
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Description:
Role Clarity | Information Technology Executive
Department: Business Tranformation
Reporting To: HOD I T
Role Definition:
The Senior Executive is responsible for day-to-day user support, ticket resolution, infrastructure maintenance, basic network and hardware security, and adherence to IT process documentation. The role ensures smooth functioning of all user-facing IT systems, supports technical issue resolution, and helps maintain compliance and governance at the ground level.
Deliverables:
Timely User Support & Ticket Management
IT Infrastructure & Network Uptime
Endpoint Security & Compliance Support
Documentation and Process Adherence
Task and Activities:

User Support & Ticket Management
Respond promptly to IT support tickets raised by internal users across functions and locations
Troubleshoot common user issues: system slowness, login problems, printer and scanner errors, internet disruptions, and email access.
Escalate unresolved issues to the next-level IT team with proper logs and initial troubleshooting steps documented.
Maintain and update the helpdesk ticket status daily. Follow up with users post-resolution to ensure satisfaction and request feedback for CSAT tracking.
Highlight recurring technical issues to the Manager for root cause analysis and long-term resolution planning.

IT Infrastructure, Network & Support
Conduct daily checks on local infrastructure elements including internet, routers, LAN cables, biometric attendance systems, printers, and telephony systems.
Perform branch-level IT health checks (branch PCs, UPS, biometric, internet speed, network sharing) and report deviations proactively.
Assist in new user hardware setup-install OS, configure email, join domain, assign printer access, and ensure patch compliance.
Support system updates and shutdown protocols during server maintenance or power downtime.
Coordinate with vendors for equipment servicing and monitor SLA adherence (e.g., AMC for printers, routers, CCTV).
Maintain inventory logs for issued hardware: laptops, desktops, LAN switches, USB drives, power backups, etc.

Hardware & Network Security
Ensure endpoint devices have updated antivirus and system firewalls enabled at all times.
Perform weekly checks on USB access, device control software status, and unauthorized software installation.
Conduct system-level cleanups for junk files, disk usage, and system performance issues.
Monitor and report any suspicious user activity or shared logins, and disable accounts of exited employees as per SOP.
Assist in implementing corrective actions based on findings from internal security reviews or external audits
Support IT team in maintaining compliance logs-access request forms, software license registers, and patch update records.

IT Process Quality & Documentation
Fill and update daily, weekly, and monthly checklists related to IT hardware status, ticket closures, backups, and antivirus updates.
Ensure user handover forms, hardware issue forms, and access request formats are filled accurately and stored properly.
Maintain SOP folders for system use (e.g., printer configuration, LIMS access process, password reset).
Assist in versioning and filing of updated IT process documents; help the manager during quarterly document reviews and audit prep.
Support documentation during internal audits including device list updates, process adherence proof, and IT policy handover.
Success Metrics:

Description:
Senior Java Full Stack Developer with strong experience in building scalable, secure, and cloud-native enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Git, Microservices, Apache Kafka, React, TypeScript, REST APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, DevSecOps, and AWS/Azure/GCP and modern DevOps practices.


Must-Have Skills
Backend: Excellent hands-on Core Java (Java 17/21), Spring Boot 3.x, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Microservices, REST APIs.
Messaging: Apache Kafka, Kafka Streams, event-driven architecture, Kafka security, and error handling.
Frontend: React, Angular TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and API integration.
Databases: PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL; SQL optimization, schema design, and performance tuning.
DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins CI/CD, Git, and Maven/Gradle.
Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, and DevSecOps.
Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP. Familiarity with AWS services such as ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, and IAM, or equivalent services on Azure/GC. Cloud-native services, serverless architectures, and automated security scanning.
Testing: JUnit 5, Mockito, integration testing, API testing, and automated testing.
Security Quality: Spring Security, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, secure coding, SonarQube, and code reviews.
Engineering Practices: Agile/Scrum, debugging, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting.
AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or Amazon Q Developer. LLM integration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and vector databases.
Spring Cloud, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, and OpenShift.


Nice-to-Have Skills
Experience with Observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry, and distributed tracing platforms.
Familiarity with centralized logging solutions such as the ELK/EFK stack.
Exposure to Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Redis, and application performance monitoring tools.
Experience with load testing, capacity planning, scalability optimization, and production performance analysis.


Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, and React.
Build secure REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven solutions using Kafka.
Develop responsive frontend components using React and TypeScript.
Optimize database performance, application scalability, and system reliability.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deploy containerized applications.
Implement automated testing, secure coding, monitoring, and logging practices.
Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and resolve performance bottlenecks.
Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and Agile ceremonies.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA, and DevOps teams.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve productivity and code quality.


Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field.
5-7 years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise.
Proven experience delivering full-stack enterprise applications.
Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently, take ownership, and mentor junior developers.
Cloud AWS, Azure, Google, and Claude certifications are a huge plus.

AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

Drive territory sales growth by executing account plans and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of Cardiac Surgery therapies across assigned hospitals and healthcare institutions.
Build and maintain clinical and commercial relationships with cardiac surgeons, perfusionists, operating room staff, vascular specialists, and procurement stakeholders.
Provide product education, technical support, and clinical expertise to support safe and effective use of Cardiac Surgery technologies.
Deliver procedural support during surgical cases, including troubleshooting and follow-up activities to ensure customer satisfaction and therapy adoption.
Conduct product training and in-service programmes for new and existing customers on assigned therapy portfolios.
Partner with key implant center's to develop strategies that increase product utilisation and support progression toward technical self-sufficiency.
Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, competitive activity, and product performance insights to internal stakeholders.
Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, inventory-related activities, and territory data within approved business systems.



Preferred candidate profile

Required Knowledge and Experience:

High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience
OR Associates Degree AND 6+ years experience
OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in Cardiac Surgery, Cardiovascular, Structural Heart, Perfusion, Extracorporeal Life Support, or related medical device therapies.
Degree or certification in Perfusion Technology.
Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Master of Business Administration.
Experience supporting live surgical procedures and working directly with cardiac surgeons and operating room teams.
Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, account development strategies, and healthcare market dynamics within South India.

Description:
Job Description Job Title Associate Sales Manager Location Branch Name (as per requirement) Department Bancassurance Function Bancassurance YBL - Sales Reporting to Center Manager Band 5A
Function Summary
The Bancassurance Department within Axis Max Life Insurance plays a critical role in driving the distribution of life insurance products through our strategic partnership with Yes Bank. This department leverages Yes Bank s existing customer base and infrastructure to offer insurance solutions.
Bancassurance Department serves as a bridge between Axis Max Life Insurance Company and Yes Bank, ensuring that insurance products are effectively marketed and sold to a wide customer base, while maintaining high standards of customer service, compliance, and performance.
Below is a summary of the key functions typically performed by the Bancassurance Department:
Sales and Distribution Management
Customer Relationship Management
Compliance and Regulatory Oversight
Job Summary
This role involves establishing and strengthening relationships with branch managers and staff to generate leads, the candidate will actively participate in branch activities. The incumbent will be responsible for closing sales and ensuring follow-up on issuance.
A key aspect of the role is to increase the bank s customer awareness about life insurance solutions and achieve targeted penetration of cross-sell within the branch s customer base. The candidate will effectively drive reward and recognition programs for bank staff and regularly train them on life insurance concepts and new product introductions.
Key Responsibilities
Establishing & strengthening relationship with branch manager & staff to gain leads from them.
Involvement in work site activities (putting up stalls and making presentations in corporate.
Closing sale and following up on issuance.
Increasing bank s customer awareness about Life Insurance solutions and achieve the targeted penetration on cross sell within the branch s customer base.
Drive effectively the Reward and recognition programs launched for the bank staff.
Train the bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.
Key skills required
Communication skills
Strategic thinking
Product Knowledge
Problem solving
Time management
Customer relationship management
Deal closing skills
Goal oriented
Customer centricity.
Desired qualification and experience
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
2 to 4 years of experience in sales
Good communication skills - English & regional language (preferred)
Age group: 22-28 years
Preferably has own conveyance

Description:
Job Title- Business Control Analyst, NCT
Location- Jaipur, India


Role Description
The person will be responsible for day-to-day review of voice logs between Client Relationship Managers (RC) and clients where trade details are discussed and agreed. He/she needs to ensure that all key trade-related details are clearly discussed, accurately captured, and documented in the applicable product-specific template. The role requires strong attention to detail, adherence to defined review standards, timely completion of assigned production duties, and appropriate escalation of exceptions, missing information, or first-level queries within the pre-specified timelines. The candidate should also act as a backup for peers when required and share best practices with the team to support consistent quality delivery.


Your key responsibilities
Review voice logs between RCs and clients to validate that trade details have been discussed and agreed as per the required standards.
Listen to and understand client and RMs discussions and accurately document the agreed details or the prescribed business template, as applicable.
Complete the relevant product-specific voice log review template with accurate details, observations, and outcome of the review.
Identify and highlight missing, incomplete, inconsistent, or unclear trade details and escalate exceptions to the relevant stakeholders within agreed timelines.
Ensure accurate and timely completion of daily production activities in line with defined SLAs, cut-off times, and quality expectations.
Perform quality checks on completed reviews to support consistency, audit readiness, and control effectiveness.
Assist in preparing and reviewing daily control / production reports, including tracking of open items, exceptions, and follow-ups.
Support follow-up with RC / business teams for clarification or resolution of deficiencies noted during voice log review.
Maintain proper documentation and evidence of review outcomes to support internal control, audit, and management reporting requirements.
Coordinate with team members and stakeholders on complex cases, escalations, reporting requirements, and process improvements.
Act as backup for peers during absence and support knowledge sharing, cross-training, and continuous improvement within the team.
Perform other administration, reporting, and control-related tasks as assigned.


Your skills and experience
Minimum educational qualification: University graduate with a Bachelor s Degree.
Good command of business English for accurate documentation, exception reporting, and stakeholder communication.
Understanding of trade lifecycle, banking / wealth management products, or control review processes will be an added advantage.
Strong listening, comprehension, documentation, and analytical skills with high attention to detail.
Ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies, missing information, and potential control issues from recorded conversations.
Candidates are required to be proficient in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Highly motivated, quality-focused, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
Ability to multi-task and work under pressure to meet production timelines, cut-off times, and quality standards.
Good communication skills and ability to manage routine queries / first-level escalations professionally.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a Lead DevOps Engineer with strong hands-on experience in AWS, GCP, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Pulumi and DevSecOps. The candidate will lead DevOps teams, drive technical delivery with client stakeholders, design scalable and secure cloud infrastructure, and establish best practices for automation, deployment, reliability, and cost optimization across cloud environments.


Key Responsibilities
Lead and mentor DevOps engineers, drive technical execution, and ensure timely delivery of client requirements.
Engage with client teams and architects to understand requirements, provide technical guidance, and drive solution design and implementation.
Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and automated release processes.
Architect and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP (Azure optional) using Infrastructure as Code.
Lead containerization and orchestration initiatives using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
Drive DevSecOps, observability, SRE practices, disaster recovery, and cloud cost optimization.
Troubleshoot complex production issues, drive root cause analysis, and ensure system reliability, security, and performance.
Collaborate with Development, QA, Security, Architecture, and client teams to drive engineering standards and continuous improvement.


Mandatory Skills
7-9 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Platform Engineering, including team leadership and client-facing responsibilities.
Strong hands-on experience with AWS and GCP, including cloud infrastructure, networking, security, and managed services.
Expertise in CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or equivalent platforms.
Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and managed Kubernetes services such as AKS, EKS, or GKE.
Hands-on expertise in Terraform and Ansible, with experience in Infrastructure as Code and configuration management.
Experience with GitOps practices and tools such as Argo CD or Flux.
Strong understanding of Git, branching strategies, release management, and deployment automation.
Experience implementing DevSecOps practices, including security scanning, secrets management, and vulnerability management.
Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, production troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
Proficiency in Linux administration, networking fundamentals, and Bash/Python/PowerShell scripting.
Proven ability to lead teams, manage priorities, communicate with clients, and drive technical decisions independently.


Preferred Skills
Knowledge of SAST/DAST, SBOM, software supply chain security, and security policy enforcement.
Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog, or Splunk.
Experience with cloud migrations, hybrid environments, disaster recovery, high availability, and cost optimisation.
Knowledge of service mesh technologies such as Istio or Consul, and API gateways or application gateways.
Experience with enterprise cloud security, IAM, network security, and infrastructure.

Description:
Job Summary
Role Overview: We are looking for a hands-on Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer who can independently design, develop, test, and deploy end-to-end Agentic AI applications using React.js and Python. You will be responsible for taking a business requirement, breaking it into modules, deciding the application architecture, designing data structures and APIs, integrating AI components, and delivering a fully functional, production-ready solution. Need someone who can think independently, make technical decisions, integrate services, and take complete ownership of the application lifecycle as a Indidual Contributor.


Responsibilities
End-to-End Development: Build complete AI applications using React.js for the frontend and Python for the backend.
Solution Design: Understand business requirements, divide work into modules, and define application architecture, data structures, and API requirements.
Agentic AI Development: Integrate LLMs, RAG pipelines, AI agents, tool calling, and frameworks such as Lang Chain and Lang Graph.
Service Integration: Integrate third-party APIs, databases, AI models, MCP servers, and other required services and protocols.
Database Design: Design and manage relational databases and vector databases based on application requirements.
Deployment Infrastructure: Handle end-to-end deployment, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, cloud infrastructure, and production releases.
Testing Quality: Perform end-to-end testing, including unit, integration, functional, and smoke testing, to ensure application reliability.
Performance Security: Monitor application performance, troubleshoot issues, and follow secure coding and deployment practices.
Ownership Communication: Work independently, communicate effectively with stakeholders, provide regular updates, and support off-hours activities when required by business needs.


Required Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience with React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frontend development.
Strong Python programming skills with experience in Fast API, Django, or similar backend frameworks.
Practical experience building and deploying end-to-end AI applications.
Good understanding of LLMs, RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI agent workflows.
Experience with frameworks such as Lang Chain or Lang Graph.
Understanding of MCP, tool calling, function calling, and API integrations.
Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases, REST APIs, and data modelling.
Experience with Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms, and production deployments.
Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks such as Py-Test and Jest.

Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR

Supporting Management of Front Desk Team

- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.

- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.

- Participates in an ongoing employee recognition program.
- Conducts training when appropriate.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process.

- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Understands the functions of the Bell Staff, Switchboard and Concierge/Guest Services operations.
- Complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.

Purpose of the role

The face of the D2C platform in the physical market. Visit mechanics, roadside garages, small workshops, and truck operators in an assigned territory. Demonstrate the platform, register new buyers, facilitate the first purchase, and ensure the buyer can use the app independently. 13 years in field sales, FMCG distribution, insurance agency, or fintech outreach roles

Smartphone proficiency; able to demonstrate app fluently in local language
High energy and comfort with ground-level market work workshops, roadside interactions
Local language fluency essential; Hindi and regional language preferred
Diploma Holder from Mechanical Background

Join Our Award-Winning Team at Dr. B. Lal Clinical Laboratory Pvt. Ltd !
We are delighted to share that Dr. B. Lal Clinical Laboratory Pvt. Ltd. has been recognized among India s Top 100 Great Mid-Size Workplaces 2025 - a proud moment in our journey of excellence. Watch the proud moment here: Award Ceremony

Role Clarity: Business Development Manager
Reporting To : Zonal Sales Manager

Role Definition:
The Business Development Manager is responsible for driving growth by identifying and acquiring new customers within the zone. This role involves prospecting, customer profiling, building relationships, and promoting the organizations brand and services to achieve sales targets and expand the market.

Deliverables:
Market Research and Analysis
Customer Acquisition and Pipeline Development
Customer Relationship Management
Sales Process Management
Reporting and Performance Analysis

Key Responsibilities:

Prospecting and Customer Acquisition:
Conduct market research in the zone to identify industry trends, competition, potential customers and growth opportunities.
Prospect potential customers from various channels, including clinicians, Corporate hospitals, SIS, Franchisee partners, and corporate industries. Reach out to a minimum of 200 new prospects each month.
Implement field level lead generation plan to build a pipeline of qualified leads. Generate at least 25 qualified leads per month.

MSL Development and Management:
Develop and update an MSL of a minimum of 150 potential customers every quarter for conversion, engagement, and building brand visibility
Regular meeting with identified potential customers to nurture relationships and explore business opportunities. Conduct at least 10 meetings with potential customers every day.

Customer Profiling and Needs Assessment:
Createa profiling of potential customers to understand their needs, desires. Identify customer pain points and business challenges through needs assessment.
Segment the customer based on criteria of A, B, C, and D Customer to prioritize outreach efforts.

Solution Offering:
Create and present the elevator pitch, tailored solutions, products and proposals that address customer needs and align with service offerings.
Collaborate with the Product and Centre of Excellence team to develop and manage scientific content and promotional materials for effective communication with customers. Communicate scientific literature detailing product features, benefits, and advantages to the target audience.
Handle objections and close deals in collaboration with Zonal Managers to ensure customer conversion.

Account Management:
Schedule regular follow up visits with existing customers to review their needs, satisfaction levels, and any issues they may have.
Plan and execute business activities such as RTMs,CMEs, Product-led scientific seminars, and other community engagement based on business needs and objectives. Engage a minimum of 30% of MSL through such activities every quarter.

Sales Process Management:
Manage the end-to-end sales process from lead generation to contract closure and post-sales follow-up.
Log all sales activities daily in the LIMS Sales module to track progress, update records, and analyze sales performance metrics.
Prepare reports and presentations on sales performance, sales funnel status, and market insights every month.

Success Metrics:
Generate at least 25 qualified leads per month
Conduct a minimum of 10 meetings with potential customers daily
Achieve a 30% conversion rate on presented proposals
Achieve minimum 75% MSL productivity

Role Requirements:
Bachelor s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA in Marketing or Healthcare Management will be an added advantage.
Relevant Experience 1-4 years of experience in Business Development, Sales, or Marketing within the healthcare or related industry, with diagnostic industry experience preferred.
Proven ability in prospecting, lead generation, and pipeline development, with a track record of achieving sales targets and converting leads into long-term business relationships.
Experience in engaging with clinicians, hospitals, corporate clients, and franchise partners, demonstrating strong networking and customer relationship management skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively communicate scientific and diagnostic service offerings.
Sound understanding of healthcare market trends and competition, along with proficiency in sales reporting and CRM/LIMS systems to track performance and derive actionable insights.

Opportunity to develop technical expertise in API manufacturing.

Description:
Job Summary
To support the effective implementation of EHS standards, Life Saving Rules, safe work practices, and risk mitigation measures across the plant. The Safety Officer will be responsible for identifying hazards, preventing unsafe acts and conditions, ensuring compliance with safety requirements, and supporting the organization in achieving its goal of Zero Accidents, Zero Fatalities, and Zero LTI. The Safety Officer shall maintain a strong shop-floor presence and work closely with Production, Maintenance, Engineering, Projects, Contractors, Security, and other functions to ensure that safety requirements are effectively implemented.


Responsibilities
EHS Standards & Life Saving Rules - Implement and monitor applicable EHS standards, procedures, and Life Saving Rules.
Conduct regular field verification of safety standards.
Immediately intervene and Stop the Work if any Life Saving Rule violation, deviation, or serious unsafe condition is observed.
Ensure work resumes only after required controls are implemented and verified.
Promote a strong safety culture across the plant.
Shop-Floor Safety Inspection - Conduct daily shop-floor and workplace safety inspections.
Identify and report Unsafe Acts (UA), Unsafe Conditions (UC), and unsafe behaviors.
Communicate observations to concerned departments and follow up for timely closure.
Monitor repeated violations and escalate critical issues to the EHS Manager.
Risk Assessment - Support preparation and review of HIRA, JSA/JHA, Risk Assessments, and SOPs.
Verify that identified risk controls are implemented at the workplace.
Ensure high-risk activities are not started without appropriate controls.
Participate in risk assessments for new processes, equipment, and activities.
Permit-to-Work System - Verify and support the Permit-to-Work (PTW) system for high-risk activities.
Inspect the workplace before work starts.
Verify required controls such as: LOTO, PPE, Barricading, Gas testing, Fire protection, Working-at-height controls, Rescue arrangements.
Conduct field verification during the work.
Contractor & Vendor Safety - Conduct safety induction for new contractors, vendors, and workers.
Verify required safety documents before deployment.
Monitor contractor work practices and compliance.
Conduct contractor safety inspections and toolbox talks.
Ensure contractor employees use required PPE and follow approved procedures.
Report and escalate serious contractor safety violations.
Machine & Equipment Safety - Conduct inspections of machinery, equipment, guards, interlocks, emergency stops, and safety devices.
Identify machine guarding deficiencies and ensure corrective actions.
Prevent bypassing or tampering with safety devices.
Support pre-commissioning safety inspections for new equipment.
MHE & Material Handling Safety - Monitor safe operation of forklifts, pallet trucks, cranes, hoists, and other MHE.
Verify operator authorization and competency.
Monitor pedestrian segregation and vehicle movement.
Check critical behaviors such as speeding, mobile phone usage, unsafe reversing, overloading, and seat-belt violations.
Support implementation of effective traffic management controls.
LOTO & Energy Isolation - Verify compliance with Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) requirements.
Ensure hazardous energy sources are properly isolated before maintenance or intervention.
Conduct field verification of LOTO practices.
Report any deviation immediately.
PPE Management - Ensure employees and contractors use appropriate PPE.
Conduct regular PPE compliance inspections.
Identify PPE requirements based on workplace risks.
Monitor PPE availability and usage.
Report PPE-related gaps and support procurement requirements.
Safety Training & Awareness - Conduct safety induction and toolbox talks.
Support training programs on: Life Saving Rules, Machine Safety, MHE Safety, Working at Height, Electrical Safety, LOTO, Fire Safety, PPE, Emergency Response.
Maintain training and attendance records.
Ensure employees understand the hazards associated with their work.
Near-Miss & Incident Reporting - Encourage employees to report Near Misses, Unsafe Acts, and Unsafe Conditions.
Participate in incident and near-miss investigations.
Support identification of root causes and corrective actions.
Follow up on action closure and verify effectiveness.
Communicate lessons learned to concerned teams.
Emergency Preparedness - Support emergency preparedness and response activities.
Participate in mock drills and emergency exercises.
Inspect emergency equipment and access routes.
Support the Emergency Response Team during emergencies.
Report deficiencies in fire and emergency preparedness systems.
Safety Audits & Compliance - Conduct routine safety audits and inspections.
Support internal, corporate, customer, and statutory audits.
Maintain inspection records and action trackers.
Follow up on observations until closure.
Ensure compliance with applicable legal and organizational requirements.
SOP & Safety Documentation - Verify availability and accessibility of approved SOPs and work instructions at the workplace.
Ensure operators follow approved procedures.
Report gaps between documented procedures and actual practices.
Support development and revision of safety checklists and SOPs.
Safety Communication - Display and communicate important EHS information across the workplace.
Conduct safety awareness campaigns and toolbox meetings.
Communicate daily safety observations and critical issues during shift handover.
Promote positive safety behavior through employee engagement.
Workplace Safety Measurements - Support workplace monitoring of: Noise, Illumination, Temperature, Humidity, Air quality and other applicable parameters.
Maintain records and communicate abnormal results for corrective action.
Safety Performance Monitoring - Maintain daily/weekly safety inspection data.
Track: Safety observations, Near Misses, Unsafe Acts/Conditions, LSR violations, Training, PTW compliance, Audit observations, Corrective action closure.
Support preparation of monthly EHS reports and dashboards.
Safety Improvement - Identify opportunities for hazard elimination and risk reduction.
Recommend engineering controls wherever practical.
Participate in safety improvement projects.
Share best practices and lessons learned.
Support continuous improvement of the plant's safety culture.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Zero Fatalities
Zero LTI / Major Injuries
100% compliance with applicable Life Saving Rules
Timely closure of critical safety observations
Reduction in Unsafe Acts and Unsafe Conditions
Improvement in Near-Miss reporting
PTW and LOTO compliance
Contractor safety performance
Training and competency compliance
Machine guarding compliance
MHE safety compliance
Safety audit performance
Legal and statutory compliance
Employee safety engagement


Required Competencies

Technical Competencies
Knowledge of industrial safety practices
Risk Assessment / HIRA / JSA
Permit-to-Work system
LOTO
Machine guarding
MHE and material handling safety
Working at Height
Fire and emergency safety
Contractor safety
Incident investigation
PPE selection and compliance
EHS documentation and reporting


Behavioral Competencies
Strong safety commitment
Good communication skills
Ability to challenge unsafe practices
Strong observation skills
Proactive approach
Teamwork and coordination
Problem-solving ability
Safety leadership
Ability to work under pressure
Strong shop-floor presence

Advanced presentation skills.
Able to manage multiple projects with minimal supervision.
Eagar to upscale and upgrade the team with various software and technology.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Assist site engineers in supervising daily construction activities.
Monitor excavation, foundation, concreting, masonry, plastering, and finishing works.
Read and understand civil engineering drawings under the guidance of senior engineers.
Monitor daily site progress and prepare progress reports.
Coordinate with contractors, supervisors, workers, and vendors.
Assist in checking the quality of construction materials and workmanship.
Monitor material consumption and maintain inventory records.
Ensure workers follow site safety procedures and use appropriate PPE.
Assist in quantity estimation, BOQ preparation, and material calculations.
Maintain site documentation, labour attendance, and inspection records.
Report construction delays, material shortages, and quality issues to the reporting manager.
Learn project planning, execution, and construction management practices.

Preferred candidate profile
Freshers or candidates with up to 2 years of relevant experience.
Candidates with a Diploma or Degree in Civil Engineering.
Candidates willing to work at the assigned construction site.

Key Deliverables
  As a Customer Service Associate at Marks and Spencer, your main role is to assist customers, maintain store standards, and learn the basics of store operations. Your key responsibilities include:
Customer Service:
Greet Assist Customers: Welcome customers with a friendly attitude and help them find what they need.
Understand Customer Needs: Listen to customers, understand their preferences, and recommend suitable products.
Store Standards:
Support Visual Merchandising: Help maintain the store's appearance by following guidelines for product displays.
Proper Product Handling: Ensure products are handled carefully and organized correctly on the shelves.
Basic Operations:
Learn Store Procedures: Follow company guidelines for tasks like stocking, housekeeping, and cashiering.
Assist with Cashiering: When needed, help with basic cashier duties to provide smooth service.
Growth Learning:
On-the-Job Training: Take part in training sessions to improve your skills and grow within the role.

Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Project ExecutionSite Execution, Site ManagementStakeholder ManagementSite OperationsPlanning and Controlquality and safetyVendor ContractsTechnical Leadership, About company, Tata Power- An Equal Opportunity Employer.
Description:
Site Head Rooftop Solar Projects (South)
Location: South India (Site-Based)
Business: Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited (TPREL)
Department: EPC / Rooftop Solar Projects
Experience: 7–14 Years
Education: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical & Electronics Engineering or Electrical Engineering
Age: 35–45 Years
Languages: Telugu and Kannada (Preferable)
Role Purpose
The Site Head – Rooftop Solar Projects will be responsible for end-to-end execution and management of rooftop solar projects at site, ensuring timely delivery within approved budget, scope, quality, and safety standards. The incumbent will lead site operations, coordinate with stakeholders, manage vendors and contractors, and drive project completion while ensuring adherence to organizational and regulatory requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Project Execution & Lifecycle Management
Lead the complete project lifecycle from site mobilization to commissioning and project handover.
Ensure successful execution of rooftop solar projects as per approved scope, timelines, quality standards, and budget.
Monitor project progress and implement corrective actions to mitigate delays and project risks.
Drive achievement of project milestones and ensure timely completion.
Site Operations Management
Oversee day-to-day site operations, workforce deployment, and resource utilization.
Conduct regular site reviews and progress assessments.
Planning & Project Controls
Develop detailed project execution plans, schedules, and tracking mechanisms.
Monitor project performance against planned timelines and budgets.
Coordinate material availability, manpower planning, and equipment deployment.
Maintain project documentation and reporting systems.
Quality & Safety Management
Ensure implementation of best-in-class quality standards and construction practices.
Drive compliance with all HSE (Health, Safety & Environment) requirements and statutory regulations.
Conduct safety audits, toolbox talks, and quality inspections.
Promote a strong safety culture across all project sites.
Stakeholder Management
Act as the primary point of contact for customers, consultants, local authorities, and internal stakeholders.
Ensure effective communication and alignment among project teams and business functions.
Manage client expectations and address project-related concerns proactively.
Vendor & Contract Management
Manage contractors, vendors, and subcontractors throughout the project lifecycle.
Monitor vendor performance against contractual obligations, safety, quality, and delivery parameters.
Resolve contractual and execution-related issues to ensure uninterrupted project progress.
Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop site engineering and execution teams.
Foster a high-performance culture focused on safety, quality, and timely project delivery.
Ensure effective coordination among engineering, procurement, and execution teams.
Technical Problem Solving
Identify and troubleshoot technical, operational, and execution challenges.
Drive resolution of site-level issues with minimal impact on project timelines.
Support commissioning, testing, and performance optimization activities.
Desired Candidate Profile
Education
B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or related discipline.
Experience
7–14 years of experience in solar, renewable energy, EPC, power, or infrastructure projects.
Proven experience in rooftop solar project execution and site management.
Strong exposure to project planning, construction management, commissioning, and stakeholder handling.
Technical Skills
Rooftop Solar Project Execution.
Project Planning & Control.
Electrical Systems & Installation.
Site Construction Management.
Quality Assurance & Safety Management.
Contract & Vendor Management.
Risk Assessment & Mitigation.
Project Scheduling Tools (MS Project/Primavera preferred).
Behavioral Competencies
Leadership and team management.
Excellent coordination and communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management capabilities.
Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Result-oriented approach with ownership mindset.
Other Requirements
Willingness to work from project sites across South India.
Proficiency in Telugu and Kannada is mandatory.
Ability to travel extensively based on project requirements.
Reporting To: Project/Regional Execution Head – Rooftop Solar Business (TPREL)
Team Size: Site Engineers, Supervisors, Contractors & Vendor Workforce (as applicable).
AboutCompany:
Tata Power- An Equal Opportunity Employer.

Led by a powerful vision, Tata Power pioneered the generation of electricity in India. It has now successfully served the Mumbai consumers for over ninety years and has spread its footprints across the nation. Today, it is the countrys largest private player in the sector. Apart from Mumbai and Delhi, the company has generation capacities in Jojobera, Jharkhand and Karnataka.As a growth strategy , Tata Power has ventured into several greenfield projects in Generation. The 4000 megawatt imported Coal-based generating station at Mundra , Gujarat , 1000 megawatt Thermal Power plant at Maithon , Jharkhand are some of its recent involvements. It has got several other upcoming capacity additions / greenfield projects in Maharashtra , Jharkhand , Orissa , West Bengal.

Description:
Job_Description":"
The Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in driving revenue growth and market expansion for our premium Ice Cream & Frozen Desserts portfolio. This strategic position is responsible for end-to-end management of sales operations, distribution network optimization, and customer relationship excellence across designated territories. The ideal candidate will be a results-driven leader with a proven track record in achieving aggressive sales targets, building robust distribution channels, and ensuring flawless execution of field operationsincluding push cart initiatives. You will lead a high-performing team, leverage market intelligence to identify growth opportunities, and ensure timely product availability through efficient logistics and inventory management. Your leadership will directly impact brand visibility, customer satisfaction, and profitability and ensuring timely delivery of ice cream and frozen dessert products, the Area Sales Manager ensures sustained business performance and customer satisfaction. Responsibilities
Responsibilities:
Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve targeted revenue goals as outlined in the business plan.
Conduct market analysis to identify growth opportunities and expand the distribution network effectively.
Lead the planning, execution, and scaling of push cart business operations to increase brand visibility and sales.
Ensure timely collection of payments and manage outstanding receivables to maintain healthy cash flow.
Optimize the use of resources, funds, and operational costs to support sustainable profitability.
Maintain robust asset management and control systems to safeguard company assets.
Coordinate logistics to ensure on-time delivery of ice cream and frozen dessert products across all channels.
Design and manage customer contract programs, while proactively addressing and resolving customer complaints.






Requirements

Requirements
Requirements:
Proven 9+ years experience in sales management, preferably within FMCG, ice cream, or frozen food industries.
Strong track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets in dynamic markets.
Excellent analytical and strategic planning skills with a focus on market intelligence and expansion.
Demonstrated ability in team leadership, resource allocation, and cost control.
Proficiency in logistics coordination and supply chain management.
Skilled in customer relationship management and handling contract programs.
High level of integrity, accountability, and financial stewardship.
Ability to work independently and adapt to fast-paced, results-oriented environments.
Excellent negotiation, leadership, and team management abilities.
Proficiency in CRM tools, ERP systems, and MS Office (especially Excel for data analysis).


Benefits Benefits
Medial Insurance
Sales Incentives
Increments
Paid leaves
Leave Encashment
Public holidays
Gratuity

Description:
About Swiggy:

Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming Indias leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees

.Role: Sales Manager I

A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants learning their business understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.

Job Description:

Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggys products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Google sheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction 80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month What We're Looking For

Experience & Background:

0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partners.
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales
AboutCompany: Swiggy is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Optometrist
Customerfocus:
DrivingNet
PromoterScore Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the
free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to

adherence Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs

reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment
Storeupkeep & maintenance regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or
damage in the store

Comprehensive training and support
Chance to make a difference in customers' lives through vision care
