Description:
Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of Spare Parts by increasing penetration in assigned territory. It involve ensuring the availability of genuine parts throughout designated territories and by closely working with retail network. It also involves creating awareness and educating the channel on benefits of genuine spare parts.

Job Responsibility
Sales Execution and Planning
Drive sales strategy through innovative activities and relationship building to garner maximum market share of Tata Genuine Parts.
Drive achievement of retail sales, institutional sales, product range and total sales targets by demand generating schemes and initiatives
Achieve distributor targets for primary and secondary sales by driving order generation activites
Develop and plan appropriate stock levels with distributers and execute plans for order generations. Monitor fulfilment of orders to ensure targets are achieved. Ensure distributers have the proper funding to support sales
Ensure the timely handling of channel partners and customer complaints including resolving payment issues, claims settlements and product availability
Actively coordinate with channel partner and procurement, warehouse & finance team to achieve high fill rates
Actively explore growth opportunities to increase market share and expanded the network to meet business objectives
Develop a deep understanding of the market and competition in assigned territory and use insights on competition pricing and distribution strategies to help improve organizations own strategies and tactics
Develop market potential matrix of Tata Genuine Parts through different methods: retailer wise, product group wise, district wise potential
Financial Management
Coordinate and monitor the availability of finances for distributors in assigned territory
Ensure competitive customer pricing by negotiating with channel partners to creating a win-win distribution pricing.
Monitor over dues of dealers and distributers in assigned area and take actions when required
Relationship Management
Deliver sales targets by working collaboratively with channel partners, participate in customer contact programs to capture voice of the customers, and providing timely solutions to the market, dealers, distributors and customers
People Management
Maintain up to date product knowledge and actively provide training and educate to the retailers, mechanics, fleet operators and channel partners regarding product and the usage of genuine spare parts.
Instilling the importance of resolving customer complaints received by distributors and guiding them on best practices for handling tricky situations in a timely manner. Also training them on importance of stock keeping and timely ordering of parts

Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal
Warehouse
Servicing of Orders, providing e-permits.
Central Logistics team.
Tracking shipments
Tech Cell
Technical support for NPI
ASM/CSM
Joint Audits of workshops.
External
Dealer
For order planning, Payments, DPM review on regular basis
Transporter
For claims and timely delivery of consignments.
Desired Candidate Profile
Education MBA from renowned B school along with B E (Mechanical / Automobile Engg)
Relevant Experience: 3 - 4 Years
Experience in Business to Business Sales or Channel Sales or Auto Component Sales
Skills & Competencies
Sales Skills
Technical knowledge
Analytical Skills
Interpersonal Skill
Negotiations skills
Local language knowledge
Customer Orientations

Description:
Graduate Marketing Executive | Sports-Minded Professionals | Hyderabad 35,000 55,000 per month + Performance Incentives Full Paid Training Provided | Immediate Start | Leadership Progression

Your Sporting Mindset Has a Place Here
The qualities that make a great athlete — consistency, resilience, the ability to perform under pressure, and an instinct to push beyond the average — are the same qualities that build exceptional marketing professionals. Here, we've have built our graduate programme around exactly that thinking.

We are currently expanding our Hyderabad team and are looking for driven graduates who bring that competitive edge and are ready to channel it into a high-performance professional environment.

Why Graduates With a Sporting Background Thrive with Us:
Team Mentality — Our campaigns are built on collective effort. You will work within a close-knit team where collaboration and shared accountability are central to how we operate, much like any high-performing squad
Discipline & Consistency — The ability to show up, follow a structure, and remain focused when results take time is something sports teaches better than any training programme. We recognise and reward that quality
Performance-Driven Culture — Targets, benchmarks, and measurable outcomes are part of daily life at Meridian. If you are motivated by improvement and results, you will feel at home here
Leadership Development — Our strongest performers move quickly into mentoring and team leadership responsibilities, giving you the opportunity to develop the same influence off the field that you carried on it

About the Role
As a Graduate Marketing Executive, you will be at the frontline of our client campaigns — engaging directly with consumers, representing brands in high-footfall environments, and contributing to measurable business outcomes from day one. This is a field-based, people-focused role that rewards energy, communication, and a results-oriented approach.

Full training is provided from the outset, so prior experience in marketing or sales is not a requirement. What we are looking for is the right attitude and the drive to develop quickly.

What You Will Be Doing
Representing client campaigns through direct marketing and face-to-face consumer engagement
Promoting products, services, and events in targeted, high-traffic locations across Bangalore
Identifying and developing new business leads, converting opportunities into tangible results
Collaborating with your team to achieve weekly and monthly campaign targets
Progressing into training and mentoring responsibilities as your confidence and skill set grows

Who We Are Looking For
Graduates from any discipline with a sporting, athletic, or team-based background
Strong communicators who are comfortable engaging with new people daily
Ambitious individuals with a clear goal-oriented mindset
Resilient, self-motivated, and comfortable in a fast-paced field environment
Available to start immediately or at short notice

Compensation & Benefits
Starting salary of 35,000 per month
Progression to 55,000 per month by Month 3, performance dependent
Weekly performance-based incentive structure
Fully paid professional training and ongoing mentorship
Structured and transparent pathway into leadership and business development roles

We design and execute immersive brand experiences that engage audiences, drive brand awareness, and deliver measurable results. From interactive events to product activations, we bring brands to life through creative, high-impact campaigns that leave a lasting impression. With a global reach and a focus on innovation, Sales Partners helps clients connect with customers in meaningful and unforgettable ways.

Description:
Job Title: Senior Sales Executive
Experience: 1 to 5 Years
Salary: 3 to 4 LPA (CTC)
Locations: Hyderabad, Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam Vizag, Coimbatore, Chennai, Bhubaneswar
Department: Sales & Business Development
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Senior Sales Executive with experience in corporate sales, industrial sales, and corporate relationship management. The ideal candidate should have strong communication, negotiation, and client-handling skills, along with knowledge of the lubrication industry. The candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, managing corporate clients, and achieving sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
Identify and develop new business opportunities in corporate and industrial markets.
Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, industrial customers, and key decision-makers.
Promote and sell lubrication products to industrial and corporate customers.
Generate leads through market research, client visits, networking, and referrals.
Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable lubrication products and solutions.
Prepare sales proposals, quotations, and commercial offers for clients.
Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and contracts to close business deals.
Achieve assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
Maintain regular follow-ups with existing customers to improve retention and generate repeat business.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely product delivery and customer satisfaction.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and potential business opportunities.
Maintain accurate sales reports, customer databases, and sales pipeline updates.

Key Skills Required
Corporate Sales
Industrial Sales
Knowledge of Lubricants and Lubrication Products
Corporate Relationship Management
Business Development and Lead Generation
Client Relationship Management
Communication and Negotiation Skills
Customer Handling and Sales Closing
Market Research and Competitor Analysis
Sales Target Management and Reporting

Eligibility Criteria

Graduate in any discipline a business-related qualification is preferred.
15 years of experience in corporate sales, industrial sales, or business development.
Experience in the lubrication, automotive, manufacturing, or industrial products industry will be an advantage.
Ability to develop and maintain long-term corporate client relationships.
Willingness to travel for client meetings and business development activities, as required.
Proficiency in MS Office and basic sales reporting tools is preferred.
Educational Qualifications:
Candidates with any of the following educational qualifications are eligible to apply:

Diploma in Mechanical Engineering
B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
B.Tech in Petrochemical Engineering
B.Sc. in Chemistry

Title Sales Associate
Reportingto Store Manager

AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies

Description:
SAP BASIS Consultant

Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)

Experience:
JL4: 2-5 Years
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP BASIS Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for managing, administering, monitoring, and optimizing SAP landscapes across enterprise environments.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP BASIS Administration, SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP HANA Database Administration, System Installation, Upgrades, Migrations, Kernel Upgrades, Performance Tuning, and Production Support. Experience in implementation, migration, upgrade, and support engagements is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Install, configure, administer, and monitor SAP systems across landscapes.
Perform SAP system installations, upgrades, refreshes, migrations, and patching activities.
Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP NetWeaver, and SAP HANA environments.
Execute client copies, system copies, kernel upgrades, and transport management activities.
Monitor system performance and optimize SAP application and database performance.
Perform regular health checks and system monitoring activities.
Manage SAP user administration, authorizations, and security-related activities.
Handle SAP Backup, Recovery, High Availability (HA), and Disaster Recovery (DR) configurations.
Support incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis (RCA).
Troubleshoot SAP application, database, and operating system-related issues.
Coordinate with infrastructure, cloud, functional, and development teams.
Support implementation, rollout, upgrade, migration, and maintenance projects.
Manage SAP Transport Management System (TMS) across landscapes.
Prepare technical documentation and operational procedures.
Ensure system availability, reliability, compliance, and operational excellence.
Provide production support and resolve critical incidents within SLA timelines.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP BASIS experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of SAP landscape architecture and administration.

Mandatory Skills
SAP BASIS Administration
SAP S/4HANA
SAP NetWeaver
SAP HANA Administration
SAP Installation
SAP Upgrades

Good to Have
SAP Solution Manager
SAP Landscape Management (LaMa)
SAP Cloud ALM
SAP BTP Administration
AWS / Azure / GCP Exposure
HANA Database Migration
Automation & Scripting
SAP Fiori Administration
SAP Router Administration
ITIL Process Knowledge

Additional Information
Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP BASIS Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP Administration experience

Description:
Join our Team
About This Opportunity
We are looking for a skilled Senior Software Developer - BMC Helix to join our team and take ownership of the development, integration deployment of BMC Remedy/Helix ITSM applications in enterprise environments. In this role, you will work across the full application lifecycle - from design and development to integration and support - ensuring the platform is aligned with business processes and ITIL best practices. You will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver robust, scalable ITSM solutions.

What You Will Do

- Develop, configure, and customize BMC Remedy AR System (ARS 8.0+) and BMC Remedy ITSM Suite modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, SRM, SLM, and Knowledge Management
- Manage Foundation Data - including creation, updates, and deletion - and configure ITSM components end-to-end
- Administer Remedy Server and Mid-Tier - covering AR Server, Approval Server, Email Engine, Reporting, and Audit Logging configuration
- Perform installation, upgrades, feature design, development, and data loads for BMC Remedy/Helix applications
- Build and maintain integrations with third-party and B2B systems; lead migrations and consolidation of disparate systems into an enterprise ITSM infrastructure
- Provide technical support across the Remedy Suite - including ADDM, BCM, CMDB, and Asset Management - across production, test, and development environments
- Manage Change Management approvals, assignments, notification mechanisms, SLM, and end-to-end CM lifecycle
- Perform bug fixes, workflow enhancements, and troubleshoot applications at workflow and database levels
- Translate business requirements into application designs using best-practice technical solutions; create and maintain design specifications and architectural diagrams
- Support all stages of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

What You Will Bring

- 2- 7 years hands-on development experience with BMC Remedy AR System and BMC/Helix ITSM applications
- Proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL
- Strong understanding of third-party and B2B integration architecture with Remedy
- Experience with enterprise migrations and consolidation of ITSM platforms
- Ability to create and maintain architectural diagrams, design specifications, and process documentation
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- End-to-end architecture visibility with the ability to understand application, integration, and infrastructure dependencies
- Demonstrated ownership and accountability in delivering solutions and resolving issues
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.

To build solutions never seen before to some of the world s toughest problems. You ll be challenged, but you won t be alone. Description:
ServiceNow ITOM Developer
Experience: 2-6 Years
Location: Pune / Bangalore / Noida/Mumbai
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a ServiceNow ITOM Developer with 2-6 years of experience to join our team. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in ServiceNow ITOM modules, particularly Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management and CMDB.
The candidate will be responsible for developing, configuring, integrating and supporting ITOM solutions to improve infrastructure visibility, service health and operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
Configure, customize and develop ServiceNow ITOM solutions based on business and technical requirements.
Work on ServiceNow Discovery, including Discovery Schedules, Credentials, MID Server, Discovery Patterns, Probes and Sensors.
Configure and maintain Service Mapping to identify application and infrastructure dependencies.
Work on Event Management, including event ingestion, event rules, alert management, CI binding and event correlation.
Maintain and enhance CMDB, including CI classes, relationships, identification and reconciliation.
Work with MID Servers and troubleshoot connectivity, credential and discovery-related issues.
Develop and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and third-party monitoring/infrastructure tools using REST/SOAP APIs and other integration mechanisms.
Troubleshoot Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management and CMDB-related issues.
Develop and maintain ServiceNow scripts using JavaScript where required.
Work with infrastructure, network, application and cloud teams to resolve ITOM-related technical issues.
Analyze and resolve issues related to CI discovery, duplicate CIs, incorrect relationships and failed discovery.
Support CMDB data quality, accuracy and governance initiatives.
Prepare technical documentation and participate in knowledge-sharing activities.
Follow ServiceNow development and implementation best practices.
Required Skills
26 years of experience in ServiceNow development/ITOM.
Hands-on experience with one or more ITOM modules, preferably:
Discovery
Service Mapping
Event Management
CMDB
Good understanding of MID Server architecture and configuration.
Knowledge of Discovery Patterns, Probes, Sensors and Discovery Schedules.
Understanding of Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE) and CI identification.
Knowledge of CI classes, relationships and CMDB data model.

Title: Presales/Operations Professional | Online Payments (Payment Gateway)

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform through a wide range of payment use cases. Paytm offers services such as utility bill payments, money transfers, UPI, Wallet, FASTag, Postpaid, and Payment Gateway solutions. For merchants, Paytm provides comprehensive payment acceptance solutions, including QR, Soundbox, EDC, and Payment Gateway, while enabling business growth through commerce and financial services.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
Paytm Payments Services Limited (PPSL) is the RBI-regulated Payment Aggregator responsible for Paytm's Online Payment Gateway business. PPSL enables thousands of merchants, startups, and enterprises to offer seamless digital payment experiences through multiple payment modes, including UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI, and BNPL. Our mission is to help businesses accelerate growth through secure, reliable, and scalable payment solutions.

About the Role:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented professional to support the Payment Gateway Sales team across pre-sales activities, client solutioning and sales operations. The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Technology and Operations teams to ensure smooth coordination, effective client engagement and seamless business execution.

Expectations / Requirements:
Generate and qualify enterprise leads through cold calling, outbound prospecting and market research.
Understand prospect requirements, conduct initial discussions and build a strong pipeline for the Enterprise Sales/KAM team.
Maintain lead pipeline, follow-ups and accurate updates in CRM/internal systems.
Coordinate with Product, Technology, Integration, Risk and Operations teams for smooth merchant onboarding and integration.
Act as a SPOC for merchant queries, issues and grievances, ensuring timely resolution and closure.
Track merchant onboarding, integration and operational issues, identify bottlenecks and drive timely resolution.
Prepare MIS, reports and dashboards covering leads, onboarding, integrations and operational metrics.
Support Sales with operational activities, documentation, approvals and internal coordination.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve productivity, prospect research, reporting and operational efficiency.
Identify process gaps and drive improvements in TAT, operational efficiency and merchant experience.

Qualifications & Skills:
2+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Inside Sales, Sales Support, Merchant Operations or similar roles.
Strong experience in B2B/Enterprise lead generation, cold calling and lead qualification.
Prior experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking or Technology preferred.
Exposure to merchant onboarding, payment integration or merchant support is an added advantage.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with prospects, merchants and internal teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and execution skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/reporting tools.
Hands-on experience with AI tools to improve prospecting, research, reporting, productivity and day-to-day execution is mandatory.
Strong ownership, customer focus and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed:
Proven ability in cold calling, lead generation & lead qualification
Strong B2B/Enterprise sales orientation
Excellent stakeholder management & coordination
Customer-centric approach with strong problem-solving skills
Good analytical and reporting skills
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
Strong ownership, follow-through and execution mindset
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM tools

Location:
Noida | Mumbai | Bengaluru
Why Join Us:
At Paytm Payments Services, you'll work on one of India's largest digital payment platforms, solving complex business challenges for leading enterprises. You'll collaborate with high-performing teams, gain exposure to cutting-edge payment technologies, and play a key role in enabling India's digital commerce ecosystem.
Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With 500M+ registered users and 21M+ merchants, Paytm offers immense opportunities to build, innovate, and grow while contributing to India's largest digital payments ecosystem
AboutCompany: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Description:
Role: Area Sales Manager
Experience - Field Sales Experience is mandatory

About the Company:

NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. We operate in six major cities: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai. About the Role: As an Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will play a crucial role in bridging demand and supply in the real estate market. You will guide, consult, and support potential homebuyers throughout their purchase journey, helping them find the right property while maximizing sales for NoBroker.

Key Responsibilities:
Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.
Attend qualified leads through virtual or in-person meetings, present tailored property options, and encourage on-site visits.
Negotiate deals between clients, ensuring a win-win agreement.
Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and generating referral business.
Cross-sell additional NoBroker services to offer a complete home-buying experience.
Nurture leads to build a strong sales pipeline and meet daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand. Requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).

Key Competencies:
Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach

Description:
Capgemini is hiring for Agentic AI Developer role

Locations: Mumbai/ Pune/Chennai/Hyderabad/Noida/Gurugram
Work mode: Hybrid
Experience range: 2 years to 6 years
Job Description
We are looking for a Agentic AI Developer with 2+ years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and deploying intelligent, autonomous AI agents that can plan, reason, and act toward achieving complex goals. This role blends expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and orchestration frameworks to build systems that go beyond static responses enabling dynamic, goal-driven behaviour.
Key responsibilities
Build autonomous agents using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and CrewAI that can plan, reason, and execute tasks iteratively.
Integrate and fine-tune LLMs (e.g., GPT, Claude, LLaMA) for use in agent workflows, including prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Develop systems where multiple agents collaborate, delegate tasks, and adapt strategies based on real-time feedback.
Enable agents to interact with external systems (e.g., APIs, databases, web apps) to perform actions autonomously.
Use tools like LangSmith, Grafana, and Splunk to monitor agent behavior, performance, and reliability.
Work closely with data scientists, architects, and product teams to align agentic solutions with business goals.
Ensure all solutions are well-documented and comply with data privacy and security standards.
Technical Skills
Languages: Python (mandatory), JavaScript, C# (optional)
Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Hugging Face Transformers
LLMs: GPT-4, GPT- 4o, Claude, LLaMA, Mistral, Gemini
Vector Databases: FAISS, Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate
Cloud Platforms: Azure (OpenAI, ML Studio), AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker), GCP (Vertex AI)
DevOps & CI/CD: Git, Azure DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes
Monitoring Tools: LangSmith, Grafana, Splunk
Other Tools: Streamlit, FastAPI, Flask for UI/API development
Qualifications
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field
213 years of experience in AI/ML development, with at least 12 years in Gen AI or Agentic AI
Strong understanding of autonomous systems, planning algorithms, and multi-agent coordination
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills

Description:
Job Summary
The Role: Lead Software Engineer (Data Engineer)
The Team: We are looking for a junior Data Engineer to join our offshore team in India. This role is focused on supporting data onboarding, pipeline support, and basic platform activities. You will work under the guidance of senior team members to assist with routine tasks related to data pipelines, integrations, and cloud-native data platform operations. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role suitable for someone starting their career in data engineering or looking to develop core skills in a modern data platform environment leveraging AWS.


Responsibilities

Data Onboarding & Support
Assist in onboarding new data assets to the enterprise platform following established procedures.
Support existing data pipelines by monitoring, troubleshooting, and performing routine maintenance.
Help ensure data quality and consistency during onboarding and ongoing operations.
Follow documented processes and checklists to support data ingestion and transformation tasks.
Support data storage and processing using Amazon S3 as the core cloud storage layer, ensuring data is organized, secure, and accessible.
Support metadata management and data cataloging using AWS Glue Data Catalog to facilitate discoverability and governance.
Assist in implementing data validation, quality checks, and lineage documentation.
Write and maintain Python scripts and Big data processing engines transformations for data ingestion, processing, and automation tasks.


Platform & Pipeline Maintenance
Support the team in maintaining data pipelines, fixing issues, and implementing small enhancements.
Assist with data validation, metadata tagging, and basic lineage documentation.
Help monitor pipeline health and escalate issues as needed.
Support operational activities such as deployment, testing, and routine monitoring.
Contribute to automation of deployment and operational workflows using AWS CloudFormation, or similar tools.


Collaboration & Documentation
Work with senior engineers to understand platform standards and best practices.
Document onboarding steps, pipeline configurations, and operational procedures.
Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders about progress and issues.


Operational Support
Participate in production incident response and troubleshooting.
Support routine deployment, testing, and monitoring activities.
Contribute to team knowledge sharing and documentation efforts.


Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience in data engineering, data support, or related roles.
Basic knowledge of SQL, Python, and Big data processing engines.
Hands-on experience with programming in Python or similar languages for data processing and automation.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Databricks or similar.
Understanding of data onboarding, data quality, metadata, and lineage concepts.
Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue Data Catalog, AWS IAM, and AWS CloudWatch.
Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.


Preferred Qualifications
Exposure to data pipelines, data onboarding, or data migration projects.
Knowledge of Delta Lake, Iceberg, or similar storage formats.
Basic understanding of data governance and security principles.
Any relevant certifications or training in data engineering or AWS.

Location - Mumbai,Noida,Hyderabad,Chennai

We provide a broad suite of capabilities designed to help track performance, generate alpha, and identify new trading and investment ideas, and perform risk analysis and mitigation strategies. Through leading desktop solutions such as the S&P Capital IQ, Global Credit Portal and MarketScope Advisor desktops; enterprise solutions such as S&P Capital IQ Valuations, and Compustat; and research offerings, including Leveraged Commentary & Data, Global Markets Intelligence, and company and funds research, S&P Capital IQ sharpens financial intelligence into the wisdom today's investors need.

Description:
The SR DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER will be a key member of the Campaign Analytics team, responsible for transforming marketing intelligence through AI, automation, advanced analytics, and performance insights. This role will drive data-driven decision-making by proactively monitoring business performance, identifying trends, uncovering risks and opportunities, and delivering actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, hands-on experience in AI-enabled analytics, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Acting as a performance intelligence hub for Marketing, this role will help leadership make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.
Experience: 812 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Shift: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
The Main Responsibilities
AI & Analytics Transformation
Drive the adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance the speed, scale, and quality of marketing insights.
Design and deploy AI-powered solutions, intelligent agents, and automated workflows to streamline analysis, reporting, and opportunity identification.
Identify and automate recurring analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Partner with Marketing Operations and Technology teams to enhance analytical capabilities and optimize workflows.
Establish best practices and governance for AI-assisted analytics and insight generation.
Strategic Business Insights
Analyze end-to-end marketing and revenue performance across campaigns, funnels, pipeline creation, sales, and revenue outcomes.
Conduct in-depth analysis to identify trends, growth opportunities, performance challenges, and key business drivers.
Perform root-cause analysis to explain performance fluctuations and support strategic decision-making.
Develop forecasting models, scenario planning frameworks, and business performance analyses to guide investment and planning decisions.
Deliver data-backed recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and overall business performance.
Performance Intelligence & Forecasting
Continuously monitor key marketing KPIs, including lead generation, MQL volume, conversion rates, funnel health, pipeline creation, campaign performance, and revenue attainment.
Provide proactive visibility into performance against goals, forecasts, and business targets.
Develop pacing, forecasting, and scenario models to identify potential performance gaps and enable early intervention.
Track week-over-week performance trends and communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Automated Monitoring & Anomaly Detection
Build and maintain automated monitoring systems and alerting frameworks to identify significant changes in marketing performance metrics.
Detect emerging risks, unusual activity, and performance anomalies across campaigns, channels, website traffic, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and spend effectiveness.
Assess business impact and distinguish between genuine performance issues, growth opportunities, and measurement discrepancies.
Lead diagnostic and root-cause investigations to identify the primary factors influencing performance outcomes.
Optimization & Executive Decision Support
Translate analytical findings into prioritized recommendations that drive measurable business impact.
Identify opportunities to optimize campaign investments, resource allocation, channel strategies, and marketing execution.
Proactively surface risks that may impact target achievement and highlight emerging opportunities for growth.
Provide executive-ready performance insights, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to support leadership decision-making.
What We Look For in a Candidate
8–12 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Analytics, Campaign Performance, or related analytical functions.
Strong expertise in data analysis, performance measurement, forecasting, and statistical modeling.
Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation technologies within analytics environments.
Proficiency with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
Advanced SQL and data manipulation skills; experience with Python or other analytical programming tools is highly desirable.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Experience supporting B2B marketing, demand generation, funnel analytics, and revenue performance initiatives is preferred.

Description:
Open Locations - Kolkata/Bangalore/Pune/Noida/Kochi

We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Managed Services Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EYs global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
Key Requirements
As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
Good understanding of US product lines and regulatory standards; hands-on implementation experience (desirable)
Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the asset or liability cashflows
Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
Hands-on experience in actuarial valuation software such as Prophet / Axis / MG Alpha. Advanced level experience in one of these softwares will be valuable
Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
Good experience of preparing PPT decks
In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of one or more geographies
We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
Skills and attributes for success
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus
Ideally, youll also have
Good actuarial exam progress
Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

Description:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Workday Technical - Senior Associate, you will engage with clients to deliver innovative solutions within our Digital Core Modernisation network. This role involves leveraging your skills in Workday Technology to support client needs and drive impactful results. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and developing a deeper understanding of the business context. You will guide and mentor others, navigate complex situations, and grow your personal brand while enhancing your technical skills.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will work within our Workforce Technology - Workday HCM practice, where you will analyze complex problems and develop deliverables within client service engagements. You will have the opportunity to use a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. This position offers a chance to deepen your understanding of business contexts and how they are evolving, while also maintaining professional and technical standards.
Responsibilities
- Implementing Workday HCM solutions to support client workforce transformation initiatives
- Collaborating with teams to optimize Workday integration processes and enhance system functionality
- Utilizing Workday Prism Analytics for data analysis and reporting to drive business insights
- Leading Workday projects and managing deliverables to align with strategic technology planning
- Developing Workday Extend applications to automate and streamline business processes
- Engaging in process improvement and optimization to enhance client service delivery
- Applying analytical thinking to solve complex problems and support business transformation efforts
- Embracing change and fostering AI-human collaboration to innovate digital tooling solutions
- Guiding teams in Workday Studio for efficient design automation and reporting tasks
- Building relationships with clients to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions

Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Noida, kolkata and Pune

Description:

Experience: 4 to 12 Years
Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli

Install, configure, administer, and monitor SAP systems across landscapes.
Perform SAP system upgrades, migrations, refreshes, and patching activities.
Manage SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, and HANA database environments.
Execute client copies, system copies, kernel upgrades, and transport management activities.
Monitor system performance and optimize SAP application and database performance.
Perform user administration, role assignments, security, and authorization support.
Handle SAP Backup, Recovery, Disaster Recovery, and High Availability configurations.
Support incident management, problem resolution, and root cause analysis.
Collaborate with functional, development, infrastructure, and cloud teams.
Support implementation, upgrade, migration, and maintenance projects.
Ensure system availability, reliability, and compliance with organizational standards.
Mandatory Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP BASIS Administration.
Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA landscapes
Experience in Kernal Upgrade and Solution Management.
Strong knowledge of:
SAP HANA Database Administration
SAP NetWeaver Administration
Transport Management System (TMS)
SAP System Monitoring
Performance Tuning
Client Copy/System Copy
Kernel Upgrades and Patch Management
Experience in SAP installation, upgrade, and migration activities.
Knowledge of SAP security, users, roles, and authorizations.
Experience in troubleshooting SAP system performance issues.
Understanding of Backup, Recovery, High Availability, and Disaster Recovery concepts.
Experience in Linux/Unix operating systems.
Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Skills
SAP S/4HANA Conversion or Migration projects.
Exposure to SAP Solution Manager.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
HANA database migration and administration experience.

Description:
The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, hands-on experience in AI-enabled analytics, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights. Acting as a performance intelligence hub for Marketing, this role will help leadership make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.
Experience: 8–12 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Shift: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
Role- Individual Contributor
The Main Responsibilities
AI & Analytics Transformation
Drive the adoption of AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance the speed, scale, and quality of marketing insights.
Design and deploy AI-powered solutions, intelligent agents, and automated workflows to streamline analysis, reporting, and opportunity identification.
Identify and automate recurring analytical processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
Partner with Marketing Operations and Technology teams to enhance analytical capabilities and optimize workflows.
Establish best practices and governance for AI-assisted analytics and insight generation.
Strategic Business Insights
Analyze end-to-end marketing and revenue performance across campaigns, funnels, pipeline creation, sales, and revenue outcomes.
Conduct in-depth analysis to identify trends, growth opportunities, performance challenges, and key business drivers.
Perform root-cause analysis to explain performance fluctuations and support strategic decision-making.
Develop forecasting models, scenario planning frameworks, and business performance analyses to guide investment and planning decisions.
Deliver data-backed recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and overall business performance.
Performance Intelligence & Forecasting
Continuously monitor key marketing KPIs, including lead generation, MQL volume, conversion rates, funnel health, pipeline creation, campaign performance, and revenue attainment.
Provide proactive visibility into performance against goals, forecasts, and business targets.
Develop pacing, forecasting, and scenario models to identify potential performance gaps and enable early intervention.
Track week-over-week performance trends and communicate key business insights to stakeholders.
Automated Monitoring & Anomaly Detection
Build and maintain automated monitoring systems and alerting frameworks to identify significant changes in marketing performance metrics.
Detect emerging risks, unusual activity, and performance anomalies across campaigns, channels, website traffic, conversion rates, pipeline creation, and spend effectiveness.
Assess business impact and distinguish between genuine performance issues, growth opportunities, and measurement discrepancies.
Lead diagnostic and root-cause investigations to identify the primary factors influencing performance outcomes.
Optimization & Executive Decision Support
Translate analytical findings into prioritized recommendations that drive measurable business impact.
Identify opportunities to optimize campaign investments, resource allocation, channel strategies, and marketing execution.
Proactively surface risks that may impact target achievement and highlight emerging opportunities for growth.
Provide executive-ready performance insights, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to support leadership decision-making.
What We Look For in a Candidate
8–12 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Revenue Analytics, Campaign Performance, or related analytical functions.
Strong expertise in data analysis, performance measurement, forecasting, and statistical modeling.
Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation technologies within analytics environments.
Proficiency with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
Advanced SQL and data manipulation skills; experience with Python or other analytical programming tools is highly desirable.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Experience supporting B2B marketing, demand generation, funnel analytics, and revenue performance initiatives is preferred.

Reporting to: Commercial Manager/ Store Manager
Qualification: Essential; Preferred
Qualifications

Key Deliverables
As a Customer Service Associate at Marks and Spencer, your main role is to assist customers, maintain store standards, and learn the basics of store operations.
  Your key responsibilities include:
Greet & Assist Customers: Welcome customers with a friendly attitude and help them find what they need.
Understand Customer Needs: Listen to customers, understand their preferences, and recommend suitable products.
Support Visual Merchandising: Help maintain the store's appearance by following guidelines for product displays.
Proper Product Handling: Ensure products are handled carefully and organized correctly on the shelves.
Learn Store Procedures: Follow company guidelines for tasks like stocking, housekeeping, and cashiering.

Description:
Position - Intern - SEO
The person will work closely with the senior SEO team to implement and manage search engine optimization strategies that will increase our website's visibility and ranking.

Key Responsibilities
Conduct in-depth keyword research and analysis to identify opportunities for optimization.
Optimize website content, including meta descriptions, headers, and tags, in accordance with SEO best practices.
Perform regular technical SEO audits and collaborate with the development team to resolve issues.
Oversee link-building strategies and outreach campaigns to enhance website authority.
Monitor and analyze website performance using SEO tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs.
Stay updated with the latest SEO trends, algorithm updates, and industry best practices.
Prepare and present SEO performance reports, providing actionable insights and recommendations.
Knowledge of tools like Canva, Fotor, Adobe Photoshop, etc., to create images and graphics for website and Knowledge of ChatGpt etc.

Qualifications and Skills:
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Information Technology, or a related field.

Required Skills
Strong understanding of Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, and Off-Page SEO.

Proficiency in:
Google Analytics (GA4)
Google Search Console
Ahrefs
SEMrush
Screaming Frog
Google Keyword Planner

Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SEO implications.
Understanding of Core Web Vitals and Page Experience.
Experience with schema markup and structured data implementation. Familiarity with CMS platforms such as WordPress, Magento, or custom CMS.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

Interested Candidates can share their resume at sharma.divya@tradeindia.com
AboutCompany:
We are one of India's largest and oldest B2B e-commerce platforms that
connects buyers and suppliers to create a customer-driven value chain for
all businesses, including SMEs, large enterprises and individuals.
We integrate businesses into global value chains by bringing them together
from across the world, on a single platform to interact and conduct the
business smoothly, securely and effectively.

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Technical Publications - Senior Engineer
Thales India Engineering Competency Center (ECC) in Bangalore is seeking a Senior Engineer - Technical Publications. In interface with Aviation Global Services (AGS) TechPubs organization and under the Senior Lead Engineer, your team will perform ATA compliant Technical Publications on Aerospace Products and Systems in compliance with company policies/procedure, assuring airworthiness / regulatory requirements.
Qualifications: B.Tech in Electronics / Mechanical / Instrumentation engineering or equivalent with 5+ years of relevant experience. Higher qualifications of Post-graduation is desirable. Technical writer experience in Aerospace industry, producing common Industry Standard Technical Data, producing structured electronic manuals.
Responsibilities:
Produce aerospace System and Product documentations in compliance with standards and specific business rules.
Develop and release Technical documents in accordance with the company policies/procedures, assuring airworthiness / regulatory requirements are met.
Ensure technical documentation meeting established quality, customer standards, budget and schedule.
Under the Senior Lead Engineer, work in a team environment with multiple participants within AGS TechPubs organization and possible multiple countries (India, US, France).
Gather and analyze the released data technical information from different sources.
Apply the engineering authoring rules.
Skills experience:
Must have strong experience within Aerospace industry, Civil Aviation Rules, Aircraft documentation, producing common industry standard technical data, and structured electronic manuals with 8 years to 12 yrs experience
Must be rigorous, organized, autonomous and proactive, and motivated by a position within a multidisciplinary team.
Must have experience of interpreting engineering drawings, software and system level documentation
Must have experience in using and producing documentations at System (AMM, AIPC, MP, IPD, FIM, TSM, AWD etc.) and Product level (CMM, ACMM, CMP etc.).
Must have expertise in the industry standards ATA iSPEC 2200, S1000D, ASD-STE 100
Must have experience of computer skills including the use Microsoft office suite, ERP and Engineering BOM systems
Must have experience of using TechData Editing tools in SGML, XML or other format (ADAM Author, PTC Arbortext, Notepad etc.)
Must have experience of using TechData Managing tools (ADAM Manager or other)

We are seeking a dynamic and motivated individual to join our team as a Premium Retail Sales Executive in Bangalore

Open to experienced professionals

Description:
JD _Cost Controller

Exp: 6+ years
Location: Pan India (Noida)
NP: Join within a month

Mention main point:
Cost control, preferable from EPC domain, energy sector
good to have primavera skills
good knowledge of excel, advance excel
Why we come to work:
In Project Controls, our goal is to ensure the right rigor around schedule and cost management processes to deliver projects on-time and within budget. With focus and rigor around tools, processes, operating rhythm, and people, here you shall have the opportunity to learn, contribute and excel in one of the best Project controls functions in the industry. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, youll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition.
Mission
Responsibilities and Accountabilities
Overall
Support PM to align project budgets to as sold in appropriate systems
Supports estimating, estimates and/or verifies the accuracy of the actual to date cost (material, labor, manufactured costs, suppliers invoices, timesheets, travel expenses.)
Aligns with planning to ensure forecasted cost risks are accurately captured
Maintain a register of potential cost risks
Maintain a register of actual and committed costs
Checks and controls cost movements, compares with current scope and progress as well as with previous forecast. Also Compares with productivity factors and validates accuracy of estimates
Communicates cost status/forecasts/risk to functional cost owners and drives/supports risk mitigation
Presents all financial data in a transparent way, attends project and management review to present cost status
Provides change order calculations to ensure cost estimates are accurate
Updates changes in appropriate systems to ensure costs are aligned to the current situation
Aligns with Finance Controller to ensure reconciliation takes place between approved project financial data and books.
Aligns with planner to ensure costs and schedule are tied to enable accurate cost/schedule management
Support project close out and claims
Provide support to tenders
Ensure quality of the project controlling reporting.
Ensure accuracy of cost budgets, actuals, and forecasting
Ensure collaboration with functional cost owners to find strategies to reduce cost
Ensure alignment to established standards (WBS, process, procedures, tools usage)
Ensure efficiency and effectives of the project cost control team where applicable
Contribute to month/quarter-end closing calendar
Ensure claims management and successful project closeout
Quality & Lean
Comply with Quality Procedures, work instructions and Processes at GSI level and Project Controls Function
Report or resolve any non-conformances and process in a timely manner
Identify areas of opportunity for standardization / optimization and where possible participate in a Kaizen or similar lean event to implement any identified improvements
EHS
Demonstrate commitment to safety through participation in formal and informal discussions
Adhere to all safe working procedures in accordance with instructions
Ensure safety work instructions are complied
Participate in the resolution of safety issues.
Initiate actions to improve health and safety where needed
Performance Measurement
Schedule quality
Cost forecasting quality
Schedule forecast quality
Cost and schedule performance of project
Timeliness of reporting
Qualifications & Experience
Educational Requirements
Degree qualified either in finance or may have engineering degree (with financial training)

Regards,
Priya Aggarwal

Its fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.
About Fractal
Fractal is one of the most prominent providers of Artificial Intelligence to Fortune 500 companies.Fractals vision is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and bring AI, engineering, and design to help the worlds most admired companies.Fractal currently has 4000+ employees across 16 global locations, including the United States, UK, Ukraine, India, Singapore, and Australia.
Fractals businesses include Crux Intelligence (AI driven business intelligence), Eugenie.ai (AI for sustainability), Asper.ai (AI for revenue growth management) and Senseforth.ai (conversational AI for sales and customer service). Fractal incubated Qure.ai, a leading player in healthcare AI for detecting Tuberculosis and Lung cancer.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure Lead Architect to join our consulting practice. In this leadership role, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for leading architecture engagements, defining cloud strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Azure-based solutions for complex enterprise applications.
Define cloud architecture and roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
Assess client s current environment and make architecture recommendations for cloud adoption, migration, and optimization.
Own end-to-end solution architecture and act as a trusted advisor to client leadership.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Data, and Application teams to align cloud solutions with enterprise strategy.
Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.
Required Skills Qualifications
12+ years of experience in IT, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Azure architecture and implementation.
Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.
Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS or GCP is a plus.
Why Join Us
Opportunity to work with top-tier clients across industries.
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud projects and digital transformation programs.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Learning and development opportunities with access to cloud certifications and trainings.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
We are looking for an Industrial Data AI Engineer to develop and industrialize Data Engineering, AI/ML, Data Science and Computer Vision solutions for global manufacturing operations. The role will transform shop-floor and manufacturing data into scalable solutions for predictive maintenance, quality, process optimization, yield, productivity and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities:
Build scalable data pipelines, ETL processes, data models and industrial data-lake solutions.
Perform data analysis, feature engineering, ML model development, validation and optimization.
Develop AI/ML solutions for predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, quality prediction, process optimization and forecasting.
Develop Computer Vision solutions for industrial inspection and defect detection.
Industrialize POCs into production-grade AI/ML applications using MLOps/DataOps, CI/CD, model monitoring and versioning.
Deploy solutions across cloud, on-premise and industrial edge environments and integrate shop-floor/OT data with enterprise platforms.
Develop dashboards and analytics supporting manufacturing KPIs such as OEE, FPY, Yield, Cycle Time and Downtime.
Collaborate with Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, IT/Data and global production teams.

Key Tools Technical Skills:
Data/Analytics: Dataiku, Python, SQL, BigQuery, Looker/Data Studio
Data Engineering: Python libraries, Apache Iceberg, Kafka, Composer
AI/ML: TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenCV, Data Science/ML frameworks
MLOps/DataOps: GitLab, CI/CD, model versioning, monitoring, data/model drift

Qualification:
Bachelor s/Master s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Engineering or related field.
3-8 years in Data Science, AI/ML Engineering or Industrial Analytics.
2+ years delivering production-grade AI/ML solutions.
Manufacturing, Smart Factory, Industrial IoT or Operational Excellence experience preferred.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills; English required, French is a plus.

Description:
Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Senior level)
Description
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a modern way of delivering IT Solutions by imbibing Software engineering principles in Service Delivery to reduce IT Risk to business, improve business resilience, attain predictability & reliability, optimize cost of IT Infra and Ops
A Site Reliability Engineer typically has deep software engineering experience encompassing design, build, deploy and manage / maintain an IT solution ensuring resilience, reliability, and performance.
An SRE is a bridge between development and operations by applying a software engineering mindset to the development, deployment, and maintenance of applications to maximize system reliability & automation, while improving efficiencies by optimizing resources
Responsibilities
Defining SLA/SLO/SLI for a product / service
Engineering in resilient design and implementation practices into solutions as they go through the product life cycle
Engineering out manual effort (Toil) through the development of automated processes and services (e.g., Automated Management of Systems, CI/CD improvements)
Developing Observability Solutions to track, report, and measure SLA adherence
Help Optimize Cost of IT Infra & Operations - FinOps
Critical Situation management
SOP / Runbook automation, Toil reduction
Data Analytics & System trend analysis
Typical Skills and Background
4+ years of experience in software product engineering principles, processes and systems
Hands-on experience in Java / J2EE, one of web server (Apache Tomcat or IBM HTTP Server), one of the application servers (Tomcat/WebSphere), and any major RDBMS like Oracle
Hands-on experience in at least one CI-CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) and IaC tools (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible etc.)
Experience in at least one cloud technology (AWS/Azure/GCP etc. and Docker, Pivotal, Kubernetes, OpenShift etc.) and its reliability tools (Azure AppInsight, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor etc.)
Experience in Linux (RHEL) operating system performance monitoring parameters and their interpretation, commands used for monitoring
Experience in Observability - APM tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics etc.), metrics / log consolidation (Splunk) and ELK Stack
Defining NFRs and SLA/SLO/SLI agreement for a product / platform / services
Knowledge on queuing models used, thread pools, request servicing processes etc.
Knowledge in Web Services, SOA, ESB (DataPower), RESTFul
Knowledge of application design patterns, J2EE application architectures, Microservices, Spring boot & Cloud native architectures
Proficiency in Java runtimes, Core Java, Garbage collection, JVM parameters tuning
Experience in performance tuning on Application Servers (Tomcat/WAS)
Experience in trouble shooting Performance / Scalability / Availability issues
Experience in Thread dump, heap dump generation & analysis
Knowledge on Query tuning and database designs & models
Knowledge at least one automation scripting language like Python
Mastery in collaborative software development using Git, Jira, Confluence etc.
AI/ML & Data Analytics knowledge and experience is a desirable

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a passionate and skilled Information Security Consultant with hands-on experience in
ISO 27001:2022 implementation and information security audits, particularly in the banking and
finance domain. The ideal candidate will possess strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and
demonstrate the ability to manage end-to-end compliance projects.
Key Experience & Skills Required:
Proven experience in the implementation of ISO 27001:2022 for clients, including gap
assessments, risk treatment plans, and ISMS documentation.
Hands-on experience in conducting risk assessments and information security audits onsite
at client location (internal and external).
Experience in comprehensive IS audits specifically within the Banking, Financial Services and
Insurance(BFSI) sector.
Strong background in developing, reviewing, and maintaining information security policies,
procedures, and SOPs.
Familiarity with industry-recognized cybersecurity standards and frameworks such as:
NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF)
ISO 27001: 2022 standard
RBI CSF, ITGRC, Outsourcing services master directions
IRDAI Cyber Security Guidelines
SEBI CSCRF
UIDAI Guidelines
SOC 1 / SOC 2 Type 1/ Type 2
Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Rules
Other relevant circulars, guidelines, and regulatory frameworks.
Excellent communication, documentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to clearly
convey technical information to stakeholders at all levels.• Ability to manage multiple assignments independently while maintaining quality and
timelines.
Ability to prepare detailed Audit checklists and reports as per the scope mentioned for the
project.
Mandatory Certification:
ISO 27001 Lead Auditor certification (IRCA CQI Certified) and CISA certification (ISACA).
Key Responsibilities:
Lead and manage end-to-end implementation of ISO 27001:2022, including scoping, risk
assessments, and creation of ISMS documentation.
Perform risk identification, assessment, and treatment in accordance with ISO 27001 and
organizational context.
Plan and conduct internal audits, external audit, and deliver IT security awareness and
training sessions onsite at client location.
Should have conduct audit based on Banking, Insurance, Aadhaar, SEBI Guidelines onsite at
client location.
Develop and maintain audit checklists, detailed audit reports, and corrective action plans.
Design, review, and update information security policies, procedures, and process-related
documentation in line with applicable standards and business requirements.
Support ongoing maintenance and continuous improvement of the Information Security
Management System (ISMS).
Coordinate with stakeholders and clients to ensure timely and effective execution of audit
and compliance tasks

Description:
Position - Sales Manager / Senior Sales Manager Government & Defence (DMR Solutions)

Company: Arya Communication (JM BAXI GROUP)

Locations: Mumbai / Bangalore / Noida

Experience: 10 to 25 years

Qualification - Any Engineering Degree
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
Arya Communication is looking for sales professionals with an established network across Paramilitary forces, Defence, Railways and other government sectors to drive business for our Digital Mobile Radio (DMR) and programmable radio solutions. The role involves identifying opportunities, building relationships with key decision-makers, managing tenders, and closing large-value orders. Candidates should combine strong government sales experience with a solid understanding of radio communication technology.

Key Responsibilities
Generate new business and grow revenue from Paramilitary forces (CRPF, BSF, CISF, ITBP, SSB, Assam Rifles), the Armed Forces, Railways, State Police and other government bodies.
Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including signals and communication officers, procurement and finance teams, and technical evaluation committees.
Track, analyse and respond to government tenders on GeM, CPPP and other procurement portals, and coordinate bid preparation, pre-bid queries and technical/commercial submissions.
Understand customer requirements and propose suitable DMR, analog/digital and programmable radio solutions, including handhelds, mobile radios, repeaters, dispatch systems and network setups.
Coordinate product demonstrations, field trials and technical presentations with the engineering team.
Manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation and requirement shaping through negotiation, order closure, delivery coordination and payment follow-up.
Develop and manage channel partners, system integrators and dealers in the assigned territory.
Track competitor activity, pricing and market trends, and feed insights back to product and management teams.
Maintain sales pipeline, forecasts and reports, and achieve assigned revenue targets.

Required Qualifications

Graduate in Engineering (Electronics / Telecommunication preferred) or any graduate with relevant experience. An MBA is an advantage.
Proven experience selling communication, electronics or security solutions to Paramilitary, Defence, Railways or other government sectors.
An established network with procurement and user departments in at least one of these sectors.
Working knowledge of Digital Mobile Radio (DMR) technology, two-way radio systems and radio programming/configuration.
Hands-on experience with government procurement processes, including GeM, CPPP, EMD/PBG and L1/QCBS evaluation.
Strong negotiation, presentation and relationship management skills.
Willingness to travel extensively within the region.
Preferred Background
Experience with radio OEMs or system integrators ..
Familiarity with TETRA, P25, LTE/MCX or railway communication systems (such as train radio and Kavach-related communication).
Ex-Armed Forces or Signals Corps background is an advantage
AboutCompany:
Arya Communications & Electronics Services Pvt. Ltd. (Aryacom) is a prominent technology-driven Indian enterprise established in 1988. Headquartered in Sion East, Mumbai,

it functions as a highly specialized systems integrator and distributor of mission-critical communication, electronic security, and specialized technology networks.

Aryacom operates as an integral technology arm of the century-old J M BAXI GROUP, one of India's premier shipping, maritime infrastructure, and logistics conglomerates
