Description:
Axis Max Life Insurance is seeking a motivated and dynamic Associate Sales Manager for our Branch Banking division. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth by managing a team of sales executives, building strong relationships with clients, and ensuring exceptional customer service. The role includes identifying new business opportunities, promoting insurance products, and achieving sales targets while maintaining compliance with company policies and industry regulations.

- Develop and implement effective sales strategies to expand the customer base.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to analyze financial data and market trends.
- Familiarity with insurance products and services.
- Proficient in using CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Strong problem-solving abilities and decision-making skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications:
- A Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
- Previous experience in sales, preferably in the insurance or financial services industry.
- Relevant certifications in insurance sales would be an added advantage.

Join Axis Max Life Insurance and be a part of a dynamic team that values excellence, innovation, and professional growth.

Description:
1. Preparation and review of the manufacturing and packaging Technical Direction.

3. Line Clearance during all critical process during Dispensing, Manufacturing, Filling & Stoppering and Packing operation.

15. Preparation of PQR data for the product manufactured in year on rolling basis.
16. Collection and evaluation of Batch process parameters(CPP), Quality attributes from batch record and analytical record.
17. To review the Non Viable trends of Production Area.
18. To Perform any other works as and when assigned by HOD.

Description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You will be responsible for coordinating and enabling the Site Asset & Technology Leader in driving asset reliability, maintenance, infrastructure and facilities performance to support the delivery of site SQCDSM targets.

The role will focus on ensuring reliable plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure and facilities, while driving effective MRO management, maintenance planning, budget utilization, inventory management and productivity initiatives. You will also ensure uninterrupted site operations through compliance with local legal regulations, Quality, Health, Safety & Environment standards and Mondel z manufacturing requirements.

How You Will Contribute
You will:
Asset, Maintenance & Infrastructure Management
Coordinate the execution of preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance activities for plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure, buildings and facilities.
Drive maintenance of site infrastructure and facilities, ensuring timely execution of preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective actions.
Support asset reliability and loss prevention initiatives to minimize breakdowns, downtime and equipment-related losses.
Implement and sustain IL6S/TPM ways of working, including Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, Condition-Based Monitoring (CBM), lubrication management, calibration, visual controls and loss elimination.
Partner with the PM and operations teams to identify maintenance requirements, validate priorities and ensure timely closure of actions.
MRO & Inventory Management
Manage and track MRO requirements, consumption, availability and inventory, ensuring the right materials are available to support maintenance activities.
Review and validate MRO requirements raised by maintenance/PM teams based on business need, equipment criticality and inventory availability.
Participate in DMS (Daily Management System) routines and translate identified maintenance requirements into appropriate procurement actions.
Coordinate the PR/PO process for MRO requirements, including requirement validation, purchase order creation and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.
Monitor MRO spend, consumption and inventory levels to improve cost effectiveness and avoid excess/obsolete inventory.
Coordinate with suppliers/OEMs and service providers to ensure timely delivery of materials and services in line with agreed SLAs.
Budget & Cost Management
Support annual maintenance, MRO, infrastructure and facilities budget planning, including allocation and tracking of spend across various requirements.
Monitor OPEX/M&R and maintenance-related expenditure against budget and identify potential deviations and corrective actions.
Support prioritization of maintenance and infrastructure requirements based on business impact, asset criticality and available budget.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and productivity improvement through effective MRO management, maintenance practices and supplier management.
Productivity & Continuous Improvement
Drive and support MRO productivity projects and cost-saving initiatives focused on reducing maintenance losses, improving asset reliability and optimizing MRO spend.
Identify opportunities for loss elimination and improve maintenance effectiveness through data-driven analysis and structured problem solving.
Apply PDCA, TPM/IL6S and other continuous improvement methodologies to address recurring equipment and maintenance issues.
Capability Building & Stakeholder Management
Coach and support operating and maintenance teams on routine maintenance, equipment care, breakdown prevention and CIL (Cleaning, Inspection & Lubrication) practices.
Support development of technical capability within operating teams and work process owners.
Interface with internal stakeholders including Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, Quality, HSE and Supply Chain, as well as external service providers and OEMs.
Ensure adherence to manufacturing standards, governance, compliance requirements and applicable legal regulations.
What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career, along with the following experience and knowledge:
Experience in plant maintenance, asset management, engineering, facilities, infrastructure or MRO management, preferably within a manufacturing/FMCG environment.
Good understanding of preventive and predictive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, asset reliability and maintenance planning.
Knowledge of MRO management, inventory management, procurement processes and supplier/OEM coordination.
Experience in budget planning, cost tracking and OPEX/M&R management.
Understanding of TPM/IL6S, Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, CBM, loss elimination and PDCA-based problem solving.
Ability to evaluate and validate maintenance/MRO requirements and coordinate the DMS requirement validation PR/PO execution cycle.
Experience in driving or supporting productivity, cost-saving or continuous improvement projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and track performance.
Computer proficiency, including MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint, with experience in ERP systems such as SAP or similar platforms.
Strong communication, collaboration, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Ability to coordinate multiple priorities across maintenance, MRO, infrastructure, facilities, inventory and budget management.
Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research & Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.
Mondel z International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Description:
Job Description -
Job Title- Area Sales Head- Havells Cable
Level- Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager
Location- Himachal Pradesh (Kangra, Mandi, Baddi & Shimla)
Reporting To Product head
Supervising-Individual Contributor
Job responsibilities

Identifying and exploring new prospective Customers & Channel Partners and to bring them into our fold & extract business from them
Maintain a high level of exposure for the company through direct sales
Meeting sales targets
Negotiating Rates/packages with corporate clients & Closing deals
Increase market/customer share in all revenue streams
External stakeholders-Primarily B2B Industry & EPC contractor
policies, procedures, and ethical standards in all sales activities.
Candidates profile -
Education

Preferred MBA B.tech /B.E or any post Graduate with 60 %
Experience

5-8 Years
Salary

Best In Industry
Personal Attributes

Excellent communication and people skills
Learning agility
Customer centricity
Strong influencing and stake holder management skills
Aptitude in problem-solving
Desire to work as a team with a result driven approach
Age

Maximum 35 Years
Brief Overview:
Havells India Limited, a Great Place to Work-Certified Organization with an overall FY 2022-23 net revenue of INR 17,500 Crore is a Fast Moving Electrical Goods (FMEG) company headquartered in Noida in existence since 1958.
The company has products ranging from home and kitchen appliances which includes water heaters, air coolers, water purifiers, fans, personal grooming, lighting for domestic, commercial and industrial applications, modular switches and wiring accessories, industries and domestic circuit protection switchgear, industrial and domestic cables and wires, induction motors and capacitors and consumer durable products like AC, washing machine, LED TV and Refrigerators. We own brands like Havells, Lloyd, Crabtree, Standard and Promptec.
We have philosophy of Make in India, extensive distribution network and world class quality. We have 40 branches/representative offices with over 6,000 professionals and 12 manufacturing plants located at Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana and Ghiloth.
For more details, visit www.havells.com

Description:
Senior Business Development Executive ( Outdoor Advertising)
Company: Star Publicity
Job Locations: Shimla
Openings: 2
Job Type: Remote
Salary: 20,000 - 40,000/month + Incentives

About the Role Star Publicity is looking for experienced Senior Business Development Executives with a strong background in Outdoor Advertising / OOH / Media Sales. The role involves independently generating leads, meeting clients, pitching outdoor advertising solutions, and closing business in the assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities
Generate leads through field visits, networking, references, and outbound calling.
Meet potential clients and decision-makers in person.
Pitch Hoardings, Unipoles, LED Displays, Bus Advertising, Billboards, and other OOH solutions.
Manage follow-ups, negotiations, and deal closures.
Develop and maintain strong client relationships.
Achieve assigned sales and revenue targets.



Requirements
1-4 years of experience in Outdoor Advertising, OOH, Media, or Advertising Sales.
Strong B2B field sales and client acquisition experience.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and convincing skills.
Strong local market knowledge and client/networking base preferred.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.
Proven ability to independently generate and close business.



Priority: Candidates from Outdoor Advertising / OOH / Media Sales backgrounds will be preferred. Benefits
Competitive salary based on experience
Attractive performance-based incentives
Petrol/Travel allowance
Food & travel support for eligible outstation work
Growth opportunities



Apply Now career@starpublicity.co.in 9875908611

Description:
We are hiring for Assistant Manager -Banking, Revenue & Reconciliation with Dmart Ready.

Location: Powai (Work from Office)

Avenue E-commerce Limited (AEL) is an online extension of Avenue Supermarts Limited flagship brand. Dmart Ready is the mobile application through which our customers order grocery and other utility products. We seek to be a one - stop shopping destination for the entire family, meeting all their daily household needs offering value for money. A wide selection of home utility products is offered at an affordable price, including groceries, foods, toiletries, beauty products, garment, kitchenware, bed and bath linen, home appliances and much more. Currently we are present at Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad and Bangalore locations.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Banking & Payment Gateway Management
Coordinate with banks, Payment Gateway (PG) partners, acquiring banks, and payment service providers for day-to-day operations.
Monitor payment transactions across different channels including cards, UPI, net banking, other digital payment modes.
Follow up with banks/PGs on failed, pending, disputed, or delayed transactions.
Coordinate for refunds, chargebacks, reversals, and other payment-related matters.

2. Revenue & Collection Management
Monitor daily revenue collections across retail stores and digital/payment channels.
Track collections against sales/revenue and identify short collections, pending collections, or discrepancies.
Monitor daily bank credits and ensure collections are received as per agreed settlement timelines.
Prepare and maintain collection trackers and ageing reports.

3. Bank & Payment Gateway Reconciliation
Perform/coordinate daily reconciliation of sales, payment gateway transactions, bank settlements, and accounting records.
Identify and investigate reconciliation differences and unmatched transactions.
Coordinate with Operations, Banks, and PG partners for timely resolution.
Maintain ageing of unreconciled transactions and ensure timely closure.
Support month-end and year-end reconciliation activities.

4. MIS & Reporting
Prepare and circulate regular MIS
Highlight major exceptions and ageing items to management.
Provide data and analysis for business and finance reviews.

Description:
Job Description
Job Title: Senior Regional Manager
Location: Delhi
Department: Strategic Alliances
Function: Catholic Syrian Bank
Reporting to: NRM & VP - CSB
Band: 4B


Job Summary
Senior Regional Manager is a senior leadership role managing the Strategic partnership with banks within the designated region and responsible for overseeing the sales, operations, and performance. This position involves managing a team of sales agents, cluster managers, and support staff, ensuring the achievement of sales targets, operational efficiency, and high levels of customer satisfaction. The Senior Regional Manager will be responsible for driving growth, expanding market share, and maintaining strong relationships with clients, partners, and stakeholders within the region.
Additionally, the candidate will suggest product synergies and identify various customer touch-points within Yes Bank for insurance sales opportunities. They will provide accurate and timely updates on competitors and best practices.


Key Responsibilities
Will be responsible for the Bancassurance partnership.
Create and maintain engagement with regional Managers / Branch Managers and other key Bank s Head Office / Management Team members
Lead a team of Sales Executives (Relationship Associates and Associate Sales Managers and Centre Managers) and monitor their input/output activity and ensure lead generation through various sources.
Increasing insurance awareness and product penetration among Bank s customers.
Increasing insurance penetration among Bank staff members
Sugges t sizzlers and R&R platforms for Bank s employees who provide prospect leads as well as for Axis Max Life s dedicated sales team.
Suggest product synergies and capture Bank s various customer touch-points for insurance sales opportunities. Provide accurate and timely competitor updates/best practices


Key Skills
Relationship Management
Leading People
Process Adherence


Measures of Success
Business Plan: Adjusted MFYP (Rs.) - Plan v/s Actual
Activation Plan: Seller Activation (%) - Plan Vs Actual
Collections: 15th month Persistency (%) - >75%
Sales process Adherence: 1. Implementation of CRM 2. Governance Rhythm 3. Business Leakage & complaints
Effective Management of People: 1. Talent Retention - 70% 2. G2V2 retention - >90%. 3. Engagement Score - 85%
Customer centricity and satisfaction: Effective Management of Customer as per Plan
Key Relationships (Internal /External): 1. Distribution leadeHR Team 3. Training Team 4. Planning & Analytics Team 5. CSB Bank Management & Sales Team


Desired qualification and experience
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills - English & Zonal language (preferred)
Age group: 35-45 years
Preferably has own conveyance
Must have 10-12 years of overall exp. in sales with a minimum of 6 to 8 years combined work experience in the fields of Life insurance sales management, Retail bank distribution, and Channel Management and/or DSA relationship

Description:
Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance


As an Associate Agency Development Manager at Axis Max Life Insurance, you will play a crucial role in driving business growth through the recruitment, training, and development of a team of agents. You will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with your team members and helping them achieve their sales targets. Your efforts will directly contribute to the company s goals of expanding market reach and increasing revenue.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit and onboard new agents as part of the agency team.
- Conduct regular training sessions to enhance the knowledge and skills of agents on products, selling techniques, and market trends.
- Monitor the performance of agents and provide ongoing coaching and support to help them achieve their individual sales targets.
- Develop and implement strategies to motivate and inspire agents, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture.
- Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders within the company to facilitate growth opportunities.

Skills Required:
- Strong leadership and management abilities to guide a diverse team of agents.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective relationship building.
- Proactive approach to problem-solving and decision-making.
- Ability to analyze performance metrics and use insights to drive improvements.
- Strong sales mindset with a results-oriented focus.

Tools Required:
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Familiarity with CRM software to track sales activities and manage relationships.
- Knowledge of insurance products and market trends.
- Ability to utilize digital tools and platforms for training and recruitment purposes.

Join Axis Max Life Insurance as an Associate Agency Development Manager and be a key player in shaping the success of our agency teams while helping individuals achieve their professional aspirations in the insurance sector.

Description:
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance
Job Title: Associate Agency Development Manager


The Associate Agency Development Manager will play a pivotal role in driving the growth of the business through the recruitment, training, and development of a strong agency force. The incumbent will be responsible for managing a team of insurance advisors, ensuring they are well-equipped to meet their sales targets while adhering to compliance standards. This position demands a proactive approach to building relationships, motivating the team, and developing strategies to enhance productivity and performance.

Key Responsibilities:
- Recruit, select, and develop a team of insurance agents to achieve sales targets.
- Provide ongoing training and support to insurance advisors to enhance their skills and product knowledge.
- Monitor team performance and implement strategies for improvement.
- Build and maintain strong customer relationships to drive business growth.
- Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
- Collaborate with senior management to develop and execute effective sales strategies.
- Prepare reports on sales performance and team activities.

Skills and Qualifications:
- Strong sales and negotiation skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to motivate and lead a team effectively.
- Proficient in establishing and maintaining relationships with clients and team members.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
- Familiarity with insurance products and regulatory standards is an advantage.

Tools and Technologies Required:
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Knowledge of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software.
- Familiarity with insurance industry software and digital tools.
- Experience with data analysis tools for tracking performance metrics.
- Strong understanding of digital communication platforms for team engagement.

This role is ideal for individuals looking to build a rewarding career in insurance and agency development while contributing to the success of Axis Max Life Insurance.
